### `battle-lab/kernel/validate.ts`

```ts
// kernel/validate.ts — 运行期规则校验：违反已确证规则的阵容直接拒绝，不静默跑
import { guessingHasOnmyoji, RuleIndex } from "./evidence.ts";
import type { Team } from "./team.ts";

export class RuleViolation extends Error {
  ruleId: string;
  constructor(ruleId: string, message: string) { super(message); this.name = "RuleViolation"; this.ruleId = ruleId; }
}

/**
 * 按已确证规则校验对局配置。
 * 目前只有一条：对弈竞猜不含阴阳师。
 */
export function validateGuessingLineups(teams: Team[], opts: { enforce?: boolean } = {}): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (guessingHasOnmyoji()) return problems;
  for (const t of teams) {
    for (const e of t.members) {
      if (e.type === "ONMYOJI") {
        problems.push(`队伍 ${t.name} 含阴阳师「${e.name}」，但规则 ${"GUESSING_NO_ONMYOJI"} 规定对弈竞猜不含阴阳师`);
      }
    }
  }
  if (problems.length && opts.enforce !== false) {
    const rule = RuleIndex.get("GUESSING_NO_ONMYOJI")!;
    throw new RuleViolation("GUESSING_NO_ONMYOJI",
      "违反已确证规则（来源 " + rule.source + "）：\n  " + problems.join("\n  ") +
      "\n  出处：" + rule.origin);
  }
  return problems;
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/effect-system.ts`

```ts
// soul/effect-system.ts — M1.5C SoulEffectSystem：把御魂战斗效果接入 Event Kernel
// 原则同全项目：**绝不静默丢弃**。
//   - 能解释的数值型效果 -> 注册成真实 handler
//   - 解释不了的        -> 仍然注册 handler，但标记 UNSUPPORTED 并计数，供报告
import { EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { DISPATCHED_EV_CODES } from "../compile/passive-runtime.ts";
import { GameMath } from "../kernel/gamemath.ts";
import { compileSoulEffect, type SoulEffectIR } from "./effects.ts";
import type { SoulEffectRef } from "./stat-source.ts";
import type { SoulDef } from "./loadout.ts";

/** 触发时机 -> EventBus code */
const TRIGGER_TO_EVENT: Record<string, string> = {
  TURN_END: EV.TURN_END,
  TURN_START: EV.TURN_START,
  ON_DEAL_DAMAGE: EV.AFTER_DAMAGE,
  ON_TAKE_DAMAGE: EV.AFTER_DAMAGE,
  ON_ATTACK: EV.BEFORE_DAMAGE,
  ON_TAKE_ATTACK: EV.BEFORE_DAMAGE,
  BATTLE_START: EV.BATTLE_START,
  ON_SKILL: EV.SKILL_END,
  ON_ACTION: EV.ACTION_END,
  ON_DEATH: EV.DEATH,
  // ★ 引擎**没有**暴击事件（EV 里根本没有 CRI）：这里刻意保留一个不存在的 code，
  //   好让「暴击时」类御魂（针女/地藏像）永远不会触发。
  //   用 as any 而不是新增 EV.CRI —— 后者会让「其实没有这个事件」这件事从类型上消失。
  //
  // ★★★ 第 90 轮更正上面那句旧注释：它原本还写着「并由 interpretEffect **如实降级为 UNSUPPORTED**」——
  //   实测这句**不总成立**：地藏像 的 interpretEffect 返回的是 **SHIELD**，
  //   于是它被报成「已安装、挂在 CRI 上」的护盾效果，而 CRI **永远不会被派发**
  //   ⇒ **一个静默的死处理器**（针女同样是 CRI，但它确实被判成 UNSUPPORTED，所以只有地藏像漏了）。
  //   ⇒ 光靠"意图 + 一句注释"守不住这件事，补一道**结构性**判据（见下面的 deadCode）：
  //     `code` 不在「真的有人派发」的集合里，就不算已安装。
  ON_CRIT: (EV as any).CRI ?? "CRI",
  ON_KILLED: EV.KILLED,
};

export interface InstalledEffect {
  soulId: number; name: string; trigger: string | null; code: string | null;
  kind: "DAMAGE_RAMP" | "ORB_START" | "ORB_TURN_START" | "HEALING" | "SHIELD" | "STATIC_BUFF" | "UNSUPPORTED";
  params: Record<string, number>;
  note: string;
}

export interface InstallReport {
  installed: InstalledEffect[];
  unsupported: number;
  /** 累计触发次数（供测试与报告） */
  fireCount: Record<string, number>;
}

/**
 * 解析文案为可执行效果。**只认明确能解释的句式**，其余标 UNSUPPORTED。
 */
export function interpretEffect(ir: SoulEffectIR): { kind: InstalledEffect["kind"]; params: Record<string, number>; note: string } {
  const d = ir.desc;
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 93 轮：**这条降级必须排在最前面** —— 它以前排在最后，于是被前面的句式匹配抢先命中。
   *
   * 事实：地藏像的文案是「受到暴击时，自身100%、友方30%概率获得1回合护盾，能吸收10%生命上限的伤害」，
   * 而「护盾…」那条正则先一步匹配成功 ⇒ 它返回 SHIELD，**永远走不到下面那句 ON_CRIT 降级**。
   *
   * 后果不是"少算"，而是**两处口径互相矛盾**：`installSoulEffects` 有自己的 deadCode 判据
   * （挂在不派发的事件上 ⇒ UNSUPPORTED，第 90 轮加的），它照旧把地藏像报成 UNSUPPORTED；
   * 而网页索引走 interpretEffect，把同一件御魂报成 **FULL**。
   * 一条数据源、两种结论 —— 这正是本项目反复出现的那一类缺口，只是这次分裂在**判读与安装之间**。
   *
   * 发现方式：重建网页索引（`tools/build-kb-index.mjs`）之后，FULL 从 6 变成 7，
   * 而 g31/ui1/ui6 三条断言同时变红 —— 断言把"文件是旧的"和"生成器错了"这两种可能分开了。
   * 判据（tests/g31 第 [7] 节，双向）：同一段护盾文案，trigger=ON_CRIT ⇒ 必须 UNSUPPORTED；
   * trigger=ON_DEAL_DAMAGE ⇒ 必须是 SHIELD。**区别在触发时机能不能派发，不在文案。**
   */
  if (ir.trigger === "ON_CRIT") {
    return { kind: "UNSUPPORTED", params: {}, note: "「暴击时」触发：引擎没有暴击事件，该效果永远不会触发（针女 / 地藏像）" };
  }
  // 永久/持续增伤，含上限：如 无刀取 "永久提升15%的伤害，最高不超过45%"
  // ★ 火灵：「战斗开始时，获得3点鬼火」—— 对弈竞猜里的核心御魂之一，
  //   在此之前它落进 UNSUPPORTED，等于开局白送对手 3 点鬼火的差距根本不存在。
  const orbStart = d.match(/战斗开始时[，,]?\s*获得\s*(\d+)\s*点鬼火/);
  if (orbStart) return { kind: "ORB_START", params: { orbs: parseFloat(orbStart[1]) }, note: "战斗开始时为己方增加鬼火" };
  /**
   * ★ 招财猫：「回合开始时，有50%的概率获得2点鬼火。」
   *   竞猜里最常见的鬼火引擎之一，直接决定对局节奏。
   *   与火灵的差别：火灵是**必定**、战斗开始时；招财猫是**概率**、回合开始时。
   *   概率与点数都写在文案里，不依赖红区 —— 所以它可以实现。
   */
  const orbTurnStart = d.match(/回合开始时[，,]?\s*有\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*的?概率获得\s*(\d+)\s*点鬼火/);
  if (orbTurnStart) return { kind: "ORB_TURN_START", params: { chance: parseFloat(orbTurnStart[1]) / 100, orbs: parseFloat(orbTurnStart[2]) }, note: "持有者回合开始时按文案概率获得鬼火" };
  const ramp = d.match(/永久提升\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*的伤害[，,]?\s*最高不超过\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/);
  if (ramp) return { kind: "DAMAGE_RAMP", params: { perTurn: parseFloat(ramp[1]) / 100, cap: parseFloat(ramp[2]) / 100 }, note: "回合结束后累加增伤，封顶" };
  const flatRamp = d.match(/永久提升\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*的伤害/);
  if (flatRamp) return { kind: "DAMAGE_RAMP", params: { perTurn: parseFloat(flatRamp[1]) / 100, cap: 1 }, note: "回合结束后累加增伤，无明确上限" };
  const heal = d.match(/(?:恢复|治疗)[^。]{0,20}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/);
  if (heal) return { kind: "HEALING", params: { ratio: parseFloat(heal[1]) / 100 }, note: "按描述触发治疗" };
  const shield = d.match(/护盾[^。]{0,24}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/);
  if (shield) return { kind: "SHIELD", params: { ratio: parseFloat(shield[1]) / 100 }, note: "按描述生成护盾" };
  // ★ 「暴击时」的降级已**移到函数最前面**（第 93 轮），原因见那里的注释：
  //   放在这里会被上面的「护盾…」正则抢先命中，于是地藏像被判成 SHIELD/FULL。
  //   事实不变：kernel/types.ts 的 EV 里没有 CRI/CRIT，ON_CRIT 映射到的 code 永远不存在，
  //   这两件御魂（针女、地藏像）的 4 件套战斗效果**一次都不会触发**。
  //   真正修好需要给 Battle 加暴击事件钩子，属于引擎功能，不在本轮范围。
  return { kind: "UNSUPPORTED", params: {}, note: "文案未匹配到可执行句式 —— 已登记但不参与计算" };
}

/**
 * 把御魂战斗效果装入 Battle。
 * 注意：这里**只碰战斗效果**，绝不改面板（竞猜模式下由 assertNoStaticDoubleCount 保证）。
 */
export function installSoulEffects(battle: any, refs: SoulEffectRef[], defs: Map<number, SoulDef>): InstallReport {
  const report: InstallReport = { installed: [], unsupported: 0, fireCount: {} };
  /**
   * ★★ 第 42 轮修：按 soulId **去重**。
   *
   * refs 是「每个穿戴单位一条」的扁平列表（10 只都穿同一件 → 10 条），
   * 而下面那个内层循环本身就会遍历**所有**穿戴单位。两者相乘 = N² 次注册：
   * 10 只都穿招财猫时，装配后 TURN_START 订阅者是 100（每只 10 个重复 handler），
   * 每个回合开始触发 10 次 —— 概率效果的期望被放大 10 倍。
   * 更糟的是这些重复 handler 的 id 完全相同（`${owner.id}:SOUL${soulId}:${code}`），
   * bus 的注册序号表被反复覆盖，排序信息也一并失真。
   *
   * 这个 bug 一直没被发现，是因为此前**所有** soul 测试都只给一个单位穿御魂
   * （refs.length === 1 时 N² === N，看不出差别）。招财猫是第一个「全队都穿」的用例。
   *
   * 去重后 installed 的含义也收紧了：从「ref 条数」变成「**本局有几种御魂战斗效果**」。
   */
  const seenSoul = new Set<number>();
  for (const ref of refs) {
    if (seenSoul.has(ref.soulId)) continue;
    seenSoul.add(ref.soulId);
    const def = defs.get(ref.soulId);
    if (!def) continue;
    const ir = compileSoulEffect(def);
    const code = ir.trigger ? TRIGGER_TO_EVENT[ir.trigger] ?? null : null;
    const { kind, params, note } = interpretEffect(ir);
    /**
     * ★★★ 第 90 轮：**挂在"永远不会被派发"的事件上的效果，不能算已安装。**
     *
     * 判据不是新造的：`DISPATCHED_EV_CODES` 是第 74 轮为被动运行时建的声明表，
     * 由 tests/g42 用生产者扫描**双向盯着**（少了红、多了也红）。
     * 这里复用它 —— 一处事实，两处消费。
     *
     * 实测抓到的那一条：地藏像（trigger=ON_CRIT → code=CRI，而 interpretEffect 给的是 SHIELD）。
     * 它此前被报成"已安装的护盾"，可 CRI 根本没有派发点 ⇒ handler 永远不会被调用。
     */
    const deadCode = !!code && !DISPATCHED_EV_CODES.has(code);
    const installed: InstalledEffect = {
      soulId: ref.soulId, name: ref.name, trigger: ir.trigger, code,
      kind: deadCode ? "UNSUPPORTED" : kind, params,
      note: deadCode
        ? "挂在事件 " + code + " 上，而该事件**没有派发点**（DISPATCHED_EV_CODES 里没有它）⇒ 处理器永远不会被调用。原判读：" + note
        : note,
    };
    report.installed.push(installed);
    if (kind === "UNSUPPORTED" || !code || deadCode) { report.unsupported++; }

    // 即便是 UNSUPPORTED 也注册 handler —— 保证"事件确实发生了"被记录，而不是当它不存在
    for (const team of battle.teams) {
      for (const e of team.members) {
        const owner = e;
        if (owner.notes.every((n: string) => !n.includes(ref.name))) continue;   // 只挂给带该御魂的单位
        /**
         * ★★★ 第 132 轮：**层数从实体身上已有的 Modifier 反推**，不再从 0 开始。
         *
         * 这个计数是**闭包状态**，不进 BattleState ⇒ 存档/续跑之后会从 0 重新叠——
         * 无刀取（每回合 +15%、上限 45%）最多再叠 3 层，"永久提升"变成了"续跑后又能涨一轮"。
         * 判据用它**自己写下去的那条 source**（\`soul<id>:stack<n>\`）：那本来就是"带来源、可整批回收"
         * 的来源标记，所以反推不需要新字段、也不会与别的 modifier 混淆。
         */
        let stacks = owner.effects.filter((x: any) => typeof x.source === "string" && x.source.startsWith("soul" + ref.soulId + ":stack")).length;
        // 层数上限 = 封顶 / 每层；这是**游戏规则决定的取整点**（不足一层即封顶），
        // 必须走 GameMath 而不是裸 Math.floor，以便日后统一替换取整模型。
        const maxStacks = kind === "DAMAGE_RAMP" && params.perTurn
          ? Math.max(1, GameMath.floorAt((params.cap ?? 1) / params.perTurn, "soul:DAMAGE_RAMP:maxStacks"))
          : 0;
        battle.bus.register({
          id: `${owner.id}:SOUL${ref.soulId}:${code ?? "NOCODE"}`,
          ownerId: owner.id,
          code: code ?? EV.TURN_END,
          range: "SELF",
          priority: 20,
          passive: false,
          source: "SOUL",   // ★ 第 96 轮：封印（御魂失效）按这个标记挡
          fn: (ctx: any) => {
            const key = `${ref.name}:${ir.trigger}`;
            report.fireCount[key] = (report.fireCount[key] ?? 0) + 1;
            // 叠层必须封顶：无刀取 每回合+15%、上限45% -> 最多 3 层，第 4 次起不再增加
            if (kind === "DAMAGE_RAMP" && stacks < maxStacks) {
              stacks++;
              // ★ 走 Modifier API：带来源、可审计、可按来源整批回收（a1-4 §7）
              // ★★ 第 43 轮修：这里原先是 dmgTakenB —— 那是**受击方**的字段，而且方向相反：
                //   无刀取的文案是「永久提升15%的伤害」，写进受击字段的结果是
                //   「携带者多挨最多 45% 伤害」。现在写源侧字段 dmgDealtB。
                owner.addModifier({ prop: "dmgDealtB", value: params.perTurn, mode: "FIXED", source: `soul${ref.soulId}:stack${stacks}` });
            }
            // ★ 火灵：开局 3 点鬼火。真改数值，不只是"登记过"。
            if (kind === "ORB_START") {
              const orbs = battle.teams[owner.teamId].orbs;
              const before = orbs.current;
              orbs.gain(params.orbs);
              /** ★ 第 120 轮：御魂路径的鬼火获得也进总线（与技能路径同一个事件码） */
              battle.queueEvent(EV.ORB_GAIN, { battle, team: owner.teamId, src: owner.id, skill: ref.name + "（4件套）" }, owner.id, owner.teamId);
              battle.trace.push({
                t: "ORB_GAIN", team: owner.teamId, src: owner.id, skill: ref.name + "（4件套）",
                requested: params.orbs, before, after: orbs.current, overflow: Math.max(0, before + params.orbs - orbs.current),
              });
            }
            /**
             * ★ 招财猫：持有者**回合开始时**按概率获得鬼火。
             *
             * 作用范围沿用既有约定（TURN_START 以 selfId = 行动者派发 + handler range = SELF）
             * → 只有「持有者自己的回合开始」才触发，与无刀取的 TURN_END 是同一条约定。
             * 这个读法**未实测**（属于 B 组候选），但它不是这一轮新猜的：引擎里回合触发类御魂一直这么做。
             * g32 有一条断言把这个语义钉死：触发机会数 ≈ 回合数，**不是** 10 × 回合数 ——
             * 若哪天改成「任意回合开始都给全场持有者触发」，那条断言会立刻红。
             *
             * 概率必须走 RNG 且带用途标签（a1-4 §20：每一次抽数都要能说清为什么抽）。
             */
            if (kind === "ORB_TURN_START" && ir.trigger === "TURN_START") {
              const tag = "soul:" + ref.name + ":turnStart";
              battle.rng.expect(tag);
              const hit = battle.rng.testHit(params.chance);
              const orbs = battle.teams[owner.teamId].orbs;
              if (hit) {
                const before = orbs.current;
                orbs.gain(params.orbs);
              /** ★ 第 120 轮：御魂路径的鬼火获得也进总线（与技能路径同一个事件码） */
              battle.queueEvent(EV.ORB_GAIN, { battle, team: owner.teamId, src: owner.id, skill: ref.name + "（4件套）" }, owner.id, owner.teamId);
                battle.trace.push({
                  t: "ORB_GAIN", team: owner.teamId, src: owner.id, skill: ref.name + "（4件套）",
                  requested: params.orbs, before, after: orbs.current,
                  overflow: Math.max(0, before + params.orbs - orbs.current),
                  probability: params.chance, roll: tag,
                });
              } else {
                // 没中也要留痕 —— 否则「50%」无法被验证，只看得见中的那些
                battle.trace.push({ t: "ORB_SOUL_MISS", team: owner.teamId, src: owner.id, skill: ref.name + "（4件套）", probability: params.chance, roll: tag });
              }
            }
            // ★ 蚌精：战斗开始时友方全体获得护盾（吸收生命上限 N%）
            if (kind === "SHIELD" && ir.trigger === "BATTLE_START") {
              for (const m of battle.teams[owner.teamId].aliveMembers()) {
                const value = m.maxHp * params.ratio;
                // ★ 同上：走内核唯一入口。id 由 addShield 生成（确定性），
                //   旧写法 `sh_soul<soulId>_<m.id>` 在同一个单位第二次拿到盾时会**撞 id**。
                m.addShield({ value, sourceId: owner.id, dispellable: false, tag: "soul" + ref.soulId });
                battle.trace.push({ t: "SHIELD_APPLY", src: owner.id, dst: m.id, value: GameMath.display(value), skill: ref.name + "（4件套）" });
              }
            }
          },
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return report;
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/effects.ts`

```ts
// soul/effects.ts — M1.5C SoulEffectSystem：御魂的**战斗效果**（与静态属性完全分离）
// 数据：data/kb/soul.json 的 desc 字段（4件套战斗触发文案）
import type { SoulEffectRef } from "./stat-source.ts";
import type { SoulDef } from "./loadout.ts";

export interface SoulEffectIR {
  soulId: number; name: string;
  desc: string;
  /** 触发时机（从文案推断；推断不出则为 null，不猜） */
  trigger: string | null;
  /** 数值参数，例如 "永久提升15%的伤害，最高不超过45%" -> [15, 45] */
  magnitudes: number[];
  confidence: "HIGH" | "LOW";
  unparsed: string[];
}

const TRIGGER_PATTERNS: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/回合结束后/, "TURN_END"],
  [/回合开始时/, "TURN_START"],
  [/造成伤害时/, "ON_DEAL_DAMAGE"],
  [/受到伤害时/, "ON_TAKE_DAMAGE"],
  [/受到攻击时/, "ON_TAKE_ATTACK"],
  [/攻击时/, "ON_ATTACK"],
  [/战斗开始时/, "BATTLE_START"],
  [/施放技能(?:时|后)/, "ON_SKILL"],
  [/行动(?:时|后)/, "ON_ACTION"],
  [/阵亡时/, "ON_DEATH"],
  [/暴击时/, "ON_CRIT"],
  [/被击败时/, "ON_KILLED"],
];

export function compileSoulEffect(def: SoulDef): SoulEffectIR {
  const desc = String(def.desc ?? "");
  let trigger: string | null = null;
  for (const [re, t] of TRIGGER_PATTERNS) if (re.test(desc)) { trigger = t; break; }
  const mags = [...desc.matchAll(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%/g)].map(m => parseFloat(m[1]));
  const unparsed: string[] = [];
  if (!trigger && desc) unparsed.push("未能识别触发时机");
  return {
    soulId: def.id, name: def.name, desc,
    trigger, magnitudes: mags,
    confidence: trigger ? "HIGH" : "LOW",
    unparsed,
  };
}

export function compileSoulBook(souls: SoulDef[]): Map<number, SoulEffectIR> {
  return new Map(souls.map(s => [Number(s.id), compileSoulEffect(s)]));
}

/**
 * 竞猜模式：只取**战斗效果**，绝不返回静态面板贡献。
 * 返回的 refs 用于注册事件 handler；静态属性一律不碰。
 */
export function battleEffectsOf(soulIds: number[], book: Map<number, SoulEffectIR>, defs: Map<number, SoulDef>): SoulEffectRef[] {
  const counts = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const id of soulIds) counts.set(id, (counts.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
  const out: SoulEffectRef[] = [];
  for (const [id, n] of counts) {
    if (n < 4) continue;                        // 只有 4 件套才是战斗效果
    const def = defs.get(id); const ir = book.get(id);
    if (!def) continue;
    out.push({ soulId: id, name: def.name, pieces: n, desc: ir?.desc ?? def.desc });
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/guessing-factory.ts`

```ts
// soul/guessing-factory.ts — M1.5A GuessingEntityFactory
// 竞猜路径：截图八维即权威输入。**不跑装备面板生成器。**
import { Entity, EntityType } from "../kernel/entity.ts";
import { makeExact, toDisplay, observe, bindExact } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import type { ExactStats, DisplayStats, ObservedStats } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import { StatSource, EntityMode, judgeLegality, assertNoStaticDoubleCount } from "./stat-source.ts";
import type { StatResolution } from "./stat-source.ts";
import { battleEffectsOf, compileSoulBook } from "./effects.ts";
import type { SoulDef } from "./loadout.ts";

export interface GuessingShikigamiInput {
  shikigamiId: number;
  /** 截图八维（整数 / 百分数） */
  observed: Partial<DisplayStats>;
  /** 御魂图标 -> 御魂 id 列表（用于组成 4 件套；静态属性一律不用） */
  soulIds?: number[];
}

export interface GuessingFactoryDeps {
  soulDefs: Map<number, SoulDef>;
  charMeta: Map<number, { name: string; type?: string }>;
}

export interface GuessingBuildResult {
  entity: Entity;
  resolution: StatResolution;
  observed: ObservedStats;
  /** 截图值 -> 可行区间（未坍缩为整数） */
  feasible: Array<{ key: string; displayed: number; range: [number, number] }>;
}

/** 竞猜口径：显示值 -> 可行区间中值作为初始精确值（保留区间不做坍缩） */
function exactFromGuessing(observed: Partial<DisplayStats>): ExactStats {
  const obs = observe(observed);
  const mid: any = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(obs) as Array<keyof typeof obs>) {
    const o = obs[k];
    const isPct = k === "cri" || k === "crid" || k === "efh" || k === "efr";
    // 点估计直接取**显示值本身**：ROUND 口径下它正是取整区间的中心，
    // 且不会引入 (lo+hi)/2 那种 149.9999999995 的浮点毛刺。
    // 区间仍然完整保留在 feasible 里，供后续边缘化使用。
    mid[k] = isPct ? o.displayed / 100 : o.displayed;
  }
  return makeExact(mid);
}

export function makeGuessingEntity(
  id: number, teamId: number, input: GuessingShikigamiInput, deps: GuessingFactoryDeps,
): GuessingBuildResult {
  const meta = deps.charMeta.get(input.shikigamiId);
  const exact = exactFromGuessing(input.observed);
  const obs = observe(input.observed);
  const { ok, mismatches } = bindExact(obs, exact);

  const soulIds = input.soulIds ?? [];
  const defs = deps.soulDefs;
  const effectBook = compileSoulBook([...defs.values()]);
  const battleEffects = battleEffectsOf(soulIds, effectBook, defs);

  const resolution: StatResolution = {
    mode: EntityMode.GUESSING,
    source: StatSource.AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE,
    exact,
    soulStaticApplied: false,          // ★ 竞猜绝不叠加御魂静态属性
    soulBattleEffects: battleEffects,
    legality: judgeLegality(EntityMode.GUESSING, { explainableByEquipment: null }),
    notes: [
      "面板来源 = AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE（截图即真值）",
      "御魂静态属性未应用（避免重复计算）",
      battleEffects.length ? `已加载 ${battleEffects.length} 条御魂战斗效果` : "无 4 件套战斗效果",
    ],
  };
  assertNoStaticDoubleCount(resolution);

  const e = new Entity(id, meta?.name ?? `shikigami#${input.shikigamiId}`, teamId, {
    atk: exact.atk, hp: exact.hp, def: exact.def, spd: exact.spd,
    cri: exact.cri, crid: exact.crid, efh: exact.efh, efr: exact.efr,
    dmgTakenB: 0, dmgTakenD: 0, healDown: 0,
  });
  if (meta?.type === "ONMYOJI") e.type = EntityType.ONMYOJI;
  e.notes.push("mode=GUESSING source=AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE");
  e.notes.push("soulStatic=NOT_APPLIED battleEffects=" + battleEffects.map(b => b.name).join("/"));

  const feasible = Object.entries(obs).map(([k, o]: any) => ({ key: k, displayed: o.displayed, range: o.feasibleRange }));
  // 不做静默坍缩：把截图校验结果也记下来
  if (!ok) e.notes.push("display-mismatch:" + mismatches.join("; "));

  return { entity: e, resolution, observed: obs, feasible };
}

/** 竞猜单位面板自检：观察值 -> 精确 -> 回显，必须与原截图逐项一致 */
export function verifyGuessingPanel(r: GuessingBuildResult): { ok: boolean; detail: string[] } {
  const disp = toDisplay(r.resolution.exact);
  const detail: string[] = [];
  const dispIdx = disp as unknown as Record<string, number>;
  for (const [k, o] of Object.entries(r.observed) as any) {
    if (Math.abs(dispIdx[k] - (o as any).displayed) > 0.500001) detail.push(`${k}: ${dispIdx[k]} vs 截图 ${(o as any).displayed}`);
  }
  return { ok: detail.length === 0, detail };
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/guessing-match.ts`

```ts
// soul/guessing-match.ts — 竞猜对局装配：截图八维（权威）+ KB 技能/AI（自动 Join）→ 完整 Battle
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import type { TraceLevel } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets, LifestealPolicies, ImmunePolicies } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { loadCharacter, selectSkillByAI } from "../compile/load.ts";
import { makeGuessingEntity, verifyGuessingPanel } from "./guessing-factory.ts";
import type { GuessingBuildResult } from "./guessing-factory.ts";
import { compileSoulBook } from "./effects.ts";
// ★★★ 第 93/133 轮：**订阅的唯一安装点**（御魂 + 被动 + 替友方拦死）—— 见下面的注释。
import { installSubscribers } from "../compile/subscribers.ts";
import { loadTips } from "../compile/tips.ts";
// ★★★ 第 186 轮：名字形态的状态引用（正文写「雄姿英发」而不是 [buff_x]）—— node 侧也要把表设上
import { loadBuffNames, setBuffNames } from "../compile/buff-names.ts";
import type { SoulDef } from "./loadout.ts";

const KB = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "data", "kb");

export interface MatchEntry {
  name: string; shikigamiId: number; rarity?: string;
  stats: { atk: number; hp: number; def: number; spd: number; cri: number; crid: number; efh: number; efr: number };
  soulIds?: number[] | null;
}
export interface MatchFixture { _meta: any; blue: MatchEntry[]; red: MatchEntry[] }

export interface AssembledMatch {
  battle: Battle;
  red: GuessingBuildResult[];
  blue: GuessingBuildResult[];
  /** 装配期发现的问题（不抛，集中报告） */
  issues: string[];
  /** 显示层同速（潜在精度陷阱） */
  displayTies: Array<{ spd: number; members: string[] }>;
}

export async function loadSoulDefs(): Promise<Map<number, SoulDef>> {
  const souls: SoulDef[] = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(KB, "soul.json"), "utf8"));
  return new Map(souls.map(s => [Number(s.id), s]));
}

export async function assembleGuessingMatch(
  fixture: MatchFixture,
  /**
   * ★ policies 是可覆盖的（第 31 轮补）。
   *   此前这里把四个红区的候选**写死**在函数体里，于是 runner/policy-sweep.ts 传进来的候选
   *   被静默忽略 —— 8 个组合跑出完全相同的胜率，看起来像"结论对候选不敏感"，
   *   实际上**什么都没测**。这正是本项目反复出现的那一类缺口：数据齐、参数齐、没人用。
   */
  opts: { seed: number; maxTurns?: number; policies?: Record<string, unknown>; traceLevel?: TraceLevel } = { seed: 1 },
): Promise<AssembledMatch> {
  const soulDefs = await loadSoulDefs();
  const issues: string[] = [];
  const results: Record<string, GuessingBuildResult[]> = { red: [], blue: [] };
  const teams: Record<string, Team> = {};

  for (const side of ["red", "blue"] as const) {
    const teamId = side === "red" ? 0 : 1;
    const team = new Team(teamId, side.toUpperCase(), ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345, 1);
    let entId = (teamId + 1) * 100;
    for (const entry of fixture[side]) {
      // 1) KB 侧：技能 / AI / 元数据（不需要随输入提供）
      const lc = await loadCharacter(entry.shikigamiId, teamId, ++entId, {});
      // 2) 竞猜侧：权威面板（覆盖 KB 的面板）
      const built = makeGuessingEntity(entId, teamId, {
        shikigamiId: entry.shikigamiId,
        observed: entry.stats,
        soulIds: entry.soulIds ?? [],
      }, { soulDefs, charMeta: new Map([[entry.shikigamiId, { name: entry.name }]]) });

      /**
       * ★★★ 第 133 轮：**把御魂 id 记到实体上**（这条路径此前漏了）。
       *   网页装配路径一直写着这一句（apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts：
       *   "图标 = 该 4 件套生效 ⇒ 实体侧也记 4 份，只记 1 份会让任何按'满 4 件'判断的路径静默失效"），
       *   而这条 Node 侧参考路径**从来没写过** —— 于是：
       *     · `battleEffectsOf(entity.soulIds, …)` 读到空数组 ⇒ 御魂订阅一条都装不上（第 133 轮实测）；
       *     · 而 resolution 里的 soulBattleEffects **是有值的**（探针 tools/_probe-node-soul133-evidence.ts）：
       *       账面说"无刀取已加载"，事件总线上一个处理器都没有 —— 正是第 70 轮在网页路径上抓到过的同一个形态。
       */
      built.entity.soulIds = (entry.soulIds ?? []).slice();
      // 3) 合并：权威面板 + 真实技能 + 真实 AI
      built.entity.skills = lc.entity.skills;
      built.entity.notes.push(`kb-skills=${lc.ir.length} ai=${lc.ai.confidence}`);
      if (!lc.ir.length) issues.push(`${entry.name} 无技能数据`);
      if (lc.ai.confidence === "LOW") issues.push(`${entry.name} AI 置信度 LOW`);
      const v = verifyGuessingPanel(built);
      if (!v.ok) issues.push(`${entry.name} 面板回显不一致: ${v.detail.join("; ")}`);

      team.add(built.entity);
      results[side].push(built);
    }
    teams[side] = team;
  }

  const battle = new Battle([teams.red, teams.blue], {
    seed: opts.seed,
    /**
     * ★★★ 第 192 轮：这条路径的档位**显式声明 NONE**（a1-4 §35：Monte Carlo 用 NONE）。
     *   它此前靠 Battle 的默认档 —— 而默认档刚刚从 SUMMARY 改成 FULL（观测默认完整）。
     *   批量跑十万局时整条事件流是纯浪费：这里一个读 trace 的地方都没有（grep 过：.trace 0 处），
     *   统计量由 stats / turnLog 提供。要事件流的调用方（runner/diff-cli.ts）自己传 FULL。
     */
    traceLevel: opts.traceLevel ?? "NONE",
    rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: opts.maxTurns ?? 300 },
    policies: {
      resource: ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345,
      startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
      death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION,
      priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
      tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM",
      guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED,
      // ★★ 第 93/94 轮：两条新红区（吸血口径 / 免疫口径）—— 两条装配路径必须给同一套默认值，
      //   否则同一场对局在 CLI 与网页上会用不同的口径（第 93 轮刚踩过"两条路径装的东西不一样"）。
      lifesteal: LifestealPolicies.APPLIED_AS_HEAL,
      immune: ImmunePolicies.DEBUFF_COVERS_CONTROL,
      ...(opts.policies ?? {}),   // 扫描等场景显式覆盖；默认行为一字不变
    },
  });
  battle.skillSelector = (b, a, e) => selectSkillByAI(b, a, e);

  /**
   * ★★★ 第 93 轮：**被动运行时此前只装在网页那条装配路径上。**
   *
   * 这条路径（CLI / monte-carlo 基线 / policy-sweep）从来没有调用过 installPassiveSkills ——
   * 于是 `policies.passives` 在这里**只是一句声明**：把它设成 PARSED_ONLY 也一个处理器都不会注册。
   * 发现方式不是读代码，而是**两个本该校验差别的数字完全相同**：
   * 接线吸血后我量"被动开/关"对典型对局胜率的影响，N=1000 两次都是 634/366、连 CI 都一样 ——
   * 单场指纹明明不同（当时 ON c47af66446febdb8 / OFF 2d7c7507e18db61f —— ★ 第 132 轮把"后加的五个红区策略"
   * 入档之后，打开被动的那一侧变成 ba4f8137c904d909：状态里多了一个**必须有的键**，不是漂移），1000 个 seed 却一模一样，
   * 那只有一个解释：这条路径上那个开关**根本没接**。
   *
   * ⇒ 两条装配路径必须装同一套运行时。默认 OFF ⇒ 这里注册 0 个处理器，**默认路径逐位不变**；
   *   显式打开时才与网页路径行为一致（判据：tests/g54 第 [7] 节 + 基线重测）。
   */
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 133 轮：**改为与网页路径同一处安装**（compile/subscribers.ts）。
   *
   * 第 93 轮把被动补到这条路径上时，御魂与"替友方拦死"**还没接线**；等到它们接线之后，
   * 这条路径又落后了两样 —— 而 ui2 那条"Node vs Web 逐局一致"的对照**测不出来**：
   * 典型夹具里没有御魂、被动默认又是关的（两个本该校验差别的数字完全相同，又是第 93 轮那个形态）。
   * ⇒ 现在两条路径都调同一个 installSubscribers，顺序也由它定（tests/g87 逐项比对订阅集合与终局结果）。
   */
  const tipsMap = loadTips(JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(KB, "tips.json"), "utf8")));
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 186 轮：**两条路径的表要一致**（这条是 node 生产路径）。
   *   名字形态的状态引用要用「名字 → id」表；浏览器侧由 EngineBundle 注入、这里读知识库 —— 读的是同一份数据。
   *   ★ 不设置就是空表 ⇒ 名字形态不解析（fail-closed），而两条路径的产物会不一样 —— 那正是本仓库要防的漂移。
   */
  setBuffNames(loadBuffNames(JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(KB, "buffs.json"), "utf8"))));
  const subReport = installSubscribers(battle as any, { soulBook: compileSoulBook([...soulDefs.values()]), soulDefs, tipsMap });
  (battle as any).passiveReport = subReport.passive;
  (battle as any).soulReport = subReport.soul;
  (battle as any).allyGuardReport = subReport.allyGuard;

  // 显示层同速检测（潜在精度陷阱）
  const bySpd = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const side of ["red", "blue"] as const) for (const s of fixture[side]) {
    if (!bySpd.has(s.stats.spd)) bySpd.set(s.stats.spd, []);
    bySpd.get(s.stats.spd)!.push(`${side === "red" ? "红" : "蓝"}·${s.name}`);
  }
  const displayTies = [...bySpd.entries()].filter(([, v]) => v.length > 1).map(([spd, v]) => ({ spd, members: v }));

  return { battle, red: results.red, blue: results.blue, issues, displayTies };
}

export function loadMatchFixture(p: string): Promise<MatchFixture> {
  return fs.readFile(p, "utf8").then(t => JSON.parse(t));
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/loadout.ts`

```ts
// soul/loadout.ts — 御魂六件套数据结构 + 2/4 件套统计
import type { Scalar } from "../kernel/gamemath.ts";
// StatKey 定义在 kernel/stats.ts（gamemath 只有 Scalar），原先从这里导入是错的
import type { StatKey, ExactStats } from "../kernel/stats.ts";

export type SoulSlot = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;

export interface SoulStatRoll { type: StatKey; exactValue: Scalar }

export interface SoulPiece {
  soulId: number;
  slot: SoulSlot;
  /** 主属性（1/3/5 固定，2/4/6 可选；值随强化等级） */
  mainStat: SoulStatRoll;
  /** 副属性，最多 4 条 */
  subStats: SoulStatRoll[];
  /** 强化等级，对弈竞猜通常为 15 */
  level: number;
}

export interface SoulLoadout { pieces: SoulPiece[] }

export interface SoulDef { id: number; name: string; suit: string; desc: string; type: number }

/** 解析 2件套文案 -> 属性加成，例如 "攻击加成15%" -> {atk: 0.15}、"暴击15%" -> {cri: 0.15} */
const SUIT_PATTERN: Array<[RegExp, StatKey, "RATE" | "FLAT"]> = [
  [/攻击加成\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "atk", "RATE"],
  [/生命加成\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "hp", "RATE"],
  [/防御加成\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "def", "RATE"],
  [/暴击伤害\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "crid", "RATE"],
  [/暴击\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "cri", "RATE"],
  [/效果命中\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "efh", "RATE"],
  [/效果抵抗\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, "efr", "RATE"],
  [/速度\s*\+?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/, "spd", "FLAT"],
];

export function parseSuitBonus(suitText: string): { rate: Partial<Record<StatKey, Scalar>>; flat: Partial<Record<StatKey, Scalar>>; parsed: boolean } {
  const rate: any = {}, flat: any = {};
  if (!suitText) return { rate, flat, parsed: false };
  let parsed = false;
  for (const [re, key, kind] of SUIT_PATTERN) {
    const m = suitText.match(re);
    if (!m) continue;
    parsed = true;
    const v = parseFloat(m[1]);
    if (kind === "RATE") rate[key] = (rate[key] ?? 0) + v / 100;
    else flat[key] = (flat[key] ?? 0) + v;
  }
  return { rate, flat, parsed };
}

/** 统计每个御魂种类的件数 */
export function countSets(loadout: SoulLoadout, book: Map<number, SoulDef>): Map<number, number> {
  const c = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const p of loadout.pieces) c.set(p.soulId, (c.get(p.soulId) ?? 0) + 1);
  return c;
}

/**
 * 套装加成。规则（社区通说 + 本轮实证的 2 件套部分）：
 *   2 件 -> suit 文案；4 件 -> 战斗触发（属于 SoulEffectSystem，不进面板）
 * 因此本函数只产出**面板加成**。
 */
export function setStatBonus(loadout: SoulLoadout, book: Map<number, SoulDef>) {
  const rate: any = {}, flat: any = {};
  const active: Array<{ soulId: number; name: string; pieces: number; kind: "2SET" | "4SET" }> = [];
  for (const [soulId, n] of countSets(loadout, book)) {
    const def = book.get(soulId);
    if (!def) continue;
    if (n >= 2) {
      const b = parseSuitBonus(def.suit);
      const rateIdx = rate as Record<string, number>, flatIdx = flat as Record<string, number>;
      for (const k of Object.keys(b.rate)) rateIdx[k] = (rateIdx[k] ?? 0) + (b.rate as Record<string, number>)[k];
      for (const k of Object.keys(b.flat)) flatIdx[k] = (flatIdx[k] ?? 0) + (b.flat as Record<string, number>)[k];
      active.push({ soulId, name: def.name, pieces: n, kind: "2SET" });
    }
    if (n >= 4) active.push({ soulId, name: def.name, pieces: n, kind: "4SET" });
  }
  return { rate, flat, active };
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/solver.ts`

```ts
// soul/solver.ts — M1.5B：面板 -> 御魂组合 是 **many-to-one，不可逆**。
// 因此**不提供** inferSoulPieces()（会制造虚假确定性）。
// 只提供 solveCompatibleSoulBuilds()，显式返回 0 / 1 / N / UNDERDETERMINED。
import { setStatBonus } from "./loadout.ts";
import { parseSuitBonus } from "./loadout.ts";
import type { SoulDef, SoulLoadout } from "./loadout.ts";
import { STAT_KEYS } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import type { ExactStats, StatKey } from "../kernel/stats.ts";

export type SolveOutcome =
  | { kind: "NO_SOLUTION"; reason: string; detail: string[] }
  | { kind: "UNIQUE"; build: unknown }
  | { kind: "MULTIPLE"; count: number; sample: unknown[] }
  | { kind: "UNDERDETERMINED"; freeVariables: number; note: string; residual: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> };

/** 面板各属性对基础面板的"必须由装备提供的增量" */
export function residualOverBase(target: ExactStats, base: ExactStats): Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> {
  const out: any = {};
  for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = target[k] - base[k];
  return out;
}

/**
 * 已知信息只有「2件套文案」（数据源可靠）。
 * 主属性/副属性的**数值表未知**，因此：
 *   - 若某属性的 2件套贡献已经**超过**目标增量 -> NO_SOLUTION（可判定）
 *   - 否则 -> UNDERDETERMINED，并给出"必须由主+副属性补足的余量"
 * 绝不返回"MULTIPLE 中的第一个"。
 */
export function solveCompatibleSoulBuilds(
  target: ExactStats, base: ExactStats, loadout: SoulLoadout | null, book: Map<number, SoulDef>,
): SolveOutcome {
  const residual = residualOverBase(target, base);
  const detail: string[] = [];

  if (!loadout || !loadout.pieces.length) {
    return { kind: "UNDERDETERMINED", freeVariables: 6 * 5, note: "未给定御魂搭配，解空间为全部可能组合", residual };
  }

  const s = setStatBonus(loadout, book);
  // 逐属性判定：套装贡献是否已经超过目标增量
  for (const k of STAT_KEYS) {
    const setRate = (s.rate as any)[k] ?? 0;
    const setFlat = (s.flat as any)[k] ?? 0;
    const isMul = k === "atk" || k === "hp" || k === "def";
    const setContribution = isMul ? base[k] * setRate + setFlat : setRate + setFlat;
    const need = residual[k] ?? 0;
    if (setContribution > need + 1e-6) {
      detail.push(`${k}: 套装已提供 ${setContribution.toFixed(2)}，但目标仅比基础高 ${need.toFixed(2)} —— 超出`);
    }
  }
  if (detail.length) {
    return { kind: "NO_SOLUTION", reason: "套装静态贡献超过目标面板增量（该组合不可能）", detail };
  }

  // 剩余必须由主属性 + 副属性提供；一个方程多个未知量 -> 欠定
  const residualAfterSets: any = {};
  for (const k of STAT_KEYS) {
    const setRate = (s.rate as any)[k] ?? 0;
    const setFlat = (s.flat as any)[k] ?? 0;
    const isMul = k === "atk" || k === "hp" || k === "def";
    const setContribution = isMul ? base[k] * setRate + setFlat : setRate + setFlat;
    residualAfterSets[k] = (residual[k] ?? 0) - setContribution;
  }
  return {
    kind: "UNDERDETERMINED",
    freeVariables: 6 * 5,   // 6 件 × (1 主 + ≤4 副)
    note: "主属性/副属性数值表未获得，无法给出唯一解。残差为『必须由主+副属性补足的余量』",
    residual: residualAfterSets,
  };
}

/** 主属性规则：1/3/5 固定，2/4/6 随机（官方概率公示） */
export const MainStatRules = {
  fixed: { 1: "atk", 3: "def", 5: "hp" } as Record<number, StatKey>,
  /** 2/4/6 的**允许集合**：数值表未获得，此处只登记"存在随机类别"这一事实 */
  randomSlots: [2, 4, 6] as const,
  allowedKnown: false,
  note: "官方公示：一、三、五号位固定；二、四、六号位存在随机属性选择。具体允许集合与各档精确值待从结构化数据获取",
} as const;

/** 强化规则（官方公示）：+3/+6/+9/+12/+15 各触发一次副属性事件 */
export const EnhanceRules = {
  breakpoints: [3, 6, 9, 12, 15] as const,
  maxSubStats: 4,
  onEvent(existingSubCount: number): "ADD_SUB" | "UPGRADE_RANDOM_SUB" {
    return existingSubCount < 4 ? "ADD_SUB" : "UPGRADE_RANDOM_SUB";
  },
  upgradeProbability: 0.25,   // 四条中随机强化一条，各 1/4
  note: "官方公示：不足四条则新增；已有四条则在四条中随机强化一条",
} as const;
```

### `battle-lab/soul/stat-source.ts`

```ts
// soul/stat-source.ts — 面板来源与**模式语义**
// 核心分层（用户冻结）：
//   对弈竞猜 = AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE（最终八维即真值，御魂静态属性**绝不**再叠加）
//   PlayerBuild = BASE + EQUIPMENT（六件御魂参与生成）
import type { ExactStats } from "../kernel/stats.ts";

export const StatSource = {
  BASE: "BASE",                                   // 六星觉醒式神基础面板
  EQUIPMENT: "EQUIPMENT",                         // 六件御魂 + 套装静态属性
  AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE: "AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE", // 对弈竞猜直接给定最终面板
} as const;
export type StatSource = (typeof StatSource)[keyof typeof StatSource];

export const EntityMode = {
  GUESSING: "GUESSING",         // 对弈竞猜：吃最终八维
  PLAYER_BUILD: "PLAYER_BUILD", // 完整养成：base + 六件御魂
} as const;
export type EntityMode = (typeof EntityMode)[keyof typeof EntityMode];

export type BuildLegality = "ACCEPT" | "IMPOSSIBLE_BUILD";

/**
 * 模式语义决定合法性。
 * 竞猜可能给出玩家养成体系里**根本无法合成**的面板（服务器直接生成），那不是错误；
 * 但同样的数据在 PlayerBuild 模式下就是 IMPOSSIBLE_BUILD。
 */
export function judgeLegality(mode: EntityMode, opts: { explainableByEquipment: boolean | null }): BuildLegality {
  if (mode === EntityMode.GUESSING) return "ACCEPT";
  if (opts.explainableByEquipment === false) return "IMPOSSIBLE_BUILD";
  return "ACCEPT";
}

export interface StatResolution {
  mode: EntityMode;
  source: StatSource;
  exact: ExactStats;
  /** ★ 竞猜模式必须为 false —— 否则御魂静态属性被重复计算 */
  soulStaticApplied: boolean;
  /** 御魂的战斗效果（4件套触发等）仍然加载 */
  soulBattleEffects: SoulEffectRef[];
  legality: BuildLegality;
  notes: string[];
}

export interface SoulEffectRef {
  soulId: number; name: string; pieces: number;
  /** 4件套的战斗触发文案（自然语言，进 SoulEffectSystem） */
  desc: string;
}

/** 不变量：竞猜模式下不得应用御魂静态属性 */
export function assertNoStaticDoubleCount(r: StatResolution): void {
  if (r.mode === EntityMode.GUESSING && r.soulStaticApplied) {
    throw new Error(
      "不变量违反：竞猜模式不得叠加御魂静态属性（面板已是装备结算后的最终值）。" +
      "否则会出现 暴伤164% + 无刀取2件套20% = 184% 这类重复计算。"
    );
  }
}
```

### `battle-lab/soul/stat-system.ts`

```ts
// soul/stat-system.ts — SoulStatSystem：只参与**开战前面板生成**
// 与 SoulEffectSystem（战斗触发）严格分离。
import { GameMath } from "../kernel/gamemath.ts";
import { makeExact } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import type { ExactStats, StatKey } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import { setStatBonus } from "./loadout.ts";
import type { SoulLoadout, SoulDef } from "./loadout.ts";

export interface DeriveResult {
  exact: ExactStats;
  /** 面板各属性的来源分解，便于 Golden Test 定位差异 */
  breakdown: Array<{ key: StatKey; base: number; fromSets: number; fromPiecesRate: number; fromPiecesFlat: number; result: number }>;
  activeSets: Array<{ soulId: number; name: string; pieces: number; kind: "2SET" | "4SET" }>;
}

/**
 * base + 御魂 -> ExactStats。**全程不取整**。
 *   atk/hp/def = base * (1 + Σrate) + Σflat
 *   spd        = base + Σflat （速度不吃百分比）
 *   cri/crid/efh/efr = base + Σrate
 */
export function deriveExactStats(base: ExactStats, loadout: SoulLoadout | null, book: Map<number, SoulDef>): DeriveResult {
  const rate: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> = {};
  const flat: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> = {};
  let activeSets: DeriveResult["activeSets"] = [];
  if (loadout && loadout.pieces.length) {
    const s = setStatBonus(loadout, book);
    Object.assign(rate, s.rate); Object.assign(flat, s.flat);
    activeSets = s.active;
  }
  // 每件御魂的主属性 / 副属性
  const pieceRate: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> = {};
  const pieceFlat: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>> = {};
  for (const p of loadout?.pieces ?? []) {
    for (const roll of [p.mainStat, ...p.subStats]) {
      if (!roll) continue;
      // 约定：RATE 型属性（百分比）用 roll.type 落在 PERCENT 集合判断；此处按类型表判断
      const isRate = RATE_TYPES.has(roll.type);
      if (isRate) pieceRate[roll.type] = (pieceRate[roll.type] ?? 0) + roll.exactValue;
      else pieceFlat[roll.type] = (pieceFlat[roll.type] ?? 0) + roll.exactValue;
    }
  }

  const mul = (k: StatKey) => base[k] * (1 + (rate[k] ?? 0) + (pieceRate[k] ?? 0)) + (flat[k] ?? 0) + (pieceFlat[k] ?? 0);
  const add = (k: StatKey) => base[k] + (flat[k] ?? 0) + (pieceFlat[k] ?? 0);
  const plusRate = (k: StatKey) => base[k] + (rate[k] ?? 0) + (pieceRate[k] ?? 0);

  const exact = makeExact({
    atk: mul("atk"), hp: mul("hp"), def: mul("def"),
    spd: add("spd"),
    cri: plusRate("cri"), crid: plusRate("crid"), efh: plusRate("efh"), efr: plusRate("efr"),
  });

  const breakdown = (["atk", "hp", "def", "spd", "cri", "crid", "efh", "efr"] as StatKey[]).map(k => ({
    key: k, base: base[k],
    fromSets: (rate[k] ?? 0), fromPiecesRate: (pieceRate[k] ?? 0),
    fromPiecesFlat: (flat[k] ?? 0) + (pieceFlat[k] ?? 0),
    result: exact[k],
  }));

  return { exact, breakdown, activeSets };
}

const RATE_TYPES = new Set<StatKey>(["atk", "hp", "def", "cri", "crid", "efh", "efr"]);
```

### `battle-lab/compile/ai-compiler.ts`

```ts
// compile/ai-compiler.ts — 官方 cast/target 自然语言规则 -> 可执行谓词
// 数据来源：data/kb/ai.json（灰机 SkillAI，272 条，官方语义由社区整理）
// 原则同技能编译器：匹配不上的一律进 unresolved[]，绝不猜。
export interface AICtx {
  self: any; allies: any[]; enemies: any[]; orbs: number; maxOrbs: number;
  turn: number; skillAvailable: (ref: string) => boolean; rng: any;
  /** 该技能本场是否已使用过（可选实现；未实现时调用方需自行判空） */
  usedSkill?: (ref: string) => boolean;
  hasBuff: (e: any, kw: string) => boolean;
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 116 轮：**场地（幻境 / 结界）查询回调**。
   *   ★ 缺省时谓词必须**失败关闭**（返回 false）—— 第 114 轮的教训：求值不了 ≠ 条件成立。
   */
  inFieldOf?: (e: any, kind: "ILLUSION" | "BARRIER", name?: string) => boolean;
  fieldRemaining?: (kind: "ILLUSION" | "BARRIER", name?: string) => number;
}

export type Predicate = (c: AICtx) => boolean;
export type Selector = (c: AICtx, cands: any[]) => any | undefined;

export interface SkillRef { index: number | null; raw: string; label: string }

export interface SkillRuleIR { priority: number; condRaw: string; cond: Predicate | null; skill: SkillRef; confidence: "HIGH" | "LOW" }
export interface TargetRuleIR { skill: SkillRef; ruleRaw: string; selector: Selector | null; confidence: "HIGH" | "LOW" }

export interface AIProfileIR {
  charId: number; charName: string;
  skillRules: SkillRuleIR[]; targetRules: TargetRuleIR[];
  unresolvedConds: string[]; unresolvedRules: string[];
  /**
   * ★ 数据质量信号：「没有写明触发条件」的规则。引擎按"每回合都满足"处理，
   * 但这往往不是官方的真实行为 —— 例如思金神 601 的 cast 只有一条
   * 「3技能（即使友方单位仅存活自身）」，cond 为空，结果就是**每回合重复施放**
   * 「智火长明」（自损 24% 生命换一个 buff），全程不普攻。
   * 引擎不猜，但必须把这件事报出来，而不是给它打上 HIGH 置信度。
   */
  unconditionalRules: string[];
  /** 技能名后面括号里的补充说明（「3技能（即使友方单位仅存活自身）」→「即使友方单位仅存活自身」） */
  skillAnnotations: string[];
  confidence: "HIGH" | "MEDIUM" | "LOW";
}

/** 「3技能」/「普攻」/「2技能【花之馨香】」-> 技能序号 */
/** 按技能名解析（阴阳师用的是「言灵·星」这类中文名，不是"N技能"）。
 *  skillNames 来自实际装载的技能列表；匹配不上就返回 null，绝不猜。 */
export function parseSkillRefByName(raw: string, skillNames: string[]): SkillRef | null {
  const s = (raw ?? "").trim();
  if (!s || !skillNames.length) return null;
  const norm = (x: string) => x.replace(/^\[[^\]]*\]|\[/g, "").replace(/[「」\[\]]/g, "").trim();
  const target = norm(s);
  if (!target || target.length < 2) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < skillNames.length; i++) if (norm(skillNames[i]) === target) return { index: i, raw: s, label: s };
  for (let i = 0; i < skillNames.length; i++) {
    const n = norm(skillNames[i]);
    if (n && (n.includes(target) || target.includes(n))) return { index: i, raw: s, label: s };
  }
  return null;
}

export function parseSkillRef(raw: string): SkillRef {
  const s = (raw ?? "").trim();
  if (/普攻|普通攻击/.test(s)) return { index: 0, raw: s, label: "普攻" };
  const m = s.match(/([1-4])\s*技能/);
  if (m) return { index: Number(m[1]) - 1, raw: s, label: s };
  if (/序幕/.test(s)) return { index: 0, raw: s, label: s };
  if (/盛幕/.test(s)) return { index: 2, raw: s, label: s };
  return { index: null, raw: s, label: s };
}

const num = (s: string) => parseFloat(s);

/** ---------- 技能选择条件词典 ---------- */
const COND_RULES: Array<{ re: RegExp; make: (m: RegExpMatchArray) => Predicate; note: string }> = [
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 116 轮：**场地（幻境 / 结界）条件** —— 第 115 轮把场地做出来了，这一轮把条件接上。
   *
   * ★ 名字捕获写成 `([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))` 并允许**空前缀**：第一版写 `(.+?)`，
   *   于是「自身处于幻境时」这种「动词后面直接就是幻境」的写法**一条都匹配不上**。
   * ★ 这几条必须排在通用 buff 规则**前面**：否则「不存在山行结界时」会落到
   *   `/(?:未拥有|没有|不存在)(.+?)…/` 上，被求值成「身上没有叫山行结界的 buff」——
   *   一个**永远为真**的谓词。那比「解析不出」更糟：它会被当成条件成立放行。
   * ★ 求值逻辑**内联**在每条 make 里（不引外部小工具）：`AICtx` 没有场地回调时一律 false ——
   *   失败关闭，绝不默认「条件成立」（第 114 轮的纪律）。
   */
  { re: /自身未处于([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))或[^，。；]{0,8}?剩余(?:时间|回合数)\s*=?\s*1\s*(?:回合)?时?/, note: "自身不在场地、或场地仅剩1回合",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, "");
      const inF = c.inFieldOf ? c.inFieldOf(c.self, k as any, n) : false; const left = c.fieldRemaining ? c.fieldRemaining(k as any, n) : 0; return !inF || left <= 1; } },
  { re: /(?:无|没有|不存在)([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))或[^，。；]{0,8}?剩余时间\s*1\s*(?:回合)?/, note: "无场地、或场地仅剩1回合",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, "");
      const inF = c.inFieldOf ? c.inFieldOf(c.self, k as any, n) : false; const left = c.fieldRemaining ? c.fieldRemaining(k as any, n) : 0; return !inF || left <= 1; } },
  { re: /自身未处于([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))时?/, note: "自身不在场地",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, ""); return c.inFieldOf ? !c.inFieldOf(c.self, k as any, n) : false; } },
  { re: /自身处于([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))时?/, note: "自身在场地",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, ""); return c.inFieldOf ? c.inFieldOf(c.self, k as any, n) : false; } },
  { re: /所有友方均无([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))时?/, note: "所有友方均无该场地",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, "");
      return c.inFieldOf ? c.allies.every((a: any) => !c.inFieldOf!(a, k as any, n)) : false; } },
  { re: /(?:不存在|没有|无)([^，。；]{0,8}?(?:幻境|结界))时?/, note: "场上没有该场地",
    make: (m) => (c) => { const w = m[1]; const k = /幻境/.test(w) ? "ILLUSION" : "BARRIER"; const n = /幻境/.test(w) ? undefined : w.replace(/结界$/, ""); return c.inFieldOf ? !c.inFieldOf(c.self, k as any, n) : false; } },
  { re: /^\s*$/, note: "无条件", make: () => () => true },
  { re: /^(否则|优先|随后|默认)$/, note: "否则/默认分支", make: () => () => true },
  { re: /鬼火充足/, note: "鬼火充足", make: () => (c) => c.orbs > 0 },
  { re: /鬼火不足/, note: "鬼火不足", make: () => (c) => c.orbs <= 0 },
  { re: /敌方(?:单位)?剩余数量\s*(?:大于|≥|>|＞)=?\s*(\d+)\s*(?:或|且)?\s*(?:己方)?鬼火(?:数量)?\s*(?:大于|＞|>|≥)\s*(\d+)/, note: "敌数或鬼火",
    make: (m) => (c) => c.enemies.length >= num(m[1]) || c.orbs > num(m[2]) },
  { re: /鬼火(?:数量)?\s*[＞>]\s*(\d+)/, note: "鬼火>N", make: (m) => (c) => c.orbs > num(m[1]) },
  { re: /鬼火(?:数量)?\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "鬼火>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.orbs >= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /(?:鬼火数|剩余鬼火|鬼火)[^。；\n]{0,4}?(?:小于|少于|不足)\s*(\d+)/, note: "鬼火<N", make: (m) => (c) => c.orbs < num(m[1]) },
  { re: /(?:鬼火数|剩余鬼火|鬼火)[^。；\n]{0,4}?(?:小于等于|不超过)\s*(\d+)/, note: "鬼火<=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.orbs <= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /敌方(?:单位)?(?:剩余)?数量\s*=\s*(\d+)/, note: "敌数=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.enemies.length === num(m[1]) },
  { re: /敌方(?:单位)?(?:剩余)?数量\s*[≤<]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "敌数<=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.enemies.length <= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /敌方(?:单位)?(?:剩余)?数量\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "敌数>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.enemies.length >= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /我方(?:目标)?存活数量\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "我方存活>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length >= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /我方(?:目标)?存活数量\s*[＜<]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "我方存活<N", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length < num(m[1]) },
  { re: /友方单位血量低于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "友方血量<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.some(a => a.hp / a.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100) },
  { re: /我方有可复活目标/, note: "有可复活目标", make: () => (c) => c.allies.some(a => a.dead && !a.reviveBlocked) },
  { re: /我方(?:目标)?(?:未存在|无)buff|友方(?:单位)?无buff/, note: "我方无buff", make: () => (c) => c.allies.some(a => a.statuses.length === 0) },
  { re: /不处于(.+?)行动时/, note: "不处于某状态", make: (m) => (c) => !c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  { re: /处于(.+?)行动时/, note: "处于某状态", make: (m) => (c) => c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  { re: /敌方目标未存在buff/, note: "敌方无buff", make: () => (c) => c.enemies.some(a => a.statuses.length === 0) },
  { re: /敌方目标存在buff/, note: "敌方有buff", make: () => (c) => c.enemies.some(a => a.statuses.length > 0) },
  { re: /(\d+)技能不可用/, note: "技能不可用", make: (m) => (c) => !c.skillAvailable(m[1] + "技能") },
  { re: /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*概率/, note: "N%概率", make: (m) => (c) => c.rng.testHit(num(m[1]) / 100) },
  { re: /自身拥有(.+?)时/, note: "自身有指定buff", make: (m) => (c) => c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  // --- 自身血量（容忍「时，优先」等后缀与裸写法「高于40%时」）---
  { re: /自身血量(?:比例)?\s*(?:低于|小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "自身血量<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /自身血量(?:比例)?\s*(?:高于|大于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "自身血量>N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp > num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /^(?:高于|大于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*时/, note: "自身血量>N%（裸写法）", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp > num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /^(?:低于|小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*时/, note: "自身血量<N%（裸写法）", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100 },
  // --- 友方群体血量（含「均高于」变体）---
  { re: /友方单位血量均(?:高于|大于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "全体友方>N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length > 0 && c.allies.every(a => a.hp / a.maxHp > num(m[1]) / 100) },
  { re: /友方单位血量均(?:低于|小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "全体友方<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length > 0 && c.allies.every(a => a.hp / a.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100) },
  // --- 友方数量 ---
  { re: /友方(?:剩余)?单位(?:剩余)?数量?\s*(?:等于|=)\s*(\d+)/, note: "友方数=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length === num(m[1]) },
  { re: /友方(?:剩余)?单位?\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "友方数>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length >= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /友方剩余单位\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)/, note: "友方剩余>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length >= num(m[1]) },
  // --- 自身资源/层数（星辰之力、狂气…）---
  { re: /自身(.+?)\s*(?:大于等于|≥|>=)\s*(\d+)\s*时/, note: "自身层数>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  { re: /自身(.+?)\s*(?:小于等于|≤|<=)\s*(\d+)\s*时/, note: "自身层数<=N", make: (m) => (c) => !c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  // --- 技能使用状态 ---
  { re: /未使用\s*(\d+)\s*技能时/, note: "尚未用过N技能", make: (m) => (c) => !c.usedSkill?.(m[1] + "技能") },
  { re: /自身生命比例在\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*以上/, note: "自身血量>=N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp >= num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /自身生命比例在\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*以下/, note: "自身血量<=N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp <= num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /自身生命比例(?:低于|小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "自身血量<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /自身生命比例(?:高于|大于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "自身血量>N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp > num(m[1]) / 100 },
  { re: /自身生命(?:上限)?(?:低于|小于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "自身血量<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.self.hp / c.self.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100 },
  // --- 友方群体血量（本轮新增簇）---
  { re: /所有友方单位生命比例\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*以上/, note: "全体友方>=N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length > 0 && c.allies.every(a => a.hp / a.maxHp >= num(m[1]) / 100) },
  { re: /友方单位血量均大于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "全体友方>N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.length > 0 && c.allies.every(a => a.hp / a.maxHp > num(m[1]) / 100) },
  { re: /(?:存在友方单位|友方存在单位)血量(?:比例)?(?:小于|低于)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/, note: "存在友方<N%", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.some(a => a.hp / a.maxHp < num(m[1]) / 100) },
  // --- buff 存在性（自身 / 我方）---
  { re: /(?:未拥有|没有|不存在)(.+?)(?:buff|状态|印记)?时?$/, note: "自身无某buff", make: (m) => (c) => !c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  { re: /(?:已拥有|拥有|存在)(.+?)(?:buff|状态|印记)(?:时)?$/, note: "自身有某buff", make: (m) => (c) => c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  { re: /我方(?:存在|有)(.+?)(?:buff|状态|印记)?(?:时)?$/, note: "我方存在某buff", make: (m) => (c) => c.allies.some(a => c.hasBuff(a, m[1])) },
  { re: /我方无(.+?)(?:buff|状态|印记)?时?$/, note: "我方无某buff", make: (m) => (c) => !c.allies.some(a => c.hasBuff(a, m[1])) },
  // --- 回合数 / 层数 ---
  { re: /第\s*(\d+)\s*回合/, note: "回合数>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.turn >= num(m[1]) },
  { re: /(.+?)层数\s*[≥>]=?\s*(\d+)\s*时?/, note: "某层数>=N", make: (m) => (c) => c.hasBuff(c.self, m[1]) },
  // --- 排序标记：不是条件，而是优先级顺序的表达 ---
  { re: /^(先|随后|然后|接着|解锁前|之后)$/, note: "顺序标记（按优先级顺序求值即为默认分支）", make: () => () => true },
];

/** ---------- 目标选择规则词典 ---------- */
const TARGET_RULES: Array<{ re: RegExp; make: (m: RegExpMatchArray) => Selector; note: string }> = [
  { re: /优先选择血量低于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*的单位|优先血量\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*以下的?目标/, note: "追残(血量比例)",
    make: (m) => (c, cands) => { const th = num(m[1] ?? m[2]) / 100; const low = cands.filter(x => x.hp / x.maxHp < th); return (low.length ? low : cands).reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]); } },
  { re: /优先选择血量低于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*的(?:敌方单位|友方单位|目标)|优先选择血量比例低于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*的敌方/, note: "追残(带单位后缀)",
    make: (m) => (c, cands) => { const th = num(m[1] ?? m[2]) / 100; const low = cands.filter(x => x.hp / x.maxHp < th); return (low.length ? low : cands).reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]); } },
  { re: /优先选择血量低的(?:敌方|友方)(?!单位)|优先选择血量低的$/, note: "最低生命比例(无阈值)",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择绝对血量更低的(?:敌方|友方)/, note: "最低绝对血量",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp < a.hp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择没有buff的友方中攻击最高的/, note: "无buff友方中攻击最高",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => { const f = cands.filter(x => x.statuses.length === 0); const pool = f.length ? f : cands; return pool.reduce((a, b) => (b.prop("atk") > a.prop("atk") ? b : a), pool[0]); } },
  { re: /固定选择施放了2技能的友方单位/, note: "固定目标(需战场标记)", make: () => (_c, cands) => cands[0] },
  { re: /优先选择没有护盾的友方单位/, note: "无护盾友方",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => { const f = cands.filter(x => x.shields.length === 0 || x.shields.every((s: any) => s.broken)); return (f.length ? f : cands)[0]; } },
  { re: /优先选择血量低的(?:友方单位|敌方单位)/, note: "最低生命比例",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择生命比例最低|优先选择生命比例低的敌方/, note: "最低生命比例",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择(?:绝对血量|血量绝对值)最高|选择血量最高的单位|优先选择生命值最高的敌方|优先选择血量高的敌方|优先选择血量高于\d+%/, note: "最高绝对血量",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp > a.hp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /(?:绝对血量|血量绝对值)更高|(?:绝对血量|血量绝对值)最高的敌方/, note: "最高绝对血量(变体)",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.hp > a.hp ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择敌方攻击最高的单位|优先选择攻击最高的敌方(?:单位)?|攻击最高的敌方/, note: "最高攻击敌方",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.prop("atk") > a.prop("atk") ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择没有(.+?)buff的敌方单位/, note: "无指定buff的敌方",
    make: (m) => (c, cands) => { const f = cands.filter(x => !c.hasBuff(x, m[1])); return (f.length ? f : cands)[0]; } },
  { re: /生命比例处于\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%\s*以下/, note: "追残(处于X%以下)",
    make: (m) => (c, cands) => { const th = num(m[1]) / 100; const low = cands.filter(x => x.hp / x.maxHp < th); return (low.length ? low : cands).reduce((a, b) => (b.hp / b.maxHp < a.hp / a.maxHp ? b : a), cands[0]); } },
  { re: /优先选择攻击高的友方|选择攻击最高的单位/, note: "最高攻击友方",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.prop("atk") > a.prop("atk") ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /随机/, note: "随机",
    make: () => (c, cands) => c.rng.pick(cands) },
  { re: /优先选择带有减益效果且数量最多的友方单位/, note: "减益最多的友方",
    make: () => (_c, cands) => cands.reduce((a, b) => (b.statuses.filter((s: any) => s.def.category.startsWith("DEBUFF")).length > a.statuses.filter((s: any) => s.def.category.startsWith("DEBUFF")).length ? b : a), cands[0]) },
  { re: /优先选择没有(.+?)buff的、攻击最高的友方/, note: "无指定buff中攻击最高",
    make: (m) => (c, cands) => { const f = cands.filter(x => !c.hasBuff(x, m[1])); const pool = f.length ? f : cands; return pool.reduce((a, b) => (b.prop("atk") > a.prop("atk") ? b : a), pool[0]); } },
];

export function compileAI(charId: number, charName: string, aiEntry: any, skillNames: string[] = []): AIProfileIR {
  const resolve = (raw: string): SkillRef => {
    const byPos = parseSkillRef(raw);
    if (byPos.index !== null || !skillNames.length) return byPos;
    return parseSkillRefByName(raw, skillNames) ?? byPos;
  };
  const skillRules: SkillRuleIR[] = [];
  const targetRules: TargetRuleIR[] = [];
  const unresolvedConds: string[] = [];
  const unresolvedRules: string[] = [];
  const unconditionalRules: string[] = [];
  const skillAnnotations: string[] = [];

  const casts = aiEntry?.cast ?? [];
  casts.forEach((c: any, i: number) => {
    /** 场地条件的两把小工具（kind/name 从条件原文里读；回调缺失 ⇒ false，不默认成立） */
  const condRaw = (c.cond ?? "").trim();
    let cond: Predicate | null = null;
    for (const r of COND_RULES) {
      const m = condRaw.match(r.re);
      if (m) { cond = r.make(m as RegExpMatchArray); break; }
    }
    if (!cond) unresolvedConds.push(condRaw || "(空)");
    // 「没写条件」不是「无条件」：两者行为相同，但可信度完全不同，必须分开记录
    if (!condRaw) unconditionalRules.push(String(c.skill ?? "").trim() + " → 每回合都会施放");
    const ann = String(c.skill ?? "").match(/[（(]([^）)]+)[）)]/);
    if (ann) skillAnnotations.push(ann[1]);
    skillRules.push({
      priority: casts.length - i,
      condRaw, cond,
      skill: resolve(c.skill ?? ""),
      confidence: cond ? "HIGH" : "LOW",
    });
  });

  for (const t of aiEntry?.target ?? []) {
    const ruleRaw = (t.rule ?? "").trim();
    let selector: Selector | null = null;
    for (const r of TARGET_RULES) {
      const m = ruleRaw.match(r.re);
      if (m) { selector = r.make(m as RegExpMatchArray); break; }
    }
    if (!selector) unresolvedRules.push(ruleRaw);
    targetRules.push({ skill: resolve(t.skill ?? ""), ruleRaw, selector, confidence: selector ? "HIGH" : "LOW" });
  }

  const allRefsOk = [...skillRules.map(s => s.skill), ...targetRules.map(t => t.skill)].every(r => r.index !== null);
  const total = skillRules.length + targetRules.length;
  const resolved = skillRules.filter(s => s.cond).length + targetRules.filter(t => t.selector).length;
  let confidence: AIProfileIR["confidence"] = "LOW";
  if (total > 0 && resolved === total && allRefsOk) confidence = "HIGH";
  else if (total > 0 && resolved / total >= 0.75) confidence = "MEDIUM";

  return { charId, charName, skillRules, targetRules, unresolvedConds, unresolvedRules, unconditionalRules, skillAnnotations, confidence };
}
```

### `battle-lab/compile/ai-gaps.ts`

```ts
// compile/ai-gaps.ts — AI 规则量化缺口分析（目标 ② 的"AI 阈值量化"部分）
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileAI } from "./ai-compiler.ts";
const KB = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "data", "kb", "ai.json");
const entries = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(KB, "utf8"));

const FUZZY = /一定|若干|部分|某些|适量|较高|较低|足够|不足|充足|多个|少量|大量/;
const NUM = /\d/;

const rows: any[] = [];
for (const e of entries) {
  const ir = compileAI(e.id, e.name, e);
  for (const r of ir.skillRules) rows.push({ kind: "cast", char: e.name, id: e.id, raw: r.condRaw || "(无条件)",
    compiled: !!r.cond, quantified: !!r.condRaw && NUM.test(r.condRaw), fuzzy: FUZZY.test(r.condRaw) });
  for (const t of ir.targetRules) rows.push({ kind: "target", char: e.name, id: e.id, raw: t.ruleRaw,
    compiled: !!t.selector, quantified: NUM.test(t.ruleRaw), fuzzy: FUZZY.test(t.ruleRaw) });
}
const T = rows.length;
const compiled = rows.filter(r => r.compiled).length;
const quantified = rows.filter(r => r.quantified).length;
const fuzzy = rows.filter(r => r.fuzzy).length;
const fuzzyUncompiled = rows.filter(r => r.fuzzy && !r.compiled).length;
const concreteUncompiled = rows.filter(r => !r.fuzzy && !r.compiled).length;

console.log("=== AI 规则量化缺口分析（" + entries.length + " 只式神，" + T + " 条规则）===");
console.log(" 可编译        : " + compiled + " / " + T + "  (" + ((compiled / T) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
console.log(" 含具体数值    : " + quantified + " / " + T + "  (" + ((quantified / T) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
console.log(" 含模糊词      : " + fuzzy + "  (" + ((fuzzy / T) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
console.log("   - 模糊 且 未编译 : " + fuzzyUncompiled + "   <- 必须实测/人工量化");
console.log("   - 不模糊 但 未编译: " + concreteUncompiled + "   <- 只是词典没覆盖，可继续加规则");

const byKind = (k: string) => { const s = rows.filter(r => r.kind === k); return s.length + " 条, 可编译 " + s.filter(r => r.compiled).length + ", 含数值 " + s.filter(r => r.quantified).length + ", 模糊 " + s.filter(r => r.fuzzy).length; };
console.log("\n cast  : " + byKind("cast"));
console.log(" target: " + byKind("target"));

console.log("\n=== 模糊词规则（全部，需人工/实测量化）===");
const fz = rows.filter(r => r.fuzzy);
for (const r of fz) console.log("  [" + r.char + "][" + r.kind + "] " + r.raw.slice(0, 66));

await fs.mkdir(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "fixtures"), { recursive: true });
await fs.writeFile(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "fixtures", "ai-gaps.json"), JSON.stringify({
  summary: { totalRules: T, compiled, quantified, fuzzy, fuzzyUncompiled, concreteUncompiled },
  fuzzyRules: fz, uncompiled: rows.filter(r => !r.compiled),
}, null, 1), "utf8");
console.log("\n-> fixtures/ai-gaps.json");
```

### `battle-lab/compile/ai-report.ts`

```ts
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileAI } from "./ai-compiler.ts";
const KB = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "data", "kb", "ai.json");
const entries = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(KB, "utf8"));
const irs = entries.map((e: any) => compileAI(e.id, e.name, e));
const byConf = { HIGH: 0, MEDIUM: 0, LOW: 0 } as any;
for (const r of irs) byConf[r.confidence]++;
console.log("=== AI 编译器覆盖率 ===");
console.log("式神数:", irs.length);
for (const k of ["HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]) console.log("  " + k + ": " + byConf[k] + " (" + ((byConf[k] / irs.length) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
const conds: Record<string, number> = {}, rules: Record<string, number> = {};
for (const r of irs) { for (const c of r.unresolvedConds) conds[c] = (conds[c] ?? 0) + 1; for (const t of r.unresolvedRules) rules[t] = (rules[t] ?? 0) + 1; }
const totC = irs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.skillRules.length, 0);
const totT = irs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.targetRules.length, 0);
const unC = Object.values(conds).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
const unT = Object.values(rules).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
console.log("\ncast 条件: " + (totC - unC) + "/" + totC + " 可编译 (" + (((totC - unC) / totC) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
console.log("target 规则: " + (totT - unT) + "/" + totT + " 可编译 (" + (((totT - unT) / totT) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%)");
console.log("\n未编译 cond TOP10:");
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(conds).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10)) console.log("  " + v + "x  " + k.slice(0, 60));
console.log("\n未编译 target rule TOP10:");
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rules).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10)) console.log("  " + v + "x  " + k.slice(0, 60));
await fs.writeFile(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "fixtures", "ai-ir.json"), JSON.stringify(irs.map(r => ({ ...r, skillRules: r.skillRules.map(s => ({ ...s, cond: undefined, condRaw: s.condRaw })), targetRules: r.targetRules.map(t => ({ ...t, selector: undefined })) })), null, 1), "utf8");
```
