### `battle-lab/runner/monte-carlo.ts`

```ts
// runner/monte-carlo.ts — Monte Carlo + Wilson 区间 + CRN 配对
// 关键：**卡住的局不计入任何一方**，单独统计为 STALL，否则胜率之和会假的凑成 100%。
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { policySnapshot, hasUnknownPolicy } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import type { BattlePolicies } from "../kernel/policies.ts";

export interface RunOutcome { winner: 0 | 1 | null; reason: string; turns: number }

export interface MonteCarloResult {
  n: number; winsRed: number; winsBlue: number; stalls: number; doubleKo: number;
  winRateRed: number | null; winRateBlue: number | null;
  ci95Red: [number, number] | null; ci95Blue: [number, number] | null;
  /** 是否可下结论：卡住比例过高 / 含 UNKNOWN 策略时不可 */
  conclusionReady: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
  policies: any;
  seedBase: number;
}

/** Wilson score interval（比正态近似更适合极端胜率） */
export function wilson(successes: number, n: number, z = 1.96): [number, number] {
  if (n === 0) return [0, 0];
  const p = successes / n;
  const d = 1 + (z * z) / n;
  const c = p + (z * z) / (2 * n);
  const s = z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n + (z * z) / (4 * n * n));
  return [(c - s) / d, (c + s) / d];
}

export async function monteCarlo(
  makeBattle: (seed: number) => Battle | Promise<Battle>,
  n: number,
  opts: { seedBase?: number; maxStallRatio?: number } = {},
): Promise<MonteCarloResult> {
  const seedBase = opts.seedBase ?? 100000;
  const maxStall = opts.maxStallRatio ?? 0.2;
  let winsRed = 0, winsBlue = 0, stalls = 0, doubleKo = 0;
  let policies: BattlePolicies | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const bt = await makeBattle(seedBase + i);
    policies = bt.policies;
    const r = await bt.run();
    if (r.reason === "TURN_LIMIT") stalls++;
    else if (r.winner === 0) winsRed++;
    else if (r.winner === 1) winsBlue++;
    else doubleKo++;
  }
  const decisive = winsRed + winsBlue;
  const winRateRed = decisive ? winsRed / decisive : null;
  const winRateBlue = decisive ? winsBlue / decisive : null;
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  if (policies && hasUnknownPolicy(policies)) warnings.push("存在 UNKNOWN 策略：" + JSON.stringify(policySnapshot(policies)) + " —— 本结果不构成机制结论");
  if (stalls / n > maxStall) warnings.push("卡住比例 " + ((stalls / n) * 100).toFixed(1) + "% 超过阈值 " + (maxStall * 100) + "%，样本被未终结局污染");
  if (decisive < 100) warnings.push("有效样本仅 " + decisive + " 局，置信区间过宽");
  return {
    n, winsRed, winsBlue, stalls, doubleKo,
    winRateRed, winRateBlue,
    ci95Red: decisive ? wilson(winsRed, decisive) : null,
    ci95Blue: decisive ? wilson(winsBlue, decisive) : null,
    conclusionReady: warnings.length === 0,
    warnings, policies: policySnapshot(policies!), seedBase,
  };
}

/**
 * 回合上限敏感性：同一阵容在不同 maxTurns 下胜率会漂移多少。
 * 这是 D 组（对弈竞猜残局加速机制）未实测时，**唯一诚实的精度声明**。
 */
export interface SensitivityPoint { maxTurns: number; winRateRed: number | null; stalls: number; decisive: number }

export async function turnLimitSensitivity(
  makeBattleWithLimit: (seed: number, maxTurns: number) => Battle | Promise<Battle>,
  limits: number[], n: number, seedBase = 600000,
): Promise<{ points: SensitivityPoint[]; spread: number; verdict: string }> {
  const points: SensitivityPoint[] = [];
  for (const maxTurns of limits) {
    const r = await monteCarlo(s => makeBattleWithLimit(s, maxTurns), n, { seedBase, maxStallRatio: 1 });
    points.push({ maxTurns, winRateRed: r.winRateRed, stalls: r.stalls, decisive: r.winsRed + r.winsBlue });
  }
  const rates = points.map(p => p.winRateRed).filter((x): x is number => x !== null);
  const spread = rates.length > 1 ? Math.max(...rates) - Math.min(...rates) : 0;
  const stallDrop = points.length > 1 ? points[0].stalls - points[points.length - 1].stalls : 0;
  let verdict: string;
  if (spread > 0.1) verdict = "胜率随回合上限漂移 " + (spread * 100).toFixed(1) + " 个百分点 —— 残局机制未实测前，该阵容胜率不可用";
  else if (stallDrop / n > 0.05) verdict = "提高回合上限可消解 " + ((stallDrop / n) * 100).toFixed(1) + "% 的卡住局，但胜率稳定，结论对该参数不敏感";
  else verdict = "胜率对回合上限不敏感（漂移 " + (spread * 100).toFixed(1) + " 个百分点）";
  return { points, spread, verdict };
}

export function formatResult(r: MonteCarloResult, label = ""): string {
  const L: string[] = [];
  const pc = (x: number | null) => (x === null ? "N/A" : (x * 100).toFixed(2) + "%");
  const ci = (c: [number, number] | null) => (c ? `[${(c[0] * 100).toFixed(2)}%, ${(c[1] * 100).toFixed(2)}%]` : "N/A");
  L.push(`### ${label}`);
  L.push(`模拟 ${r.n} 局 | 红胜 ${r.winsRed} | 蓝胜 ${r.winsBlue} | 卡住(未终结) ${r.stalls} | 同归于尽 ${r.doubleKo}`);
  L.push(`红方胜率 ${pc(r.winRateRed)}  Wilson 95% CI ${ci(r.ci95Red)}`);
  L.push(`蓝方胜率 ${pc(r.winRateBlue)}  Wilson 95% CI ${ci(r.ci95Blue)}`);
  L.push(`可下结论: ${r.conclusionReady ? "是" : "否"}`);
  for (const w of r.warnings) L.push(`  ⚠️ ${w}`);
  return L.join("\n");
}
```

```ts
// runner/policy-sweep-cli.ts — 对某一组对阵跑策略敏感性扫描
//
// 用法：node runner/policy-sweep-cli.ts [N=120] [seed=20261001] [fixture=fixtures/guessing-match-canonical-001.json]
//
// 它回答的是使用者真正关心的问题：**换成别的合理候选，"押哪边"会不会变。**
// 机制本身是什么仍然是红区（只能靠游戏内观测），但"结论稳不稳"是可以算的。
import path from "node:path";
import { assembleGuessingMatch, loadMatchFixture } from "../soul/guessing-match.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { sweepPolicies, formatSweep } from "./policy-sweep.ts";
import type { SweepAxis } from "./policy-sweep.ts";

const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).map(a => a.split("=") as [string, string]));
const N = Number(args.N ?? 120);
const seedBase = Number(args.seed ?? 20261001);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const fixPath = path.resolve(args.fixture ?? path.join(ROOT, "fixtures", "guessing-match-canonical-001.json"));

const base = {
  resource: ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345,
  startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
  death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION,
  priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
  tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM",
  guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED,
};

// 轴：只列**说得通**的候选；已知有偏的候选计入参照、不参与判定（见 policy-sweep.ts 的两条纪律）
const axes: SweepAxis[] = [
  { name: "开局顺序", variants: [
    { id: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI.id, status: "HYPOTHESIS", plausible: true,
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI }) },
    { id: StartupPolicies.SENKI_FIRST.id, status: "HYPOTHESIS", plausible: true,
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, startup: StartupPolicies.SENKI_FIRST }) },
  ] },
  { name: "击杀时点", variants: [
    { id: DeathPolicies.HP_ZERO_IS_KILLED.id, status: "HYPOTHESIS", plausible: true,
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, death: DeathPolicies.HP_ZERO_IS_KILLED }) },
    { id: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION.id, status: "HYPOTHESIS", plausible: true,
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION }) },
  ] },
  { name: "并列先后", variants: [
    { id: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", status: "HYPOTHESIS", plausible: true, note: "同速均匀随机",
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM" }) },
    { id: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", status: "UNKNOWN", plausible: false, note: "已知会造成红方结构性优势，仅作参照",
      apply: (p: any) => ({ ...p, tieBreak: "UNRESOLVED" }) },
  ] },
];

const fx: any = await loadMatchFixture(fixPath);
console.log("对阵：" + path.basename(fixPath) + "｜N=" + N + "｜seedBase=" + seedBase);
console.log("（每格都是独立的一次 Monte Carlo；仅参照的候选用 · 标出，不参与结论）");
console.log("");
const r = await sweepPolicies(
  async (seed, policies) => (await assembleGuessingMatch(fx, { seed, maxTurns: 300, policies })).battle,
  base, axes, N, { seedBase },
);
console.log(formatSweep(r));
console.log("");
console.log("这对使用者意味着什么：");
if (r.verdict === "FLIPS") console.log("  → 不要下注。换一条尚未确定的规则就能翻转胜负，此时任何下注都是在赌那条规则。");
else if (r.verdict === "INCONCLUSIVE") console.log("  → 没有可判定的候选，先补充候选再谈稳健性。");
else console.log("  → 可以按结论方向考虑，但请记住：稳健 ≠ 正确。它只说明这个判断不取决于已列出的那几个候选。");
```

### `battle-lab/runner/policy-sweep.ts`

```ts
// runner/policy-sweep.ts — ★ 策略敏感性扫描：把「无法下结论」变成「这个判断稳不稳」
//
// 动机：项目里有四个红区（开局顺序 / 并列先后 / 击杀时点 / 竞猜残局），每个都有若干**都说得通**的
// 候选。此前的做法是：把 UNKNOWN 写进产物、然后声明"本结果不构成机制结论"。
// 这是诚实的，但对**使用者真正要回答的问题**毫无帮助 —— 他要的是"我该押哪边"。
//
// 关键区分：机制**是什么**无法由我们决定（那是红区，只能靠游戏内观测）；
// 但"**换成别的候选，结论会不会翻**"是我们完全可以算的。如果红方在全部合理候选下都赢，
// 那么"押红"这个判断就不依赖于那几个未解的问题 —— 这比"无法下结论"有用得多，而且同样是诚实的。
//
// 两条纪律：
//   ① 只把**说得通的候选**计入判定。已知有偏的候选（例如并列按注册序，会造成红方结构性优势）
//      单独列出、**不计入** verdict —— 否则用一个人为偏差去"证明"结论不稳，等于自己制造噪声。
//   ② 扫描结论的措辞必须限定范围：「在这些候选下稳健」，不是「已确证」。
import type { MonteCarloResult } from "./monte-carlo.ts";
import { monteCarlo } from "./monte-carlo.ts";

export interface SweepVariant {
  id: string;
  /** 该候选的可信度（沿用红区的三态） */
  status: "UNKNOWN" | "HYPOTHESIS" | "VERIFIED";
  /**
   * 是否计入判定。已知有偏 / 仅作参照的候选填 false —— 它们会被跑、会被列出，但不参与 verdict。
   */
  plausible: boolean;
  note?: string;
  /** 把该候选作用到 policies 上（返回新的 policies，不要就地改） */
  apply: (policies: any) => any;
}

export interface SweepAxis { name: string; variants: SweepVariant[] }

export interface SweepCell {
  combo: Record<string, string>;
  winRateRed: number | null;
  ci95: [number, number] | null;
  stalls: number;
  n: number;
  /** 该组合是否全部候选都 plausible（false = 含仅作参照的候选，不进 verdict） */
  countsTowardVerdict: boolean;
}

export type SweepVerdict = "STABLE_RED" | "STABLE_BLUE" | "FLIPS" | "INCONCLUSIVE";

export interface SweepResult {
  cells: SweepCell[];
  verdict: SweepVerdict;
  /** 计入判定的那些组合里，红方胜率的最低/最高 */
  minRate: number | null;
  maxRate: number | null;
  spread: number | null;
  /**
   * 连同「仅作参照」的候选一起看的极差。
   * ★ 为什么要单列：只报 spread 时，表格里明明有 55.0% 与 57.5% 两行，标题却写「极差 0.0」——
   *   技术上没错（判定只看计入的那些），但读起来像「什么都没变」。两个数都给，才不误导。
   */
  spreadAll: number | null;
  axes: string[];
  counts: { total: number; towardVerdict: number; excluded: number };
  note: string;
}

/** 笛卡尔积 */
function combinations(axes: SweepAxis[]): Array<Record<string, SweepVariant>> {
  let acc: Array<Record<string, SweepVariant>> = [{}];
  for (const ax of axes) {
    const next: Array<Record<string, SweepVariant>> = [];
    for (const base of acc) for (const v of ax.variants) next.push({ ...base, [ax.name]: v });
    acc = next;
  }
  return acc;
}

export async function sweepPolicies(
  makeBattle: (seed: number, policies: any) => Promise<any>,
  basePolicies: any,
  axes: SweepAxis[],
  n: number,
  opts: { seedBase?: number } = {},
): Promise<SweepResult> {
  const combos = combinations(axes);
  const cells: SweepCell[] = [];
  for (const combo of combos) {
    let policies = basePolicies;
    for (const v of Object.values(combo)) policies = v.apply(policies);
    const mc: MonteCarloResult = await monteCarlo((seed: number) => makeBattle(seed, policies), n, { seedBase: opts.seedBase ?? 20261001 });
    cells.push({
      combo: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(combo).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.id])),
      winRateRed: mc.winRateRed, ci95: mc.ci95Red, stalls: mc.stalls, n: mc.n,
      countsTowardVerdict: Object.values(combo).every(v => v.plausible),
    });
  }
  const counted = cells.filter(c => c.countsTowardVerdict && c.winRateRed !== null);
  const rates = counted.map(c => c.winRateRed as number);
  const minRate = rates.length ? Math.min(...rates) : null;
  const maxRate = rates.length ? Math.max(...rates) : null;
  // ★ 数据层不做四舍五入：把它留给格式化。曾经在这里 toFixed(4)，
  //   结果测试按精确值断言时差了一点点 —— 数值字段应当是精确的，显示才需要取整。
  const spread = rates.length ? (maxRate! - minRate!) : null;

  let verdict: SweepVerdict = "INCONCLUSIVE";
  if (rates.length) {
    const allRed = rates.every(r => r > 0.5);
    const allBlue = rates.every(r => r <= 0.5);
    verdict = allRed ? "STABLE_RED" : allBlue ? "STABLE_BLUE" : "FLIPS";
  }
  const allRates = cells.map(c => c.winRateRed).filter((x): x is number => x !== null);
  const spreadAll = allRates.length ? (Math.max(...allRates) - Math.min(...allRates)) : null;
  const excluded = cells.length - counted.length;
  const note =
    verdict === "STABLE_RED"
      ? `在计入判定的 ${counted.length} 种候选组合下，红方胜率全部高于 50%（${(minRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}%–${(maxRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}%）——「押红」这个判断不依赖于那几个未解的问题。`
      : verdict === "STABLE_BLUE"
        ? `在计入判定的 ${counted.length} 种候选组合下，红方胜率全部不高于 50%（${(minRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}%–${(maxRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}%）——「押蓝」这个判断不依赖于那几个未解的问题。`
        : verdict === "FLIPS"
          ? `★ 结论会**翻**：红方胜率在 ${(minRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}%–${(maxRate! * 100).toFixed(1)}% 之间随候选而变，跨越 50%。在这种局面下"押哪边"取决于尚未确定的那条规则，本工具**不建议**据此下注。`
          : "没有可判定的组合（全部候选都被标记为仅作参照），无法给出稳健性判断。";
  return {
    cells, verdict, minRate, maxRate, spread, spreadAll,
    axes: axes.map(a => a.name),
    counts: { total: cells.length, towardVerdict: counted.length, excluded },
    note: note + "（注意：这只说明「结论对这几个候选不敏感」，不等于机制已被确证 —— 机制本身仍需游戏内观测。）"
      + ((spreadAll !== null && spread !== null && Math.abs(spreadAll - spread) > 1e-9)
        ? "（判定内的极差 " + (spread * 100).toFixed(1) + " 个百分点；连同仅作参照的候选一起看是 " + (spreadAll * 100).toFixed(1) + "）"
        : ""),
  };
}

/** 把结果排成一张可读的表（CLI 与测试共用，避免两处各写一遍格式） */
export function formatSweep(r: SweepResult): string {
  const L: string[] = [];
  L.push("=== 策略敏感性扫描 ===");
  L.push("轴：" + r.axes.join(" × ") + "｜组合 " + r.counts.total + "（计入判定 " + r.counts.towardVerdict + "，仅参照 " + r.counts.excluded + "）");
  L.push("");
  for (const c of r.cells) {
    const rate = c.winRateRed === null ? "—" : (c.winRateRed * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
    const ci = c.ci95 ? "[" + (c.ci95[0] * 100).toFixed(1) + ", " + (c.ci95[1] * 100).toFixed(1) + "]" : "";
    L.push("  " + (c.countsTowardVerdict ? " " : "·") + " " + Object.values(c.combo).join(" × ").padEnd(58) + rate.padStart(7) + "  " + ci + (c.stalls ? "  卡住 " + c.stalls : ""));
  }
  L.push("");
  const sp = r.spread !== null
    ? "（判定内极差 " + (r.spread * 100).toFixed(1) + " 个百分点"
      + ((r.spreadAll !== null && Math.abs(r.spreadAll - r.spread) > 1e-9) ? "；含仅参照候选 " + (r.spreadAll * 100).toFixed(1) : "") + "）"
    : "";
  L.push("结论：" + r.verdict + sp);
  L.push(r.note);
  L.push("");
  L.push("标 · 的行含「仅作参照」的候选，不参与结论 —— 用已知有偏的候选去证明结论不稳，等于自己制造噪声。");
  return L.join("\n");
}
```

### `battle-lab/runner/replay-cli.ts`

```ts
// runner/replay-cli.ts — ★ G3：逐帧回放 CLI（a1-4.md §58）
//
// 文档要求先在命令行证明这一件事，UI 才接：
//   node replay.ts seed=12345
//   Frame 000 START
//   Frame 001 TIMELINE
//   ...
//   Frame 382 BATTLE_END
//   并且：Frame 382 state == Engine final state
//
// 用法：
//   node runner/replay-cli.ts seed=12345              跑一局并逐帧打印 + 校验
//   node runner/replay-cli.ts seed=12345 save=out.json 跑完存成 Replay 文件
//   node runner/replay-cli.ts file=out.json            **纯播放**：不装配、不执行引擎
//   node runner/replay-cli.ts file=out.json frame=137  跳到某一帧看战场状态
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch, assembleCount } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { SnapshotRecorder } from "../kernel/snapshot.ts";
import { buildReplay, loadReplay, serializeReplay, ReplayPlayer } from "../kernel/replay.ts";

const here = import.meta.dirname;
const ROOT = path.resolve(here, "..", "..");
const args = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).map(a => a.split("=") as [string, string]));

const bundle = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const ENGINE_VERSION = bundle.engineVersion, GAME_DATA_VERSION = bundle.gameDataVersion;

const pad = (n: number, w = 3) => String(n).padStart(w, "0");

function line(frame: any, state: any): string {
  const who = (id: any) => state?.teams?.flatMap((t: any) => t.members).find((m: any) => m.id === id)?.name ?? (id != null ? "#" + id : "—");
  const extra: string[] = [];
  if (frame.actor !== undefined) extra.push("actor=" + who(frame.actor));
  if (frame.target !== undefined) extra.push("target=" + who(frame.target));
  if (frame.src !== undefined && frame.dst !== undefined) extra.push(who(frame.src) + "→" + who(frame.dst));
  if (frame.skill) extra.push("skill=" + frame.skill);
  if (frame.applied !== undefined) extra.push("dmg=" + frame.applied);
  if (frame.crit) extra.push("CRIT");
  if (frame.amount !== undefined) extra.push("amount=" + frame.amount);
  if (frame.before !== undefined && frame.after !== undefined) extra.push(`orb ${frame.before}→${frame.after}`);
  if (frame.status) extra.push("status=" + frame.status);
  if (frame.id !== undefined) extra.push("unit=" + who(frame.id));
  if (frame.killer !== undefined) extra.push("killer=" + who(frame.killer));
  if (frame.hp !== undefined && frame.t !== "DAMAGE") extra.push("hp=" + Math.round(frame.hp));
  if (frame.team !== undefined) extra.push((frame.team === 0 ? "红" : "蓝") + "方回火 +" + (frame.gained ?? frame.requested ?? 0) + (frame.overflow ? `（溢出 ${frame.overflow}）` : ""));
  if (frame.percent !== undefined) extra.push(`${frame.direction === "pull" ? "拉条" : "推条"} ${(frame.percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);
  return `Frame ${pad(frame.frame)}  ${String(frame.t).padEnd(16)} ${extra.join("  ")}`;
}

// ─────────── 模式一：跑一局并录像 ───────────
if (args.seed !== undefined) {
  const seed = Number(args.seed);
  const kit = createKit(bundle);
  const a = assembleMatch(kit, canonicalMatch(), { seed });
  const rec = new SnapshotRecorder(64);
  (a.battle as any).traceLevel = "FULL";
  a.battle.recorder = rec;
  const result = await a.battle.run();
  const finalState = captureState(a.battle);

  console.log(`=== Replay seed=${seed} （${result.turns} 回合，winner=${result.winner}，${a.battle.trace.length} 帧）===`);
  const all = args.all !== undefined;
  const from = args.from !== undefined ? Number(args.from) : 0;
  const to = args.to !== undefined ? Number(args.to) : a.battle.trace.length - 1;
  const step = args.step !== undefined ? Number(args.step) : 1;
  for (let i = from; i <= to && i < a.battle.trace.length; i += step) {
    if (!all && step === 1 && a.battle.trace.length > 40 && i !== from && i !== to && i % Math.ceil(a.battle.trace.length / 30) !== 0) continue;
    console.log(line(a.battle.trace[i], finalState));
  }
  console.log(`Frame ${pad(a.battle.trace.length)}  BATTLE_END        ${result.reason}  winner=${result.winner}`);

  const replay = buildReplay(a.battle, rec, {
    engineVersion: ENGINE_VERSION, gameDataVersion: GAME_DATA_VERSION,
    matchId: canonicalMatch().id, seed, maxTurns: a.battle.rules.maxTurns,
    policyIds: {
      startup: a.battle.policies.startup.id, priority: a.battle.policies.priority, tieBreak: a.battle.policies.tieBreak,
      death: a.battle.policies.death.id, resource: a.battle.policies.resource.id, guessing: a.battle.policies.guessing.id,
    },
    red: canonicalMatch().red.units.map(u => u.name), blue: canonicalMatch().blue.units.map(u => u.name),
  }, finalState, { winner: result.winner, turns: result.turns, reason: result.reason });

  // ★ 文档的验收点：Frame N state == Engine final state
  const player = new ReplayPlayer(loadReplay(serializeReplay(replay)));
  const rebuilt = player.stateAt(rec.lastFrame);
  const okSame = JSON.stringify(rebuilt) === JSON.stringify(finalState);
  console.log(`\n[校验] Frame ${rec.lastFrame} 重建状态 == Engine 终局状态 : ${okSame ? "✓ 一致" : "✗ 不一致"}`);
  console.log(`[校验] 指纹：重建 ${rebuilt ? stateHash(rebuilt) : "null"} / 终局 ${stateHash(finalState)}`);

  if (args.save) {
    const out = path.isAbsolute(args.save) ? args.save : path.join(here, args.save);
    const json = serializeReplay(replay);
    await fs.writeFile(out, json, "utf8");
    console.log(`[保存] ${out}  ${(json.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB（${replay.frames.length} 帧 / ${replay.checkpoints.length} Checkpoint / ${replay.deltas.length} Delta / ${replay.events.length} 事件链节点）`);
  }
  if (!okSame) process.exitCode = 1;
}

// ─────────── 模式二：纯播放（不装配、不执行引擎）───────────
else if (args.file) {
  const before = assembleCount;
  const p = path.isAbsolute(args.file) ? args.file : path.join(here, args.file);
  const file = loadReplay(await fs.readFile(p, "utf8"));
  const player = new ReplayPlayer(file);
  console.log(`=== 纯播放 ${path.basename(p)}（seed=${file.match.seed}，${player.frameCount} 帧）===`);
  const frame = args.frame !== undefined ? Number(args.frame) : player.frameCount - 1;
  const state = player.stateAt(Number.isFinite(frame) ? frame : player.lastFrame);
  console.log(line({ frame, t: "(状态)", ...player.frame(Math.min(frame, player.frameCount - 1)) }, state));
  if (state) {
    for (const t of state.teams) {
      const side = t.id === 0 ? "红" : "蓝";
      const units = t.members.map((m: any) => `${m.name} ${Math.round(m.hp)}/${m.maxHp}${m.alive ? "" : "†"}`).join("  ");
      console.log(`  ${side}  鬼火 ${t.orbs.orb}  回火计数 ${t.orbs.cycle}  ${units}`);
    }
    console.log(`  该帧指纹 ${stateHash(state)}（终局指纹 ${file.finalHash}）`);
  }
  const anc = player.ancestryOfFrame(Math.min(frame, player.frameCount - 1));
  if (anc.length) console.log(`  事件链：${anc.map((n: any) => n.code + "#" + n.seq).join(" → ")}`);
  console.log(`\n[校验] 纯播放期间引擎装配次数：${before} → ${assembleCount}（必须不变，§36：回放不是第二次执行）`);
  if (assembleCount !== before) process.exitCode = 1;
}

else {
  console.log("用法：");
  console.log("  node runner/replay-cli.ts seed=12345 [all=1] [from=0] [to=100] [step=5] [save=out.replay.json]");
  console.log("  node runner/replay-cli.ts file=out.replay.json [frame=137]");
}
```

```ts
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { loadCharacter, selectSkillByAI } from "../compile/load.ts";
const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
const POL = { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED };
for (const [a, b] of [[201, 390], [212, 570]]) {
  const la = await loadCharacter(a, 0, 1), lb = await loadCharacter(b, 1, 101);
  console.log("=== " + la.entity.name + " vs " + lb.entity.name + " ===");
  for (const lc of [la, lb]) {
    console.log("  " + lc.entity.name + " AI=" + lc.ai.confidence + " 规则:" + lc.ai.skillRules.map((r:any)=>r.skill.label+"<-"+(r.condRaw||"无条件")).join(" | "));
    for (const s of lc.ir) console.log("     ["+s.name+"] cost="+s.cost+" dmg="+JSON.stringify(s.damage.map((x:any)=>x.ratio+"%"+x.type))+" hits="+s.hits+" heal="+s.heal.length+" shield="+s.shield.length+" conf="+s.confidence);
  }
  const t0 = new Team(0,"R",R,1), t1 = new Team(1,"B",R,1); t0.add(la.entity); t1.add(lb.entity);
  const bt = new Battle([t0,t1], { seed: 1, rules: {...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 400}, policies: POL });
  bt.skillSelector = (x,y,z) => selectSkillByAI(x,y,z);
  await bt.run();
  const used: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const rec of bt.turnLog) used[rec.skill ?? "(none)"] = (used[rec.skill ?? "(none)"] ?? 0) + 1;
  console.log("  回合 " + bt.turn + " | 技能使用: " + JSON.stringify(used) + " | 伤害事件 " + bt.trace.filter((x:any)=>x.t==="DAMAGE").length + " | 剩余HP " + la.entity.hp.toFixed(0) + "/" + lb.entity.hp.toFixed(0));
}
```

### `battle-lab/runner/stall-survey.ts`

```ts
// runner/stall-survey.ts — 全量卡住率普查（修正 M1 报告中"膀胱局"的归因）
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import { Entity } from "../kernel/entity.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { loadCharacter, selectSkillByAI } from "../compile/load.ts";
const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
const POL = { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED };
const cache = new Map<number, any>();
async function clone(id: number, team: number, ent: number) {
  if (!cache.has(id)) cache.set(id, await loadCharacter(id, 0, 1));
  const b = cache.get(id);
  const e = new Entity(ent, b.entity.name, team, { ...b.entity.base });
  e.skills = b.entity.skills; return e;
}
async function tm(ids: number[], t: number, s: number) {
  const x = new Team(t, t === 0 ? "RED" : "BLUE", R, 1);
  let i = s; for (const id of ids) x.add(await clone(id, t, i++));
  return x;
}
async function run(red: number[], blue: number[], n: number, maxTurns = 500) {
  let stall = 0, r0 = 0, r1 = 0;
  for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) {
    const bt = new Battle([await tm(red, 0, 1), await tm(blue, 1, 101)], { seed: 400000 + s, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns }, policies: POL });
    bt.skillSelector = (b, a, e) => selectSkillByAI(b, a, e);
    const res = await bt.run();
    if (res.reason === "TURN_LIMIT") stall++; else if (res.winner === 0) r0++; else if (res.winner === 1) r1++;
  }
  return { stall, r0, r1, winRate: r0 + r1 ? r0 / (r0 + r1) : null };
}
const pool = [236, 201, 212, 246, 307, 347, 385, 390, 396, 555, 570, 571];
console.log("=== 1v1 全组合卡住率普查（每对 20 局，maxTurns=500）===");
let totalStall = 0, total = 0, worst: any[] = [];
for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < pool.length; j++) {
  const r = await run([pool[i]], [pool[j]], 20);
  totalStall += r.stall; total += 20;
  if (r.stall > 0) worst.push({ pair: pool[i] + "v" + pool[j], ...r });
}
console.log("总卡住率: " + totalStall + "/" + total + " = " + ((totalStall / total) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%");
if (worst.length) { console.log("有卡住的组合:"); for (const w of worst.sort((a,b)=>b.stall-a.stall).slice(0,8)) console.log("  " + w.pair + " 卡住 " + w.stall + "/20 红胜率 " + (w.winRate===null?"N/A":(w.winRate*100).toFixed(1)+"%")); }
else console.log("  无任何组合卡住");
console.log("\n=== 3v3 辅助阵容（原先 100% 卡住的那组）===");
const r3 = await run([201, 212, 236], [246, 307, 347], 30, 500);
console.log("  卡住 " + r3.stall + "/30  红胜 " + r3.r0 + " 蓝胜 " + r3.r1 + " 红胜率 " + (r3.winRate===null?"N/A":(r3.winRate*100).toFixed(1)+"%"));
```

### `battle-lab/capability/registry.ts`

```ts
// capability/registry.ts — 把官方 48 类技能 tags 提升为引擎能力清单
// tags[] 来自 data/kb/shikigami.full.json 的每条技能（游戏自己的分类）
// support: FULL=已实现  PARTIAL=Schema有但行为未实测  NONE=未实现
export interface Capability {
  tag: string; key: string; support: "FULL" | "PARTIAL" | "NONE";
  evidence: "OFFICIAL" | "SPEC" | "DATA" | "NONE";
  note: string;
  /**
   * ★ 生产者：一段**必须在生产代码里出现**的正则（定义处不算，要有真正的调用路径）。
   * 有了它，这张表就从「一份声明」变成「一份可被机器证伪的声明」：
   *   support=FULL  ⇒ producer 必须能在生产代码里匹配到（tests/g22 强制）
   *   support=NONE  ⇒ 若给了 producer，则它必须**匹配不到**
   * 没写 producer 的条目会在测试输出里如实列出（不是静默通过）。
   */
  producer?: string;
}

export const CAPABILITIES: Capability[] = [
  { tag: "伤害",   key: "DAMAGE",         support: "FULL",    evidence: "OFFICIAL", note: "5 种伤害类型 + 300/(300+def)，官方[5][12][18][28]", producer: "dealDamage" },
  { tag: "增伤",   key: "DMG_UP",         support: "PARTIAL", evidence: "DATA",     note: "effects 折叠已支持，叠层规则未实测", producer: "dealtBuff" },
  { tag: "控制",   key: "CONTROL",        support: "FULL",    evidence: "OFFICIAL", note: "官方[3] 16 种 + 能力矩阵", producer: "preventsAction" },

];

export function coverage() {
  const total = CAPABILITIES.length;
  const by = (s: string) => CAPABILITIES.filter(c => c.support === s).length;
  const full = by("FULL"), partial = by("PARTIAL"), none = by("NONE");
  return {
    total, full, partial, none,
    kernelCoverage: +(((full + partial * 0.5) / total) * 100).toFixed(1),
    hardCoverage: +((full / total) * 100).toFixed(1),
    unsupported: CAPABILITIES.filter(c => c.support === "NONE").map(c => c.key),
  };
}
```

### `battle-lab/capability/report.ts`

```ts
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { CAPABILITIES, coverage } from "./registry.ts";

const KB = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json");
const shiki = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(KB, "utf8"));
const tagFreq: Record<string, number> = {};
for (const s of shiki) for (const sk of s.skills) for (const t of sk.tags ?? []) tagFreq[t] = (tagFreq[t] ?? 0) + 1;

const rows = CAPABILITIES.map(c => ({ ...c, freq: tagFreq[c.tag] ?? 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.freq - a.freq);
const cov = coverage();
const icon = (s: string) => (s === "FULL" ? "FULL" : s === "PARTIAL" ? "PARTIAL" : "NONE");

const L: string[] = [];
L.push("# Capability Coverage — 引擎能力覆盖率", "");
L.push("以游戏自身的技能 tags[]（48 类）为基准，而不是自定的功能清单。", "");
L.push("| 能力 | 官方tag频次 | 引擎支持 | 机制来源 | 生产者（须在生产代码中匹配到） | 说明 |", "|---|---:|---|---|---|---|");
for (const r of rows) L.push("| " + r.key + " | " + r.freq + " | " + icon(r.support) + " | " + r.evidence + " | " + (r.producer ? "`" + r.producer + "`" : (r.support === "FULL" ? "**缺失（FULL 却没有生产者）**" : "—")) + " | " + r.note + " |");
L.push("", "## 汇总", "");
L.push("- 能力总数: **" + cov.total + "**");
L.push("- FULL: " + cov.full);
L.push("- PARTIAL: " + cov.partial);
L.push("- NONE: " + cov.none);
L.push("- **Kernel Coverage = " + cov.kernelCoverage + "%**（PARTIAL 按 0.5 计）");
L.push("- Hard Coverage = " + cov.hardCoverage + "%（只算 FULL）");
L.push("", "未支持能力: " + cov.unsupported.join(", "));
L.push("", "> 这是**内核能力**覆盖率，不是实现了多少式神。M1 装载真实式神后应重新统计。");
L.push("> ");
L.push("> **这不是「真实性 / 准确率」** —— 没有依据把覆盖率线性映射成预测准确率（见 HealthCheck 的同一句声明）。");
L.push("> 「生产者」一列由 tests/g22-capability-claims.ts 强制：FULL 的能力必须能在**生产代码**里匹配到");
L.push("> 那个正则；匹配不到就说明这句声明比代码乐观。tests / tools / experiments 都**不算**生产代码 ——");
L.push("> 否则脚手架会把自己的缺口掩盖掉（第 28 轮：封印的抑制集合只有 experiments 会写）。");

const out = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "coverage.md");
await fs.writeFile(out, L.join("\n"), "utf8");
await fs.writeFile(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "coverage.json"), JSON.stringify({ cov, rows }, null, 1), "utf8");
console.log(L.slice(L.length - 12).join("\n"));
```

### `battle-lab/experiments/definitions.ts`

```ts
// experiments/definitions.ts — 44 个红区实验
// 原则：每个实验只改一个变量。
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { DamageType, TurnType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { makeTeam, wireDummy } from "../dummy/dummy.ts";
import type { Experiment } from "./runner.ts";

const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;

function lab(seed: number, teams: any, extra: any = {}) {
  const [a, b] = teams;
  const bt = new Battle([a.team, b.team], {
    seed, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 200 },
    policies: {
      resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
      death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
      tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED, ...extra,
    },
  });
  for (const e of [...a.entities, ...b.entities]) wireDummy(bt, e);
  return bt;
}
const stdTeams = (hooksA: any = {}, hooksB: any = {}, stats: any = {}) => {
  const a = makeTeam(0, "RED", [
    { name: "R1", hp: 20000, atk: 1000, def: 300, spd: 120, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 500 }], hooks: hooksA },
    { name: "R2", hp: 20000, atk: 900, def: 300, spd: 100, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 500 }] },
  ], R, 0);
  const b = makeTeam(1, "BLUE", [
    { name: "B1", hp: 20000, atk: 1000, def: 300, spd: 110, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 500 }], hooks: hooksB },
    { name: "B2", hp: 20000, atk: 900, def: 300, spd: 100, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 500 }] },
  ], R, 100);
  return [a, b];
};

export const EXPERIMENTS: Experiment[] = [
  // ---------------- A 开局结算顺序 ----------------
  {
    id: "A01", group: "A", question: "两个「先机」之间谁先结算？",
    inGameObservation: "双方各带一个开局生效的 buff，观察第一回合开始前谁的效果先出现（战斗日志/状态栏出现顺序）",
    hypotheses: [
```

### `battle-lab/experiments/groups-bcd.ts`

```ts
// experiments/groups-bcd.ts — B / C / D 三组红区实验
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { DamageType, StatusCategory } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { makeTeam, wireDummy } from "../dummy/dummy.ts";
import type { Experiment } from "./runner.ts";

const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
function lab(seed: number, teams: any, extra: any = {}) {
  const [a, b] = teams;
  const bt = new Battle([a.team, b.team], {
    seed, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 200, ...(extra.rules ?? {}) },
    policies: { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED, ...extra },
  });
  for (const e of [...a.entities, ...b.entities]) wireDummy(bt, e);
  return bt;
}
const two = (hA: any = {}, hB: any = {}, st: any = {}) => {
  const a = makeTeam(0, "RED", [{ name: "R1", hp: st.hpA ?? 20000, atk: st.atkA ?? 1000, def: 300, spd: st.spdA ?? 120, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: st.base ?? 500 }], hooks: hA }], R, 0);
  const b = makeTeam(1, "BLUE", [{ name: "B1", hp: st.hpB ?? 20000, atk: 1000, def: 300, spd: st.spdB ?? 110, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: st.base ?? 500 }], hooks: hB }], R, 100);
  return [a, b];
};

export const EXPERIMENTS_BCD: Experiment[] = [
  // ---------------- B 同时触发优先级 ----------------

    id: "B01", group: "B", question: "同一次伤害：攻击方御魂 与 防守方被动 谁先？",

                 { id: "DEFENDER_FIRST", note: "受击方的效果先结算", apply: p => { p.priority = "OTHER_SIDE_FIRST"; } }],
    run: async (p) => {
      const order: string[] = [];
      const a = makeTeam(0, "RED", [{ name: "R1", skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 100 }], hooks: { passive: [(bt: any, s: any) => bt.bus.register({ id: s.id + ":atkSoul", ownerId: s.id, code: "DAMAGE", range: "SELF", priority: 10, passive: false, fn: () => order.push("ATK") })] } }], R, 0);
      const b = makeTeam(1, "BLUE", [{ name: "B1", hp: 99999, skills: [{ name: "普攻", base: 1 }], hooks: { passive: [(bt: any, s: any) => bt.bus.register({ id: s.id + ":defPas", ownerId: s.id, code: "DAMAGE", range: "ENEMY", priority: 10, passive: false, fn: () => order.push("DEF") })] } }], R, 100);
      const bt = lab(11, [a, b], p);
      await bt.runStartup();
      const s = a.entities[0], t = b.entities[0];

    hypotheses: [{ id: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", note: "注册顺序", apply: p => { p.priority = "REGISTRATION_ORDER"; } },

    hypotheses: [

      { id: "COMMUNITY_2020", note: "按 2020 攻略假设存在阶梯增伤（未验证）", apply: (p: any) => { p.guessing = { ...GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED, id: "COMMUNITY_2020", stalemate: { damageRamp: null, healingReductionRamp: null, startTurn: 10 } }; } },

];
```

```ts
import path from "node:path";
import { runAll } from "./runner.ts";
import { EXPERIMENTS } from "./definitions.ts";
import { EXPERIMENTS_BCD } from "./groups-bcd.ts";

const all = [...EXPERIMENTS, ...EXPERIMENTS_BCD];
const outDir = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "results");
const results = await runAll(all, outDir);

const byGroup: Record<string, { total: number; discriminating: number }> = {};
for (const r of results) {
  byGroup[r.group] ??= { total: 0, discriminating: 0 };
  byGroup[r.group].total++;
  if (r.discriminating) byGroup[r.group].discriminating++;
}
console.log("=== 红区实验台结果 ===");
console.log("实验总数:", results.length);
for (const [g, v] of Object.entries(byGroup)) console.log(`  组 ${g}: ${v.total} 个，其中 ${v.discriminating} 个能区分候选假设`);
const hyp = results.filter(r => r.kind !== "CONFORMANCE");
console.log("可区分比例（仅假设检验类 " + hyp.length + " 个）:", (hyp.filter(r => r.discriminating).length / hyp.length * 100).toFixed(1) + "%");
console.log("官方一致性校验（单假设）:", results.length - hyp.length, "个");
console.log("已确证(RESOLVED):", results.filter(r => r.status === "RESOLVED").length, "  ← 必须做游戏内观测才能变为 RESOLVED");
console.log("输出目录:", outDir);
```

### `battle-lab/experiments/runner.ts`

```ts
// experiments/runner.ts — 红区实验框架
// 目的不是"记录谁快"，而是：对每个候选假设各跑一遍实验室，
// 输出【判别性观测】（discriminating observable）——即"在游戏里看到 X 就是 H1，看到 Y 就是 H2"。
// 真正的一手观测必须来自游戏；本框架负责把观测成本降到最低。
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

export interface Experiment {
  id: string;
  group: "A" | "B" | "C" | "D";
  question: string;
  /** 每个候选假设：名字 + 如何配置实验室 */
  hypotheses: Array<{ id: string; note: string; apply?: (p: any) => void }>;
  /** 跑一次实验室并返回可观测结果 */
  run: (policies: any) => Promise<any>;
  /** 在游戏里应该看什么 */
  inGameObservation: string;
}

export interface ExperimentResult {
  experiment: string;
  group: string;
  question: string;
  inGameObservation: string;
  hypotheses: Array<{ id: string; note: string; observable: any }>;
  /** 候选假设之间是否产生可区分的结果 */
  discriminating: boolean;
  /** CONFORMANCE = 单假设的官方一致性校验（不参与可判别率统计） */
  kind?: "HYPOTHESIS_TEST" | "CONFORMANCE";
  distinctObservables: number;
  confidence: "NOT_RUN" | "LOW" | "HIGH";
  status: "AWAITING_IN_GAME_OBSERVATION" | "RESOLVED";
  chosenHypothesis: string | null;
  gameVersion: string;
  recordedAt: string;
}

export async function runExperiment(e: Experiment): Promise<ExperimentResult> {
  const hypotheses = [];
  for (const h of e.hypotheses) {
    const policies: any = {};
    if (h.apply) h.apply(policies);
    let observable: any;
    try { observable = await e.run(policies); }
    catch (err: any) { observable = { error: String(err?.message ?? err) }; }
    hypotheses.push({ id: h.id, note: h.note, observable });
  }
  const keys = new Set(hypotheses.map(h => JSON.stringify(h.observable)));
  return {
    experiment: e.id, group: e.group, question: e.question,
    inGameObservation: e.inGameObservation,
    hypotheses,
    discriminating: keys.size > 1,
    distinctObservables: keys.size,
    kind: e.hypotheses.length === 1 ? "CONFORMANCE" : "HYPOTHESIS_TEST",
    confidence: "NOT_RUN",
    status: "AWAITING_IN_GAME_OBSERVATION",
    chosenHypothesis: null,
    gameVersion: "2026.10 (Data 快照)",
    recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function runAll(experiments: Experiment[], outDir: string) {
  await fs.mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });
  const results: ExperimentResult[] = [];
  for (const e of experiments) {
    const r = await runExperiment(e);
    results.push(r);
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(outDir, `${e.id}.json`), JSON.stringify(r, null, 1), "utf8");
  }
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(outDir, "_all.json"), JSON.stringify(results, null, 1), "utf8");
  // verified-rules.json —— 只放已确证的规则，未跑的实验不放进来
  const verified = results.filter(r => r.status === "RESOLVED");
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(outDir, "..", "verified-rules.json"), JSON.stringify({
    _note: "仅包含 status=RESOLVED 的规则。所有 AWAITING_IN_GAME_OBSERVATION 的实验结果禁止用于产出胜率。",
    rules: verified,
  }, null, 1), "utf8");
  return results;
}
```

### `battle-lab/dummy/dummy.ts`

```ts
// dummy/dummy.ts — 可任意配置的 Dummy：制造控制变量实验，不模拟真实式神
import { Entity, EntityType } from "../kernel/entity.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { DamageType, EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import type { ResourcePolicy } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import type { Battle } from "../kernel/battle.ts";

export interface DummyHooks {
  senki?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
  passive?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
  soulStart?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
  onDeath?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity, killerId: number) => void>;
  onTurnStart?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
  onTurnEnd?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
  onLethal?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity, hook: { prevented: boolean }) => void>;
  onKilled?: Array<(b: Battle, self: Entity) => void>;
}

export interface DummySkillSpec {
  name: string; cost?: number; base?: number; rate?: number; type?: DamageType;
  heal?: number; healSelf?: boolean; recover?: boolean; loseHpTarget?: number;
  applyStatus?: string; statusDuration?: number; priorityPick?: (t: Entity[]) => Entity | undefined;
}

export interface DummyConfig {
  name: string; hp?: number; atk?: number; def?: number; spd?: number;
  cri?: number; crid?: number; team?: number; id?: number;
  skills?: DummySkillSpec[]; hooks?: DummyHooks; caps?: Partial<Entity["caps"]>;
  type?: EntityType;
}

export function makeDummy(cfg: DummyConfig, id: number, teamId: number): Entity {
  const e = new Entity(id, cfg.name, teamId, {
    hp: cfg.hp ?? 10000, atk: cfg.atk ?? 1000, def: cfg.def ?? 300,
    spd: cfg.spd ?? 100, cri: cfg.cri ?? 0, crid: cfg.crid ?? 1.5,
    dmgTakenB: 0, dmgTakenD: 0, healDown: 0,
  });
  if (cfg.type) e.type = cfg.type;
  if (cfg.caps) e.caps = { ...e.caps, ...cfg.caps };

  const h = cfg.hooks ?? {};
  // ★ 第 57 轮删掉了一个**从未被调用**的 reg 助手 —— 它的 id 里带着 Math.random()。
  //   死代码不执行，但 handler id 会进 BattleState（kernel/state.ts 的 busHandlers），
  //   留着它等于在"唯一入口"旁边摆一把上了膛的枪：谁哪天接上一根线就把不确定性带回来了。
  //   真正在用的是下面 wireDummy() 的 mk()，它的 id 是确定性的 `<实体id>:<code>:<range>`。

  e.skills = (cfg.skills ?? [{ name: "普攻", cost: 0, base: 1000, rate: 1, type: DamageType.NORMAL }]).map((s, i) => ({
    name: s.name, cost: s.cost ?? 0, selectable: true,
    pickTarget: s.priorityPick ?? ((_b: Battle, _a: Entity, enemies: Entity[]) => enemies[0]),
    execute: async (b: Battle, self: Entity, target: Entity) => {
      // 泛鬼火支付
      const cost = s.cost ?? 0;
      if (cost > 0 && !b.teams[self.teamId].orbs.pay(cost)) {
        const basic = self.skills.find((x: any) => (x.cost ?? 0) === 0);
        if (basic && basic !== self.skills[i]) { await basic.execute(b, self, target); return; }
        return;
      }
      if (s.base !== undefined) await b.damage(self, target, s.base, s.type ?? DamageType.NORMAL, s.rate ?? 1);
      if (s.loseHpTarget) b.lose(target, s.loseHpTarget);
      if (s.heal) await b.heal(self, s.healSelf ? self : target, s.heal, { recover: s.recover ?? false });
      if (s.applyStatus) {
        const def = StatusBook.get(s.applyStatus);
        if (def) target.addStatus(def, self.id, 1, s.statusDuration ?? 1);
      }
    },
  }));

  e.notes.push(JSON.stringify({ hooks: Object.keys(h) }));
  // 开局钩子（注册为 SENKI / BATTLE_START / 御魂 / 被动 四类，供 A 组实验区分先后）
  (e as any)._hooks = h;
  return e;
}

/** 把 Dummy 的 hooks 挂到 EventBus 上（顺序由 startup policy 决定） */
export function wireDummy(b: Battle, e: Entity): void {
  const h: DummyHooks = (e as any)._hooks ?? {};
  const mk = (code: string, fn: (ctx: any) => void, priority = 0, passive = false, range: string = "SELF") =>
    b.bus.register({ id: `${e.id}:${code}:${range}`, ownerId: e.id, code, range: range as any, priority, passive, fn });

  for (const f of h.senki ?? []) mk(EV.SENKI, () => f(b, e), 100);
  for (const f of h.soulStart ?? []) mk(EV.SOUL_START, () => f(b, e), 50);
  for (const f of h.passive ?? []) mk(EV.PASSIVE_START, () => f(b, e), 50, true);
  for (const f of h.onTurnStart ?? []) mk(EV.TURN_START, () => f(b, e), 10);
  for (const f of h.onTurnEnd ?? []) mk(EV.TURN_END, () => f(b, e), 10);
  for (const f of h.onDeath ?? []) mk(EV.DEATH, () => f(b, e, (b as any).__lastKiller ?? -1), 10);
  // ★ 第 91 轮：这三个此前都是**裸字符串**，打错字不会报错、只会永远不触发。
  for (const f of h.onLethal ?? []) mk(EV.LETHAL, (ctx: any) => f(b, e, ctx), 10);
  for (const f of h.onKilled ?? []) mk(EV.KILLED, () => f(b, e), 10);
  // DEATH_PREVENTION 拦截点
  const anyHook = h.onLethal ?? [];
  void anyHook;
}

/** 便捷：造一支全 Dummy 队伍 */
export function makeTeam(teamId: number, name: string, cfgs: DummyConfig[], resource: ResourcePolicy, startId: number): { team: Team; entities: Entity[] } {
  const team = new Team(teamId, name, resource, 1);
  const entities: Entity[] = [];
  cfgs.forEach((c, i) => { const e = makeDummy(c, startId + i, teamId); team.add(e); entities.push(e); });
  return { team, entities };
}
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g0-state.ts`

```ts
// tests/g0-state.ts — ★ G0 验收：BattleState 收口（a1-4.md §55）
//
// 文档给的标准是一句话：
//   暂停战斗 → 保存 state → 杀掉 Engine → 重新加载 → 可以继续完全相同地战斗。
//
// 本测试把这句话拆成可执行断言：
//   ① 捕获的状态是**纯数据**（JSON 往返后指纹不变、零函数、零 Map/Set）
//   ② 续跑与连续跑**逐位一致**（胜者/回合/结束原因/事件数/最终状态指纹）
//   ③ 真的"杀掉 Engine"：旧实例被丢弃，用另一份 kit 重建
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch, runtimeFor, attachRuntime } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, restoreBattle, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import type { BattleState } from "../kernel/state.ts";

const here = import.meta.dirname;
const ROOT = path.resolve(here, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);

const SEED = 20261001;
const PAUSE_AT = 20;      // 第 20 回合暂停

/** 运行时工厂：与 assembleMatch 用的是同一份 buildCharacter（因此不是"另写一套恢复逻辑"） */
function makeDeps(kit: any) {
  // 与装配路径同源：runtimeFor 内部就是 assembleMatch 用的那份 buildCharacter + 缓存
  return { kit, makeRuntime: (shikigamiId: number) => runtimeFor(kit, shikigamiId), attachRuntime };
}

// ── 参照组：一口气跑完 ──
const kitA = createKit(bundle);
const a = assembleMatch(kitA, canonicalMatch(), { seed: SEED });
const refResult = await a.battle.run();
const refState = captureState(a.battle);
const refHash = stateHash(refState);
console.log(`参照：${refResult.turns} 回合 winner=${refResult.winner} reason=${refResult.reason} trace=${a.battle.trace.length} hash=${refHash}`);

sec("[1] 捕获的状态必须是纯数据");
const json = JSON.stringify(refState);
const roundTrip = JSON.parse(json) as BattleState;
ok("JSON 往返成功", json.length > 0, `${(json.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`);
ok("★ 往返后指纹不变（无损）", stateHash(roundTrip) === refHash, `${stateHash(roundTrip)} vs ${refHash}`);
const fnCount = (json.match(/"\s*:\s*undefined/g) ?? []).length;
ok("序列化结果里没有 undefined 字段", fnCount === 0, String(fnCount));
ok("★ 没有任何 Map/Set/类实例（全被投影成纯数据）", !/\[object (Map|Set)\]/.test(json));
ok("实体身份（shikigamiId）在状态里", roundTrip.teams[0].members.every(m => m.shikigamiId !== null));
ok("随机数发生器内部状态已入档（s/n，不是只有 seed）", typeof roundTrip.rng.s === "number" && typeof roundTrip.rng.n === "number" && roundTrip.rng.n > 0, JSON.stringify(roundTrip.rng));
// 注意：死亡单位会从行动条移除（Battle.kill），所以终局时条上只剩存活者 —— 4 条是正确的，不是漏记
ok("行动条位置逐条入档（终局只剩存活者）", roundTrip.timeline.entries.length > 0 && roundTrip.timeline.entries.length <= 10, String(roundTrip.timeline.entries.length));
ok("存活者数量与行动条条目一致", roundTrip.timeline.entries.length === refState.teams.reduce((n, t) => n + t.members.filter(m => m.alive).length, 0), JSON.stringify(roundTrip.timeline.entries.map(e => e.id)));
ok("六条红区策略 id 全部入档", Object.values(roundTrip.policyIds).every(Boolean), JSON.stringify(roundTrip.policyIds));

sec(`[2] 暂停在第 ${PAUSE_AT} 回合 → 捕获 → 杀掉引擎 → 重建 → 续跑`);
const kitB = createKit(bundle);                       // 全新的运行时
const bAssembled = assembleMatch(kitB, canonicalMatch(), { seed: SEED });
await bAssembled.battle.runStartup();                  // 先跑开局流水线（建立御魂 handler / 行动条）
await bAssembled.battle.runPartial(PAUSE_AT);          // 推进到第 20 回合
const mid = captureState(bAssembled.battle);
console.log(`暂停点：turn=${mid.turn} rng.n=${mid.rng.n} trace=${bAssembled.battle.trace.length}`);
ok("确实停在了指定回合（不是一口气跑完）", mid.turn === PAUSE_AT && bAssembled.battle.winner === null, `turn=${mid.turn} winner=${bAssembled.battle.winner}`);

const saved = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mid)) as BattleState;   // 存盘：只剩字符串
// 杀掉引擎：丢弃 kitB 与旧 Battle，全部重新来过
const kitC = createKit(bundle);
const restored = restoreBattle(saved, makeDeps(kitC) as any);
ok("重建后回合数与存盘一致", restored.turn === saved.turn, `${restored.turn} vs ${saved.turn}`);
ok("重建后随机数位置一致（否则下一次抽数就分叉）", (restored.rng.snapshot(false) as any).s === saved.rng.s && (restored.rng.snapshot(false) as any).n === saved.rng.n);
ok("重建后行动条位置一致", JSON.stringify(restored.timeline.all().map(e => [e.id, Math.round(e.pos)]).sort()) === JSON.stringify(saved.timeline.entries.map(e => [e.id, Math.round(e.pos)]).sort()));
const needMore = await restored.runPartial(Infinity);
// runPartial 返回的是"还要不要继续"（boolean），胜者/回合要读战斗自身 —— 别把返回值当结果对象
const resumed = { winner: restored.winner, turns: restored.turn, reason: restored.endReason, needMore };
console.log(`续跑后：needMore=${needMore} turn=${resumed.turns} winner=${resumed.winner} reason=${resumed.reason} trace=${restored.trace.length}`);

sec("[3] ★ 续跑结果必须与连续跑逐位一致");
ok(`胜者一致（${resumed.winner}）`, resumed.winner === refResult.winner, `${resumed.winner} vs ${refResult.winner}`);
ok(`回合数一致（${resumed.turns}）`, resumed.turns === refResult.turns, `${resumed.turns} vs ${refResult.turns}`);
ok(`结束原因一致（${resumed.reason}）`, resumed.reason === refResult.reason, `${resumed.reason} vs ${refResult.reason}`);
// 续跑的战斗从空日志开始，因此它应当复现的是"暂停点之后"的那一段事件，且必须逐条一致
const postPauseRef = a.battle.trace.slice(mid.counts.trace);
ok(`★ 暂停后事件逐条一致（${restored.trace.length} 条）`, JSON.stringify(restored.trace) === JSON.stringify(postPauseRef),
   `resumed=${restored.trace.length} expected=${postPauseRef.length}`);
ok("回合日志也逐条一致", JSON.stringify(restored.turnLog) === JSON.stringify(a.battle.turnLog.slice(mid.counts.turnLog)), `${restored.turnLog.length} vs ${a.battle.turnLog.length - mid.counts.turnLog}`);
const finalHash = stateHash(captureState(restored));
ok(`★ 最终核心状态指纹一致`, finalHash === refHash, `${finalHash} vs ${refHash}`);

sec("[4] 复现性：同一个 seed 跑两次必须完全一样（State Hash 的意义）");
const a2 = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: SEED });
await a2.battle.run();
ok("两次独立运行的最终指纹相同", stateHash(captureState(a2.battle)) === refHash);

console.log(`\n=== G0: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g1-event-queue.ts`

```ts
// tests/g1-event-queue.ts — ★ G1 验收：事件队列标准化（a1-4.md §20、§26-28、§43、§56）
//
// 文档要求（§56）：
//   skill / passive / soul / status 里不许再"直接调用另一个 skill / 直接改 HP / 直接改 speed"，
//   要逐渐迁移成 Effect → EventQueue → Resolver，否则 Theater 永远会漏事件。
//
// 本测试把"漏事件"变成可执行断言：
//   ① 每一条 trace 都知道自己属于哪个事件（frame / ev / depth），事件有 Parent/Root 链
//   ② 技能释放的每个子步骤都在事件流里可见（扣火/拉条/护盾/上状态/回火/退回普攻）
//   ③ 递归保护真的会生效（超深链不炸栈，且**留痕**而不是静默吞掉）
//   ④ 守恒不变量成立（鬼火收支、HP 不为负、死亡与血量自洽）
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);

const kit = createKit(bundle);
const a = assembleMatch(kit, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
await a.battle.run();
const trace = a.battle.trace as any[];
const chain = a.battle.bus.chain as any[];
const byCode = (c: string) => trace.filter(e => e.t === c);

sec("[1] 事件链完整性（§28 Event 必须有 Parent/Root）");
ok(`事件链有 ${chain.length} 个节点`, chain.length > 50);
ok("每个节点都有 seq/parent/root/depth", chain.every(n => typeof n.seq === "number" && typeof n.root === "number" && typeof n.depth === "number" && (n.parent === null || typeof n.parent === "number")));
ok("根节点的 parent 为 null", chain.filter(n => n.parent === null).length >= 1);
ok("★ 每个节点的 root 指向一个真实存在的根", chain.every(n => { const r = chain.find(x => x.seq === n.root); return !!r && r.parent === null; }));
ok("★ 祖先回溯能一路走到根（无断链）：ancestry() 返回根在前", chain.every(n => {
  const anc = a.battle.bus.ancestry(n.seq);
  return anc.length >= 1 && anc[0].seq === n.root && anc[anc.length - 1].seq === n.seq && anc[0].parent === null;
}));
ok("子节点列表与 parent 相互一致", chain.every(n => n.children.every((c: number) => chain.find(x => x.seq === c)?.parent === n.seq)));
ok("★ 存在真正的事件嵌套（每个回合是一个 TURN 节点，内部事件挂在它下面）", chain.some(n => n.depth > 0), "最深 " + Math.max(...chain.map(n => n.depth)));
ok("TURN 节点数量 = 实际回合数", chain.filter(n => n.code === "TURN").length === a.battle.turn, `${chain.filter(n => n.code === "TURN").length} vs ${a.battle.turn}`);
ok("★ TURN 的子节点就是该回合内部的真实事件", chain.filter(n => n.code === "TURN").every(n => n.children.length >= 1));

sec("[2] 每条 trace 都能归属到事件（Theater 靠这个定位）");
ok("trace 全部带 frame/ev/depth", trace.every(e => typeof e.frame === "number" && typeof e.depth === "number" && (e.ev === null || typeof e.ev === "number")));
ok("帧号连续且唯一（0..N-1）", trace.every((e, i) => e.frame === i), `${trace.length} 帧`);
ok("★ 非根事件的 trace 都能找到对应事件节点", trace.filter(e => e.ev !== null).every(e => chain.some(n => n.seq === e.ev)));
const owned = trace.filter(e => e.ev !== null).length;
ok("★ 绝大部分 trace 归属于某个事件（不是游离的日志）", owned / trace.length > 0.95, `${owned}/${trace.length}`);
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 244 轮按事实改写：规格 §60 的两端（`BATTLE_START` / `BATTLE_END`）是**战斗级**标记 ——
   *   它们合理地为 `ev === null`（不属于任何父事件），而 `BATTLE_END` 出现在**末帧**，
   *   于是原来那条「游离帧必须落在前 8 帧内」的判据不再成立（实测：游离帧恰好就是这两个）。
   * 判据改成**具名**、而且比原来更严：游离帧只允许是这两个战斗级标记，别的任何游离帧都要报出来。
   * 「如实标记、不许硬塞假父节点」这条意图一个字没丢。
   */
  const FREE_OK = new Set(["BATTLE_START", "BATTLE_END"]);
  const freeBad = trace.filter((e: any) => e.ev === null && !FREE_OK.has(String(e.t)));
  ok("★ 游离帧只能是**具名的战斗级标记**（BATTLE_START / BATTLE_END），其余一律报出来",
    freeBad.length === 0, JSON.stringify(trace.filter((e: any) => e.ev === null).map((e: any) => [e.frame, e.t]).slice(0, 12)));

sec("[3] 以前看不见的步骤，现在都在事件流里（§15/§16/§17/§56）");
ok(`SKILL_CAST 事件存在（${byCode("SKILL_CAST").length} 条）`, byCode("SKILL_CAST").length > 20);
ok(`ORB_PAY 扣火事件存在（${byCode("ORB_PAY").length} 条）`, byCode("ORB_PAY").length > 0);
// 回火必然发生：鬼火条推进到满格就回火（技能给火 ORB_GAIN 或周期回火 ORB_REWARD 至少有一种）
  ok(`回火事件存在（技能给火 ${byCode("ORB_GAIN").length} 条 / 周期回火 ${byCode("ORB_REWARD").length} 条）`, byCode("ORB_GAIN").length + byCode("ORB_REWARD").length >= 1);
ok(`STATUS_APPLY 上状态事件存在（${byCode("STATUS_APPLY").length} 条）`, byCode("STATUS_APPLY").length > 0);
ok("SKILL_CAST 与行动日志一一对应", byCode("SKILL_CAST").length === a.battle.turnLog.filter(t => t.skill).length,
   `${byCode("SKILL_CAST").length} vs ${a.battle.turnLog.filter(t => t.skill).length}`);
const fallbacks = byCode("SKILL_FALLBACK");
ok(`★ 技能调用技能（鬼火不足退回普攻）已被**显式记录**（${fallbacks.length} 次）`, fallbacks.every(f => f.reason === "ORB_SHORT" && typeof f.need === "number"));
if (fallbacks.length) {
  const idx = trace.indexOf(fallbacks[0]);
  const after = trace.slice(idx, idx + 3).some(e => e.t === "SKILL_CAST" && e.skill === fallbacks[0].fallback);
  ok("退回普攻确实跟着一次真实施放（不是只有一行日志）", after, JSON.stringify(trace.slice(idx, idx + 3).map(e => e.t)));
} else {
  // 典型对局可能整场鬼火都够用；这条断言只是"若有则必须自洽"，无则跳过不算失败
  ok("本次对局未触发鬼火不足（该断言的前提不成立，不算失败）", true);
}
ok("拉条/推条事件带前后位置（Theater 行动条要用）", byCode("TIMELINE_SHIFT").every(e => e.posBefore !== null && e.posAfter !== null));
ok("护盾事件带数值", byCode("SHIELD_APPLY").every(e => typeof e.value === "number"));

sec("[4] 递归保护（§27 不要递归爆栈）");
// 真实对局里嵌套深度有限，所以用一个**合成深链**来证明保护真的生效（而不是靠运气）
{
  const kit2 = createKit(bundle);
  const b = assembleMatch(kit2, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const bus: any = b.battle.bus;
  bus.maxDepth = 3;
  // 自己触发自己：不设保护就是无限递归
  bus.register({ id: "probe:self", ownerId: 101, code: "PROBE", range: "ALL", priority: 0, passive: false,
    fn: async () => { await bus.dispatch("PROBE", {}, 101, 0, (id: number) => b.battle.teamOf(id)); } });
  let threw = "";
  try { await bus.dispatch("PROBE", {}, 101, 0, (id: number) => b.battle.teamOf(id)); } catch (e: any) { threw = String(e?.message ?? e); }
  ok("★ 自我触发的深链没有把栈打爆（被上限截断）", threw === "", threw || "（未抛错）");
  ok("★ 溢出被计数", bus.overflowCount > 0, String(bus.overflowCount));
  ok("链深度不超过上限", Math.max(...bus.chain.map((n: any) => n.depth)) <= 3, String(Math.max(...bus.chain.map((n: any) => n.depth))));
}
{
  // 在**真实对局**里制造溢出：注册一个"收到 TURN_START 就再发一次 TURN_START"的探针，
  // 并把上限压到 2（TURN 节点 = 0 层，TURN_START = 1 层，再嵌套就到顶）。
  const c = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const bus: any = c.battle.bus;
  // ★ 先把开局跑完再压低上限：开局自 G1 起收敛成 STARTUP → STARTUP:<stage> 两层，
  //   若在开局前就把上限设为 2，溢出会来自开局阶段的嵌套事件，而不是本节要考察的
  //   「TURN_START 里再发 TURN_START」。断言因此会指向错误的来源。
  await c.battle.runStartup();
  bus.maxDepth = 2;
  bus.register({ id: "probe:turn-restart", ownerId: 101, code: "TURN_START", range: "ALL", priority: -1, passive: false,
    fn: async () => { await bus.dispatch("TURN_START", {}, 101, 0, (id: number) => c.battle.teamOf(id)); } });
  await c.battle.run();
  ok("★ 压低上限后战斗仍能跑完（不炸栈、不中断）", c.battle.turn > 0 && c.battle.winner !== null, `turn=${c.battle.turn} winner=${c.battle.winner}`);
  ok("★ 溢出被计数", bus.overflowCount > 0, String(bus.overflowCount));
  ok("★ 溢出写进事件流（留痕，不静默吞掉）", (c.battle.trace as any[]).some(e => e.t === "EVENT_OVERFLOW"), String(bus.overflowCount));
  // 压低上限到 2 之后，**所有**超过 2 层的合法嵌套都会溢出（不只是探针那一处），
  // 所以断言分两半：① 每条溢出都必须带得清"是谁触发的"（非空 code + 真实上限）；
  // ② 探针那条必须被抓到（否则等于没验证到本节真正想验证的递归）。
  const ovs = (c.battle.trace as any[]).filter(e => e.t === "EVENT_OVERFLOW");
  ok("溢出事件带 code 与上限，便于定位是谁触发的",
     ovs.length > 0 && ovs.every(e => typeof e.code === "string" && e.code.length > 0 && e.maxDepth === 2));
  ok("★ 探针制造的 TURN_START 自递归确实被抓到并标注了来源",
     ovs.some(e => e.code === "TURN_START"), JSON.stringify([...new Set(ovs.map(e => e.code))]));
}
{
  const d = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  await d.battle.run();
  ok("默认上限下不发生溢出", (d.battle.bus as any).overflowCount === 0, String((d.battle.bus as any).overflowCount));
}

sec("[5] 守恒与自洽不变量（§43）");
const pays = byCode("ORB_PAY");
ok("★ 每次扣火：before − cost === after", pays.every(e => Math.abs(e.before - e.amount - e.after) < 1e-9), JSON.stringify(pays.slice(0, 3)));
ok("扣火后鬼火不为负", pays.every(e => e.after >= 0));
const gains = byCode("ORB_GAIN");
ok("回火：after === min(上限, before + requested)", gains.every(e => e.after >= e.before && e.after <= e.before + e.requested + 1e-9));
const units = captureState(a.battle).teams.flatMap(t => t.members);
ok("★ 没有单位 HP 为负", units.every(u => u.hp >= 0), JSON.stringify(units.filter(u => u.hp < 0).map(u => [u.id, u.hp])));
ok("★ 死亡与血量自洽（alive=false ⇒ hp<=0）", units.every(u => u.alive || u.hp <= 0), JSON.stringify(units.filter(u => !u.alive && u.hp > 0).map(u => [u.id, u.hp])));
ok("HP 从未超过上限", units.every(u => u.hp <= u.maxHp + 1e-6), JSON.stringify(units.filter(u => u.hp > u.maxHp + 1e-6).map(u => [u.id, u.hp, u.maxHp])));
const shieldTotal = byCode("SHIELD_APPLY").reduce((s, e) => s + e.value, 0);
ok("护盾总量非负", shieldTotal >= 0);
ok("伤害事件的 applied 不为负", byCode("DAMAGE").every(e => (e.applied ?? 0) >= 0));

sec("[6] 加了事件之后，确定性不能被破坏");
const d1 = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
await d1.battle.run();
const d2 = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
await d2.battle.run();
ok("★ 两次运行的最终核心状态指纹一致", stateHash(captureState(d1.battle)) === stateHash(captureState(d2.battle)));
ok("★ 两次运行的事件流逐字节一致", JSON.stringify(d1.battle.trace) === JSON.stringify(d2.battle.trace));

console.log(`\n=== G1: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g10-modifiers.ts`

```ts
// tests/g10-modifiers.ts — ★ Modifier 生命周期验收（a1-4 §6/§7、目标 ⑨）
// 要求：属性改动必须带来源、可审计、可按来源整批回收；御魂叠层不再直接 push effects。
import { Entity } from "../kernel/entity.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);

sec("[1] Modifier API 语义");
{
  const e = new Entity(1, "T", 0, { atk: 1000, hp: 10000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0.1, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 });
  const baseAtk = e.prop("atk");
  e.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 200, mode: "FIXED", source: "test:a" });
  ok("FIXED：加法生效", e.prop("atk") === baseAtk + 200, String(e.prop("atk")));
  e.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 0.5, mode: "ADD_RATE", source: "test:b" });
  ok("ADD_RATE：按比例生效（先固定后乘率）", Math.abs(e.prop("atk") - (baseAtk + 200) * 1.5) < 1e-9, String(e.prop("atk")));
  e.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 5000, mode: "SET", source: "test:c" });
  ok("SET：覆盖式生效（优先级最高）", e.prop("atk") === 5000, String(e.prop("atk")));
  ok("★ 无来源的改动被直接拒绝（不可审计的改动不允许存在）", (() => { try { e.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 1, mode: "FIXED", source: "" }); return false; } catch { return true; } })());
  ok("modifierSources() 能列出全部来源", e.modifierSources().join(",") === "test:a,test:b,test:c", e.modifierSources().join(","));

  sec("[2] 按来源整批回收");
  const removed = e.removeModifiersBySource("test:");
  ok("回收条数正确", removed === 3, String(removed));
  ok("★ 回收后属性回到基线（不留残留）", e.prop("atk") === baseAtk, String(e.prop("atk")));
  ok("回收是精确的（只动匹配前缀的）", (() => {
    const x = new Entity(2, "T", 0, { atk: 100 });
    x.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 10, mode: "FIXED", source: "soul12:stack1" });
    x.addModifier({ prop: "atk", value: 20, mode: "FIXED", source: "soul13:stack1" });
    x.removeModifiersBySource("soul12:");
    return x.prop("atk") === 120 && x.modifierCount("soul13:") === 1;
  })());
}

sec("[3] 御魂叠层走 Modifier API（战斗内实测）");
{
  const fs = await import("node:fs");
  const path = await import("node:path");
  const { createKit, assembleMatch } = await import("../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts");
  const { canonicalMatch } = await import("../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts");
  const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
  const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
  // 无刀取：回合结束永久+15%伤害、上限45% → 最多 3 层
  const soulId = (bundle.souls as any[]).find(s => /永久提升.*的伤害/.test(s.desc ?? ""))?.id;
  const m = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0].soulId = soulId ?? null;
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 20261001 });
  a.battle.traceLevel = "NONE";
  await a.battle.run();
  const u = a.battle.allEntities().find((x: any) => x.id === 101)!;
  const soulMods = u.effects.filter((x: any) => String(x.source).startsWith("soul"));
  ok(`带来源的御魂 modifier 数量合理（${soulMods.length} 条，上限 3 层）`, soulMods.length <= 3, String(soulMods.length));
  ok("★ 每一条 modifier 都有非空来源（没有匿名属性改动）", u.effects.every((x: any) => !!x.source), JSON.stringify(u.effects.filter((x: any) => !x.source)));
  // ★ 第 43 轮：无刀取从 dmgTakenB 改到 dmgDealtB（源侧字段，见报告 §35）。
  //   这条断言测的是**回收生命周期**，不该绑死在某个具体属性名上 —— 直接从 modifier 自己取。
  const prop = soulMods[0]?.prop ?? "dmgDealtB";
  const before = u.prop(prop);
  u.removeModifiersBySource(`soul${soulId}:`);
  ok("★ 战斗结束后仍能按来源精确回收，属性随之回落", u.prop(prop) < before || soulMods.length === 0, `${prop}: ${before} → ${u.prop(prop)}`);
}

console.log(`\n=== Modifier 生命周期: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g100-active-bearer.ts — ★★★ 第 177 轮：**写在主动 / 普攻技能里的来源子句**（装配点问题）
//
// 缺口清单第 176 轮留下来的三条尾巴之一：鸩「毒之华」（cost=2）的「受到攻击时，为攻击者附加1层[buff_2852_1]」
//   写在**主动技能**里，而被动运行时的 cost 闸门只收 cost<0 ⇒ 这一句此前永远不会被装上。
//   与第 172 轮「主动技能里的先机」同一类：装配点，不是判据。
//
// 本轮：装配点挪到 cost 闸门**之前**（只收「有来源证据 + 族认得出来 + 事件码真有派发点」的），
//   执行走 execute 的 **statusOnly** 模式 —— 否则挨一下打就把整门大招再放一遍（多算）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { DamageType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { matchFamily } from "../kernel/triggers.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const { input } = compileAll(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb"));
const irs = (input.skills as any[]).map((e: any) => ({ key: String(e.key), ir: JSON.parse(String(e.json)) }));
const charOf = (key: string) => KB.find((c: any) => String(c.id) === key.split("/")[0])!;
const skillOf = (key: string) => (charOf(key).skills ?? []).find((s: any) => String(s.id) === key.split("/")[1])!;

async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261014) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}
const has = (e: any, id: string) => (e?.statuses ?? []).some((s: any) => String(s.def?.id ?? "") === id);

sec("[1] ★★★ 形状：8 条带来源证据的技能里，只有 **2 条**写在主动 / 普攻里 —— 其中只有 1 条的族认得出来");
{
  const rows = irs.filter(x => (x.ir.sourceBearerRefs ?? []).length > 0).map(x => {
    const sk = skillOf(x.key);
    // ★ 族按**整句**判（证据子句是逗号切出来的小句，不含「受到攻击时」—— 见 passive-runtime 的同一条注）
    const ev = String(x.ir.sourceBearerRefs[0].clause ?? "");
    const sentence = (x.ir.sentences ?? []).map((s: any) => String(s?.text ?? "")).find((t: string) => t.includes(ev)) ?? ev;
    const fam = matchFamily(sentence);
    return { key: x.key, cost: Number(sk.cost ?? 0), family: fam?.family ?? "无族", code: fam?.evCode ?? null };
  });
  const active = rows.filter(r => r.cost >= 0);
  console.log("  主动/普攻：" + (active.map(r => r.key + "(cost=" + r.cost + " " + r.family + "→" + (r.code ?? "-") + ")").join(" · ") || "无"));
  ok("★★★ 主动/普攻里的来源子句恰好 2 条：285/285_02 与 346/346_01",
    active.map(r => r.key).sort().join(",") === "285/285_02,346/346_01", JSON.stringify(active.map(r => r.key)));
  ok("★★★ 其中只有鸩「毒之华」的族认得出来且有派发点（受到攻击 → BEFORE_DAMAGE）",
    active.filter(r => r.code !== null).map(r => r.key + ":" + r.code).join(",") === "285/285_02:BEFORE_DAMAGE",
    JSON.stringify(active.map(r => r.key + ":" + r.code)));
  ok("★★ 聆海金鱼姬「川流」是「无族」（「友方受到单次敌方伤害超过其生命上限30%时」）⇒ 本轮装不上，留着",
    active.some(r => r.key === "346/346_01" && r.family === "无族"));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 运行时（被动档）：鸩挨打 ⇒ 状态落在**攻击者**身上，而且**没有**再放一遍大招");
{
  const a = await mk("鸩", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY");
  const b = a.battle;
  const all = b.allEntities();
  const zhen = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
  const foes = all.filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1);
  const attacker = foes[0];
  ok("★★★ 装配账上有它：activeBearerFields 记了 285_02 / BEFORE_DAMAGE / refs=[2852_1]",
    (b.passiveReport?.activeBearerFields ?? []).some((x: any) => x.skill === "毒之华" && x.code === "BEFORE_DAMAGE" && x.refs.join() === "2852_1"),
    JSON.stringify(b.passiveReport?.activeBearerFields));
  const dmg0 = b.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "DAMAGE").length;
  await b.damage(attacker, zhen, 1000, DamageType.NORMAL, 1);
  ok("★★★ 攻击者拿到了 2852_1", has(attacker, "2852_1"), JSON.stringify({ who: attacker.id, got: (attacker.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id) }));
  ok("★★★ 其他敌人一个都没有", foes.filter((e: any) => e.id !== attacker.id && has(e, "2852_1")).length === 0,
    JSON.stringify(foes.map((e: any) => (e.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id))));
  ok("★★★ 鸩自己也没有（这一句的承受者是攻击者，不是自己）", !has(zhen, "2852_1"),
    JSON.stringify((zhen.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id)));
  ok("★★★ 而且**没有**多打一次：这次事件只产生 1 条 DAMAGE（statusOnly 挡住了伤害/治疗/护盾那几节）",
    b.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "DAMAGE").length === dmg0 + 1,
    JSON.stringify({ before: dmg0, after: b.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "DAMAGE").length }));
  ok("★★★ 也没有把「毒之华」当成一次技能释放记进来（没有 SKILL_CAST）",
    !b.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "SKILL_CAST" && String(t.skill ?? "").includes("毒之华")),
    JSON.stringify(b.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "SKILL_CAST").map((t: any) => t.skill)));
}

sec("[3] ★★ 反向：默认档（被动 OFF）既没有处理器、也不会施加任何状态（指纹由 g43 守）");
{
  const a = await mk("鸩", "NOT_EXECUTED");
  const b = a.battle;
  const all = b.allEntities();
  const zhen = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
  const attacker = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 1)!;
  ok("★★ 默认档没有 activeBearerFields 记账", (b.passiveReport?.activeBearerFields ?? []).length === 0);
  await b.damage(attacker, zhen, 1000, DamageType.NORMAL, 1);
  ok("★★ 挨打之后攻击者身上没有 2852_1（这一档不装任何机制类东西）", !has(attacker, "2852_1"),
    JSON.stringify((attacker.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id)));
}

console.log("\n=== 主动/普攻里的来源子句: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g101-subject-plan.ts — ★★★ 第 178 轮：**触发句的主语**（承受者之外的第二个维度）
//
// 由来（探针 tools/_probe-subject178.ts）：全库有 **27 条**子句，它们的**触发主语不是拥有者** ——
//   「非召唤物的敌方阵亡时，增加50%行动条」（鬼使白）·「任一友方受到伤害时…」（骁浪荒川之主）·
//   「当敌方造成伤害暴击时…」（百目鬼）·「全体目标回合结束时，言和获得1层…」（言和）……
// 而现在的模型里**只有 SELF / TARGET 两种 side**（族表里 16 个族根本没有 side）：
//   · side=TARGET 的族 ⇒ range ALL + 处理器里按 `ctx.input.target.id === e.id` 过滤
//     ⇒ 主语是「任一友方 / 带 buff 的敌方」时，拥有者**不是**承受者 ⇒ **永远不触发**；
//   · side="-" 的族 ⇒ range SELF ⇒ 只有「事件的起点正好是自己」才触发 ⇒ 主语是敌方/友方时**方向反了**。
// 两条路都与原文不符。这一节只把事实与**判据**钉住（实现见下一轮，形状写在 §150.4）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { tipsTable, resolveTips } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { matchFamily, TRIGGER_FAMILIES } from "../kernel/triggers.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const tips = tipsTable();
const strip = (s: string) => String(s).replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, "");
const read = (p: string) => strip(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, p), "utf8"));

sec("[1] ★★★ 结构现状：族表只有两种 side，而总线**有四种 range**");
{
  const sides: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const f of TRIGGER_FAMILIES) sides[(f as any).side ?? "-"] = (sides[(f as any).side ?? "-"] ?? 0) + 1;
  console.log("  族表 side 分布：" + JSON.stringify(sides) + "（族总数 " + TRIGGER_FAMILIES.length + "）");
  ok("★★★ 族表里只有 SELF / TARGET 两种 side（" + TRIGGER_FAMILIES.length + " 个族里 6 个 TARGET，其余没有 side）",
    Object.keys(sides).sort().join() === "-,TARGET" && sides["TARGET"] === 6, JSON.stringify(sides));
  const ev = read("battle-lab/kernel/types.ts");
  ok("★★★ 而总线的 range 有**四种**（SELF / TEAM / ENEMY / ALL）—— 结构上够用，只是运行时没用",
    /EventRange = \{[^}]*SELF[^}]*TEAM[^}]*ENEMY[^}]*ALL/.test(ev.replace(/\s+/g, " ")), ev.match(/EventRange[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? "");
  const pr = read("battle-lab/compile/passive-runtime.ts");
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 179 轮**按事实改写**：这一节此前钉的是「运行时只用了两种 range ⇒ 主语这一维根本不存在」。
   *   第 179 轮接上之后，运行时按**主语**挑 range（敌方⇒ENEMY · 任意⇒ALL · 其余⇒SELF；友方暂缓）。
   */
  ok("★★★ 被动运行时现在按**主语**挑 range（第 179 轮接线；友方暂缓 ⇒ 仍是 SELF）",
    /const subject: string = \(u as any\)\.subject \?\? "SELF"/.test(pr)
    && /subject === "ENEMY" \? "ENEMY"/.test(pr) && /subject === "ANY" \? "ALL"/.test(pr));
}

/** 主语不是拥有者的写法（与探针同一判据） */
const OTHER_SUBJECT = /^(?:敌方|友方|场上|非召唤物|任意|所有|全体|除自身|其他友方)|(?:敌方|友方)(?:目标|单位|全体)?(?:造成|受到|行动|阵亡)/;
const rows: Array<{ who: string; key: string; cost: number; family: string; code: string | null; text?: string }> = [];
const seenRow = new Set<string>();
for (const c of KB) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
  const raw = [String(sk.description ?? ""), ...((sk.tips ?? []) as any[]).map((t: any) => String(t?.text ?? t))].join(" ");
  /**
   * ★ 两种形态都扫：原文（占位符 [tips_12] 未解析）与解析后（[传导伤害]）。
   *   实测：非[tips_12] 那一族只在**未解析**形态下匹配得上（阿香「自身及友方受到非[tips_12]时」、
   *   鲸汐千姬「对召唤物外的敌方造成非[tips_12]时」）—— 探针单跑是 27，尺子取并集是 29。
   *   ★ 取并集是**故意**的：这一族的用途是"把候选列全"，宁可多列两条，也不许漏。
   */
  for (const form of [raw, String(resolveTips(raw, tips).text)]) {
    for (const s of String(form).split(/[。\n]/).map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean)) {
      const fam: any = matchFamily(s);
      if (!fam || !OTHER_SUBJECT.test(s)) continue;
      const id = c.id + "/" + sk.id + "|" + fam.family + "|" + s.slice(0, 40);
      if (seenRow.has(id)) continue;
      seenRow.add(id);
      rows.push({ who: c.name, key: c.id + "/" + sk.id, cost: Number(sk.cost ?? 0), family: fam.family, code: fam.evCode ?? null, text: s });
    }
  }
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 主语不是拥有者、但族认得出来的子句：**27 条**（按族分布钉住）");
{
  const byFam: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const r of rows) byFam[r.family] = (byFam[r.family] ?? 0) + 1;
  console.log("  按族：" + JSON.stringify(byFam));
  for (const r of rows) console.log("      [" + r.family + "→" + (r.code ?? "-") + "] " + r.who + " " + r.key + "：" + String(r.text ?? "").slice(0, 56));
  ok("★★★ 总数 = 29 条（两种形态取并集；任何 KB 变化都会在这里显形）", rows.length === 29, String(rows.length));
  ok("★★★ 按族分布与实测逐条一致（阵亡 8 / 受到伤害 4 / 回合结束 4 / 攻击 2 / 造成伤害 2 / 暴击 2 / 非[tips_12] 2 / 回合开始 2 / 其余各 1）",
    JSON.stringify(byFam) === JSON.stringify({ "阵亡": 8, "被攻击": 1, "回合结束": 4, "攻击": 2, "受到伤害": 4, "造成伤害": 2, "暴击": 2, "非[tips_12]": 2, "施放技能前": 1, "回合开始": 2, "受到治疗": 1 }),
    JSON.stringify(byFam));
  const wanted = ["210/210_02", "293/293_02", "334/334_02", "606/606_02", "580/580_02", "399/399_02"];
  ok("★★ 六条代表都在名单里（阵亡 / 暴击 / 任一友方受伤 / 全体目标回合结束 / 其他友方造成伤害 / 非召唤物敌方回合结束）",
    wanted.every((w) => rows.some((r) => r.key === w)), JSON.stringify(rows.map(r => r.key).filter(k => wanted.includes(k))));
  ok("★★ 其中有一批写在**主动**技能里（装配点问题第 177 轮已解决，主语问题仍在）",
    rows.filter((r) => r.cost >= 0).length >= 6, String(rows.filter((r) => r.cost >= 0).length));
}

async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261015) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 实测：这些被动**装是装上了**，但装法按的是「拥有者自己的事件」（主语维度缺失）");
{
  /** ★ 第 183 轮按事实改写：晴思日和坊从 1 → **0** —— 它此前能装上，靠的是一条**假阳性伤害**（「储存等同于伤害20%」被当成造成伤害），那条已被第 183 轮拒掉 */
  for (const [name, skill, want] of [["百目鬼", "鬼眸", 0], ["言和", "和音", 1], ["晴思日和坊", "澄空彩虹", 0]] as Array<[string, string, number]>) {

    console.log("  " + name + "（" + skill + "）：装了 " + hit.length + " 条 → " + JSON.stringify(hit.map((x: any) => x.family + "→" + x.event)));

  const off = await mk("百目鬼", "NOT_EXECUTED");
  ok("★★ 反向：默认档（OFF）一条都不装（红区 E 的底线，指纹由 g43 守）",

sec("[4] ★★ 判据表（下一轮照它实现）：主语 → 总线 range");
{

  console.log("  " + JSON.stringify(MAP));
```

```ts
// tests/g102-subject.ts — ★★★ 第 179 轮：触发句的**主语**（谁身上发生这件事）接线

const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));

    ["回合结束后，若自身未承受[tips_3]，则打起精神来", "SELF"],
    ["受到攻击时，有40%概率为攻击者附加[buff_2322_1]", "SELF"],
    ["", "SELF"],
  ];
  for (const [clause, want] of cases) {
    const got = subjectOf(clause);
    ok("★ " + (clause ? clause.slice(0, 22) + "…" : "(空串)") + " ⇒ " + want, got === want, got);
  }
  ok("★★ 顺序敏感的一条：「全体友方」是 ALLY 而不是 ANY（ALLY 的判据排在 ANY 前面）",
    subjectOf("全体友方获得护盾") === "ALLY" && subjectOf("全体目标回合结束时") === "ANY");
}

async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261016) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}
const selfOf = (b: any) => b.allEntities().find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
const foesOf = (b: any) => b.allEntities().filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1);
const matesOf = (b: any) => b.allEntities().filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 0);
const SKILL = "399_02";
const layersOf = (e: any, ref: string) => {
  const st = (e.statuses ?? []).find((s: any) => String(s.def?.id ?? "") === ref);
  return st ? Number(st.stacks ?? 0) : 0;
};
const refOf = (e: any, skillId: string) => String((e.skills ?? []).find((s: any) => String(s.ir?.id ?? "") === skillId)?.ir?.statusRefs?.[0] ?? "");

    afterFoe === before + per, JSON.stringify({ before, afterFoe, per, ref }));

  await b.bus.dispatch(EV.TURN_END, {}, mate.id, mate.teamId, (id: number) => b.teamOf(id));
  ok("★★★ **友方**单位回合结束 ⇒ 层数不变（主语不是友方）", layersOf(e, ref) === afterFoe, String(layersOf(e, ref)));
  await b.bus.dispatch(EV.TURN_END, {}, e.id, e.teamId, (id: number) => b.teamOf(id));
  ok("★★★ **自己**回合结束 ⇒ 层数也不变（主语是敌方，不是自己）", layersOf(e, ref) === afterFoe, String(layersOf(e, ref)));
```

```ts
// tests/g103-status-attribution.ts — ★★★ 第 181 轮：状态引用的**逐句证据**（细化到槽位）+ 执行侧判据
//
// 第 180 轮落了产物（statusRefClauses），本轮把它**细化到槽位**并接上执行侧：
//   · 每个槽位 ← **它自己所在的那一句**（不再是"这个 ref 出现在哪些子句里"——那样多个槽位共享一份清单，收窄时分不开）；
//   · 只当条件的槽位单独标出来（statusRefConditionOnly）—— 「若拥有4层[buff_x]」里的那个引用**不是效果**；
//   · 执行侧 statusRefsForClause(ir, 子句)：没有证据 ⇒ null（照旧全放）；有证据 ⇒ 严格按证据（可能是空数组）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { DamageType, EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";
```
