```ts
// tests/g14-targeting.ts — ★ 可选中性（canBeTargeted）接线验收（a1-4 §22 Targeting 独立系统）
// 背景：canBeTargeted 字段此前**全库无人读取** —— 无敌/放逐/隐匿 只是挂了个状态，敌人照样能打。
// 关键区分：不可选中 ≠ 不计入胜负。活着、计入胜负、但不能被选中，是三件不同的事。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const m = () => { const x = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 }); return x.battle as any; };

sec("[1] 不可选中的敌人会被寻敌跳过");
{
  const b = m();
  await b.runStartup();
  const foe = b.teams[1].members[0];
  ok("初始可被选中", b.enemiesOf(0).some((e: any) => e.id === foe.id));
  foe.setTargetable(false, "probe:invincible");
  ok("★ 标记后不再出现在寻敌结果里", !b.enemiesOf(0).some((e: any) => e.id === foe.id), JSON.stringify(b.enemiesOf(0).map((e: any) => e.id)));
  ok("★ 但它**仍然活着、仍然计入胜负**", b.teams[1].aliveMembers().some((e: any) => e.id === foe.id) && foe.alive);
  ok("痕迹写进了 notes（可审计）", foe.notes.some((n: string) => n.startsWith("targetable=false")));
  foe.setTargetable(true, "probe:invincible-end");
  ok("恢复后可再次被选中", b.enemiesOf(0).some((e: any) => e.id === foe.id));
}

sec("[2] 全员不可选中时不死锁（红区假设，显式退回）");
{
  const b = m();
  await b.runStartup();
  for (const e of b.teams[1].members) e.setTargetable(false, "probe:all-untargetable");
  ok("★ 全员不可选中时退回存活列表（而不是返回空数组造成行动空转）", b.enemiesOf(0).length === b.teams[1].aliveMembers().length, `${b.enemiesOf(0).length} vs ${b.teams[1].aliveMembers().length}`);
  const r = await b.runPartial(3);
  ok("战斗照常推进", b.turn > 0, `turn=${b.turn}`);
}

sec("[3] 胜负判定不受可选中性影响（最关键的一条）");
{
  const b = m();
  await b.runStartup();
  for (const e of b.teams[1].members) { e.alive = false; e.dead = true; e.hp = 0; }
  const last = b.teams[1].members[4];
  last.alive = true; last.dead = false; last.hp = 100;
  last.setTargetable(false, "probe:untargetable-survivor");
  const finished = b.checkVictory?.();
  ok("★ 唯一存活者即使不可选中，也**不会**被判为全灭", b.winner === null, `winner=${b.winner}`);
  last.alive = false; last.dead = true; last.hp = 0;
  b.checkVictory?.();
  ok("★ 它真的死了才判负", b.winner === 0, `winner=${b.winner}`);
}

sec("[4] 诚实边界：状态 → 不可选中的自动联动尚未实现");
  console.log("    已接线：canBeTargeted 被寻敌读取；setTargetable() 是可审计的受控入口。");
  console.log("    未接线：无敌/放逐/隐匿 类**状态**还不会自动调用 setTargetable —— StatusDef 上没有对应标记字段，");
  console.log("            要做得先扩 StatusDef + buff-compiler（属下一步，不在本轮）。");
  ok("(记录性质，不作通过判断)", true);

console.log(`\n=== 可选中性: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g15-effect-probability.ts — ★「有N%概率…」必须真的掷骰（第五个同型接线缺口）
//
// 由来：field-census 查出 SkillIR.probabilities **在生产代码里没有任何读取方**。
// 追下去发现：skill-compiler 把「有30%概率冰冻」里的 30 解析出来了，但没人用，
// 于是带状态的技能**全部 100% 施加**。同理「有30%概率击退100%行动条」也必定击退。
// 这是第五个"数据齐、字段齐、就是没有生产读取方"的缺口。
//
// 本测试锁三件事：
//   ① 归因正确（按**小句**把概率绑到效果上，不猜歧义句）
//   ② 运行时真的掷骰，且只有"原文写了概率"时才掷（没写 = 必定施加，且不污染 RNG 序列）
//   ③ 掷骰结果可复现、可在 Theater 里看见（STATUS_MISS / TIMELINE_MISS 事件）
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill, probOf, durationOf, splitClauses } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { buildCharacter } from "../compile/character.ts";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const buffs = new Map<string, any>(
  (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
    .map(b => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]),
);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
/** 造一个只做一件事的技能，好把注意力集中在概率上 */
const probeChar = (desc: string, title = "探查") =>
  buildCharacter({ id: 1, name: "探查单位", panel: { atk: 1000, hp: 100000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, skills: [{ id: "probe", name: title, cost: 0, description: desc }] }, undefined, undefined, buffs, 0, 1);
const mk = (desc: string) => compileSkill(1, "探查单位", { id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc });

sec("[1] 归因：概率必须绑到**同一小句**里的效果上");
{
  const ir = mk("造成攻击100%的伤害，并有30%概率击退100%行动条");
  ok("行动条概率被归因到 timeline:0", probOf(ir, "timeline:0") === 0.3, JSON.stringify(ir.effectProbs));
  ok("evidence 保留了原小句（可人工复核）", /30%概率击退/.test(ir.effectProbs[0]?.evidence ?? ""), JSON.stringify(ir.effectProbs));

  const ir2 = mk("造成攻击100%的伤害，有50%概率获得[buff_2173_1]");

sec("[2] 歧义句**不猜**：保持「必定施加」并留下证据");

  ok("★ 歧义被显式记录（绝不静默丢弃）", ir.effectProbSkips.length >= 1, JSON.stringify(ir.effectProbSkips));

  ok("概率数与槽位数对不上时放弃归因", probOf(ir2, "status:0") === null, JSON.stringify([ir2.effectProbs, ir2.effectProbSkips]));

sec("[3] 没写概率 = 必定施加（默认语义不能被改变）");
{

  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });

  const applies = bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY" && e.status === "2002_1").length;

sec("[4] 写了概率 = 真的按概率施加（统计 + 可复现）");
{
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const bt: any = a.battle;
  await bt.runStartup();

  const foe = bt.teams[1].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);

    if (bt.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY" && e.status === "2002_1")) applied++;
    if (bt.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_MISS" && e.status === "2002_1")) miss++;
  }
  const rate = applied / N;
  ok("★ 施加率落在 30% 附近（0.22–0.38，N=600）", rate > 0.22 && rate < 0.38, (rate * 100).toFixed(1) + "%");
  ok("★ 未命中有显式事件（Theater 能看见「为什么没挂上」）", miss > 0 && applied + miss === N, "applied=" + applied + " miss=" + miss);
}
{
  const run = async (seed: number) => {

  console.log("    seed 777: " + x + "   seed 778: " + z);
  ok("不同 seed 允许不同（掷骰确实在消耗随机数）", true);
}
{
  // 行动条：被推的单位位置必须**不变**（而不是被推两次）
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });

  }

sec("[5] 持续回合：技能原文写明的「持续N回合」必须真的生效（第十个同型缺口）");
{
  // durations 同样是被普查查出的「从未被读」字段：运行时的持续时间只取印记**自身**描述，
  // 印记没写就退化成 1 回合。全库 339 个带状态的技能里 107 个只在技能原文写了持续回合。
  const ir = mk("造成攻击100%的伤害，有30%概率使目标获得[buff_5952_1]，持续3回合");
  ok("前置：这个技能确实带一个状态引用", ir.statusRefs.length === 1, JSON.stringify(ir.statusRefs));
  ok("★ 跨小句也归因得上（持续时间与状态引用天然不在同一小句）", durationOf(ir, "status:0") === 3, JSON.stringify(ir.statusDurations));
  ok("evidence 保留原句", /持续3回合/.test(ir.statusDurations[0]?.evidence ?? ""), JSON.stringify(ir.statusDurations));
  ok("没写持续回合时返回 null（null ≠ 1）", durationOf(mk("使目标获得[buff_5952_1]"), "status:0") === null);

  // 运行时：三级优先（技能原文 > 印记描述 > 1）
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const bt: any = a.battle;
  await bt.runStartup();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const foe = bt.teams[1].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const s3 = probeChar("造成攻击1%的伤害，有100%概率使目标获得[buff_5952_1]，持续3回合", "三回合").entity.skills[0];
  foe.statuses.length = 0; bt.trace.length = 0;
  await s3.execute(bt, self, foe);
  const st = foe.statuses[0];
  ok("★ 挂在目标身上的持续时间 = 3 回合（修复前恒为 1）", st?.remaining === 3, JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((x: any) => [x.def.id, x.remaining])));
  ok("STATUS_APPLY 里记的 duration 也是 3", bt.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY" && e.duration === 3), JSON.stringify(bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY").map((e: any) => e.duration)));
  const s1 = probeChar("造成攻击1%的伤害，有100%概率使目标获得[buff_5952_1]", "无期限").entity.skills[0];
  foe.statuses.length = 0; bt.trace.length = 0;
  await s1.execute(bt, self, foe);
  ok("原文没写持续回合时仍退化为 1 回合（默认语义不变）", foe.statuses[0]?.remaining === 1, String(foe.statuses[0]?.remaining));

  // 冲突留痕：技能说 X、印记说 Y
  const conflictSkill = probeChar("造成攻击1%的伤害，有100%概率使目标获得[buff_5952_1]，持续5回合", "冲突").entity.skills[0];
  const buffDur = buffs.get("5952_1")?.durationFromText ?? null;
  foe.statuses.length = 0; bt.trace.length = 0;
  await conflictSkill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  if (buffDur === null) {
    ok("该印记自身没写持续回合 → 无冲突可言（如实记录，不假装验证过）", !bt.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_DURATION_CONFLICT"));
  } else {
    ok("★ 两处都写了且不一致 → 留下冲突事件（不假装其中一个一定对）", bt.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_DURATION_CONFLICT"), JSON.stringify(bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_DURATION_CONFLICT")));
  }
}

sec("[6] 全库口径：107 个「只写在技能里」的持续回合被补回");
{
  const shiki = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const list = Array.isArray(shiki) ? shiki : (shiki.characters ?? shiki.items ?? []);
  let withRefs = 0, rescued = 0, ambiguous = 0, lost = 0;
  for (const c of list) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
    const ir = compileSkill(Number(c.id ?? 0), String(c.name ?? ""), sk);
    if (!ir.statusRefs.length) continue;
    withRefs++;
    ambiguous += ir.durationSkips.length;
    let any = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < ir.statusRefs.length; i++) {
      const fromSkill = durationOf(ir, "status:" + i);
      const fromBuff = buffs.get(ir.statusRefs[i])?.durationFromText ?? null;
      if (fromSkill !== null) any = true;
      // 原文写了却没归因上，且印记也没写 → 仍然只能退化成 1 回合（如实计数，不掩饰）
      if (fromSkill === null && fromBuff === null && ir.durations.length > 0) lost++;
    }
    if (any) rescued++;
  }
  console.log("    带状态的技能 " + withRefs + "，其中至少有一个状态拿到了原文持续回合的 " + rescued + "；归因歧义 " + ambiguous + " 处；仍无期限可依 " + lost + " 处");
  ok("★ 补回的规模是真实且有限的（不是 0，也不是全部）", rescued > 50 && rescued < withRefs, rescued + "/" + withRefs);
  ok("歧义句被如实记录（绝不静默丢弃）", ambiguous >= 0, String(ambiguous));
}
sec("[7] 全库口径：改动的规模是**有界**的（不是把全部状态都变成概率施加）");
{
  const shiki = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const list = Array.isArray(shiki) ? shiki : (shiki.characters ?? shiki.items ?? []);
  let withRefs = 0, probed = 0, timelineSlots = 0, timelineProbed = 0, skips = 0;
  for (const c of list) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
    const ir = compileSkill(Number(c.id ?? 0), String(c.name ?? ""), sk);
    if (ir.statusRefs.length) {
      withRefs++;
      if (ir.statusRefs.some((_, i) => probOf(ir, "status:" + i) !== null)) probed++;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < ir.timeline.length; i++) { timelineSlots++; if (probOf(ir, "timeline:" + i) !== null) timelineProbed++; }
    skips += ir.effectProbSkips.length;
  }
  console.log("    带状态技能 " + withRefs + " 个，其中原文写了概率的 " + probed + "；行动条槽位 " + timelineSlots + "，其中写了概率的 " + timelineProbed + "；歧义未归因 " + skips + " 处");
  ok("有概率的技能数远小于全库（只动了明写概率的那一批）", probed > 0 && probed < withRefs * 0.25, probed + "/" + withRefs);
  ok("行动条概率也有归因（≠0）", timelineProbed > 0, String(timelineProbed));
}

sec("[8] 小句切分本身正确");
{
  ok("逗号/分号都切", splitClauses("甲，乙；丙,丁").length === 4, JSON.stringify(splitClauses("甲，乙；丙,丁")));
  ok("空小句被丢弃", splitClauses("甲，，乙").length === 2);
}

console.log("\n=== 效果概率归因与掷骰: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g16-startup-once.ts`

```ts
// tests/g16-startup-once.ts — ★ 开局钩子必须**只发生一次**（第六个同型接线缺口）
//
// 由来：runStartupStage 的尾部与 runStartup 的尾部重复了一份
//   `dispatch(BATTLE_START) + phase = BATTLE + startupDone = true`
// 于是 9 个开局阶段每个都派发一次 BATTLE_START，加上结尾那次 = **10 次**。
// 而 soul/effect-system.ts 把「战斗开始时」御魂挂在 BATTLE_START 上 —— 这些效果就触发 10 次。
// 危险之处在于它**看起来是对的**：无刀取那类有层数上限的效果被 cap 掩盖了，
// 「有 3 层」这个现象既可以来自正常累加，也可以来自 10 次连发被封顶。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { makeGuessingEntity } from "../soul/guessing-factory.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { installSoulEffects } from "../soul/effect-system.ts";
import type { SoulDef } from "../soul/loadout.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

const fresh = async () => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const bt: any = a.battle;
  const seen: string[] = [];
  const orig = bt.bus.dispatch.bind(bt.bus);
  bt.bus.dispatch = (...args: any[]) => { seen.push(String(args[0])); return orig(...args); };
  return { a, bt, seen };
};

sec("[1] BATTLE_START 只能派发一次");
{
  const { bt, seen } = await fresh();
  await bt.runStartup();
  const n = seen.filter(c => c === "BATTLE_START").length;
  // 语义修正：BATTLE_START 必须是**按单位**派发（selfId = 单位 id），否则 SELF 范围的御魂订阅者
  // 永远匹配不上（ownerId !== 0）。修复前是"每个开局阶段派发一次、selfId 恒为 0"：
  // 9 阶段 × 单位数 = 90 次广播，而真正该收到它的单位一次也没收到。
  ok("★ BATTLE_START 按单位派发，次数 === 单位数（不是 90）", n === 10, "实际 " + n + " 次（修复前为 10 次广播 selfId=0）");
  const senki = seen.filter(c => c === "SENKI").length;
  ok("SENKI 也只有一次", senki === 1, String(senki));
  const soul = seen.filter(c => c === "SOUL_START").length;
  ok("SOUL_START 按**单位**派发（10 个单位 = 10 次，不是按阶段叠乘）", soul === 10, String(soul));
}

sec("[2] ★ 行为级证明：开局御魂只结算一次（火灵 3 鬼火 / 蚌精 全队护盾）");
{
  // 这一节是整份测试的重点。只看"BATTLE_START 派发了几次"是**结构断言**；
  // 真正要证明的是**数值只被改了一次** —— 修复前每个开局阶段都派发一次，
  // 火灵会给出 3×10=30 点鬼火（被上限截断），蚌精会给每个单位叠 10 层护盾。
  const souls: SoulDef[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "soul.json"), "utf8"));
  const soulDefs = new Map<number, SoulDef>(souls.map(s => [Number(s.id), s]));
  const byName = new Map(souls.map(s => [s.name, s]));
  const huo = byName.get("火灵")!, bang = byName.get("蚌精")!;
  ok("前置：知识库里找得到火灵与蚌精（否则本节平凡通过）", !!huo && !!bang, JSON.stringify([huo?.id, bang?.id]));

  const mk = (id: number, teamId: number, soulId: number | null) =>
    makeGuessingEntity(id, teamId, {
      shikigamiId: 217,
      observed: { atk: 3000, hp: 20000, def: 400, spd: 120, cri: 0, crid: 150, efh: 0, efr: 0 },
      soulIds: soulId ? [soulId, soulId, soulId, soulId] : null,
    }, { soulDefs, charMeta: new Map([[217, { name: "大天狗" }]]) });

  const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
  const A = mk(1, 0, huo.id), B = mk(2, 1, bang.id);
  const t0 = new Team(0, "RED", R, 1); t0.add(A.entity);
  const t1 = new Team(1, "BLUE", R, 1); t1.add(B.entity);
  const bt = new Battle([t0, t1], { seed: 7, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 30 },
    policies: { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
      death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
      tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED } });
  const orbPolicy = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345 as any;
  const orbBefore = t0.orbs.current;
  const rep = installSoulEffects(bt, [...A.resolution.soulBattleEffects, ...B.resolution.soulBattleEffects], soulDefs);
  ok("前置：两件御魂的 4 件套效果都装入成功", rep.installed.length === 2, JSON.stringify(rep.installed.map(i => i.name + "/" + i.kind)));
  await bt.runStartup();
  const gained = t0.orbs.current - orbBefore;
  ok("★ 火灵只给一次 3 点鬼火（修复前会被派发 10 次）", gained === 3, "实际 +" + gained + "（上限 " + (orbPolicy?.maxOrb ?? "?") + "，开局 " + orbBefore + " → " + t0.orbs.current + "）");
  const shields = B.entity.shields.length;
  ok("★ 蚌精只给一层护盾（不是 10 层）", shields === 1, "shields=" + shields);
  const expect = B.entity.maxHp * 0.10;
  ok("护盾值 = 生命上限 10%", Math.abs((B.entity.shields[0]?.value ?? 0) - expect) < 1e-6, JSON.stringify([B.entity.shields[0]?.value, expect]));
  ok("前置：确实有触发计数（否则下一条会平凡通过）", Object.keys(rep.fireCount).length > 0, JSON.stringify(rep.fireCount));
  ok("★ 每件御魂只结算 1 次", Object.values(rep.fireCount).length > 0 && Object.values(rep.fireCount).every(v => v === 1), JSON.stringify(rep.fireCount));
}

sec("[3] 阶段序列：每个 Phase 都真的被进入过（含此前全库无人使用的两个）");
{
  const { bt } = await fresh();
  await bt.runStartup();
  const log = bt.phaseLog.join(" | ");
  ok("★ 装载策略阶段被进入（LOAD_RULESET）", bt.phaseLog.some((l: string) => l.startsWith("LOAD_RULESET")), log.slice(0, 160));
  ok("★ 开局效果阶段被进入（START_EFFECTS）", bt.phaseLog.some((l: string) => l.startsWith("STARTUP:SOUL_START") || l.startsWith("STARTUP:PASSIVE_START")));
  ok("开局后处于 BATTLE 阶段", String(bt.phase) === "BATTLE", String(bt.phase));
  ok("开局标志已置位", bt.startupDone === true);
  const idx = (s: string) => bt.phaseLog.findIndex((l: string) => l.startsWith(s));
  ok("★ LOAD_RULESET 出现在 CREATE 之后、SPAWN 之前", idx("LOAD_RULESET") > idx("CREATE") && idx("LOAD_RULESET") < idx("STARTUP:SPAWN"), JSON.stringify(bt.phaseLog.slice(0, 4)));
}

sec("[4] 事件树仍然是「一次开局一棵树」，没有被这次修复破坏");
{
  const { bt } = await fresh();
  const before = (bt.bus as any).nodes?.size ?? 0;
  await bt.runStartup();
  const nodes = (bt.bus as any).nodes as Map<number, any>;
  ok("前置：事件树确实在记录节点（否则本节平凡通过）", nodes && nodes.size > before, "before=" + before + " after=" + nodes?.size);
  const roots = [...nodes.values()].filter((n: any) => n.parent === null);
  ok("★ 整个开局只有**一个**根节点（此前 9 个阶段各自成根 = 10 个根）", roots.length === 1, "roots=" + roots.length + " nodes=" + nodes.size);
  const depth = Math.max(...[...nodes.values()].map((n: any) => n.depth ?? 0));
  console.log("    事件树节点 " + nodes.size + " 个，根 " + roots.length + " 个，最大深度 " + depth);
  ok("★ 开局事件没有堆积成超深层级（防递归爆栈哨兵）", depth < 64, String(depth));
}


sec("[5] ★★★ 第 190 轮：runStartup **幂等**（跑第二遍必须什么都不做）");
{
  /**
   * 由来：`run()` 内部**也会**调 `runStartup()`，于是几乎所有人写的 `await runStartup(); await run()`
   *   让开局流水线跑了两遍（BATTLE_START 按单位再派发一轮 ⇒ 先机/御魂「战斗开始时」再触发一次）。
   *   默认档看不出来（无御魂、被动 OFF），有先机时当场分叉：
   *   实测典型对局被动档 `runStartup()+run()` = 6d7fb675c3d14eaf，而 `run()` = 7bc24506bdcd349e。
   *   这个缺口是**跨进程续跑**（tests/g112）顺出来的 —— 恢复出来的战斗 startupDone 已经是 true。
   */
  const souls: SoulDef[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "soul.json"), "utf8"));
  const soulDefs = new Map<number, SoulDef>(souls.map(s => [Number(s.id), s]));
  const huo = souls.find(s => s.name === "火灵")!;
  const mk = (id: number, teamId: number, soulId: number | null) =>
    makeGuessingEntity(id, teamId, { shikigamiId: 217, observed: { atk: 3000, hp: 20000, def: 400, spd: 120, cri: 0, crid: 150, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, soulIds: soulId ? [soulId, soulId, soulId, soulId] : null },
      { soulDefs, charMeta: new Map([[217, { name: "大天狗" }]]) });
  const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
  const A = mk(1, 0, huo.id), B = mk(2, 1, null);
  const t0 = new Team(0, "RED", R, 1); t0.add(A.entity);
  const t1 = new Team(1, "BLUE", R, 1); t1.add(B.entity);
  const bt: any = new Battle([t0, t1], { seed: 7, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 30 },
    policies: { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
      death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
      tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing: GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED } });
  const rep = installSoulEffects(bt, [...A.resolution.soulBattleEffects], soulDefs);
  const dispatched: string[] = [];
  const orig = bt.bus.dispatch.bind(bt.bus);
  bt.bus.dispatch = (...args: any[]) => { dispatched.push(String(args[0])); return orig(...args); };
  const orb0 = t0.orbs.current;
  await bt.runStartup();
  const afterFirst = { orbs: t0.orbs.current, bat: dispatched.filter(c => c === "BATTLE_START").length, nodes: (bt.bus as any).nodes.size, log: bt.phaseLog.length };
  await bt.runStartup();
  await bt.runStartup();
  const afterThird = { orbs: t0.orbs.current, bat: dispatched.filter(c => c === "BATTLE_START").length, nodes: (bt.bus as any).nodes.size, log: bt.phaseLog.length };
  console.log("    第一次开局后 " + JSON.stringify(afterFirst) + "｜再跑两次之后 " + JSON.stringify(afterThird));
  ok("★★★ 前置：第一次开局确实发生了（火灵给了鬼火、BATTLE_START 派发过）", afterFirst.orbs > orb0 && afterFirst.bat > 0, JSON.stringify({ orb0, afterFirst }));
  ok("★★★ 再跑两次 ⇒ **鬼火一点没多**（修复前每跑一次就再给 3 点）", afterThird.orbs === afterFirst.orbs, JSON.stringify({ a: afterFirst.orbs, b: afterThird.orbs }));
  ok("★★★ BATTLE_START 派发次数**不变**（修复前每跑一次 +10）", afterThird.bat === afterFirst.bat, JSON.stringify({ a: afterFirst.bat, b: afterThird.bat }));
  ok("★★★ 事件树节点数与阶段日志长度都不变（幂等是**无痕**的，不留事件）", afterThird.nodes === afterFirst.nodes && afterThird.log === afterFirst.log, JSON.stringify({ a: [afterFirst.nodes, afterFirst.log], b: [afterThird.nodes, afterThird.log] }));
  ok("★★ 而两件御魂的结算计数仍然是 1（不是 3）", Object.values(rep.fireCount).every(v => v === 1), JSON.stringify(rep.fireCount));
}

sec("[6] ★★★ 行为面：`runStartup(); run()` 与 `run()` 必须得到**同一个**对局（幂等的意义）");
{
  const one = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001, passives: "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" });
  const r1 = await one.battle.run();
  const h1 = stateHash(captureState(one.battle));
  const two: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001, passives: "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" });
  await two.battle.runStartup();

  const h2 = stateHash(captureState(two.battle));
  console.log("    run()=" + h1 + "｜runStartup()+run()=" + h2);
  ok("★★★ 两条路得到同一个指纹（修复前：6d7fb675c3d14eaf vs 7bc24506bdcd349e）", h1 === h2, h1 + " vs " + h2);
  ok("★★★ 而单次开局的被动档指纹 = 7bc24506bdcd349e（本轮按事实改的常量）", h1 === "7bc24506bdcd349e", h1);
  ok("★★ 胜者/回合数也一致", r1.winner === r2.winner && r1.turns === r2.turns, JSON.stringify([r1, r2]));
  const off = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  await off.battle.runStartup();
  await off.battle.run();
  ok("★★★ 默认档仍然逐位不变（2d7c7507e18db61f）", stateHash(captureState(off.battle)) === "2d7c7507e18db61f");
}
console.log("\n=== 开局唯一性: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g17-target-scope.ts`

```ts
// tests/g17-target-scope.ts — ★ 技能作用范围：一个技能打谁、给谁加（第八个同型接线缺口）
//
// 由来：SkillIR.targeting 是 field-census 查出的「从未被读」字段之一。追下去发现它不是边角料，
// 而是**整层"效果作用对象"缺失**，而且三个方向全都是错的：
//   ① 114 个「敌方全体」技能只打 1 个目标（雪女「暴风雪」只打到 1/5）
//   ② 64 个「友方全体」技能把护盾/治疗丢给敌方 —— AI 目标永远取自敌人列表，
//      连「优先选择没有护盾的友方单位」这类规则也拿到敌人当候选
//   ③ 127 个「自身」技能也去打敌人
//   ④ 「击退行动条」推的是**自己**（对 self.id 生效），方向与对象全错
// 全库 818 个技能里 653 个 targeting 非空 —— 这不是边角情况。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill, targetModeOf, isAllyScoped } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { buildCharacter } from "../compile/character.ts";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { compileAI } from "../compile/ai-compiler.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const buffs = new Map<string, any>(
  (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
    .map(b => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]),
);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const mk = (desc: string) => compileSkill(1, "探查单位", { id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc });
/** 造一个探查技能；aiEntry 给 AI 目标规则用（可为 undefined = 没有规则） */
const probeSkill = (desc: string, aiEntry?: any) =>
  buildCharacter({ id: 1, name: "探查单位", panel: { atk: 1000, hp: 50000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, skills: [{ id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc }] },
    aiEntry ? compileAI(1, "探查单位", aiEntry, ["探查"]) : undefined, undefined, buffs, 0, 1).entity.skills[0];

const fresh = async (seed = 20261001) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a.battle;
};

sec("[1] 分类：技能原文 -> 作用范围");
{
  const cases: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ["对敌方全体造成攻击100%的伤害", "ENEMY_ALL"],
    ["使友方全体获得护盾，能吸收12%生命上限的伤害", "ALLY_ALL"],
    ["治疗友方目标，恢复其12%生命", "ALLY_ONE"],
    ["自身获得护盾，能吸收10%生命上限的伤害", "SELF"],
    ["对随机敌方目标造成攻击100%的伤害", "ENEMY_RANDOM"],
    ["对敌方目标造成攻击100%的伤害", "ENEMY_ONE"],
    ["造成攻击100%的伤害", "ENEMY_ONE"],
  ];
  for (const [desc, want] of cases) {
    const got = targetModeOf(mk(desc));
    ok(desc.slice(0, 18) + "… → " + want, got === want, "得到 " + got);
  }
  ok("友方范围为真的判定为友方（决定候选名单取队友）",
     isAllyScoped("SELF") && isAllyScoped("ALLY_ALL") && isAllyScoped("ALLY_ONE") && !isAllyScoped("ENEMY_ALL"));
  // 真实技能抽样
  const shiki = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const list = Array.isArray(shiki) ? shiki : (shiki.characters ?? shiki.items ?? []);
  const find = (charName: string, skillName: string) => {
    for (const c of list) if (c.name === charName) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
      const ir = compileSkill(Number(c.id ?? 0), charName, sk);
      if (ir.name === skillName) return targetModeOf(ir);
    }
    return null;
  };
  ok("真实技能 雪女「暴风雪」= 敌方全体", find("雪女", "暴风雪") === "ENEMY_ALL", String(find("雪女", "暴风雪")));
  ok("真实技能 雪女「冰甲术」= 自身", find("雪女", "冰甲术") === "SELF", String(find("雪女", "冰甲术")));
}

sec("[2] 群攻：必须打到**全部**敌人（此前只打第一个）");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const enemies = bt.enemiesOf(0);
  ok("前置：对方有 5 个可被选中的敌人", enemies.length === 5, String(enemies.length));
  const skill = probeSkill("对敌方全体造成攻击100%的伤害");
  bt.trace.length = 0;
  await skill.execute(bt, self, enemies[0]);
  const hit = new Set(bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "DAMAGE").map((e: any) => e.dst));
  ok("★ 5 个敌人**全部**受到伤害", hit.size === 5, "命中 " + hit.size + " 个：" + JSON.stringify([...hit]));
  const scope = bt.trace.find((e: any) => e.t === "TARGET_SCOPE");
  ok("作用范围写进事件流（Theater 能看见）", scope?.mode === "ENEMY_ALL" && scope.hurt.length === 5, JSON.stringify(scope));
}

sec("[3] 友方技能：护盾必须给**队友**，一个敌人都不能有");

sec("[6] 群控的概率是**逐目标**判定，不是掷一次决定全场");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const enemies = bt.enemiesOf(0);
  // 用一个**真实的 DEBUFF 类印记**：2081_1 是【通用、印记】，按语义该挂在自己身上，
  // 拿它测"群控逐目标判定"会得到恒为 1 个承受者的假象（第一版就是这么写错的）。
  const debuffId = String((JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
    .find(b => String(compileBuff(b).category).startsWith("DEBUFF"))!.id);
  console.log("    使用的减益印记 id = " + debuffId);
  // ⚠ 刻意**不带伤害**：第一版写了"造成攻击100%的伤害"，200 次群攻直接把对面打死了，
  //   后续几次自然一个都控不到（平均值 0.04），看起来像"概率没生效"，
  //   其实是被测对象已经不在场上了。测机制时要先把无关变量按住。
  const skill = probeSkill("使敌方全体有30%概率获得[buff_" + debuffId + "]");
  const nHits: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
    for (const e of bt.teams[1].members) { e.statuses.length = 0; e.hp = e.maxHp; e.alive = true; e.dead = false; }
    bt.trace.length = 0;
    await skill.execute(bt, self, enemies[0]);
    nHits.push(bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY").length);
  }
  const dealt = nHits.filter(n => n > 0).length / nHits.length;
  ok("★ 至少有一次只中了一部分（逐目标判定的直接证据）", nHits.some(n => n > 0 && n < 5), JSON.stringify([...new Set(nHits)].sort()));
  const avg = nHits.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / nHits.length;
  ok("平均命中数接近 5×30% = 1.5（逐目标独立判定）", Math.abs(avg - 1.5) < 0.35, avg.toFixed(2));
  console.log("    200 次群控的命中数分布：" + JSON.stringify([...new Set(nHits)].sort().map(n => n + "中×" + nHits.filter(x => x === n).length)));
  ok("整场至少有人中过（不是恒 0）", dealt > 0, (dealt * 100).toFixed(0) + "%");
}

sec("[7] 回归：单目标技能仍然只打 1 个");

  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);

}

sec("[8] 候选名单：友方规则不再拿到敌人列表");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g18-lock-timeline.ts`

```ts
// tests/g18-lock-timeline.ts — ★ 缚足「无法受到改变行动条的效果」必须真的生效（第九个同型接线缺口）
//
// 由来：field-census 把 StatusDef.locksTimeline 报成"有读取方"（toStatusDef 里搬运了一次），
// 但**搬运不是判断**。追下去发现：
//   · 生产代码里没有任何一处调用 Timeline.setLock（只有 tests/m0 直接调用它自测）
//   · 也没有任何地方读 StatusDef.locksTimeline 来决定"能不能被拉条/推条"
// 于是被缚足的单位照样被拉被推 —— 与 canBeTargeted / preventsAction 完全同型。
//
// 附带发现：Timeline.advance() 原本对 locked 单位直接 continue。一旦把缚足接上锁条，
// 那单位就会永远停在原地、永远不到达终点、于是永远不再行动 —— 那不是"免疫改变行动条"，那是死锁。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { buildCharacter } from "../compile/character.ts";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { StatusBook, locksTimeline } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const buffs = new Map<string, any>(
  (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
    .map(b => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]),
);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const probeSkill = (desc: string) =>
  buildCharacter({ id: 1, name: "探查单位", panel: { atk: 8000, hp: 50000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, skills: [{ id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc }] },
    undefined, undefined, buffs, 0, 1).entity.skills[0];
const fresh = async (seed = 20261001) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a.battle;
};
/** 让行动条上有正的位置可推（否则推到 0 会被 clamp，看不出差别） */
const primePositions = async (bt: any, n = 2) => { bt.timeline.advance(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) bt.timeline.advance(); };

sec("[1] 数据层：缚足带着锁条标记");
{
  const bf = StatusBook.get("boundFeet");
  ok("前置：缚足已定义且 locksTimeline = true", !!bf?.locksTimeline, JSON.stringify(bf));
  ok("locksTimeline(defs) 判定函数可用", locksTimeline([bf as any]) === true && locksTimeline([StatusBook.get("stun") as any]) === false);
}

sec("[2] 谓词：Timeline 直接查状态，而不是等调用方 setLock");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const e = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  ok("前置：未上缚足时不被锁", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === false);
  e.addStatus(StatusBook.get("boundFeet"), 999, 1, 3);
  ok("★ 上了缚足之后 isLocked 立刻为真（没有任何人调用 setLock）", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === true);
  const before = bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos;
  const moved = bt.timeline.shift(e.id, 0.5);
  ok("★ 拉条被拒绝，位置不变", moved === false && bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos === before, "moved=" + moved + " pos=" + before + "→" + bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos);
}

sec("[3] 技能级：群推只推得动没被缚足的人");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  await primePositions(bt);
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const enemies = bt.enemiesOf(0);
  const locked = enemies[1];
  locked.addStatus(StatusBook.get("boundFeet"), 999, 1, 5);
  const lockedPos = bt.timeline.get(locked.id).pos;
  const others = enemies.filter((e: any) => e.id !== locked.id).map((e: any) => bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos);
  const skill = probeSkill("对敌方全体造成攻击1%的伤害，并击退50%行动条");
  bt.trace.length = 0;
  await skill.execute(bt, self, enemies[0]);
  const shifts = bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "TIMELINE_SHIFT");
  const lockedEv = bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "TIMELINE_LOCKED");
  ok("★ 被缚足者收到 TIMELINE_LOCKED（而不是静默不动）", lockedEv.some((e: any) => e.id === locked.id), JSON.stringify(lockedEv));
  ok("★ 被缚足者位置分毫未动", bt.timeline.get(locked.id).pos === lockedPos, lockedPos + " → " + bt.timeline.get(locked.id).pos);
  ok("★ 其余敌人照常被推", shifts.length === enemies.length - 1, "被推 " + shifts.length + " 人 / 共 " + enemies.length + " 人");
  const moved = enemies.filter((e: any) => e.id !== locked.id).every((e: any, i: number) => bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos < others[i]);
  ok("未锁者的位置确实变小了", moved, JSON.stringify(enemies.map((e: any) => e.id + ":" + bt.timeline.get(e.id).pos)));
}

sec("[4] ★ 锁条不得变成死锁：被缚足的单位照常自然推进、照常行动");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const e = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  e.addStatus(StatusBook.get("boundFeet"), 999, 1, 99);   // 长时间锁条
  const before = bt.turn;
  await bt.runPartial(12);
  const acted = (bt.trace as any[]).some((x: any) => x.t === "SKILL_CAST" && x.actor === e.id);
  ok("★ 被缚足的单位在 12 回合内**依然行动过**（锁条不是冻结）", acted, "turn " + before + " → " + bt.turn);
  ok("战斗没有卡住", bt.turn > before, before + " → " + bt.turn);
  ok("该单位仍在行动条上（没有被移出）", bt.timeline.has(e.id));
}

sec("[5] 解除缚足后恢复可被拉条");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const e = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  e.addStatus(StatusBook.get("boundFeet"), 999, 1, 5);
  ok("前置：已被锁", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === true);
  e.statuses.length = 0;                                  // 模拟解除/驱散/到期
  ok("★ 状态移除后立刻恢复可被改变行动条", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === false && bt.timeline.shift(e.id, 0.2) === true);
}

sec("[6] 回归：显式 setLock 仍然有效（tests/m0 用的那条路径）");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const e = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  bt.timeline.setLock(e.id, true);
  ok("显式锁 + 谓词锁是「或」的关系", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === true && bt.timeline.shift(e.id, 0.3) === false);
  bt.timeline.setLock(e.id, false);
  ok("解除显式锁后恢复（此时没有缚足状态）", bt.timeline.isLocked(e.id) === false);
}

sec("[7] 确定性：锁条不影响可复现性");
{
  const run = async () => {
    const bt: any = await fresh(4242);
    const e = bt.teams[1].members[0];
    e.addStatus(StatusBook.get("boundFeet"), 999, 1, 99);
    await bt.runPartial(20);
    return JSON.stringify((bt.trace as any[]).filter(x => x.t === "TIMELINE_SHIFT" || x.t === "TIMELINE_LOCKED").map((x: any) => [x.t, x.id, x.percent]));
  };
  const a = await run(), b = await run();
  ok("★ 同 seed 两次的推拉事件序列完全一致", a === b, a.slice(0, 90) + " vs " + b.slice(0, 90));
  ok("序列里确实出现了被锁的痕迹", a.includes("TIMELINE_LOCKED") || a.includes("TIMELINE_SHIFT"));
}

console.log("\n=== 锁条: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g19-first-divergence.ts`

```ts
// tests/g19-first-divergence.ts — ★ G6 仪器验收：定位游戏/模拟的**第一处**分歧（目标 ⑧）
//
// G6 的难点从来不是"要不要对照"，而是"对照结果放在哪里、以什么为准"。
// 真实的游戏内观测要由人在游戏里做（那一半只能等），但**仪器本身今天就能被验证**：
// 用合成的观测序列去喂它，看它能不能精确指出第一处分歧、会不会漏报、会不会把
// "玩家没记的字段"误判成分歧、会不会把"模拟有而游戏不显示"的内部帧当成差异。
//
// 这一轮同时补上了让对照**成为可能**的前提：DAMAGE/HEAL/HP_LOSS 现在记 hpBefore/hpAfter。
// 血量是玩家在画面上唯一能逐事件核对的量；没有它，两边根本没法逐条比。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { diffTimelines, projectObserved, sameEvent, buildAlias } from "../kernel/diff.ts";
import type { ObsFrame } from "../kernel/diff.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

sec("[1] 身份判定：什么算「同一件事」");
{
  const a: ObsFrame = { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "三尾狐", amount: 100 };
  ok("种类/施动者/目标一致 → 同一件事", sameEvent(a, { ...a, amount: 999 }));
  ok("种类不同 → 不是", !sameEvent(a, { ...a, kind: "HEAL" }));
  ok("目标不同 → 不是", !sameEvent(a, { ...a, target: "日和坊" }));
  ok("人工没写技能名时不因技能名判否", sameEvent(a, { ...a, skill: "暴风雪" }));
  ok("两边都写了技能名且不同 → 不是", !sameEvent({ ...a, skill: "A" }, { ...a, skill: "B" }));
}

sec("[2] 完全一致 → 不报分歧（仪器不能自己造分歧）");
{
  const t: ObsFrame[] = [
    { kind: "SKILL", actor: "雪女", skill: "暴风雪" },
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "三尾狐", amount: 1200, hpAfter: 4800 },
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "雪女", target: "三尾狐", status: "冰冻" },
  ];
  const d = diffTimelines(t, t);
  ok("★ ok = true，first = null", d.ok && d.first === null, d.summary);
  ok("匹配条数 = 观测条数", d.matched === 3, String(d.matched));
}

sec("[3] 第一处分歧必须**精确**指出，且只有一处被当作 first");
{
  const exp: ObsFrame[] = [
    { kind: "SKILL", actor: "雪女" },
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "三尾狐", amount: 1200 },
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "日和坊", amount: 1300 },   // ← 这里开始不一样
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "雪女", target: "日和坊", status: "冰冻" },
  ];
  const act: ObsFrame[] = [
    { kind: "SKILL", actor: "雪女" },
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "三尾狐", amount: 1200 },
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "雪女", target: "日和坊", amount: 1300 },
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "雪女", target: "日和坊", status: "眩晕" },
  ];
  const d = diffTimelines(exp, act);
  ok("报出分歧", !d.ok && !!d.first);
  ok("★ 指向第 4 条观测（索引 3），不是第 1 条", d.first?.index === 3, JSON.stringify(d.first));
  ok("原因是字段不一致，并指出是哪个字段", d.first?.reason === "FIELD" && d.first?.field === "status", JSON.stringify([d.first?.reason, d.first?.field]));
  ok("把两边的值都列出来（可复核）", d.first?.expectedValue === "冰冻" && d.first?.actualValue === "眩晕", JSON.stringify([d.first?.expectedValue, d.first?.actualValue]));
  ok("分歧点带上下文（前 3 条 / 后 2 条）", (d.first?.context.before.length ?? 0) === 3, JSON.stringify(d.first?.context.before.length));
}

sec("[4] 数值容差：游戏显示会四舍五入，不该被判成分歧");
{
  const e: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 1200, hpAfter: 4800 }];
  ok("差 0.4 → 不算分歧（默认容差 1）", diffTimelines(e, [{ ...e[0], amount: 1200.4, hpAfter: 4800.4 }]).ok);
  ok("差 5 → 算分歧", !diffTimelines(e, [{ ...e[0], amount: 1205 }]).ok);
  ok("可以显式收紧容差", !diffTimelines(e, [{ ...e[0], amount: 1200.4 }], { tolerance: 0.1 }).ok);
}

sec("[5] 人工没记的字段**不能**被判成分歧（这是最容易冤枉正确代码的地方）");
{
  const exp: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 1200 }];   // 人没记血量
  const act: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 1200, hpAfter: 4800, orbs: 5 }];
  ok("★ 观测侧没写的字段一律不比较", diffTimelines(exp, act).ok, diffTimelines(exp, act).summary);
  const exp2: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", hpAfter: 4800 }];  // 人只记了血量
  ok("只记血量的观测也只比血量", diffTimelines(exp2, [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", hpAfter: 4800, amount: 99999 }]).ok);
  ok("但记了血量的场合血量不对就要报", !diffTimelines(exp2, [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", hpAfter: 4000 }]).ok);
}

sec("[6] 漏报 / 多报");
{
  const exp: ObsFrame[] = [
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 },
    { kind: "DEATH", target: "B" },
  ];
  const act: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 }];
  const d = diffTimelines(exp, act);
  ok("★ 游戏里发生了、模拟里没有 → MISSING", d.first?.reason === "MISSING" && d.first?.expected?.kind === "DEATH", JSON.stringify(d.first));
  // ★ EXTRA 只在**观测窗口之内**成立：多出来的事件后面还有观测能对上，
  //   说明"人在看，且看到了后面的事，却没记这一件"。
  //   若多出来的事件落在最后一条观测之后，那只是"人看了一段就停了"，不算分歧（见 [7]）。
  const d2 = diffTimelines([
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 },
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "A", target: "B", status: "冰冻" },
  ], [
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 },
    { kind: "DEATH", target: "B" },
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "A", target: "B", status: "冰冻" },
  ]);
  ok("★ 窗口内：模拟里发生了、观测里没有 → EXTRA", d2.first?.reason === "EXTRA" && d2.first?.actual?.kind === "DEATH", JSON.stringify(d2.first));
}

sec("[7] 模拟侧的内部帧要**被跳过但不隐藏**");
{
  const exp: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 }];
  const act: ObsFrame[] = [
    { kind: "STATUS", actor: "A", target: "A", status: "内部触发" },   // 游戏画面看不到
    { kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 },
  ];
  // ★ 语义澄清（第一版这里是错的）：模拟产生了「玩家应当看得见、观测里却没有」的事件，
  //   这是**真分歧** —— 要么模拟多做了，要么人漏记了，两种可能都要摆出来，不能替使用者选。
  const d = diffTimelines(exp, act);
  ok("★ 窗口内多出来的可见事件被报成 EXTRA（不静默跳过）", !d.ok && d.first?.reason === "EXTRA" && d.first?.actual?.status === "内部触发", JSON.stringify(d.first));
  ok("同时留下明细，供人工判断是模拟错了还是漏记了", d.skipped === 1 && d.skippedDetail[0]?.status === "内部触发", JSON.stringify(d.skippedDetail));
  const d2 = diffTimelines(exp, act, { lookahead: 0 });
  ok("把容差设为 0 时连位置都懒得挪 → 直接 MISSING", !d2.ok && d2.first?.reason === "MISSING", JSON.stringify(d2.first));
  // 观测窗口之外的模拟帧**不是**分歧：人只看了前几回合是完全正常的
  const partial = diffTimelines([{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 }],
    [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "A", target: "B", amount: 100 }, { kind: "DEATH", target: "B" }, { kind: "DEATH", target: "C" }]);
  ok("★★ 只观测了开头、后面还有一大段 → **不算分歧**（第一版会报 2 处分歧）", partial.ok, partial.summary);
  ok("但会如实说明观测范围只覆盖了一部分", partial.beyondObservation === 2 && /观测范围/.test(partial.summary), partial.summary);
}

sec("[8] 别名归一：人工写名字、模拟给 id");
{
  const alias = buildAlias({ 101: "三尾狐", 201: "座敷童子" });
  ok("id → 名字", alias(101) === "三尾狐" && alias(201) === "座敷童子", alias(101));
  ok("名字保持名字", alias("三尾狐") === "三尾狐");
  ok("未知值原样返回（不静默变成空）", alias(999) === "999");
  const exp: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: "三尾狐", target: "座敷童子", amount: 100 }];
  const act: ObsFrame[] = [{ kind: "DAMAGE", actor: 101, target: 201, amount: 100 }];
  ok("★ 用别名归一后，人工记录与模拟 trace 可以直接比对", diffTimelines(exp, act, { alias }).ok, diffTimelines(exp, act).summary);
  ok("不归一时会被判成分歧（说明归一确实在起作用）", !diffTimelines(exp, act).ok);
}

sec("[9] 真实 trace 的投影：只取玩家看得见的量");
{
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  await a.battle.runPartial(8);
  const trace = a.battle.trace as any[];
  const { frames, unobservable } = projectObserved(trace);
  ok("前置：这一局产生了可观测帧", frames.length > 10, String(frames.length));
  ok("投影里出现伤害/技能/状态等玩家可见类型", ["DAMAGE", "SKILL"].every(k => frames.some(f => f.kind === k)), JSON.stringify([...new Set(frames.map(f => f.kind))]));
  ok("★ 伤害帧带着 hpAfter（G6 对照的硬前提）", frames.filter(f => f.kind === "DAMAGE").every(f => typeof f.hpAfter === "number"), JSON.stringify(frames.find(f => f.kind === "DAMAGE")));
  console.log("    可观测帧 " + frames.length + "｜内部帧（游戏画面看不到） " + unobservable + "｜类型 " + JSON.stringify([...new Set(frames.map(f => f.kind))]));
  ok("内部帧被计数而不是被丢弃", unobservable > 0, String(unobservable));
}

sec("[10] ★ 端到端：同一份 trace 自己和自己比必须一致；改一个数字必须被第一处抓到");
{
  const a = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  await a.battle.runPartial(8);
  const byId: Record<number, string> = {};
  for (const t of a.battle.teams) for (const m of t.members) byId[m.id] = m.name;
  const alias = buildAlias(byId);
  const { frames } = projectObserved(a.battle.trace as any[]);
  const selfDiff = diffTimelines(frames, frames, { alias });
  ok("★ 自己和自己比 → 无分歧（仪器不会凭空造分歧）", selfDiff.ok, selfDiff.summary);

  // 造一份"游戏观测"：把第 4 条伤害的数字改掉，模拟侧保持不变
  const dmgIdx = frames.findIndex(f => f.kind === "DAMAGE");
  ok("前置：找得到一条伤害帧来改", dmgIdx >= 2, String(dmgIdx));
  const observed = frames.map((f, i) => (i === dmgIdx ? { ...f, amount: (f.amount ?? 0) + 500 } : f));
  const d = diffTimelines(observed, frames, { alias });
  ok("★ 精确抓到那一条", !d.ok && d.first?.index === dmgIdx, JSON.stringify([d.first?.index, dmgIdx]));
  ok("★ 报出「观测 200 vs 模拟 100」这类可复核的数字", d.first?.field === "amount" && d.first?.actualValue === frames[dmgIdx].amount, JSON.stringify([d.first?.field, d.first?.expectedValue, d.first?.actualValue]));
  console.log("    第一处分歧：" + d.summary);
}

console.log("\n=== G6 第一处分歧: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g2-snapshot.ts`

```ts
// tests/g2-snapshot.ts — ★ G2 验收：Snapshot + Delta + Checkpoint（a1-4.md §22/§23/§35/§57）
//
// 文档要求：
//   §57 snapshot(before) → resolve(event) → snapshot(after) → diff()，先用粗暴 diff，先正确后性能
//   §22 不必每帧完整复制   §23 但必须有 Checkpoint   §35 Trace Level 三档
//
// 验收标准：
//   ① 任意帧都能从「最近 Checkpoint + 其后 Delta」**精确重建**（与当场捕获的状态指纹一致）
//   ② Delta 相比每帧全量快照确实省很多（§22 的动机，用数字说话）
//   ③ Trace Level 三档产出**相同的战斗结果**（观测粒度不得影响模拟）
//   ④ NONE 档确实更快（否则这一档就没有存在意义）
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { SnapshotRecorder, diffStates, applyDelta } from "../kernel/snapshot.ts";
import { SUMMARY_KINDS } from "../kernel/battle.ts";

const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);

sec("[1] 粗暴 diff 本身必须正确（§57 的第一步）");
{
  const a = { x: 1, y: { z: [1, 2, 3], w: "s" }, gone: true };
  const b = { x: 2, y: { z: [1, 9, 3], w: "s" }, added: 5 };
  const ops = diffStates(a, b);
  const back = applyDelta(a, ops);
  ok("diff → apply 能精确还原目标", JSON.stringify(back) === JSON.stringify(b), JSON.stringify(ops));
  ok("未被改动的字段不产生操作（不是整对象替换）", ops.every(o => o.path.length > 0) && !ops.some(o => o.path.length === 0), JSON.stringify(ops.map(o => o.path)));
  ok("删除字段也有对应操作", ops.some(o => o.path.join(".") === "gone" && !("to" in o)), JSON.stringify(ops));
  ok("数组长度变化时整段替换（粗暴但不会错）", JSON.stringify(applyDelta({ a: [1, 2] }, diffStates({ a: [1, 2] }, { a: [1] }))) === JSON.stringify({ a: [1] }));
}

sec("[2] 逐帧记录：Checkpoint + Delta 重建任意帧");
const kit = createKit(bundle);
const b = assembleMatch(kit, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
const rec = new SnapshotRecorder(64);        // 每 64 帧一个 Checkpoint
(b.battle as any).traceLevel = "FULL";
b.battle.recorder = rec;
await b.battle.run();
const frames = b.battle.trace.length;
console.log(`    ${frames} 帧 / ${rec.checkpoints.length} 个 Checkpoint / ${rec.deltas.length} 个 Delta`);
ok("记录器真的收到了帧", rec.checkpoints.length > 0 && rec.deltas.length > 0);
ok("Checkpoint 间隔符合设定", rec.checkpoints.every((c, i) => i === 0 || c.frame - rec.checkpoints[i - 1].frame === 64), JSON.stringify(rec.checkpoints.map(c => c.frame).slice(0, 5)));

// 逐帧重建，与"当场捕获"对比
const kit2 = createKit(bundle);
const ref = assembleMatch(kit2, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
(ref.battle as any).traceLevel = "FULL";
await ref.battle.run();
const truth = captureState(ref.battle);
ok("参照运行的最终状态可捕获", !!truth);

let reconstructOk = 0, reconstructBad: string[] = [];
for (const target of [0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, frames - 1]) {
  const st = rec.stateAt(target);
  const cp: any = [...rec.checkpoints].reverse().find(c => c.frame <= target);
  if (!st || !cp) { reconstructBad.push(target + ":no-checkpoint"); continue; }
  // 用 Checkpoint 自身做锚点验证：stateAt(frame) 再往前 diff 回 checkpoint 帧应当等于该 checkpoint
  const same = JSON.stringify(st) === JSON.stringify(target === cp.frame ? cp.state : st);
  if (same) reconstructOk++; else reconstructBad.push(String(target));
}
ok(`★ 关键帧重建无异常（${reconstructOk}/8）`, reconstructBad.length === 0, reconstructBad.join(","));

// ★ 最强的逐帧断言：另跑一场"每帧都是 Checkpoint"的**密集录像**作为真值，
//   然后拿稀疏录像（每 64 帧一个 Checkpoint）重建**每一帧**去对。
//   注意一个容易想错的地方：Checkpoint 那一帧的状态跃迁**不在 Delta 流里**
//   （它被 Checkpoint 本身代表了），所以"cp0 + 全部 Delta"并不等于最后一帧状态 ——
//   唯一正确的对比方式是同一帧的 stateAt vs 真值。
{
  const dense = new SnapshotRecorder(1);        // 每一帧都存完整状态 = 真值
  const dk = createKit(bundle);
  const db = assembleMatch(dk, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  (db.battle as any).traceLevel = "FULL";
  db.battle.recorder = dense;
  await db.battle.run();

  let mismatches: string[] = [];
  const n = Math.min(rec.lastFrame, dense.lastFrame);
  for (let f = 0; f <= n; f++) {
    const a = rec.stateAt(f), b = dense.stateAt(f);
    if (!a || !b || JSON.stringify(a) !== JSON.stringify(b)) mismatches.push(String(f));
  }
  ok(`★★ 稀疏录像重建的**每一帧**（${n + 1} 帧）都与密集录像逐字节一致`, mismatches.length === 0, `不一致帧：${mismatches.slice(0, 5).join(",")}`);

  const rebuiltFinal = rec.stateAt(rec.lastFrame);
  ok(`★★ 逐帧重建出的最终状态 === 连续跑完的真实状态（终局帧 ${rec.lastFrame}）`, JSON.stringify(rebuiltFinal) === JSON.stringify(truth),
     `重建 vs 真实：${rebuiltFinal ? stateHash(rebuiltFinal) : "null"} vs ${stateHash(truth)}`);
  ok("密集录像的每帧确实都是 Checkpoint（真值来源可信）", dense.checkpoints.length === n + 1, `${dense.checkpoints.length} vs ${n + 1}`);
}

sec("[3] Delta 比全量快照省多少（§22 的动机）");
const st = rec.stats(frames);
const perState = rec.checkpoints[0].bytes;
const naiveKB = (perState * frames / 1024).toFixed(1);
const actualKB = ((st.checkpointBytes + st.deltaBytes) / 1024).toFixed(1);
const avgDelta = st.deltaBytes / Math.max(1, st.deltas);
console.log(`    单帧完整状态 = ${(perState / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB；每帧全量 = ${naiveKB} KB；Checkpoint+Delta = ${actualKB} KB；省 ${(st.savingRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
console.log(`    单个 Delta 平均 ${avgDelta.toFixed(0)} 字节 / 最多 ${st.maxDeltaOps} 个操作`);
ok("★ 相比每帧全量快照至少省 50%", st.savingRatio > 0.5, `省 ${(st.savingRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
ok("单个 Delta 是稀疏的（平均不到 3KB）", avgDelta < 3000, `平均 ${avgDelta.toFixed(0)} 字节`);

sec("[4] Trace Level 三档（§35）：观测粒度不得影响模拟结果");
async function runWith(level: "NONE" | "SUMMARY" | "FULL") {
  const k = createKit(bundle);
  const x = assembleMatch(k, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  (x.battle as any).traceLevel = level;
  if (level === "FULL") x.battle.recorder = new SnapshotRecorder(128);
  const r = await x.battle.run();
  /** ★★★ 第 192 轮：把**事件标签直方图**也带出来 —— 三档的差别要看标签，不能只看条数 */
  const kinds: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const e of x.battle.trace as any[]) kinds[String(e.t)] = (kinds[String(e.t)] ?? 0) + 1;
  const stats = {
    damage: (x.battle.trace as any[]).filter((e: any) => e.t === "DAMAGE").length,
    killed: (x.battle.trace as any[]).filter((e: any) => e.t === "KILLED").length,
    casts: (x.battle.trace as any[]).filter((e: any) => e.t === "SKILL_CAST").length,
  };
  /**
   * ★ §35 的第四项 first kill。
   *   ★ 判据用**「首杀之前发生过多少次伤害」**，不用事件流下标：SUMMARY 会把逐帧细节滤掉，
   *     同一条阵亡在两条流里的下标天然不同（16 vs 62）—— 那不是分歧，是两档的粒度不同。
   *     以「伤害次数」为刻度就与档位无关，而它恰好就是统计档能回答的问题（第几次伤害后出现首杀）。
   */
  const firstDeathAt = (() => {
    const arr = x.battle.trace as any[];
    const i = arr.findIndex((e: any) => e.t === "DEATH" || e.t === "KILLED");
    return i < 0 ? -1 : arr.slice(0, i).filter((e: any) => e.t === "DAMAGE").length;
  })();
  return { r, state: captureState(x.battle), traceLen: x.battle.trace.length, hash: stateHash(captureState(x.battle)), kinds, stats, firstDeathAt };
}
const none = await runWith("NONE");
const summary = await runWith("SUMMARY");
const full = await runWith("FULL");
ok("★ 三档的胜者/回合/原因完全一致", none.r.winner === summary.r.winner && summary.r.winner === full.r.winner && none.r.turns === full.r.turns && none.r.reason === full.r.reason,
   JSON.stringify([none.r, summary.r, full.r]));
ok("★ 三档的最终核心状态指纹完全一致", none.hash === summary.hash && summary.hash === full.hash, `${none.hash} / ${summary.hash} / ${full.hash}`);
ok("NONE 档确实不产生事件流", none.traceLen === 0, String(none.traceLen));
ok("FULL 档产生事件流且抓了快照", full.traceLen > 0);
/**
 * ★★★ 第 192 轮：**SUMMARY 是统计档，不是「FULL 去掉快照」**。
 *   旧断言写的是 summary.traceLen === full.traceLen —— 那是在「SUMMARY 与 FULL 无法区分」的时期
 *   按事实写下的，但它同时把**规格**（a1-4 §35：SUMMARY 只收 damage / death / skill usage / first kill）
 *   钉成了「不该成立」。这一轮把 SUMMARY 做实，断言按规格与事实一起改写。
 */
ok("★★★ SUMMARY 只留「统计」那四类（§35：damage / death / skill usage / first kill）",
  summary.traceLen > 0 && Object.keys(summary.kinds).every(k => SUMMARY_KINDS.has(k)),
  JSON.stringify({ len: summary.traceLen, kinds: Object.keys(summary.kinds) }));
ok("★★★ 而 SUMMARY 明显比 FULL 短（统计档不再原样收下整条事件流）",
  summary.traceLen > 0 && summary.traceLen < full.traceLen, `${summary.traceLen} vs ${full.traceLen}`);
ok("★★★ FULL 有、SUMMARY 没有的那些正是逐帧细节（状态 / 行动条 / 治疗 / AI 决策）",
  ["STATUS_APPLY", "TIMELINE_SHIFT", "HEAL", "AI_DECISION"].every(k => (full.kinds[k] ?? 0) > 0 && (summary.kinds[k] ?? 0) === 0),
  JSON.stringify({ fullKinds: Object.keys(full.kinds).length, summaryKinds: Object.keys(summary.kinds).length }));
ok("★★★ 但**统计量本身一致**：伤害 / 阵亡 / 技能使用三类在 SUMMARY 与 FULL 里逐条相同（观测粒度不改战斗）",
  JSON.stringify(summary.stats) === JSON.stringify(full.stats) && summary.stats.damage > 0 && summary.stats.casts > 0,
  JSON.stringify({ summary: summary.stats, full: full.stats }));
/**
 * ★★★ §35 给 SUMMARY 列了四项：damage / death / skill usage / **first kill**。
 *   前两项与 skill usage 已由 stats 断言；「first kill」是**位置**信息 —— 它在 SUMMARY 里也必须算得出来。
 */
ok("★★★ 第四项 first kill 也在（SUMMARY 能回答「第几次伤害之后出现首杀」，与 FULL 一致）",
  summary.firstDeathAt === full.firstDeathAt && summary.firstDeathAt >= 0,
  JSON.stringify({ summary: summary.firstDeathAt, full: full.firstDeathAt }));
ok("★★★ SUMMARY 的三类统计**都能从它自己的事件流里算出来**（这就是这一档的用途）",
  summary.kinds.DAMAGE === summary.stats.damage && (summary.kinds.SKILL_CAST ?? 0) === summary.stats.casts,
  JSON.stringify(summary.kinds));

sec("[5] ★★★ Trace Level 三档在内核里必须真的分成三档（第 64 轮重写）");

/**
 * 这一节原来是**墙钟比值**断言：`NONE 档耗时 / SUMMARY 档耗时 ≤ 1.35`。
 * 它自己都写明了"本引擎战斗计算占大头，观测开销只有几个百分点，比值在噪声范围内" ——
 * 也就是说它守不住它想守的东西，却会**因为机器忙而变红**：
 * 第 63 轮我把两套测试并发跑，这条就红了（单独重跑 20/20）。
 * 一条会因负载变红的断言，长期看就是在训练人忽略红字。
 *
 * 换成**与负载无关**的判据：数"这一档到底做了多少观测"。
 * 而要做到这一点，先得把内核里的一个洞补上 ——
 * 此前 `recorder.onFrame` 是**无条件**调用的，`traceLevel` 只管 trace：
 *   · NONE 挂了 recorder 仍会回调终局帧（不是"只跑战斗，不留观测"）；
 *   · SUMMARY 与 FULL 在内核里完全无法区分（差别只在调用方挂不挂 recorder）。
 * battle.ts 现在收口到 `snapshot()`：只有 FULL 档产生快照。
 */
async function observe(level: "NONE" | "SUMMARY" | "FULL", attach: boolean) {
  const k = createKit(bundle);
  const x = assembleMatch(k, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  (x.battle as any).traceLevel = level;
  let frames = 0;
  if (attach) x.battle.recorder = { onFrame: () => { frames++; } };
  const r = await x.battle.run();
  return { trace: x.battle.trace.length, frames, r };
}
{
  const rows: Array<[{ trace: number; frames: number }, string]> = [];
  for (const [level, want] of [["NONE", "trace=0 / frames=0"], ["SUMMARY", "trace>0 / frames=0"], ["FULL", "trace>0 / frames>0"]] as const) {
    const yes = await observe(level as any, true);
    const no = await observe(level as any, false);
    rows.push([yes, level + " + 挂 recorder：trace " + yes.trace + "｜frames " + yes.frames + "（期望 " + want + "）"]);
    // ★ 核心断言：**档位名必须保证行为** —— 挂了 recorder 也不能越过档位拿到快照
    if (level === "NONE") {
      ok("★★★ NONE 档即使挂了 recorder 也不产生任何观测（trace 0 / frames 0）", yes.trace === 0 && yes.frames === 0, JSON.stringify(yes));
    } else if (level === "SUMMARY") {
      ok("★★★ SUMMARY 档产生事件流、但**拿不到快照**（挂 recorder 也不行）", yes.trace > 0 && yes.frames === 0, JSON.stringify(yes));
    } else {
      ok("★★★ FULL 档产生事件流与快照", yes.trace > 0 && yes.frames > 0, JSON.stringify(yes));
    }
    // 反向：没挂 recorder 自然没有帧（这一条排除"帧数被别的东西凑出来"）
    ok("★★ " + level + " 档不挂 recorder ⇒ 0 帧", no.frames === 0, String(no.frames));
    ok("★ " + level + " 档挂不挂 recorder，trace 条数一致（观测不影响模拟）", yes.trace === no.trace, yes.trace + " vs " + no.trace);
  }
  console.log("    " + rows.map(r => r[1]).join("\n    "));
  // 三档的"观测工作量"必须**严格递增** —— 这才是"三档有存在意义"的可数形式
  const [none, summary, full] = await Promise.all([observe("NONE", true), observe("SUMMARY", true), observe("FULL", true)]);
  const work = (x: { trace: number; frames: number }) => x.trace + x.frames;
  ok("★★★ 观测工作量严格递增：NONE < SUMMARY < FULL", work(none) < work(summary) && work(summary) < work(full),
    JSON.stringify([work(none), work(summary), work(full)]));
  ok("★★ 三档的胜负与回合仍然一致（观测粒度不得影响结果）",
    none.r.winner === full.r.winner && none.r.turns === full.r.turns,
    JSON.stringify([none.r, full.r]));
}
{
  // 耗时只作为**信息**打印，不作为断言：它取决于机器负载（第 63 轮踩过）。
  const bench = async (level: "NONE" | "SUMMARY" | "FULL", n: number) => {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const k = createKit(bundle);
      const x = assembleMatch(k, canonicalMatch(), { seed: 100000 + i });
      (x.battle as any).traceLevel = level;
      await x.battle.run();
    }
    return Date.now() - t0;
  };
  const N = 30;
  await bench("NONE", 5); await bench("SUMMARY", 5);            // 预热
  const tNone = await bench("NONE", N), tSum = await bench("SUMMARY", N), tFull = await bench("FULL", N);
  console.log("    （仅供参考，不作为断言）" + N + " 局：NONE " + tNone + "ms / SUMMARY " + tSum + "ms / FULL " + tFull + "ms");
  console.log("    战斗计算占绝对大头，观测开销在噪声范围内 —— 所以这一档的判据是**工作量**，不是毫秒。");
}

console.log(`\n=== G2: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g20-conservation.ts`

```ts
// tests/g20-conservation.ts — ★ 守恒不变量（目标 ⑩）：把「只有唯一入口能改这些值」证明出来
//
// 由来：g1 已经逐条检查了「扣火: before − cost === after」「HP 不为负」这类**局部**约束，
// 但局部约束证明不了"没有第二条路径偷偷改过它"。真正能证明的是**整局守恒恒等式**：
//   初始总血量 − 终局总血量 == Σ伤害.applied + Σ失去 − Σ治疗 − Σ恢复
// 只要有任何一处绕过 Entity.mutateHp 直接写 hp，这个等式立刻不成立。
// 鬼火同理：初始 + Σ回火（按实际入账）− Σ扣火 == 终局。
//
// 这类断言的价值在于：它不需要知道"正确的机制是什么"，只需要知道"账必须平"。
// 在红区（规则未实测）里，这是少数几个**不依赖游戏知识**就能成立的硬约束。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const EPS = 1e-6;
const sum = (a: number[]) => a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);

/** 跑一局并保留完整 trace（守恒等式需要每条事件） */
const runFull = async (seed: number) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const startHp = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const e of a.battle.allEntities()) startHp.set(e.id, e.hp);
  const startOrbs = a.battle.teams.map((t: any) => t.orbs.current);
  const r = await a.battle.run();
  return { battle: a.battle, result: r, startHp, startOrbs };
};

sec("[1] 血量守恒恒等式（整局账必须平）");
{
  const { battle, result, startHp } = await runFull(20261001);
  const trace = battle.trace as any[];
  const endHp = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const e of battle.allEntities()) endHp.set(e.id, e.hp);
  const h0 = sum([...startHp.values()]), h1 = sum([...endHp.values()]);
  const dmg = sum(trace.filter(e => e.t === "DAMAGE").map(e => e.applied ?? 0));
  const loss = sum(trace.filter(e => e.t === "HP_LOSS").map(e => e.amount ?? 0));
  const heal = sum(trace.filter(e => e.t === "HEAL").map(e => e.amount ?? 0));
  const rec = sum(trace.filter(e => e.t === "RECOVER").map(e => e.amount ?? 0));
  const lhs = h0 - h1, rhs = dmg + loss - heal - rec;
  console.log("    初始总血 " + Math.round(h0).toLocaleString() + " → 终局 " + Math.round(h1).toLocaleString() +
    "｜扣血 " + Math.round(lhs).toLocaleString() + " = 伤害 " + Math.round(dmg).toLocaleString() + " + 失去 " + Math.round(loss).toLocaleString() +
    " − 治疗 " + Math.round(heal).toLocaleString() + " − 恢复 " + Math.round(rec).toLocaleString());
  console.log("    回合 " + result.turns + "｜事件 " + trace.length + " 条");
  ok("★ 伤害/治疗事件确实产生了（否则等式会平凡成立）", dmg > 0 && (heal > 0 || rec > 0), JSON.stringify([dmg, heal, rec]));
  ok("★★ 整局血量守恒：初始 − 终局 == Σ伤害 + Σ失去 − Σ治疗 − Σ恢复", Math.abs(lhs - rhs) < 1, lhs.toFixed(2) + " vs " + rhs.toFixed(2));
}

sec("[2] 鬼火守恒恒等式（每队各算一次）");
{
  const { battle, startOrbs } = await runFull(20261001);
  const trace = battle.trace as any[];
  for (const teamId of [0, 1]) {
    const t: any = battle.teams[teamId];
    // ★ 三种入账路径的字段形状**各不相同**，这是守恒等式逼出来的：
    //   ORB_GAIN（技能给火）用 before/after；ORB_REWARD（鬼火条周期回火）只有 gained；
    //   ORB_PAY 用 amount。第一版我按 before/after 一把算，直接算出 NaN —— 正是这类
    //   "我以为我知道所有改鬼火的地方"被守恒等式当场戳穿。
    const gained = sum(trace.filter(e => e.team === teamId && e.t === "ORB_GAIN").map(e => (e.after ?? 0) - (e.before ?? 0)))
      + sum(trace.filter(e => e.team === teamId && e.t === "ORB_REWARD").map(e => e.gained ?? 0));
    const paid = sum(trace.filter(e => e.team === teamId && e.t === "ORB_PAY").map(e => e.amount ?? 0));
    const lhs = t.orbs.current - startOrbs[teamId];
    console.log("    队" + teamId + " 初始 " + startOrbs[teamId] + " → 终局 " + t.orbs.current + "｜入账 +" + gained + "｜支出 −" + paid);
    ok("★ 队" + teamId + " 鬼火守恒：终局 − 初始 == Σ入账 − Σ支出", Math.abs(lhs - (gained - paid)) < EPS, lhs + " vs " + (gained - paid));
    ok("队" + teamId + " 鬼火始终在 [0, 上限] 内", t.orbs.current >= 0 && t.orbs.current <= (t.orbs.max ?? 8), String(t.orbs.current));
  }
}

sec("[3] 死亡状态机：不重复、层级自洽、凶手真实");
{
  const { battle } = await runFull(20261001);
  const trace = battle.trace as any[];
  const deaths = trace.filter(e => e.t === "DEATH");
  const byId = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const d of deaths) byId.set(d.id, (byId.get(d.id) ?? 0) + 1);
  ok("前置：本局确实有人阵亡", deaths.length > 0, String(deaths.length));
  ok("★ 同一个单位不会死两次", [...byId.values()].every(n => n === 1), JSON.stringify([...byId.entries()].filter(([, n]) => n > 1)));
  const units = battle.allEntities();
  ok("★ killed ⇒ dead ⇒ !alive（三层不能互相矛盾）", units.every((u: any) => !u.killed || (u.dead && !u.alive)),
    JSON.stringify(units.filter((u: any) => u.killed && !(u.dead && !u.alive)).map((u: any) => u.id)));
  ok("★ hpZero ⇒ hp ≤ 0", units.every((u: any) => !u.hpZero || u.hp <= EPS), JSON.stringify(units.filter((u: any) => u.hpZero && u.hp > EPS).map((u: any) => u.id)));
  ok("★ 击杀归属指向真实存在的单位（或是环境）", units.every((u: any) => u.killCredit === null || u.killCredit === undefined || battle.entity(u.killCredit) !== undefined),
    JSON.stringify(units.filter((u: any) => u.killCredit != null && battle.entity(u.killCredit) === undefined).map((u: any) => [u.id, u.killCredit])));
  ok("阵亡人数与统计一致", deaths.length === [...battle.stats.deaths.values()].reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0), String(deaths.length));
}

sec("[4] ★ Victory 即时检查：判胜必须发生在最后一个成员阵亡的**那一回合**");
{
  let checked = 0, bad = 0;
  for (const seed of [20261001, 20261002, 20261003, 7, 99]) {
    const { battle, result } = await runFull(seed);
    if (result.winner === null) continue;
    const loser = 1 - (result.winner as number);
    const deaths = (battle.trace as any[]).filter(e => e.t === "DEATH" && battle.teamOf(e.id) === loser);
    // 败方最后一个阵亡者的回合：用状态序列里的 turn 归属（trace 事件带 frame，回合数从 turnLog 取）
    const lastDeath = deaths[deaths.length - 1];
    if (!lastDeath) continue;
    // 通过该事件所在的 TURN 节点反查回合序号
    const node = (battle.bus as any).node?.(lastDeath.ev);
    let turnOfDeath: number | null = null;
    let cur = node;
    while (cur && turnOfDeath === null) {
      if (cur.code === "TURN") turnOfDeath = (battle.turnLog as any[]).findIndex((t: any) => t.turn === cur.payload?.turn) + 1 || null;
      cur = cur.parent === null ? null : (battle.bus as any).node?.(cur.parent);
    }
    checked++;
    // 判胜那一回合 = 战斗结束时的 turn
    if (result.turns !== battle.turn) bad++;
  }
  ok("★ 抽到的每一局都检查过", checked > 0, String(checked));
  ok("★★ 结束回合与引擎记录的回合一致（不存在「多打了几回合才发现」）", bad === 0, String(bad));
  // 更直接的证据：败方最后一个成员阵亡之后，不应再有该方成员行动
  const { battle, result } = await runFull(20261001);
  const loser = 1 - (result.winner as number);
  const aliveAtEnd = battle.allEntities().filter((e: any) => battle.teamOf(e.id) === loser && e.alive);
  ok("★ 判负方在终局时确实一个不剩", aliveAtEnd.length === 0, JSON.stringify(aliveAtEnd.map((e: any) => e.id)));
}

sec("[5] 状态生命周期：层数与持续时间自洽，到期必留痕");
{
  const { battle } = await runFull(20261001);
  const trace = battle.trace as any[];
  const applies = trace.filter(e => e.t === "STATUS_APPLY");
  const expires = trace.filter(e => e.t === "STATUS_EXPIRE");
  ok("前置：本局有状态施加", applies.length > 0, String(applies.length));
  ok("★ 施加事件都带 duration 且 ≥ 1", applies.every(e => typeof e.duration === "number" && e.duration >= 1), JSON.stringify(applies.filter(e => !(e.duration >= 1)).slice(0, 3)));
  ok("★ 到期事件存在（状态不是只进不出）", expires.length > 0, String(expires.length));
  const units = battle.allEntities();
  ok("★ 活着的单位身上没有 remaining ≤ 0 的残留状态", units.every((u: any) => !u.alive || u.statuses.every((s: any) => s.remaining > 0)),
    JSON.stringify(units.flatMap((u: any) => u.statuses.filter((s: any) => s.remaining <= 0).map((s: any) => [u.id, s.def.id, s.remaining]))));
  ok("★ 状态条数不超过施加次数（不能凭空增殖）", units.every((u: any) => u.statuses.length <= applies.length), String(applies.length));
}

sec("[6] 三档 Trace Level 的**全部统计**必须完全一致（不只总伤害）");
{
  const statsOf = async (level: string) => {
    const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001, traceLevel: level });
    await a.battle.run();
    const s = a.battle.stats;
    const norm = (m: Map<number, number>) => [...m.entries()].sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]).map(([k, v]) => k + ":" + Math.round(v * 1000));
    const usage = [...s.skillUsage.entries()].sort().map(([k, v]: any) => k + ":" + [...v.entries()].sort().map(([a2, b2]: any) => a2 + "=" + b2).join(","));
    return JSON.stringify({ d: norm(s.damageDealt), t: norm(s.damageTaken), h: norm(s.healing), k: norm(s.kills), dd: norm(s.deaths), a: norm(s.actions), u: usage, end: stateHash(captureState(a.battle)) });
  };
  const none = await statsOf("NONE"), summary = await statsOf("SUMMARY"), full = await statsOf("FULL");
  ok("★★ NONE 与 FULL 的全部统计逐字节一致", none === full, none.slice(0, 120) + " vs " + full.slice(0, 120));
  ok("★★ SUMMARY 与 FULL 也一致", summary === full, summary.slice(0, 80) + " vs " + full.slice(0, 80));
}

sec("[7] 事件计数与统计口径一致（同一份真相，不是两处各算一遍）");
{
  const { battle } = await runFull(20261001);

  const casts = trace.filter(e => e.t === "SKILL_CAST").length;
  const usageTotal = [...battle.stats.skillUsage.values()].reduce((a: number, m: any) => a + [...m.values()].reduce((x: number, y: number) => x + y, 0), 0);
  ok("★ SKILL_CAST 条数 == 技能使用统计总数", casts === usageTotal, casts + " vs " + usageTotal);
  const dmgEvents = trace.filter(e => e.t === "DAMAGE").length;

  ok("伤害事件数与统计覆盖的单位数自洽", dmgEvents > 0 && dmgStat > 0, JSON.stringify([dmgEvents, dmgStat]));
  const frames = trace.map(e => e.frame);
  ok("★ 帧号连续且唯一（0..N-1）", frames.every((f, i) => f === i), String(trace.length));
}

console.log("\n=== 守恒与不变量: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g21-purge.ts`

```ts
// tests/g21-purge.ts — ★ 驱散 / 解除：一个**完全没有被实现**的机制，而且被报成 HIGH 置信度
//
// 由来：把 EV 事件码纳入字段级普查后发现 STATUS_REMOVE 从未被派发。追下去：
//   · Entity.dispel() / Entity.remove() 在生产代码里**零调用**（只有 tests/m0 直接调）
//   · 技能文本里的「驱散」「解除」根本没进过 IR
// 最坏的部分不是"没实现"，而是**它自称实现了**：句子只要匹配到 [tips_1] 之类的引用就记为 PARSED，
// 于是「为友方目标驱散3个减益状态或[tips_3]，并治疗生命上限30%的生命」被报成
// confidence=HIGH / unparsed=0 —— Fidelity 的 SKILL 层据此把它算作"完整编译"。
//
// 官方[8]驱散 / 官方[1]解除的差别是现成的：能否驱散看印记的 dispellable，
// 能否解除看 removable。这两个标记一直在，只是从来没人读。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { buildCharacter } from "../compile/character.ts";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const buffs = new Map<string, any>(
  (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
    .map(b => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]),
);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const mk = (desc: string) => compileSkill(1, "探查单位", { id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc });
const probeSkill = (desc: string) =>
  buildCharacter({ id: 1, name: "探查单位", panel: { atk: 1000, hp: 50000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, skills: [{ id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc }] },
    undefined, undefined, buffs, 0, 1).entity.skills[0];
const fresh = async (seed = 20261001) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a.battle;
};
const firstDebuff = String((JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[])
  .find(b => String(compileBuff(b).category).startsWith("DEBUFF") && compileBuff(b).dispellable)!.id);

sec("[1] 解析：数量 / 对象 / 类型");
{
  const p1 = mk("为友方目标驱散3个减益状态");
  ok("前置：解析出了 purge 条目", p1.purge.length === 1, JSON.stringify(p1.purge));
  ok("★ 数量 3", p1.purge[0]?.count === 3, JSON.stringify(p1.purge[0]));
  ok("★ 对象 = 己方（友方目标）", p1.purge[0]?.side === "ALLY", JSON.stringify(p1.purge[0]));
  ok("★ 类型 = 减益", p1.purge[0]?.what === "DEBUFF", JSON.stringify(p1.purge[0]));
  ok("默认动作是 DISPEL（驱散）", p1.purge[0]?.kind === "DISPEL", JSON.stringify(p1.purge[0]));

  const p2 = mk("解除自身所有减益状态");
  ok("★ 「所有」→ count = 99", p2.purge[0]?.count === 99, JSON.stringify(p2.purge));
  ok("★ 动作是 REMOVE（解除）", p2.purge[0]?.kind === "REMOVE", JSON.stringify(p2.purge));

  const p3 = mk("驱散敌方目标1个增益状态");
  ok("★ 对象 = 敌方", p3.purge[0]?.side === "ENEMY" && p3.purge[0]?.what === "BUFF", JSON.stringify(p3.purge));

  const p4 = mk("该护盾不可驱散，且无法被解除");
  ok("★ 「不可驱散 / 无法被解除」是免疫声明，不是动作 → 不产生 purge", p4.purge.length === 0, JSON.stringify(p4.purge));

  const p5 = mk("造成攻击100%的伤害");
  ok("没有驱散字样的技能不产生 purge", p5.purge.length === 0);
}

sec("[2] 运行时：驱散真的把状态拿掉了");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const foe = bt.enemiesOf(0)[0];
  // 真实的进攻性驱散：驱散**敌方**身上的**增益**。内置 StatusBook 里全是减益，
  // 所以这里按 g13 的做法临时造一个可驱散的增益状态（这也让"类型过滤"被真正检验到）。
  const buffDef = { ...StatusBook.get("freeze")!, id: "probe_buff", name: "探查·增益", category: "BUFF_STATE" as any, dispellable: true };
  foe.addStatus(buffDef as any, 999, 1, 5);
  ok("前置：敌人身上有增益", foe.hasStatus("probe_buff"), JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((s: any) => s.def.id)));
  const skill = probeSkill("驱散敌方目标1个增益状态");
  bt.trace.length = 0;
  await skill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  const ev = bt.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "STATUS_REMOVE");
  ok("★★ 增益被驱散（此前 dispel() 在生产代码里零调用 = 什么都不发生）", !foe.hasStatus("probe_buff"), JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((s: any) => s.def.id)));
  ok("★ 发出 STATUS_REMOVE 事件（这个事件码此前从未被派发过）", ev.length === 1 && ev[0].by === "DISPEL", JSON.stringify(ev));
  ok("事件写明顺序依据（驱散优先级是红区，不假装知道）", /红区/.test(ev[0]?.order ?? ""), JSON.stringify(ev[0]));
}

sec("[3] 不可驱散 / 不可解除 的边界必须守住");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const foe = bt.enemiesOf(0)[0];
  foe.addStatus(StatusBook.get("stun")!, 999, 1, 5);            // 眩晕：不可驱散，但可解除
  const dispelSkill = probeSkill("驱散敌方目标1个减益状态");
  await dispelSkill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  ok("★ 不可驱散的状态驱散不掉", foe.hasStatus("stun"), JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((s: any) => s.def.id)));
  const removeSkill = probeSkill("解除敌方目标1个减益状态");
  await removeSkill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  ok("★ 但可以解除（remove 看 removable，与 dispel 是两套标记）", !foe.hasStatus("stun"), JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((s: any) => s.def.id)));
  const frost = StatusBook.get("frost")!;
  foe.addStatus(frost, 999, 1, 5);
  await removeSkill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  ok("★ 霜冻不可解除（官方[3]明确写死）", foe.hasStatus("frost"), JSON.stringify(foe.statuses.map((s: any) => s.def.id)));
}

sec("[4] 数量上限：写 1 个就只拿 1 个");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const foe = bt.enemiesOf(0)[0];
  const id = firstDebuff;
  const cb = buffs.get(id)!;
  const def = StatusBook.get(cb.id) ?? { id: cb.id, name: cb.name, category: cb.category, dispellable: cb.dispellable, removable: cb.removable, preventsAction: false, preventsSkill: false, forcesBasicAttack: false, suppressPassive: false, suppressSoul: false, locksTimeline: false, durationPolicy: "SOURCE_TURN", desc: cb.desc };
  StatusBook.set(cb.id, def as any);
  foe.addStatus(def as any, 999, 1, 5);
  foe.addStatus(StatusBook.get("bind")!, 999, 1, 5);            // 禁锢：可驱散
  const before = foe.statuses.filter((s: any) => s.def.dispellable).length;
  ok("前置：身上有 ≥2 个可驱散状态", before >= 2, String(before));
  const skill = probeSkill("驱散敌方目标1个减益状态");
  await skill.execute(bt, self, foe);
  const after = foe.statuses.filter((s: any) => s.def.dispellable).length;
  ok("★ 只掉了 1 个（count=1）", after === before - 1, before + " → " + after);
}

sec("[5] 全库口径：有多少技能真的带上了 purge，以及 HIGH 置信度里的水分");
{
  const shiki = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const list = Array.isArray(shiki) ? shiki : (shiki.characters ?? shiki.items ?? []);
  let withPurge = 0, dispelTxt = 0, highButUnparsed = 0, total = 0;
  for (const c of list) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
    total++;
    const ir = compileSkill(Number(c.id ?? 0), String(c.name ?? ""), sk);
    if (ir.purge.length) withPurge++;
    const d = String(sk.description ?? "");
    if (/驱散/.test(d) && !/不可驱散|无法(?:被)?驱散/.test(d)) {
      dispelTxt++;
      // ★ 文本里有驱散、却既没解析出 purge、也没报 unparsed 的 —— 就是"自称完整编译"的水分
      /**
       * ★★★ 第 199 轮：**purgeSkips 也算账**。规则句/条件句（「被束缚的单位可以通过…解除控制」）
       *   不再被当成动作（那会凭空扒状态），但它们**没有消失** —— 逐条记在 purgeSkips 里带理由码。
       *   闸门的本意是「别自称完整」，不是「必须解析成动作」⇒ 有 purgeSkips 就不算水分。
       */
      const recorded = !!(ir as any).purgeSkips?.length;
      if (!ir.purge.length && ir.unparsed.length === 0 && !recorded) { highButUnparsed++; }
    }
  }
  console.log("    技能 " + total + "｜带 purge " + withPurge + "｜文本含「驱散」 " + dispelTxt + "｜其中**既没解析也没报缺口** " + highButUnparsed);
  ok("★ 确实解析出了一批 purge（不是 0）", withPurge > 10, String(withPurge));
  ok("★★ 含驱散却自称无缺口的技能必须为 0（本轮修掉的就是这个）", highButUnparsed === 0, String(highButUnparsed));
}

console.log("\n=== 驱散与解除: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g22-capability-claims.ts`

```ts
// tests/g22-capability-claims.ts — ★ 能力矩阵必须**可被机器证伪**（目标 ①：Fidelity 不许过度声称）
//
// 由来：capability/registry.ts 的 48 条能力声明是 Fidelity **MECHANIC 层**的数据源 ——
// 它说 FULL，报告里就少一条缺口。但这份表长期只是"一份声明"：
//   · 复活标 FULL，而 Battle.revive() 在生产代码里**零调用**（只有 tests/m0 直接调）
//   · 封印标 FULL，而抑制集合 suppressedPassive 在生产代码里**没有任何写入方**
//   · 反击/协战标 PARTIAL，而 runPseudoTurn 同样**没有生产者**
// 这三条都不是实现问题，是**声明与代码脱节**：表格比代码乐观。
//
// 本轮给每条能力加 producer（一段必须在生产代码里出现的正则），并把这个不变量变成测试：
//   FULL  ⇒ producer 必须匹配到生产代码
//   NONE  ⇒ 若给了 producer，则必须匹配不到
//   PARTIAL ⇒ producer 可选，但没有 producer 的条目会被如实列出（不静默通过）
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { CAPABILITIES, coverage } from "../capability/registry.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const BL = path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab");

function walk(d: string, acc: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.name === "node_modules" || e.name === "dist") continue;
    const p = path.join(d, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p, acc);
    else if (p.endsWith(".ts")) acc.push(p);
  }
  return acc;
}
/**
 * 「生产代码」= 战斗路径（kernel / compile / soul / runner 的业务部分）+ 网页 src。
 * 排除三类：
 *   · tests / tools —— 测试与审计工具
 *   · capability/registry|report —— **声明本身不是实现**（否则一句话就能让声明自我满足）
 *   · compile/unmodeled.ts —— 同上：它是「引擎缺什么」的**声明表**，不是实现。
 *     第 29 轮真实踩到：它在 evidence 里原样记录了探测用的正则，
 *     于是"复活没有调用方"这条断言被自己的文档字符串弄红了 —— 文档不是代码。
 *   · experiments/  —— A/B 对照脚手架（与 tools 同类：它验证机制，但不参与实战路径）
 * 最后一条是第 28 轮明确下来的：封印的抑制集合只有 experiments 会写，
 * 若把脚手架算作"有生产者"，这个缺口就会被自己的脚手架掩盖 —— 那正是本项目反复踩的坑。
 */
const isScaffold = (f: string) => /[\\/](tests|tools|experiments)[\\/]/.test(f);
const isDeclaration = (f: string) =>
  /[\\/]capability[\\/](registry|report)\.ts$/.test(f) ||
  /[\\/]compile[\\/]unmodeled\.ts$/.test(f) ||
  /[\\/]tools[\\/]field-census\.ts$/.test(f);
const prod = [
  ...walk(BL).filter(f => !isScaffold(f)),
  ...walk(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src")),
].filter(f => !isDeclaration(f));
/**
 * ★ 先剥注释再匹配：注释里写「rg 'this\\.revive\\(' 无命中」**不是**调用点。
 *   这个坑在本轮真实发生过 —— compile/unmodeled.ts 里为了记录验证依据，
 *   把探测用的正则原文写进了注释，于是"复活无调用方"这条断言当场变红。
 *   生产者的判定必须只看代码，不看文档。
 */
const stripComments = (s: string) => s.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, "$1");
const sources = prod.map(f => ({ f: path.relative(ROOT, f), s: stripComments(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")) }));
const grep = (re: string) => {
  const r = new RegExp(re, "g");
  const hits: string[] = [];
  for (const { f, s } of sources) for (const line of s.split("\n")) if (r.test(line)) { hits.push(f); r.lastIndex = 0; }
  return [...new Set(hits)];
};

sec("[1] 表本身：48 条能力、与游戏 tags[] 对齐");
{
  ok("能力条目 = 48（官方 tags 48 类）", CAPABILITIES.length === 48, String(CAPABILITIES.length));
  const keys = CAPABILITIES.map(c => c.key);
  ok("key 不重复", new Set(keys).size === keys.length, JSON.stringify(keys.filter((k, i) => keys.indexOf(k) !== i)));
  const shiki = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const tagFreq: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const s of shiki) for (const sk of s.skills ?? []) for (const t of sk.tags ?? []) tagFreq[t] = (tagFreq[t] ?? 0) + 1;
  const missing = CAPABILITIES.filter(c => !(c.tag in tagFreq)).map(c => c.tag);
  ok("★ 每一条的 tag 都能在游戏数据里找到（没有自造能力）", missing.length === 0, JSON.stringify(missing));
}

    JSON.stringify(unmatched.map(c => c.key + " /" + c.producer + "/")));
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g23-unmodeled.ts`

```ts
// tests/g23-unmodeled.ts — ★ 「自称完整编译」的水分必须被挤掉（目标 ①：Fidelity 不许过度声称）
//
// 由来：句子分类是**整句**级的 —— 只要匹配到任何一个模式（哪怕 [tips_1] 这种纯引用）就记 PARSED。
// 于是「战斗开始时获得[buff]，受到致命伤害时复活」这种句子被报成 confidence=HIGH / unparsed=0，
// Fidelity 的 SKILL 层据此算进「完整编译（无可执行缺口）」。
//
// 第 27 轮试过"子句里有机制词就判未建模"，结果大面积误报（印记自带效果、条件碎片）。
// 这一版只收**能证明引擎里没有行为代码**的动词，并排除三种误报。本测试同时锁住两边：
//   ① 真机制必须被标出来；② 误报类（过滤器/条件碎片/免疫声明）必须**不**被标出来。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill, splitClauses } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { UNMODELED, findUnmodeled } from "../compile/unmodeled.ts";
import { assessFidelity } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";
import type { FidelityInput } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
```
