### `battle-lab/tests/g74-delta-economy.ts`

```ts
// tests/g74-delta-economy.ts — ★★★ 第 118 轮：G2 的 Delta 体积与自证（a1-4.md §35/§38/§103）
//
// 由来：tools/_probe-size118.ts 实测（seed 123456 / **当时 597 帧**；第 244 轮补上规格 §60 的两端后为 599 帧）整份录像 730 KB：
//   frames 277 KB｜deltas 191 KB｜events 137 KB｜checkpoints 93 KB。
// 191 KB 里 2582 个标量 op，每个都要把 ["counts","trace"] 这样的路径整段写一遍 ——
// 而一局里不同路径只有几十条。这一轮做**路径字典（PATH_V1）**，并且两侧都钉死：
//   ① 体积真的降下来（同一份 rec：PLAIN vs PATH_V1 逐字节量，不靠"感觉更小"）；
//   ② 信息一点没丢（packed → expand 逐 op 还原；全部帧重建三方一致：PATH_V1 == PLAIN == 记录器内存链）；
//   ③ 老录像还放得动（v1 文件没有 deltaCodec 字段，一律按 PLAIN 读）；
//   ④ 反向：改一条 delta / 越界一个路径下标，verify 必须红 —— 否则这套编码就是没人验的空转。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { recordReplay, verifyReplayFile } from "../tools/replay-cli.ts";
import { loadReplay, serializeReplay, plainDeltas, ReplayPlayer } from "../kernel/replay.ts";
import { applyDelta, packDeltas } from "../kernel/snapshot.ts";
import { stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const SEED = 123456;
const OUT = path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "fixtures", "replay-demo-" + SEED + ".json");

sec("[0] 前提：同一场战斗、同一份记录器，分别按 PATH_V1 与 PLAIN 打包");
const A = await recordReplay(SEED);
const v1 = A.file, plain = A.plainFile;
ok("★★★ 两个文件出自**同一份 rec**（不是跑了两遍战斗 —— 那样比的就不是编码了）",
  v1.deltas.length === A.rec.deltas.length && plain.deltas.length === A.rec.deltas.length,
  v1.deltas.length + " Delta");
ok("★★ 编码声明与版本号：新文件 = v2 + PATH_V1，对照文件 = PLAIN",
  v1.schemaVersion === 2 && v1.deltaCodec === "PATH_V1" && plain.deltaCodec === "PLAIN",
  v1.schemaVersion + "/" + v1.deltaCodec + " vs " + plain.schemaVersion + "/" + plain.deltaCodec);
const paths = v1.deltaPaths ?? [];
ok("★★ 路径字典去重生效（字典里没有重复路径）",
  paths.length > 0 && new Set(paths.map(p => JSON.stringify(p))).size === paths.length,
  paths.length + " 条路径 / " + v1.deltas.reduce((s, d) => s + d.ops.length, 0) + " 个 op");
ok("★★ 帧数 / Checkpoint / 终局指纹两文件完全一致（编码不该改变任何事实）",
  v1.frames.length === plain.frames.length && v1.checkpoints.length === plain.checkpoints.length && v1.finalHash === plain.finalHash,
  v1.frames.length + " 帧｜" + v1.finalHash);

sec("[1] 体积：省掉的正是「重复写路径」这一笔");
const plainBytes = serializeReplay(plain).length, v1Bytes = serializeReplay(v1).length;
const dPlain = plain.deltas.reduce((s, d) => s + d.bytes, 0), dV1 = v1.deltas.reduce((s, d) => s + d.bytes, 0);
const dictBytes = JSON.stringify(paths).length;
const pctD = (100 * (1 - dV1 / dPlain)).toFixed(1), pctF = (100 * (1 - v1Bytes / plainBytes)).toFixed(1);
console.log("    Delta " + dPlain + " → " + dV1 + " 字节（省 " + pctD + "%）｜整文件 " + plainBytes + " → " + v1Bytes + " 字节（省 " + pctF + "%）｜路径字典本身 " + dictBytes + " 字节");
ok("★★★ Delta 部分至少省 40%", dV1 <= dPlain * 0.6, pctD + "%");
ok("★★★ 整文件更小（含字典开销在内仍然更小）", v1Bytes < plainBytes, pctF + "%");
ok("★ 诚实记录：路径字典本身是新增开销，写在文件里（" + dictBytes + " 字节），不是零成本",
  v1.deltaCodec === "PATH_V1" && dictBytes > 0 && dictBytes < dPlain - dV1);
ok("★★ 单帧平均开销 < 2KB（长局要存得下）", v1Bytes / v1.frames.length < 2048, (v1Bytes / v1.frames.length).toFixed(0) + " 字节/帧");

sec("[2] 信息不丢：packed → expand 必须逐 op 还原成记录器里的原样");
/** op 的规范化形状（用来做深比较；path/resize/有无 to/有无 from 都要对上） */
const norm = (ops: any[]) => JSON.stringify(ops.map((o: any) => ({
  p: o.path, r: o.resize ? [o.resize.to, o.resize.tail] : null,
  hasTo: "to" in o, to: o.to ?? null, hasFrom: "from" in o, from: o.from ?? null,
})));
const back = plainDeltas(v1);
const diff: string[] = [];
for (let i = 0; i < back.length; i++) {
  if (norm(back[i].ops) !== norm(A.rec.deltas[i].ops)) { if (diff.length < 2) diff.push("frame " + back[i].frame); }
}
ok("★★★ 每一帧的 op 序列都能逐字段还原（" + back.length + " 帧全查）", back.length === A.rec.deltas.length && diff.length === 0, diff.join(","));
const pk = packDeltas(A.rec.deltas);
ok("★★ 纯函数层同一条路：packDeltas(rec) 的字典与帧数据 == 文件里那份",
  JSON.stringify(pk.paths) === JSON.stringify(paths) && JSON.stringify(pk.frames) === JSON.stringify(v1.deltas));

sec("[3] 全部帧重建：PATH_V1 == PLAIN == 记录器内存链（三方一致）");
const lastFrame = A.rec.lastFrame;
const backByFrame = new Map(back.map(d => [d.frame, d]));
const plainByFrame = new Map(plain.deltas.map(d => [d.frame, d]));
const recByFrame = new Map(A.rec.deltas.map(d => [d.frame, d]));
const cpByFrame = new Map<number, any>();
for (const c of v1.checkpoints) cpByFrame.set(c.frame, {
  v: c.state as any,
  p: plain.checkpoints.find(x => x.frame === c.frame)!.state,
  r: A.rec.checkpoints.find(x => x.frame === c.frame)!.state,
});
const valueAt = (s: any, p: any[]): any => { let c = s; for (const k of p) { if (c === null || c === undefined) return undefined; c = c[k]; } return c; };
const start = cpByFrame.get(0);
let walkV: any = structuredClone(start.v), walkP: any = structuredClone(start.p), walkR: any = structuredClone(start.r);
let cpChecked = 0, cpBad = 0, deltaFrames = 0, holes = 0, badFrames = 0;
let fromChecked = 0, fromBad = 0;
const firstBad: string[] = [], fromSample: string[] = [], cpNote: string[] = [];
for (let f = 1; f <= lastFrame; f++) {
  const dv = backByFrame.get(f), dp = plainByFrame.get(f), dr = recByFrame.get(f);
  if (!dv || !dp || !dr) { holes++; continue; }
  deltaFrames++;
  /** ★ [4] 的 from 自检同步在这里做（不再另走一遍链）：from 必须等于**前一帧**该路径的实际值 */
  for (const o of dv.ops as any[]) {
    if (o.resize) continue;
    const actual = valueAt(walkV, o.path);
    /** JSON 里 undefined 值本就不存在（set-to-undefined 与"缺键"同形），这一类不算自检样本 */
    if (actual === undefined && o.from === undefined) continue;
    fromChecked++;
    if (JSON.stringify(actual) !== JSON.stringify(o.from)) {
      fromBad++;
      if (fromSample.length < 3) fromSample.push("frame " + f + " " + JSON.stringify(o.path) + " 实为 " + JSON.stringify(actual) + " 但记的 from=" + JSON.stringify(o.from));
    }
  }
  walkV = applyDelta(walkV, dv.ops as any); walkP = applyDelta(walkP, dp.ops); walkR = applyDelta(walkR, dr.ops);
  if (JSON.stringify(walkV) !== JSON.stringify(walkP) || JSON.stringify(walkV) !== JSON.stringify(walkR)) {
    badFrames++; if (firstBad.length < 3) firstBad.push("frame " + f);
  }
  const cp = cpByFrame.get(f);
  if (cp) {
    cpChecked++;
    /**
     * ★★ v2 与 v1 的分水岭：v2 在 Checkpoint 帧**也记 Delta**，于是"上一 Checkpoint + 区间 Delta"
     *    必须**正好**落在本 Checkpoint 存的状态上。这就是旧写法那句恒真的 checkpoint 自证换来的东西。
     */
    if (JSON.stringify(walkV) !== JSON.stringify(cp.v)) { cpBad++; if (cpNote.length < 3) cpNote.push("cp@" + f + " 区间重建对不上"); }
    if (JSON.stringify(cp.v) !== JSON.stringify(cp.p) || JSON.stringify(cp.v) !== JSON.stringify(cp.r)) { cpBad++; if (cpNote.length < 3) cpNote.push("cp@" + f + " 三份文件档不一致"); }
    walkV = structuredClone(cp.v); walkP = structuredClone(cp.p); walkR = structuredClone(cp.r);
  }
}
ok("★★★ 每一帧都有 Delta（v2 = 完整链）：" + deltaFrames + "/" + lastFrame + " 帧，没有空洞", holes === 0 && deltaFrames === lastFrame, "洞 " + holes);
ok("★★★ 每个 Checkpoint 帧：「上一 Checkpoint + 区间 Delta」== 档里状态（" + cpChecked + " 个全查）", cpBad === 0, "坏 " + cpBad + " " + cpNote.join(","));
ok("★★★ 每个 Delta 帧：PATH_V1 == PLAIN == 记录器内存链（" + deltaFrames + " 帧逐字节比对）", badFrames === 0, "坏 " + badFrames + " " + firstBad.join(","));
ok("★★★ 走完链得到的状态指纹 == 文件 finalHash（Frame N == Engine final state）", stateHash(walkV) === v1.finalHash, stateHash(walkV) + " vs " + v1.finalHash);
ok("★★★ [4] 每个 op 的 from == 前一帧该路径的实际值（" + fromChecked + " 个 op 自检，不是装饰）", fromChecked > 500 && fromBad === 0, "坏 " + fromBad + " " + fromSample.join(" | "));
/** 播放器路径（含 Checkpoint 选择逻辑）单独抽查：每个 Checkpoint + 均匀 30 帧 */
const pv = new ReplayPlayer(v1), pp = new ReplayPlayer(plain);
let pvBad = 0, pvChecked = 0;
const sample = [...v1.checkpoints.map(c => c.frame), ...Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => Math.floor((i * lastFrame) / 30))].filter(f => f <= lastFrame);
for (const f of sample) {
  const a = pv.stateAt(f), b = pp.stateAt(f);
  pvChecked++;
  if (!a || !b || JSON.stringify(a) !== JSON.stringify(b)) pvBad++;
}
ok("★★★ ReplayPlayer（走 Checkpoint + Delta）抽查 " + pvChecked + " 帧同样一致", pvBad === 0 && pvChecked > 30, "坏 " + pvBad);

sec("[4] from 不是装饰：Delta 链自带逐 op 自检（在上面的走链里同步做，不另走一遍链）");
ok("★★ 这一步真的查了东西（不是空转）：自检样本 " + fromChecked + " 个 op", fromChecked > 500, String(fromChecked));

sec("[5] 反向：改坏 delta / 越界路径下标 / 缺字典 —— 三条都得红");
const tmp = path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "fixtures", "replay-tmp-g74.json");
const pathOf = (f: any, o: any): any[] => (f.deltaCodec === "PATH_V1" ? (f.deltaPaths?.[o[0]] ?? []) : (o.path ?? []));
const isCore = (f: any) => (o: any) => /^(teams|turn|timeline|winner)/.test(String(pathOf(f, o)[0]));
/** ★ 正向对照：原封不动的那份必须通过，且 Checkpoint 交叉校验真的跑了（否则下面那些"变红"没有意义） */
fs.writeFileSync(tmp, serializeReplay(v1));
const vOk = verifyReplayFile(tmp);
ok("★★★ 正向对照：原文件 verify 通过，且 Checkpoint 交叉校验跑了 " + vOk.cpCross + " 个（不是跳过）",
  vOk.ok === true && vOk.cpCross === v1.checkpoints.length - 1 && vOk.cpCrossSkipped === false,
  JSON.stringify({ ok: vOk.ok, cpCross: vOk.cpCross, skipped: vOk.cpCrossSkipped, issues: vOk.issues }));
/** ① 只改一条核心 delta 的值（finalHash 原样不动） */
/**
   * ① 改**最后一次**写核心路径的那个 op —— 保证后面没有任何写入把它盖回去。
   *    第一版改的是"第一个"核心 op：它被同路径的后续写入覆盖（后一个 op 的 to 是绝对值），
   *    verify 照样绿 ⇒ 那就是一条**空转的反向闸门**。这个坑是这一轮实测出来的。
   */
const bad1 = JSON.parse(serializeReplay(v1));
let hit: { d: any; o: any } | null = null;
for (const d of bad1.deltas) for (const o of d.ops) { if (isCore(bad1)(o)) hit = { d, o }; }
if (hit) hit.o[2] = typeof hit.o[2] === "number" ? hit.o[2] + 12345 : "TAMPERED";
fs.writeFileSync(tmp, serializeReplay(bad1));
const vb1 = verifyReplayFile(tmp);
const pv1 = new ReplayPlayer(loadReplay(fs.readFileSync(tmp, "utf8")));
ok("★★★ 改坏最后一条核心 op ⇒ verify 红，且**重建出的末帧指纹真的变了**（不是靠 finalHash 字段兜底）",
  !!hit && vb1.ok === false && stateHash(pv1.stateAt(lastFrame)!) !== v1.finalHash,
  JSON.stringify(hit ? pathOf(bad1, hit.o) : null) + " → " + JSON.stringify(vb1.issues));
/** ② 把某条 op 的路径下标改成字典外 */
const bad2 = JSON.parse(serializeReplay(v1));
const td = bad2.deltas.find((x: any) => x.ops.length > 0) ?? bad2.deltas[0];
td.ops[0][0] = (bad2.deltaPaths ?? []).length + 99;
fs.writeFileSync(tmp, serializeReplay(bad2));
const vb2 = verifyReplayFile(tmp);
ok("★★★ 路径下标越界 ⇒ verify 明确指出（不是静默偏移到别的字段上）",
  vb2.ok === false && vb2.issues.some((s: string) => s.indexOf("字典外") >= 0), JSON.stringify(vb2.issues));
/** ③ 声明 PATH_V1 却没有字典 ⇒ 解析期就拒绝 */
const bad3 = JSON.parse(serializeReplay(v1));
delete bad3.deltaPaths;
let threw = "";
try { loadReplay(bad3); } catch (e: any) { threw = String(e && e.message); }
ok("★★ 声明 PATH_V1 但缺 deltaPaths ⇒ loadReplay 直接报错", threw.indexOf("deltaPaths") >= 0, threw);
if (fs.existsSync(tmp)) fs.unlinkSync(tmp);

sec("[6] 老录像还放得动：v1 文件没有 deltaCodec 字段");
/** 忠实模拟 v1 文件：老记录器在 Checkpoint 帧**不记 Delta**（那一步的转移只存在于 Checkpoint 内部） */
const cpFrames = new Set(plain.checkpoints.map(c => c.frame));
const legacy = JSON.parse(serializeReplay(plain));
delete legacy.deltaCodec;
legacy.schemaVersion = 1;
legacy.deltas = legacy.deltas.filter((d: any) => !cpFrames.has(d.frame));
const lp = new ReplayPlayer(loadReplay(legacy));
ok("★★★ v1 老录像（无 deltaCodec、Checkpoint 帧缺 Delta）：仍能逐帧重建，末帧指纹 == finalHash",
  stateHash(lp.stateAt(lp.frameCount - 1)) === legacy.finalHash,
  stateHash(lp.stateAt(lp.frameCount - 1)) + " vs " + legacy.finalHash);
ok("★★ 前提成立：老格式 op 自带 path、无 deltaPaths，且 Delta 数 = 帧数 − Checkpoint 数",
  legacy.deltaPaths === undefined && Array.isArray(legacy.deltas[0].ops[0].path)
    && legacy.deltas.length === v1.deltas.length - (v1.checkpoints.length - 1),
  legacy.deltas.length + " vs " + v1.deltas.length + " − " + (v1.checkpoints.length - 1));
fs.writeFileSync(tmp, serializeReplay(legacy));
const vLegacy = verifyReplayFile(tmp);
ok("★★★ 老文件也过 verify，且**明说**跳过了 Checkpoint 交叉校验（不装作查过）",
  vLegacy.ok === true && vLegacy.cpCrossSkipped === true && vLegacy.cpCross === 0,
  JSON.stringify({ ok: vLegacy.ok, skipped: vLegacy.cpCrossSkipped, issues: vLegacy.issues }));

console.log("\n=== G2 Delta 体积与自证: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g75-event-coverage.ts`

```ts
// tests/g75-event-coverage.ts — ★★★ 第 119 轮：事件码覆盖率的**四态账**（唯一口径 + 证据行）
//
// 由来（实测，不是推理）：同一个问题在库里有两把尺子 ——
//   · tools/_probe-dispatch.ts 与 tests/g42 的旧 dispatched()：
//       s.includes("dispatch(EV." + code) || s.includes("EV." + code + ",")
//   · 事实：`ON_SKILL: EV.SKILL_END,`（御魂时机映射）命中了后半段 ⇒ SKILL_END 被算成「有派发点」，
//     而全库**没有一处**派发它 —— 一个被自己的尺子藏住的静默死处理器（与第 90 轮 CRI 同类）。
//
// 这一轮把口径统一到 tools/event-audit.ts，并把二值问题拆成四态账：
//   BUS           走事件总线 —— 被动 / 御魂 / 触发类机制今天就能挂
//   TRACE_ONLY    机制在跑，但只有 trace（Theater 看得见，触发类机制挂不上）
//   MENTION_ONLY  只是被别处提到（例如 mock 的时间线白名单）
//   DECLARED_ONLY 只有声明
// 声明表写在下面，**两个方向**都断言：漏一个红、多一个也红。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { coverageSummary, dispatchCallSites, maskComments } from "../tools/event-audit.ts";
import { DISPATCHED_EV_CODES } from "../compile/passive-runtime.ts";
import { EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));

const S: any = coverageSummary(ROOT);
const codesOf = (v: string): string[] => S.codes.filter((c: any) => c.verdict === v).map((c: any) => c.code).sort();
const sorted = (a: Iterable<string>) => [...a].sort();
const eq = (a: Iterable<string>, b: Iterable<string>) => JSON.stringify(sorted(a)) === JSON.stringify(sorted(b));

/** ★ 声明：四态账。谁接线 / 谁删码 / 谁新增事件码，都必须来改这里，否则红。 */
const DECLARED: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "BUS": [
    "SOUL_START",
    "PASSIVE_START",
    "SENKI",
    "BATTLE_START",
    "TURN_START",
    "TURN_END",
    "ACTION_END",
    "SKILL_SELECT",
    "SKILL_START",
    "SKILL_END",
    "ORB_GAUGE_ADVANCE",
    "ORB_GAIN",
    "ORB_OVERFLOW",
    "ORB_COST",
    "RESIST",
    "IMMUNE",
    "BEFORE_DAMAGE",
    "DAMAGE",
    "AFTER_DAMAGE",
    "HP_LOSS",
    "HEAL",
    "RECOVER",
    "SHIELD_CREATE",
    "SHIELD_DAMAGE",
    "SHIELD_BREAK",
    "STATUS_ADD",
    "STATUS_REMOVE",
    "STATUS_EXPIRE",
    "STATUS_MISS",
    "TIMELINE_MISS",
    "DEATH_PREVENTION",
    "LETHAL",
    "DEATH",
    "KILLED",
    "REVIVE",
    "TRANSFORM",
    "VICTORY_CHECK",
    "BATTLE_END"
  ],
  "TRACE_ONLY": [],
  "MENTION_ONLY": [
    "TARGET_SELECT",
    "HIT"
  ],
  "DECLARED_ONLY": [
    "BATTLE_CREATE",
    "PRE_BATTLE",
    "TIMELINE_ADVANCE",
    "ACTION_START",
    "BEFORE_HIT"
  ]
};
sec("[1] 四态账：声明与实测逐条对齐（两个方向）");
{
  for (const v of ["BUS", "TRACE_ONLY", "MENTION_ONLY", "DECLARED_ONLY"]) {
    const measured = codesOf(v);
    const missing = DECLARED[v].filter(c => !measured.includes(c));
    const extra = measured.filter(c => !DECLARED[v].includes(c));
    ok("★★★ " + v + " 名单一致（" + DECLARED[v].length + " 个）", missing.length === 0 && extra.length === 0,
      "声明漏了 " + JSON.stringify(missing) + "｜实测多了 " + JSON.stringify(extra));
  }
  const all = Object.values(DECLARED).flat();
  ok("★★★ 四态之和 == EV 表条数（不漏不重）", eq(all, Object.keys(EV)) && new Set(all).size === all.length,
    all.length + " vs EV " + Object.keys(EV).length + "｜重复 " + (all.length - new Set(all).size));
  ok("★★★ 扫描面非空（否则「0 个未派发」只说明没扫到文件）", S.files > 50 && S.total === 45, S.files + " 个文件 / " + S.total + " 个码");
}

sec("[2] 每条结论都带证据行（人能按 file:line 复核）");
{
  const noEvidence = S.codes.filter((c: any) => c.verdict !== "DECLARED_ONLY" && (c.bus.length + c.trace.length + c.mention.length) === 0).map((c: any) => c.code);
  ok("★★★ 非 DECLARED_ONLY 的码都至少有一条证据", noEvidence.length === 0, JSON.stringify(noEvidence));
  const bad = S.codes.flatMap((c: any) => [...c.bus, ...c.trace]).filter((x: any) => !(x.line > 0) || String(x.snippet).length < 5);
  ok("★★ 证据行都有行号与片段", bad.length === 0, JSON.stringify(bad.slice(0, 3)));
  const heal = S.codes.find((c: any) => c.code === "HEAL");
  ok("★★ 抽一条复核：HEAL 的 trace 证据落在 kernel/damage.ts（正是治愈那一刻）",
    heal.trace.some((x: any) => x.file.endsWith("kernel/damage.ts")), JSON.stringify(heal.trace.slice(0, 2)));
  const se = S.codes.find((c: any) => c.code === "SKILL_END");
  ok("★★★ SKILL_END 的派发证据在 kernel/battle.ts（第 119 轮补的那一处）",
    se.bus.some((x: any) => x.file.endsWith("kernel/battle.ts")), JSON.stringify(se.bus));
}

sec("[3] 浏览器侧的声明表不许说谎（它是 deadCode 判据的输入）");
{
  const bus = DECLARED.BUS;
  ok("★★★ BUS 的 " + bus.length + " 个码**全部在** DISPATCHED_EV_CODES 里", bus.every(c => DISPATCHED_EV_CODES.has(c)),
    JSON.stringify(bus.filter(c => !DISPATCHED_EV_CODES.has(c))));
  ok("★★★ 反向：声明表里没有「实测不在 BUS」的码（第 119 轮的 SKILL_END 正是这一类）",
    eq([...DISPATCHED_EV_CODES], bus), JSON.stringify([...DISPATCHED_EV_CODES].filter(c => !bus.includes(c))));
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 120 轮：这里原来是「TRACE_ONLY 的码都不在声明表里」—— TRACE_ONLY 被清空之后，
   *   那条断言会**恒真**（空集），所以换成不可能空转的三条：TRACE_ONLY 必须为空、
   *   它的 8 个历史成员现在**都在 BUS 里**、而且都进了声明表。
   */
  ok("★★★ TRACE_ONLY 已清空（第 119 轮还有 8 个）", DECLARED.TRACE_ONLY.length === 0, JSON.stringify(DECLARED.TRACE_ONLY));
  const wired8 = ["ORB_GAIN", "HP_LOSS", "HEAL", "RECOVER", "STATUS_REMOVE", "STATUS_EXPIRE", "STATUS_MISS", "TIMELINE_MISS"];
  ok("★★★ 那 8 个历史 TRACE_ONLY 码现在**都在 BUS 里**（接线没把谁弄丢）",
    wired8.every(c => bus.includes(c)), JSON.stringify(wired8.filter(c => !bus.includes(c))));
  ok("★★ 反向：这 8 个码**确实在声明表里**（deadCode 判据随之变活）",
    wired8.every(c => DISPATCHED_EV_CODES.has(c)), JSON.stringify(wired8.filter(c => !DISPATCHED_EV_CODES.has(c))));
}

sec("[4] SKILL_END 真的会被派发：接一个探针，数它被调用几次");
{
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const battle = a.battle;
  let fires = 0;
  battle.bus.register({ id: "PROBE:SKILL_END", ownerId: 0, code: EV.SKILL_END, range: "ALL", priority: 0, passive: false, fn: () => { fires++; } });
  const r = await battle.run();
  const executed = battle.turnLog.filter((t: any) => t.skill).length;
  const starts = battle.bus.chain.filter((n: any) => n.code === "SKILL_START").length;
  const ends = battle.bus.chain.filter((n: any) => n.code === "SKILL_END").length;
  ok("★★★ 探针在 SKILL_END 上真的被调用了（" + fires + " 次）", fires > 0, "winner=" + r.winner + " turns=" + r.turns);
  ok("★★★ 触发次数 == 真的释放了技能的次数（turnLog 里带 skill 的条目）", fires === executed, fires + " vs " + executed);
  ok("★★ 事件链里 SKILL_END 节点数 == 探针触发次数（派发与订阅是同一件事的两面）", ends === fires, ends + " vs " + fires);
  ok("★★ 它与 SKILL_START **不是一对**：后者只给攻击技能派发 ⇒ 次数 ≤ SKILL_END", starts <= ends, "SKILL_START " + starts + " vs SKILL_END " + ends);
}

sec("[5] 一把尺子：不许有人把第二把装回去");
{
  /**
   * ★ 判据只看**代码**：注释里可以引用旧规则（那样才讲得清它错在哪），
   *   所以先遮盖注释再匹配 —— 第一次写这条断言时它被自己的注释绊红了，正是这个原因。
   */
  const toolSrc = maskComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "tools", "event-audit.ts"), "utf8"));
  const g42Src = maskComments(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "tests", "g42-trigger-registry.ts"), "utf8"));
  const loose = /includes\("EV\."\s*\+/;
  ok("★★★ g42 不再自带尺子（import 了 event-audit，代码里没有旧的宽松判据）",
    /tools\/event-audit\.ts/.test(g42Src) && !loose.test(g42Src));
  ok("★★★ 工具里也没有旧的宽松判据（只看代码）", !loose.test(toolSrc));
  ok("★★★ 反向：合成一句御魂映射，旧判据命中而新口径不认（证明尺子真的换了）", (() => {
    const s = "const M = { ON_SKILL: EV.SKILL_END, };";
    return /EV\.SKILL_END,/.test(s) && !/(?:dispatch|emit|publish|fire|queueEvent)\s*\([\s\S]{0,48}?EV\.SKILL_END/.test(s);
  })());
  ok("★★ 旧的 _probe-dispatch.ts 已删除（第二把尺子的来源）", !fs.existsSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "tools", "_probe-dispatch.ts")));
}

sec("[6] 完备性：按字面量扫描不会漏（派发与入队的第一个实参都是 EV.*）");
{
  const cs = dispatchCallSites(ROOT);
  ok("★★★ 生产代码 " + cs.total + " 处派发/入队点：变量码 " + cs.variable.length + " 个（有变量码就说明按字面量扫描会漏）",
    cs.variable.length === 0, JSON.stringify(cs.variable.slice(0, 3)));
  ok("★★★ 裸字符串 " + cs.bareString.length + " 个（打错字会静默不派发 —— 第 91 轮的 SOUL_START 就是这么漏的）",
    cs.bareString.length === 0, JSON.stringify(cs.bareString.slice(0, 3)));
  ok("★★ 三元字面量 " + cs.ternary.length + " 处（形如 recover ? EV.RECOVER : EV.HEAL：两个分支都是码，不是变量）",
    cs.ternary.length + cs.literal + cs.drainSites === cs.total, JSON.stringify(cs.ternary));
  ok("★★★ 变量码的**唯一**允许处是队列自己的 drain（battle.ts 的 drainEvents 把入队的 code 投出去）",
    cs.drainSites === 1, String(cs.drainSites));
  ok("★★ 字面量占绝对多数（" + cs.literal + "/" + cs.total + "）", cs.literal > 30, String(cs.literal));
  ok("★★ 反向：合成的变量码派发会被同一条判据抓到", (() => {
    const src = maskComments("await bus.dispatch(code, {}, 0, 0, f);");
    const m = [...src.matchAll(/(?:dispatch|emit|publish|fire|queueEvent)\s*\(\s*([^,)]{0,60})/g)][0];
    return !!m && !/^EV\.[A-Z_]+$/.test(m[1].trim());
  })());
}


console.log("\n=== 事件码覆盖四态账: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g76-event-wiring.ts`

```ts
// tests/g76-event-wiring.ts — ★★★ 第 120 轮：把「机制在跑、只有 trace」的那批事件码接进总线
//
// 由来（第 119 轮的四态账）：TRACE_ONLY 8 个 —— HEAL / RECOVER / HP_LOSS / STATUS_REMOVE /
//   STATUS_EXPIRE / STATUS_MISS / TIMELINE_MISS / ORB_GAIN。它们的**机制一直在跑**，只是只有 trace 通道：
//   Theater 看得见，而「受到治疗时」这类触发类机制**挂不上**（声明表说它们没有派发点）。
// 这一轮：Battle 加**事件队列**（同步生产者没法 await 派发 —— 硬写就是悬空 Promise），
//   生产者入队、Battle 在安全点 drain；顺带把只有声明的 ORB_OVERFLOW / ORB_COST 也接上。
//
// 本测试只回答一个问题：**它们真的会触发吗** —— 而不是「代码里有那一行」。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { healTarget, loseHp } from "../kernel/damage.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const CODES = ["HEAL", "RECOVER", "HP_LOSS", "STATUS_ADD", "STATUS_REMOVE", "STATUS_EXPIRE", "STATUS_MISS", "TIMELINE_MISS", "ORB_GAIN", "ORB_OVERFLOW", "ORB_COST", "SHIELD_CREATE", "SHIELD_DAMAGE", "SHIELD_BREAK"];
const probe = (battle: any, sink: Record<string, number>) => {
  for (const c of CODES) battle.bus.register({ id: "P:" + c, ownerId: 0, code: c, range: "ALL", priority: 0, passive: false, fn: () => { sink[c] = (sink[c] ?? 0) + 1; } });
};

sec("[1] 直接驱动：同步生产点 → 队列 → drain（drain 之前订阅者一次都不该被调用）");
{
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const b = a.battle;
  await b.runStartup();
  const sink: Record<string, number> = {};
  probe(b, sink);
  const src = b.teams[0].members[0], dst = b.teams[0].members[1];
  dst.hp = Math.max(1, dst.hp - 300);
  healTarget(b, src, dst, 100);
  healTarget(b, src, dst, 100, { recover: true });
  loseHp(b, dst, 10);
  ok("★★★ 入队后**未 drain**：订阅者一次都没被调用（证明走的确实是队列）",
    (sink.HEAL ?? 0) + (sink.RECOVER ?? 0) + (sink.HP_LOSS ?? 0) === 0, JSON.stringify(sink));
  const n = await b.drainEvents();
  ok("★★★ drain 一次投递 3 条（治愈 / 恢复 / 失血各一）", n === 3, String(n));
  ok("★★★ 三个码都真的送到了订阅者", sink.HEAL === 1 && sink.RECOVER === 1 && sink.HP_LOSS === 1,
    JSON.stringify({ HEAL: sink.HEAL, RECOVER: sink.RECOVER, HP_LOSS: sink.HP_LOSS }));
  ok("★★ 事件链里也各有一个节点（Inspector 同样看得见）",
    ["HEAL", "RECOVER", "HP_LOSS"].every(c => b.bus.chain.some((x: any) => x.code === c)));
  ok("★★ 排空后再 drain 返回 0（不会重复投递）", (await b.drainEvents()) === 0);
}

sec("[2] 真实对局：哪些码在自然战斗里就会触发（两个 seed，0 的那些也如实记下）");
const observed: Record<string, number> = {};
{
  for (const seed of [20261001, 123456]) {
    const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed });
    const sink: Record<string, number> = {};

  }
  console.log("    两局合计：" + CODES.map(c => c + "=" + (observed[c] ?? 0)).join(" "));
  ok("★★★ HEAL / STATUS_EXPIRE 反复触发（各 > 10 次）",
    (observed.HEAL ?? 0) > 10 && (observed.STATUS_EXPIRE ?? 0) > 10,
    JSON.stringify({ HEAL: observed.HEAL, STATUS_EXPIRE: observed.STATUS_EXPIRE }));
  ok("★★★ ORB_GAIN / ORB_COST 也都触发过", (observed.ORB_GAIN ?? 0) > 0 && (observed.ORB_COST ?? 0) > 0,
    JSON.stringify({ ORB_GAIN: observed.ORB_GAIN, ORB_COST: observed.ORB_COST }));
  ok("★★ 接线的码全部在 EV 表里（没有野码）", CODES.every(c => Object.keys(EV).includes(c)));
  ok("★★★ STATUS_ADD（第 122 轮接）在自然对局里触发 " + (observed.STATUS_ADD ?? 0) + " 次（> 10）",
    (observed.STATUS_ADD ?? 0) > 10, String(observed.STATUS_ADD ?? 0));
}

sec("[3] 定向场景：自然对局触发不到的两个码，用带该子句的式神逼出来");
{
  const swap = (id: number) => { const m: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(canonicalMatch())); m.red.units[0].shikigamiId = id; m.blue.units[0].shikigamiId = id; return m; };
  let tl = 0, ov = 0;

  ok("★★★ ORB_OVERFLOW：3 局定向场景（座敷童子 50% 获得鬼火）里触发 " + ov + " 次", ov > 0, String(ov));
}

sec("[4] 队列语义：同批按入队顺序；drain 期间新入队的事件留到下一批");
{

  } });
  b.bus.register({ id: "ORDER:RECOVER", ownerId: 0, code: "RECOVER", range: "ALL", priority: 0, passive: false, fn: () => { order.push("RECOVER"); } });

  const n2 = await b.drainEvents();

sec("[6] 记账：可达性与未观测项（这些数字一变就要来说明）");
{
  const kb = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));

      if (ir.purge?.length) purge++;
      if (ir.statusRefs?.length) statusRefs++;
      if (ir.timeline?.length) timeline++;
      if ((ir.orb?.gain ?? 0) > 0) orbGain++;
    }
  }
  // ★★★ 第 199 轮：38 → **37**。摘掉了 4 条**规则句/条件句**（晴明「言灵·缚」×2 · 入殓师「离魂」 · 梦寻山兔「梦心迷兔阵！」），
  //   它们此前被当成「本技能在驱散」⇒ 施放时凭空扒状态（多仓）；现在记进新键 purgeSkips。
  // ★★★ 第 196 轮：39 → **38**。摘掉了食梦貘「沉睡」那条假命中（「**不会自动移除**目标的沉睡」是关于这个状态的
  //   **规则**，不是本技能在移除它）—— 这不是数字漂移，是少算/多算各减一条。
  ok("★★★ 802 个技能里带非空 purge 的 **37** 条 ⇒ STATUS_REMOVE 的派发点不是死代码", skills === 802 && purge === 37, skills + " / purge " + purge);
  ok("★★ 可达性来源：有 timeline 的 " + timeline + " 条、有 orb.gain 的 " + orbGain + " 条、有 statusRefs 的 " + statusRefs + " 条",
    timeline > 0 && orbGain > 0 && statusRefs > 0);
  ok("★★★ 如实记账：STATUS_MISS 本轮 8 局（含定向）**一次都没触发** —— 派发点在代码里存在（g75 仍算 BUS），但条件没被走到。哪天真触发了这条会红，届时改成已观测",
    (observed.STATUS_MISS ?? 0) === 0, String(observed.STATUS_MISS ?? 0));
}

sec("[7] 第 122 轮接的码：护盾三兄弟（直接驱动）与变形（定向形态场景）");
{
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  const b = a.battle;
  await b.runStartup();
  const sink: Record<string, number> = {};
  probe(b, sink);
  const src = b.teams[0].members[0], dst = b.teams[1].members[0];
  dst.addShield({ value: 10, sourceId: src.id, tag: "probe" });
  ok("★★★ 加盾后**未 drain**：SHIELD_CREATE 一次都没送到（走的是队列）", (sink.SHIELD_CREATE ?? 0) === 0);
  await b.drainEvents();
  ok("★★★ drain 后 SHIELD_CREATE = 1（护盾创建进总线了）", sink.SHIELD_CREATE === 1, JSON.stringify(sink));
  await b.damage(src, dst, 100, "NORMAL");
  await b.drainEvents();
  ok("★★★ 100 点伤害打穿 10 点小盾 ⇒ SHIELD_DAMAGE 与 SHIELD_BREAK 各 1",
    sink.SHIELD_DAMAGE === 1 && sink.SHIELD_BREAK === 1, JSON.stringify(sink));
  ok("★★ 三个护盾事件都在事件链里（Inspector 看不见就必须补）",
    ["SHIELD_CREATE", "SHIELD_DAMAGE", "SHIELD_BREAK"].every(c => b.bus.chain.some((x: any) => x.code === c)));
  const addBefore = sink.STATUS_ADD ?? 0;
  dst.addStatus({ id: "probe_add", name: "探查·状态", category: "BUFF_STATE", dispellable: true, removable: true, blocksRevive: false, durationPolicy: "SOURCE_TURN", tags: [] } as any, 999, 1, 3);
  ok("★★★ 加状态后未 drain：STATUS_ADD 还没送（生产点 → sink → 队列）", (sink.STATUS_ADD ?? 0) === addBefore);
  await b.drainEvents();
  ok("★★★ drain 后 STATUS_ADD +1", (sink.STATUS_ADD ?? 0) === addBefore + 1, String(sink.STATUS_ADD));

  /** 变形：形态的编译要 tips 表（没设置时 forms 静默为空 —— 第 101 轮踩过并写进 g62 的断言里） */
  const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
  const tipsList = Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : ((Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? []);
  setTipsTable(loadTips(tipsList));
  const kb = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
  const list: any[] = Array.isArray(kb) ? kb : (kb.characters ?? kb.items ?? []);
  const snake = list.find((s: any) => s.name === "神堕八岐大蛇");
  ok("前置：KB 里有神堕八岐大蛇（「神堕之力」= 化身形态）", !!snake);
  if (snake) {
    const m: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(canonicalMatch()));
    m.red.units[0].shikigamiId = snake.id; m.blue.units[0].shikigamiId = snake.id;
    const t: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 1 });
    await t.battle.runStartup();
    const actor = t.battle.teams[0].members[0];
    const formSkill = actor.skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "神堕之力");
    ok("★★ 换上场后确实带着「神堕之力」（cost=0，ON_CAST 形态）", !!formSkill, JSON.stringify(actor.skills.map((s: any) => s.name)));
    let tf = 0;
    t.battle.bus.register({ id: "P:TRANSFORM", ownerId: 0, code: "TRANSFORM", range: "ALL", priority: 0, passive: false, fn: () => { tf++; } });
    /**
     * ★ 直接驱动这个技能（而不是等 AI 选中它）：这是一条**真实的生产路径**
     *   （character.ts 的 execute → forms 分支 → kernel/summon.ts 的 enterForm → queueEvent）。
     *   ★ 为什么不等 AI：3 局实测里 AI 一次都没选「神堕之力」（它选了同式神的「审判仪式」）——
     *   那是**选择策略**的问题，不是事件接线的问题，两者不能混着说。
     */
    await formSkill.execute(t.battle, actor, t.battle.enemiesOf(actor.teamId)[0]);
    await t.battle.drainEvents();
    ok("★★★ 驱动「神堕之力」⇒ TRANSFORM 触发（进入形态）", tf >= 1, String(tf));
    ok("★★ 事件链里也有 TRANSFORM 节点", t.battle.bus.chain.some((x: any) => x.code === "TRANSFORM"));
    const enter = t.battle.trace.filter((x: any) => x.t === "FORM_ENTER").length;
    console.log("    形态 trace：FORM_ENTER=" + enter + "（Theater 走 trace，总线走事件 —— 两条通道都在）");
  }
}
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g77-purge-recycle.ts`

```ts
// tests/g77-purge-recycle.ts — ★★★ 第 121 轮：**驱散/解除漏回收属性加成**（一个不报错、只是悄悄失真的缺陷）
//
// 由来（实测）：`Entity.dispel()` / `Entity.remove()` 此前只 `statuses.splice(...)` + refreshReviveBlock，
//   而 `expireStatus()` 会把该状态的 effects 一并回收 —— 三个入口本该是同一件事，实现却是两套。
//   探针（tools/_probe-dispel121.ts）：给单位加 +100 攻击的增益 → `dispel()` 之后**攻击仍然 +100**，
//   `effects` 里还留着一条没有主人的 effect。长局里这类泄漏会持续累积。
// 修复：三个入口共用一份 `recycleStatus()`。本测试就是它的两侧闸门。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { buildCharacter } from "../compile/character.ts";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const buffs = new Map<string, any>((JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[]).map(b => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]));
const fresh = async (seed = 20261001) => { const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed }); await a.battle.runStartup(); return a.battle; };
const probeSkill = (desc: string) =>
  buildCharacter({ id: 1, name: "探查单位", panel: { atk: 1000, hp: 50000, def: 300, spd: 100, cri: 0, crid: 1.5, efh: 0, efr: 0 }, skills: [{ id: "probe", name: "探查", cost: 0, description: desc }] } as any,
    undefined, undefined, buffs, 0, 1).entity.skills[0];
/** 造一个带属性加成的探查状态：+100 攻击（FIXED） */
const buffDef = (id: string, dispellable: boolean, removable: boolean): any => ({
  id, name: "探查·" + id, category: "BUFF_STATE", dispellable, removable,
  preventsLethal: null, immuneTo: null, blocksRevive: false, durationPolicy: "SOURCE_TURN", tags: [],
});
const plusAtk = [{ prop: "atk", value: 100, mode: "FIXED" as const }];

sec("[1] dispel / remove 必须把属性加成一起回收（两侧）");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const e = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  const base = e.prop("atk");
  e.addStatus(buffDef("probe_disp", true, true), 999, 1, 5, plusAtk);
  ok("前置：加上 +100 攻击的增益后攻击确实上升", e.prop("atk") === base + 100, base + " → " + e.prop("atk"));
  const gone = e.dispel("probe_disp");
  ok("★ 状态确实被驱散（dispel 返回 true 且 hasStatus 为假）", gone === true && !e.hasStatus("probe_disp"));
  ok("★★★ 而且**属性加成回落**（第 121 轮修复的那一步）", e.prop("atk") === base, "期望 " + base + "，实际 " + e.prop("atk"));
  ok("★★★ effects 里不再留下无主的加成", !e.effects.some((x: any) => String(x.source).startsWith("probe_disp")), JSON.stringify(e.effects.length));

  e.addStatus(buffDef("probe_rm", false, true), 999, 1, 5, plusAtk);
  const base2 = base;
  const okRm = e.remove("probe_rm");
  ok("★ 不可驱散但可解除：remove 生效", okRm === true && !e.hasStatus("probe_rm"));
  ok("★★★ remove 同样回收加成", e.prop("atk") === base2, "期望 " + base2 + "，实际 " + e.prop("atk"));
}

sec("[2] 反向：把**旧实现**（裸 splice + refreshReviveBlock）装回去，必须泄漏");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const u = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  const base = u.prop("atk");
  u.addStatus(buffDef("probe_old", true, true), 999, 1, 5, plusAtk);
  const i = u.statuses.findIndex((s: any) => s.def.id === "probe_old");
  u.statuses.splice(i, 1);            // ← 旧 dispel 的全部动作
  u.refreshReviveBlock();
  ok("★★★ 旧实现确实**泄漏**（攻击仍高出 100）—— 证明上一条闸门不是空转",
    u.prop("atk") === base + 100 && !u.hasStatus("probe_old"), "期望泄漏 +100，实际 " + (u.prop("atk") - base));
}

sec("[3] 端到端：走真实技能路径（编译出的「驱散敌方目标1个增益状态」）");
{
  const bt: any = await fresh();
  const self = bt.teams[0].members.find((m: any) => m.alive);
  const foe = bt.enemiesOf(0)[0];
  const base = foe.prop("atk");
  foe.addStatus(buffDef("probe_e2e", true, true), 999, 1, 5, plusAtk);
  ok("前置：敌方带着 +100 攻击的增益", foe.prop("atk") === base + 100);
  const skill = probeSkill("驱散敌方目标1个增益状态");
  bt.trace.length = 0;
  await skill.execute(bt, self, foe);

  ok("★★ 事件照样发出（与 g21 的分工：g21 查状态被拿掉，这里查**属性也回落**）",

}
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g78-passive-status-trigger.ts`

```ts
// tests/g78-passive-status-trigger.ts — ★★★ 第 123 轮：登记「被施加」这一族，并证明它真的会触发
//
// 由来：第 122 轮把 STATUS_ADD 接进了事件总线，但**没有任何一族触发时机**登记它 ——
//   于是「再次被施加[buff_X]时…」这类被动被算进 `skipped.noTrigger`（「没有触发时机」），
//   把「有时机但没登记」与「真的没有时机」说成同一件事（本登记册最该防的错）。
// 这一轮：登记 family「被施加」（test 正则，因为 [buff_N] 夹在名字与「时」之间），
//   并修掉目标侧过滤的一个静默失效（只认伤害事件的 `input.target`，其它事件形状全被 fail-closed 挡掉）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { TRIGGER_FAMILIES } from "../kernel/triggers.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { compileBuff, toStatusDef } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const withUnit = (id: number, name: string) => { const m: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(canonicalMatch())); m.red.units[0].shikigamiId = id; m.red.units[0].name = name; return m; };
const run = async (passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", match?: any, seed = 20261001) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), match ?? canonicalMatch(), { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a.battle;
};

sec("[1] 登记事实：family「被施加」→ STATUS_ADD（TARGET 侧）");
{
  const fam = TRIGGER_FAMILIES.find((f: any) => f.family === "被施加");
  ok("★★★ 登记册里有「被施加」这一族", !!fam, JSON.stringify(TRIGGER_FAMILIES.map((f: any) => f.family).slice(-6)));
  ok("★★★ 它映射到 STATUS_ADD（第 122 轮才接上总线的事件码）", fam?.evCode === "STATUS_ADD", String(fam?.evCode));
  ok("★★★ 它是**目标侧**时机（被施加的是自己）", (fam as any)?.side === "TARGET", String((fam as any)?.side));
  ok("★★★ 用 test 正则而不是「名字+时」子串（[buff_N] 夹在中间，子串永远匹配不到）", !!fam?.test && fam.test.test("敌方被施加[tips_5671]时"), String(fam?.test));
  ok("★★ 计数 2 条（g42 会用 matchFamily 重新数一遍，对不上就红）", (fam as any)?.kbCount === 2, String((fam as any)?.kbCount));
}

sec("[2] 账目移动：那两条子句不再算「没有触发时机」");
{
  const off = await run("NOT_EXECUTED", withUnit(348, "浮世青行灯"));
  const on = await run("PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", withUnit(348, "浮世青行灯"));
  const repOff = off.passiveReport, repOn = on.passiveReport;
  ok("★★★ 默认 OFF：一个都不注册（与历史逐位一致）", repOff.installed.length === 0 && repOff.mode === "OFF");
  ok("★★★ 打开后**装上了**浮世青行灯「茕灯焕夜」，家族正是「被施加」",
    repOn.installed.some((i: any) => i.skill === "茕灯焕夜" && i.family === "被施加" && i.event === "STATUS_ADD"),
    JSON.stringify(repOn.installed.map((i: any) => i.skill + "[" + i.family + "→" + i.event + "]")));
  console.log("    换阵容后的跳过：无时机 " + repOn.skipped.noTrigger + "｜有条件 " + repOn.skipped.hasCondition +
    "（条件 " + repOn.skipped.byCondition + " / 效果 " + repOn.skipped.byEffect + "）｜无派发 " + repOn.skipped.noDispatch);
  ok("★★★ 无派发（noDispatch）必须是 0 —— 那一族的事件码现在真的在派发", repOn.skipped.noDispatch === 0, String(repOn.skipped.noDispatch));
  const other = await run("PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", withUnit(567, "申屠子夜"));
  ok("★★ 同族的另一条（申屠子夜「渊冰三尺」）**如实记为被条件/效果挡住**，不是静默消失",
    other.passiveReport.installed.every((i: any) => i.skill !== "渊冰三尺") &&
    (other.passiveReport.skipped.byCondition + other.passiveReport.skipped.byEffect) > 0,
    JSON.stringify(other.passiveReport.skipped));
}

sec("[3] 真的会触发：给本体上同一个状态两次 ⇒ 第二次触发「被施加」");
{
  const b = await run("PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", withUnit(348, "浮世青行灯"));
  const me = b.teams[0].members[0];
  /** [buff_3481_1] 的运行时定义：StatusBook 只有控制类，别的要走 buff-compiler（character.ts 同款） */
  const kbBuffs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[];
  const cb = kbBuffs.map(b => compileBuff(b)).find((b: any) => String(b.id) === "3481_1" || String(b.id) === "3481");
  const def: any = StatusBook.get("3481_1") ?? (cb ? toStatusDef(cb as any) : null);
  ok("前置：KB 里的 [buff_3481_1] 在 StatusBook 里有定义", !!def, String(def));
  if (def) {
    const before = b.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "SKILL_CAST" && e.skill === "茕灯焕夜").length;
    me.addStatus(def as any, me.id, 1, 3);          // 第一次：满足「对于有[buff]的目标」这个前提
    await b.drainEvents();
    me.addStatus(def as any, me.id, 1, 3);          // 第二次：「再次被施加」
    await b.drainEvents();
    const after = b.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "SKILL_CAST" && e.skill === "茕灯焕夜").length;
    ok("★★★ 第二次施加触发了「茕灯焕夜」（trace 里出现它的 SKILL_CAST）", after > before, before + " → " + after);
  }
  /** 反向：把状态施加到**别人**身上，这条被动不该触发（目标侧过滤必须真的在过滤） */
  const b2 = await run("PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", withUnit(348, "浮世青行灯"));
  const me2 = b2.teams[0].members[0], other2 = b2.teams[0].members[1];
  if (def && other2) {
    const before2 = b2.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "SKILL_CAST" && e.skill === "茕灯焕夜").length;
    other2.addStatus(def as any, other2.id, 1, 3);
    other2.addStatus(def as any, other2.id, 1, 3);
    await b2.drainEvents();
    const after2 = b2.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "SKILL_CAST" && e.skill === "茕灯焕夜").length;
    ok("★★★ 反向：施加在**队友**身上时，这条被动不触发（目标侧过滤真的在过滤）", after2 === before2, before2 + " → " + after2);
  }
}

sec("[4] 默认档位不变：OFF 时指纹仍是基准值");
{
  const off = await run("NOT_EXECUTED");
  await off.run();
  const h = stateHash(captureState(off));
  ok("★★★ 默认（NOT_EXECUTED）跑完整场后指纹仍是 2d7c7507e18db61f", h === "2d7c7507e18db61f", h);
}

console.log("\n=== 被施加 → STATUS_ADD: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g79-field-per-turn.ts — ★★★ 第 124 轮：场地里的**每回合效果**（第 115 轮明说"没有行为代码"的那一块）
//
// 由来：第 115 轮把场地（幻境 / 结界）的**存在性 + 持续时间 + 静态光环**做完了，并在文件头写明：
//   「场地里那些每回合触发/条件触发的效果仍然没有行为代码」。这一轮补第一种形状：
//   辉夜姬「龙首之玉」的「且在回合开始前有67%概率获得1点鬼火」（全库**唯一**一条这个写法）。
//   ★ 概率只在**这一段**里读：创建动词后面的概率属于每回合效果，不属于创建（第 115 轮在这里读错过一次）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const kb = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(kb) ? kb : (kb.characters ?? kb.items ?? []);
{
  const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
  setTipsTable(loadTips(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : ((Object.values(raw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? [])));
}
const kaguya = LIST.find((s: any) => s.name === "辉夜姬");
const withKaguya = () => { const m: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(canonicalMatch())); m.red.units[0].shikigamiId = kaguya.id; m.red.units[0].name = "辉夜姬"; return m; };
const run = async (match: any, seed = 20261001, passives?: any) => {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), match, { seed, ...(passives ? { passives } : {}) });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a.battle;
};

sec("[1] 解析：全库唯一一条这个写法，概率读在**每回合那一段**里");
{
  const ir: any = compileSkill(kaguya.id, "辉夜姬", (kaguya.skills ?? []).find((k: any) => k.name === "龙首之玉"));
  ok("★★★ 解析出 perTurn（第 115 轮这里是空的）", !!ir.field?.perTurn, JSON.stringify(ir.field?.perTurn));
  ok("★★★ 触发时机 = 回合开始，范围 = 友方（ALLY）", ir.field?.perTurn?.trigger === "TURN_START" && ir.field?.perTurn?.scope === "ALLY");
  ok("★★★ 概率 0.67 / 数量 1 点鬼火（不是「有67%概率开幻境」——那是第 115 轮读错的那个）",
    ir.field?.perTurn?.probability === 0.67 && ir.field?.perTurn?.amount === 1, JSON.stringify(ir.field?.perTurn));
  ok("★★ 创建概率仍是 null（这一段里没有创建概率）", ir.field?.probability === null, String(ir.field?.probability));
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of LIST) for (const sk of (s.skills ?? [])) { const i2: any = compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk); if (i2.field?.perTurn) n++; }
  //   ★★ 第 125/126 轮：1 → 2 → **3**（每轮接一种形状，见 tests/g80 / g81）。
  ok("★★ 全库带 perTurn 的技能 3 条（第 124/125/126 轮各接一种形状；其余形状仍然逐句记账）", n === 3, String(n));
}

sec("[2] 运行时：场地在场时，行动者回合开始按概率回火");
{
  const b = await run(withKaguya());
  const actor = b.teams[0].members[0];
  const skill = actor.skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "龙首之玉");
  ok("前置：换上场后带着「龙首之玉」", !!skill, JSON.stringify(actor.skills.map((s: any) => s.name)));
  if (skill) {
    await skill.execute(b, actor, b.enemiesOf(actor.teamId)[0]);
    ok("★★★ 场地创建成功（trace 里有 FIELD_ENTER）", b.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "FIELD_ENTER"));
    ok("★★★ 而且 perTurn 随场地进了**状态档**（暂停→存档→续跑不会丢）",
      fieldsOf(b)[0]?.perTurn?.probability === 0.67, JSON.stringify(fieldsOf(b)[0]));
    const snap: any = captureState(b);
    ok("★★ 序列化后仍在（state.fields[0].perTurn）", snap.fields?.[0]?.perTurn?.amount === 1, JSON.stringify(snap.fields?.[0]?.perTurn));
    const before = b.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "FIELD_PER_TURN").length;
    /** N = 友方单位数 × 20（每个单位在自己回合开始时各掷一次） */
    const N = b.teams[0].members.length * 20;
    let fired = 0;
    for (const m of b.teams[0].members) for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) fired += fieldTurnStart(b, m);
    const rows = b.trace.filter((e: any) => e.t === "FIELD_PER_TURN");
    ok("★★★ " + N + " 次回合开始产生了 " + N + " 条 FIELD_PER_TURN 记录（含没中的，否则 67% 无法被验证）",
      rows.length - before === N, String(rows.length - before));
    const sigma = Math.sqrt(N * 0.67 * 0.33);
    ok("★★★ 触发次数落在 67%±5σ 区间内（二项分布，n=" + N + "，σ≈" + sigma.toFixed(1) + "）",
      fired > 0.67 * N - 5 * sigma && fired < 0.67 * N + 5 * sigma, String(fired));
    /**
     * ★ 鬼火池有上限（8 点）：掷中之后要么进池（gained），要么**溢出**（overflow）——
     *   所以判据是 gained + overflow == 触发次数，而不是 gained == 触发次数（第一版写成后者，实测对不上）。
     */
    const gsum = rows.reduce((s: number, r: any) => s + (r.gained ?? 0), 0);
    const osum = rows.reduce((s: number, r: any) => s + (r.overflow ?? 0), 0);
    ok("★★ 每一次触发都真的产生了 1 点鬼火（进池 " + gsum + " + 溢出 " + osum + " == 触发 " + fired + "）",
      gsum + osum === fired && fired > 0, String(fired));
    await b.drainEvents();
    ok("★★ 触发时同时发事件（ORB_GAIN 进了总线 —— 复用第 120 轮的队列）",
      b.bus.chain.some((x: any) => x.code === "ORB_GAIN"));
  }
}
{
  const b = await run(withKaguya());
  const me = b.teams[0].members[0], enemy = b.teams[1].members[0];
  const spec: any = { kind: "ILLUSION", name: "探查幻境", duration: 3, durationSource: "CLAUSE", auras: [], perTurn: { trigger: "TURN_START", scope: "ENEMY", kind: "ORB_GAIN", amount: 2, probability: null, evidence: "单元测试" }, evidence: "单元测试" };
  createField(b, me, spec);
  const enemyBefore = b.teams[1].orbs.current;
  const n1 = fieldTurnStart(b, enemy);
  ok("★★★ ENEMY 范围：对手回合开始才结算（自己回合不结算）", n1 === 1 && fieldTurnStart(b, me) === 0, String(n1));
  ok("★★★ probability=null ⇒ 必触发（不是「掷不中」）", b.teams[1].orbs.current >= enemyBefore, enemyBefore + " → " + b.teams[1].orbs.current);
  const b2 = await run(withKaguya());
  const n2 = fieldTurnStart(b2, b2.teams[0].members[0]);
  ok("★★★ 没有场地时一次都不触发（不是「默认有效果」）", n2 === 0 && !b2.trace.some((e: any) => e.t === "FIELD_PER_TURN"), String(n2));
}

sec("[4] 确定性：同一 seed 两次，回火次数与指纹都一致");
{
  const a1 = await run(withKaguya(), 12345);
  const a2 = await run(withKaguya(), 12345);
  const s1 = a1.teams[0].members[0].skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "龙首之玉");
  const s2 = a2.teams[0].members[0].skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "龙首之玉");
  if (s1 && s2) {
    await s1.execute(a1, a1.teams[0].members[0], a1.enemiesOf(0)[0]);
    await s2.execute(a2, a2.teams[0].members[0], a2.enemiesOf(0)[0]);
    let f1 = 0, f2 = 0;
    for (const m of a1.teams[0].members) f1 += fieldTurnStart(a1, m);
    for (const m of a2.teams[0].members) f2 += fieldTurnStart(a2, m);
    ok("★★★ 同一 seed 两次的回火次数完全相同（掷数走 battle.rng + 稳定 tag）", f1 === f2, f1 + " vs " + f2);
    ok("★★ 而且整场指纹相同", stateHash(captureState(a1)) === stateHash(captureState(a2)));
  }
}

console.log("\n=== 场地每回合效果: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
```

```ts
// tests/g80-field-turn-end.ts — ★★★ 第 125 轮：场地的**回合结束**效果（第二种每回合形状）
//
// 第 124 轮做了第一种形状（辉夜姬：回合开始 67% 回火）。这一轮做第二种：
//   神酿星熊童子「饮过三巡」的「结界中敌我双方所有非召唤物目标在回合结束时有40%[tips_2]被施加[tips_103]」。
//   ★ 两处**实测踩到的坑**（都写在这里，因为它们不是"少做"而是"做错"）：
//     ① 原文写「有40%[tips_2]」——**没有「概率」二字**（tips_2 本身就是「基础概率」），
//        第一版正则要求「概率」⇒ 永远匹配不到；
//     ② 这句**不在创建句里**（创建句只写到「创造存在2回合的神饮之宴结界，期间自身免疫[混乱]」），

import path from "node:path";

import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { fieldTurnEnd, fieldTurnStart, fieldsOf, createField, clearField } from "../kernel/field.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const kb = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));

    const sigma = Math.sqrt(N * 0.4 * 0.6);
    ok("★★★ 触发次数落在 40%±5σ 区间（n=" + N + "，σ≈" + sigma.toFixed(1) + "）",

    const confused = all.filter((u: any) => u.hasStatus("confuse")).length;

  }
}

{

    /** ★ 先把「饮过三巡」那个 ALL 范围的场地清掉 —— 否则它会同时命中，把范围过滤的判据搅浑（第一版就踩了） */
    for (const st of [...fieldsOf(b)]) clearField(b, st, "TEST_RESET");
    ok("前置：场地已清空", fieldsOf(b).length === 0, String(fieldsOf(b).length));
    const spec: any = { kind: "ILLUSION", name: "探查幻境", duration: 2, durationSource: "CLAUSE", auras: [], perTurn: { trigger: "TURN_END", scope: "ALLY", kind: "STATUS_APPLY", statusId: "stun", duration: 1, probability: null, evidence: "单元测试" }, evidence: "单元测试" };
    createField(b, b.teams[1].members[0], spec);
    const n = fieldTurnEnd(b, me);
    ok("★★ 范围过滤：ALLY 场地对**敌方**单位不结算", n === 0, String(n));
    ok("★★ probability=null 时必触发", fieldTurnEnd(b, b.teams[1].members[0]) === 1);
    ok("★★ 查不到定义的 statusId 什么都不做（编译器那边已记账）", (() => {

      const f = createField(b, me, bad);
      return f ? fieldTurnEnd(b, me) === 0 : false;
    })());
  }
}
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g82-fidelity-cli.ts`

```ts
// tests/g82-fidelity-cli.ts — ★★★ 第 127 轮：Per-Match Fidelity 与「第一处分歧」的 **CLI**（目标 ① / ⑧）
//
// 由来：库层早就有（kernel/fidelity.ts 五层 + kernel/diff.ts 第一处分歧 + g19/ui10 的 38/53 条断言），
//   但**没有 CLI** —— 与第 117 轮之前的 Replay 同型：能力在、入口不在，而 a1-4 给的是**用法**。
// 本测试钉三件事：① report 出的五层与非评价性分类；② 报告里**不许**有真实性百分比；
//   ③ diff 能定位「第一处分歧」并且**改坏就红**（含「观测没写的字段不比较」这条判据）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fidelityReport, diffObserved } from "../tools/fidelity-cli.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { projectObserved } from "../kernel/diff.ts";
import { FIDELITY_CLASS_LABEL, FIDELITY_LAYERS } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const TMP = path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "fixtures", "obs-tmp-g82.json");

sec("[1] report：五层 + 冻结分类（且**没有**真实性百分比）");
{
  const r = await fidelityReport();
  const f: any = r.fidelity;
  ok("★★★ 拿到了 Fidelity 报告", !!f && Array.isArray(f.layers), JSON.stringify(Object.keys(f ?? {})));
  const names = (f?.layers ?? []).map((L: any) => L.layer);
  ok("★★★ 五层齐全：INPUT / SKILL / AI / MECHANIC / RULESET",
    FIDELITY_LAYERS.every(n => names.includes(n)), JSON.stringify(names));
  ok("★★★ 分类取四个冻结值之一（VERIFIED / COMPLETE_UNVERIFIED / PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT）",
    ["VERIFIED", "COMPLETE_UNVERIFIED", "PARTIAL", "INSUFFICIENT"].includes(f?.klass), String(f?.klass));
  ok("★★ 分类有中文标签（界面与 CLI 用同一份）", !!FIDELITY_CLASS_LABEL[f?.klass], String(FIDELITY_CLASS_LABEL[f?.klass]));
  ok("★★★ 每条结论都**给理由**，不给分数", Array.isArray(f?.reasons) && f.reasons.length > 0, String(f?.reasons?.length));
  const text = JSON.stringify(f);
  ok("★★★ 报告里**没有**任何「真实性百分比」（目标 ① 的铁律）", !/%/.test(text), (text.match(/[^"]{0,12}%[^"]{0,12}/) ?? [""])[0]);
  ok("★★ 免责声明随结果一起给（§2 显示精度 / §8 红区）", Array.isArray(f?.caveats) && f.caveats.length > 0, String(f?.caveats?.length));
  console.log("    分类 " + f?.klass + "｜五层 " + (f?.layers ?? []).map((L: any) => L.layer + ":" + L.klass).join(" "));
}

sec("[2] diff：与「真实观测」对照 —— 一致时不报，改坏时必须报，而且报**第一处**");
{
  const seed = 123456;
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed });
  await a.battle.run();
  const { frames } = projectObserved(a.battle.trace as any[]);
  ok("前置：模拟产出可观测帧（> 20 条）", frames.length > 20, String(frames.length));
  /** 人工观测的典型形态：只记「谁打谁、多少伤害」+ 别名，其它字段缺省（不比较） */
  /**
   * ★ 人工观测的典型形态：**帧序列完整**（diff 按 kind 对齐，少一帧就会被判 EXTRA —— 第一版只挑 DAMAGE 帧，
   *   结果模拟侧第一条是 SKILL，直接判成分歧），但**字段只记一部分**（act/tgt/数值，血量不记）。
   */
  const obs = frames.slice(0, 12).map((f: any) => ({ kind: f.kind, actor: f.actor, target: f.target, ...(f.amount !== undefined ? { amount: Math.round(f.amount) } : {}) }));
  fs.writeFileSync(TMP, JSON.stringify({ seed, alias: {}, frames: obs }));
  const good: any = await diffObserved(TMP, seed, { frames });
  ok("★★★ 与模拟一致（在容差内）⇒ ok=true，且明确报告比了多少帧",
    good.ok === true && good.observed === obs.length, JSON.stringify({ ok: good.ok, observed: good.observed, simulated: good.simulated }));
  /**
   * 改坏一条：把**带数值的那一帧**改成 +999 ⇒ 必须定位到它。
   * ★ 第一版改的是 obs[2]，而那一帧是 SKILL、**没有 amount** —— 改了个寂寞，反向闸门看起来像空的。
   */
  const badFrames = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obs));
  const dmgIdx = badFrames.findIndex((f: any) => f.kind === "DAMAGE" && typeof f.amount === "number");
  badFrames[dmgIdx].amount = Math.round(badFrames[dmgIdx].amount) + 999;
  fs.writeFileSync(TMP, JSON.stringify({ seed, frames: badFrames }));
  const bad: any = await diffObserved(TMP, seed, { frames });

   *      那是**让测试 spawn 自己** ⇒ 子进程又跑一遍测试、又 spawn…**无限递归**（实测挂了 700+ 个 node 进程）；
   *   ② 第二版改成 spawn 一个 import 探针，**仍然挂着**：adapter 会把事件循环留住（子进程不退出 ⇒ execSync 永远等）。
   *   现在只用**不产生子进程**的判据，而且证据更强：本文件顶部就 import 了这个模块 ——
   *   若 main 被触发，输出里会出现 CLI 用法；下面把正则钉死，人能一眼复核。
   */
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "tools", "fidelity-cli.ts"), "utf8");
  ok("★★★ isMain 正则**锚定 tools/**（不会匹配 tests/*-fidelity-cli.ts）",
    /\/\[\/\\\\\]tools\[\/\\\\\]fidelity-cli/.test(src), (src.match(/const isMain = .*/) ?? [""])[0].slice(0, 100));
  ok("★★★ import 到的是函数（模块被安静地加载，没有副作用把进程带跑）",
    typeof fidelityReport === "function" && typeof diffObserved === "function");
  ok("★★★ 反向：用**本测试文件**的路径去跑同一条正则，必须不匹配",
    !new RegExp("/[/\\\\]tools[/\\\\]fidelity-cli\\.ts$").test(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "tests", "g82-fidelity-cli.ts").split(path.sep).join("/")));
}
```

```ts
// tests/g83-death-revive.ts — ★★★ 第 129 轮：**死亡级联与触发式自复活**
//
// 这一轮修的是两条**互相咬合**的事实（两条都是探针先跑出来的，不是推理出来的）：
//
//   ① 「阵亡的单位不再做事」原来靠 `unregisterOwner` 实现 —— 副作用是
//      **复活带不回订阅**（三尾狐「诱惑」阵亡前挨打回流 200 点，复活后再派发同一条
//      AFTER_DAMAGE，一条 trace 都没有），而且注销发生在 EV.DEATH 派发**之前**，
//      于是「阵亡时」这一族**永远不可能触发**。
//      改法：订阅不动，「还算不算在场」由总线按存活状态裁决（EventBus.ownerActive），
//      死亡级联的事件码豁免（倒下这件事本身要通知到他）。
//
//   ② 「阵亡时…立即复活」在 IR 里第一次有了产物（SkillIR.selfRevive），
//      运行时由 kernel/self-revive.ts 执行（与主动复活共用 Battle.revive + healTarget）。
//
// ★ 本文件里的每个数字都来自实测（tools/_probe-revive129c.ts 总线双向 / _probe-selfrevive-run.ts
//   端到端数值 / _probe-selfrevive129.ts IR 形状 / _probe-death3rd.ts 承受者归属 /
//   _probe-revive-scope.ts 全库候选计数），不是从文档推的。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileBuff } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { newUnitId } from "../../apps/web/src/contracts/guessing-match.ts";
import { EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { installPassiveSkills } from "../compile/passive-runtime.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(KB) ? KB : (KB.characters ?? KB.items ?? []);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const buffs = new Map<string, any>((JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[]).map((b: any) => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]));
const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
const tips = loadTips(Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : (Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? []);
setTipsTable(tips);
const isOnmyoji = (n: string) => /晴明|神乐|八百比丘尼|源博雅/.test(n);
const skillIR = (who: string, skill: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === who)!;
  const sk = (s.skills ?? []).find((x: any) => x.name === skill)!;
  return compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk);
};

sec("[1] ★★★ 编译：selfRevive 的四条判据（收两条、挡两条，两个方向都查）");

  const nine: any = skillIR("九命猫", "九命");

    nine.selfRevive?.hpPercent === 20 && nine.selfRevive?.requireStacks?.n === 4 &&

    tao.revive?.scope === "ONE" && !tao.selfRevive, JSON.stringify({ revive: tao.revive, selfRevive: tao.selfRevive }));

  // 全库计数（量出来的，不是我挑的）
  const hits: string[] = [];

    for (const sk of (s.skills ?? [])) {

const unit = (name: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === name)!;
  return {
    unitId: newUnitId(), shikigamiId: s.id, name,
    stats: { attack: 3000, hp: 20000, defense: 400, speed: 150, critRate: 0, critDamage: 1.5, effectHit: 100, effectResist: 0 },
    soulId: null,
  };
};

/** 造一局：红 0 号位换成 `who`，其余沿用典型对局 #001（蓝方 2 号位当击杀者，故意不是 0 号位） */
async function arena(who: string, opts: { stacks?: number; buffId?: string; seed?: number; passives?: boolean } = {}) {
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = unit(who);
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, {
    seed: opts.seed ?? 7, traceLevel: "FULL",
    passives: opts.passives === false ? "NOT_EXECUTED" : "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY",
  });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const b = a.battle;
  const e = b.teams[0].members[0];
  const killer = b.teams[1].members[2];
  if (opts.stacks && opts.buffId) e.addStatus(buffs.get(opts.buffId)!, e.id, opts.stacks, 5);
  return { battle: b, e, killer, report: b.passiveReport };
}

/** 把 `e` 打死（走真实的死亡状态机，不是直接置 dead） */
async function slay(b: any, e: any, killer: any) {
  e.hp = 0; e.hpZero = true;
  await b.resolveLethal(e, killer.id);
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 总线：阵亡**不再注销订阅**（阵亡期间不做事 / 复活后恢复做事，双向）");
{
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001, traceLevel: "FULL", passives: "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const b = a.battle;
  const fox = b.allEntities().find((x: any) => x.name === "三尾狐")!;   // 「诱惑」= 造成伤害时 50% 概率 20% 吸血
  const foe = b.teams[1].members[0];
  const owned = () => b.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => h.ownerId === fox.id);
  ok("★ 前置：三尾狐身上确实装着 1 个处理器（否则下面三条是平凡通过）", owned().length === 1, String(owned().length));

  const fire = async () => {
    const t0 = b.trace.length;
    await b.bus.dispatch(EV.AFTER_DAMAGE,
      { input: { source: fox, target: foe }, result: { applied: 1000, final: 1000, absorbed: 0 } },
      fox.id, fox.teamId, (id: number) => b.teamOf(id));
    return b.trace.slice(t0).filter((t: any) => /LIFESTEAL|HEAL/.test(String(t.t))).length;
  };
  const before = await fire();
  ok("★★★ 阵亡前：这条被动真的会做事（吸血留下 trace）", before > 0, String(before));

  fox.hp = 0; fox.hpZero = true;
  await b.resolveLethal(fox, foe.id);
  ok("★★ 阵亡后处理器**仍然在表里**（不再是 unregisterOwner 那条路）", owned().length === 1, String(owned().length));
  const during = await fire();
  ok("★★★ 但阵亡期间它**一次都不许触发**（「死了就不做事」这条语义没有丢）", during === 0, String(during));

  const revived = await b.revive(fox, 1);
  ok("★ 复活成功", revived === true && fox.alive === true, JSON.stringify({ revived, alive: fox.alive, hp: fox.hp }));
  const after = await fire();
  ok("★★★ 复活后同一条派发又能触发 —— **订阅没有被死亡带走**（这一轮修掉的核心缺陷）",
    after > 0, String(after));
}

  await slay(c.battle, c.e, c.killer);
  ok("★★★ 对照：没有复活的目标仍然记 killed=true 且派发 KILLED（这一档没有被整体关掉）",
    c.e.killed === true && !c.battle.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "KILLED_SKIPPED"),
    JSON.stringify({ killed: c.e.killed }));
}

sec("[7] ★★ 与主动复活的分工：被动关闭时，触发式复活**不注册**（默认档不许改变历史结果）");
{
  const a = await arena("骨女", { stacks: 5, buffId: "2232_1", passives: false });
  ok("★ 前置：被动策略 OFF 时安装报告是空的", (a.report?.installed ?? []).length === 0, JSON.stringify(a.report?.mode));
  await slay(a.battle, a.e, a.killer);
  ok("★★★ 默认档下骨女**不复活**（红区 E：默认不许产生新行为，指纹才不会漂）",
    a.e.dead === true && !a.battle.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "SELF_REVIVE"),
    JSON.stringify({ dead: a.e.dead }));
}

console.log("\ng83-death-revive: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed");
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);
```

```ts
    soulId: null,
  };
};

async function arena(who: string, seed = 21) {
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = unit(who);
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return { battle: a.battle, e: a.battle.teams[0].members[0], foe: a.battle.teams[1].members[0] };
}
const slay = async (b: any, e: any, killer: any) => { e.hp = 0; e.hpZero = true; await b.resolveLethal(e, killer.id); };

    h2 === 0 && e.hp === before && b.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "HEAL_SKIPPED" && t.reason === "OFF_FIELD"),
    JSON.stringify({ h2, before, hp: e.hp }));

sec("[6] ★★ 默认档没有被动运行时也不受影响（这一轮的能力位与形态都不依赖被动策略）");
{
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = unit("百羽凤凰火");
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 21, traceLevel: "FULL", passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" });

    e.transformed === true && b.teams[0].summons.some((x: any) => x.notes.includes("summon:6071")),
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g85-ally-guard.ts`

```ts
// tests/g85-ally-guard.ts — ★★★ 第 131 轮：**替友方拦截致命伤**（EV.DEATH_PREVENTION 的第一个生产者）
//
// 三类拦死里前两类早有执行点（状态字段 preventsLethal / 自身的 ON_LETHAL 形态），第三类一直只躺在账上：
//   KB：伊邪那美「神赐之吻」——「自身在场时，处于[buff_5572_1]的友方目标受到致命伤害将剩余1点生命
//   （目标下回合开始前至多触发1次，被再次施加毁灭前至多累计触发3次）」。
// 它写在**主动技能**原文里（cost=2），被动运行时只收 cost<0 ⇒ 它是"站在场上的常驻条款"。
//
// ★ 次数上限必须真的执行（第 78 轮层数封顶同一条判据）。本文件把**每回合 1 次 / 累计 3 次 /
//   状态重施清零 / 拥有者离场不拦**四条全部双向验一遍 —— 探针 tools/_probe-allyguard-run131.ts
//   实测过第一版把计数写成"流水"而不是"当前值"：第 4 次照样拦住（多算一步，且不报错）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { compileBuff, toStatusDef } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { newUnitId } from "../../apps/web/src/contracts/guessing-match.ts";
import { clearAllyGuardWindow } from "../kernel/ally-guard.ts";
import { captureState, restoreBattle } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { runtimeFor, attachRuntime } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(KB) ? KB : (KB.characters ?? KB.items ?? []);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const buffs = new Map<string, any>((JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[]).map((b: any) => [String(b.id), compileBuff(b)]));
const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
setTipsTable(loadTips(Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : (Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? []));
/**
 * ★★★ 毁灭（5572_1）的状态定义必须按**引擎那条路**造：compileBuff → toStatusDef → 注册进 StatusBook。
 *   探针 tools/_probe-allyguard-restore131.ts 实测：直接拿 compileBuff 的结果 `addStatus`，
 *   状态在**存档往返**里会被丢掉（state.ts 按 defId 查 StatusBook，查不到就不还原）——
 *   于是"续跑后条款不生效"看起来像引擎的错，其实是测试没走引擎的注册路径。
 */
const DESTRUCT = (() => {
  const def = toStatusDef(buffs.get("5572_1"));
  if (!StatusBook.has(def.id)) StatusBook.set(def.id, def);
  return def;
})();
const skillIR = (who: string, skill: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === who)!;
  const sk = (s.skills ?? []).find((x: any) => x.name === skill)!;
  return compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk);
};
const allIR = () => {
  const out: Array<{ who: string; ir: any }> = [];
  for (const s of LIST) for (const sk of (s.skills ?? [])) out.push({ who: s.name, ir: compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk) });
  return out;
};

sec("[1] ★★★ 编译：allyGuard 收一条、挡两条（fail-closed）");
{
  const hit = allIR().filter(x => x.ir.allyGuard);
  ok("★★★ 全库恰好 1 条替友方拦死（伊邪那美「神赐之吻」）", hit.length === 1, JSON.stringify(hit.map(x => x.who)));
  const g = skillIR("伊邪那美", "神赐之吻").allyGuard!;
  ok("★★★ 四个字段都从原文读出来了（状态引用 / 每回合1次 / 累计3次 / 自身在场）",
    g.statusRef === "5572_1" && g.perTurnMax === 1 && g.totalMax === 3 && g.requireSelfOnField === true && g.resetOn === "STATUS_REAPPLY",
    JSON.stringify(g));
  ok("★★★ 而它**不再**报「致命伤害拦截」缺口（有执行点了）",
    !(skillIR("伊邪那美", "神赐之吻").unmodeledMechanics ?? []).some((m: any) => m.verb === "致命伤害拦截"),
    JSON.stringify((skillIR("伊邪那美", "神赐之吻").unmodeledMechanics ?? []).map((m: any) => m.verb)));
  ok("★★ 那一句的句子分类也跟着变 PARSED（否则账上会出现「有执行点却仍报未解析」）",
    (skillIR("伊邪那美", "神赐之吻").sentences ?? []).some((s: any) => /受到致命伤害/.test(s.text) && s.kind === "PARSED"),
    JSON.stringify((skillIR("伊邪那美", "神赐之吻").sentences ?? []).map((s: any) => s.kind)));

  // 反向：另外两条同类写法**必须**保持未建模
  const ice = skillIR("蝉冰雪女", "息吹");
  const stone = skillIR("石长姬", "磐长纪");
  ok("★★★ 反向：蝉冰雪女「息吹」（凝结形态，KB 里没有这个单位的定义）不收，仍报缺口",
    !ice.allyGuard && (ice.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).some((m: any) => m.verb === "致命伤害拦截"), JSON.stringify(ice.allyGuard));
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 187 轮**按事实改写**：石长姬那条**仍然不是**替友方拦死（写法不同型），但它**有了自己的执行点** ——
   *   SkillIR.lethalConsume + kernel/lethal-consume.ts（第 187 轮接线，tests/g109-lethal-consume.ts 16 条），
   *   于是它不再报「致命伤害拦截」缺口。这一条现在守的是"**别把它错收成 allyGuard**"。
   */
  ok("★★★ 反向：石长姬「磐长纪」（消耗1朵花换生命）**不收**成替友方拦死，而是走它自己的消耗型换命",
    !stone.allyGuard && !!stone.lethalConsume, JSON.stringify({ allyGuard: stone.allyGuard ?? null, lethalConsume: stone.lethalConsume ?? null, unmodeled: (stone.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).map((m: any) => m.verb) }));
}

const unit = (name: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === name)!;
  return {
    unitId: newUnitId(), shikigamiId: s.id, name,
    stats: { attack: 3000, hp: 20000, defense: 400, speed: 150, critRate: 0, critDamage: 1.5, effectHit: 0, effectResist: 0 },
    soulId: null,
  };
};
/** 一局：红 0 号位 = 伊邪那美（条款拥有者），1/2 号位 = 队友；蓝 0 号位当杀手 */
async function arena(passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" = "NOT_EXECUTED", seed = 31) {
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = unit("伊邪那美");
  m.red.units[1] = unit("座敷童子");
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, traceLevel: "FULL", passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const b = a.battle;
  return { b, owner: b.teams[0].members[0], mate: b.teams[0].members[1], mate2: b.teams[0].members[2], foe: b.teams[1].members[0] };
}
const slay = async (b: any, e: any, killer: any) => { e.hp = 0; e.hpZero = true; await b.resolveLethal(e, killer.id); };
const guardTraces = (b: any) => b.trace.filter((t: any) => /^ALLY_GUARD/.test(String(t.t)));

sec("[2] ★★★ 运行时：条款被装上，EV.DEATH_PREVENTION 有了第一个订阅者");

    JSON.stringify(b.allyGuardReport));
  const subs = b.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => h.code === "DEATH_PREVENTION");
  ok("★★★ DEATH_PREVENTION 从「只有声明」变成有订阅者（此前生产代码里 0 个）", subs.length === 1, JSON.stringify(subs.map((h: any) => h.id)));
  ok("★★ 而且它**不受被动封印**（没写 source ⇒ 不属于 PASSIVE/SOUL 两类）", subs[0].source === undefined, String(subs[0].source));
}

{

  ok("★★★ 留痕：ALLY_GUARD（谁救的 / 本窗口第几次 / 累计第几次）+ DEATH_PREVENTED",
    guardTraces(b).some((t: any) => t.t === "ALLY_GUARD" && t.owner === owner.id && t.usedThisWindow === 1 && t.totalUsed === 1) &&

    JSON.stringify(guardTraces(b)[0]));

  await slay(b, mate, foe);

    mate.dead === true && guardTraces(b).some((t: any) => t.t === "ALLY_GUARD_BLOCKED" && t.reason === "PER_TURN_LIMIT"),
    JSON.stringify(guardTraces(b).map((t: any) => t.t + "/" + (t.reason ?? ""))));

  // 换窗口（=它自己的回合开始）后连续触发，直到累计 3 次用尽
  const revive = (e: any) => { e.hp = 20000; e.dead = false; e.alive = true; e.hpZero = false; clearAllyGuardWindow(e); };
  revive(mate); await slay(b, mate, foe);
  revive(mate); await slay(b, mate, foe);
  const used = mate.notes.find((n: string) => n.startsWith("allyGuardCount:"));

  revive(mate); await slay(b, mate, foe);

  await slay(b, mate, foe);
  ok("★★ 同一个窗口里的**第二次** ⇒ 又被每回合上限挡住（两把锁各自独立生效）",
    mate.dead === true && guardTraces(b).some((t: any) => t.t === "ALLY_GUARD_BLOCKED" && t.reason === "PER_TURN_LIMIT"),
    JSON.stringify({ dead: mate.dead, traces: guardTraces(b).map((t: any) => t.t + "/" + (t.reason ?? "")) }));
}

sec("[5] ★★★ 拥有者条件：「自身在场时」——阵亡 / 离场（形态期间）都不再拦");
{
  const { b, owner, mate, mate2, foe } = await arena();

sec("[6] ★★ 默认档（被动运行时 OFF）也生效：它是技能原文里的常驻条款，不是被动");

  const { b, owner, mate, foe } = await arena("NOT_EXECUTED");

}
```

```ts
// tests/g86-g0-subscribers.ts — ★★★ 第 132 轮：**三种订阅在"装配"与"恢复"两条路径上装同一套**
//
// 由来（第 131 轮那条笔记的续集）：订阅是**事件总线上的函数**，不进 BattleState。
//   装配路径装、恢复路径不装 ⇒「存档前御魂在跑、续跑后御魂消失」这种**静默降级**在架构上成立。
//   第 131 轮先把"替友方拦死"搬进 attachRuntime，这一轮把**御魂与被动**一起搬进去，
//   并补上御魂**闭包层数**的反推（无刀取的 stacks 原先从 0 重来）。
//
// 本文件的判据是**行为**而不是"函数被调用过"：
//   ① 装配路径装了哪三种订阅（id 集合）；
//   ② 恢复之后 id 集合**逐项相同**；
//   ③ 续跑终局与连续跑**逐位一致**（这就是"暂停→存档→杀掉引擎→重载→继续完全相同地战斗"）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch, runtimeFor, attachRuntime } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { captureState, restoreBattle, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const SEED = 20261302;
const PAUSE_AT = 18;
const SOUL_WUDAOQU = 56;   // 无刀取：回合结束后永久提升15%伤害，上限45% ⇒ 最多 3 层
const PASSIVES = "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" as const;

/** 典型对局 #001 + 给红 0 号位（三尾狐）穿四件套无刀取 + 打开被动运行时 */
function fixture() {
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0].soulId = SOUL_WUDAOQU;
  return m;
}
const stackCount = (battle: any, id: number) =>
  (battle.teams[0].members[0].effects ?? []).filter((x: any) => typeof x.source === "string" && x.source.startsWith("soul" + SOUL_WUDAOQU + ":stack")).length;
/** 三种订阅的 id 集合（御魂 / 被动 / 替友方拦死）—— 只取这三类，别的处理器不参与比较 */
const subscriberIds = (battle: any) =>
  (battle.bus.handlers ?? []).filter((h: any) => h.source === "SOUL" || h.source === "PASSIVE" || String(h.id).startsWith("allyGuard:"))
    .map((h: any) => h.id).sort();

sec("[1] 装配路径：三种订阅都装上，而且账上有据（soulReport / passiveReport）");
const kitA = createKit(bundle);
const a: any = assembleMatch(kitA, fixture(), { seed: SEED, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
await a.battle.runStartup();
const idsA = subscriberIds(a.battle);
ok("★★★ 御魂装上了（无刀取 = TURN_END 的层数 ramp）",
  !!a.battle.soulReport && a.battle.soulReport.installed.some((x: any) => x.soulId === SOUL_WUDAOQU),
  JSON.stringify(a.battle.soulReport?.installed?.map((x: any) => x.soulId)));
ok("★★★ 被动运行时装上了（三尾狐「诱惑」= AFTER_DAMAGE 的吸血）",
  (a.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length > 0,
  JSON.stringify(a.battle.passiveReport?.installed?.map((x: any) => x.skill)));
ok("★★ 三种订阅的 id 集合非空（否则下面的比较是平凡通过）", idsA.length >= 2, JSON.stringify(idsA));

sec("[2] 跑到第 " + PAUSE_AT + " 回合 → 存档 → 杀掉引擎 → 重建：订阅必须逐项相同");
await a.battle.runPartial(PAUSE_AT);
const mid = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(captureState(a.battle)));
const stacksAtPause = stackCount({ teams: mid.teams.map((t: any) => ({ members: t.members.map((m: any) => ({ effects: m.effects })) })) } as any, 0);
ok("★ 前置：存档点上无刀取已经叠过层（否则第 [4] 节证明不了「层数会续」）", stacksAtPause > 0, String(stacksAtPause));

const kitC = createKit(bundle);   // ★ 全新的运行时
const restored: any = restoreBattle(mid, {
  kit: kitC,
  makeRuntime: (id: number) => runtimeFor(kitC, id),
  attachRuntime,                   // ★ 与装配路径**同一个**函数
} as any);
const idsB = subscriberIds(restored);
ok("★★★ 恢复之后的订阅 id 集合与装配路径**逐项相同**",
  JSON.stringify(idsA) === JSON.stringify(idsB),
  JSON.stringify({ 装配: idsA, 恢复: idsB }));

sec("[3] ★★★ 御魂的闭包层数**从实体身上反推**（不是从 0 重来）");
ok("★★★ 恢复后立刻读：已叠层数与存档点一致（无刀取不会「续跑后又能再涨一轮」）",
  stackCount(restored, 0) === stacksAtPause, JSON.stringify({ 恢复后: stackCount(restored, 0), 存档点: stacksAtPause }));

sec("[4] ★★★ 续跑终局与连续跑逐位一致（在有订阅者的情况下）");
const b: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), fixture(), { seed: SEED, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
await b.battle.run();
const refHash = stateHash(captureState(b.battle));
const needMore = await restored.runPartial(Infinity);
const gotHash = stateHash(captureState(restored));
ok("★★★ 终局状态指纹一致（帧号/事件号/RNG/实体状态全部对齐）", gotHash === refHash, JSON.stringify({ 连续: refHash, 续跑: gotHash }));
ok("★★★ 胜者与回合数一致",
  restored.winner === b.battle.winner && restored.turn === b.battle.turn,
  JSON.stringify({ 连续: [b.battle.winner, b.battle.turn], 续跑: [restored.winner, restored.turn] }));
ok("★★ 无刀取的叠层最终都封顶在同一层数（上限 45% / 每层 15% ⇒ 3 层）",
  stackCount(restored, 0) === stackCount(b.battle, 0) && stackCount(b.battle, 0) === 3,
  JSON.stringify({ 连续: stackCount(b.battle, 0), 续跑: stackCount(restored, 0) }));
void needMore;

sec("[5] ★★ 不给知识库时**明确留痕**，而不是安静地少装一套御魂");
{
  const kitD = createKit(bundle);
  const mid2: any = (() => {
    const c: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), fixture(), { seed: SEED, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
    return c.battle;   // 只需要一份状态快照（开局即存）
  })();
  await mid2.runStartup();
  const snap = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(captureState(mid2)));
  const noKit: any = restoreBattle(snap, {
    kit: undefined,                                   // ★ 调用方没给知识库（不是给了一个空的）
    makeRuntime: (id: number) => runtimeFor(kitD, id),
    attachRuntime,
  } as any);
  ok("★★★ 没有知识库时留下 SOUL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE（理由 NO_KIT）——「少装」必须看得见",
    noKit.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "SOUL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE" && t.reason === "NO_KIT"),
    JSON.stringify(noKit.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "SOUL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")));
  ok("★★ 而被动仍然装上了（它只需要 policies 与模块级 tips 表）",
    (noKit.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length > 0, JSON.stringify(noKit.passiveReport?.installed?.length));
}

console.log("\ng86-g0-subscribers: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed");
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);
```
