### `battle-lab/tests/g87-two-path-parity.ts`

```ts
// tests/g87-two-path-parity.ts — ★★★ 第 133 轮：**两条装配路径必须装同一套订阅**
//
// 由来：三次同类事故都长一个样 ——
//   · 第 93 轮：被动运行时只装在网页路径上，Node 侧（CLI / 基线）里那个开关**只是一句声明**；
//   · 第 132 轮：御魂与被动只装在**装配**路径上，**恢复**路径不装；
//   · 第 133 轮：Node 侧参考装配**既没有御魂、也没有替友方拦死**（接线在后，补装在前）。
// 而既有那条"Node vs Web 逐局一致"的对照（apps/web/tests/ui2-engine.ts §[3]）**测不出来**：
//   典型夹具里没有御魂、被动默认又是关的 —— 两个本该校验差别的数字完全相同。
// ⇒ 本文件用**会差别的夹具**（伊邪那美 + 四件套无刀取 + 打开被动）来比订阅集合与终局结果，
//   并且带一条**反向哨兵**：故意让一条路径少给知识库，比对必须红（否则这个比对是平凡的）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileBuff, toStatusDef } from "../compile/buff-compiler.ts";
import { StatusBook } from "../kernel/status.ts";
import { PassivePolicies } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { assembleGuessingMatch } from "../soul/guessing-match.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(KB) ? KB : (KB.characters ?? KB.items ?? []);
const ID_IZANAMI = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === "伊邪那美")!.id;
const SOUL_WUDAOQU = 56;
const PASSIVES = "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" as const;
const DESTRUCT = (() => {
  const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[];
  const def = toStatusDef(compileBuff(raw.find(b => String(b.id) === "5572_1")));
  if (!StatusBook.has(def.id)) StatusBook.set(def.id, def);
  return def;
})();
const FIXTURE = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "fixtures", "guessing-match-canonical-001.json"), "utf8"));

/**
 * 夹具的三处改动（**刻意让三种订阅都出现**）：
 *   · 红 0 保持三尾狐 —— 它的「诱惑」是被动运行时唯一装得上的那一条（换掉它就没有被动了）；
 *   · 红 1 穿四件套无刀取 —— 御魂（TURN_END 的层数 ramp）；
 *   · 红 2 换成伊邪那美 —— 「神赐之吻」的替友方拦死。
 */
function nodeFixture() {
  const f: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FIXTURE));
  f.red[1] = { ...f.red[1], soulIds: [SOUL_WUDAOQU, SOUL_WUDAOQU, SOUL_WUDAOQU, SOUL_WUDAOQU] };
  f.red[2] = { ...f.red[2], name: "伊邪那美", shikigamiId: ID_IZANAMI };
  return f;
}
/** 网页侧对局：同样的三处改动（同一个 KB id / 同一个御魂） */
function webMatch() {
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[1] = { ...m.red.units[1], soulId: SOUL_WUDAOQU };
  m.red.units[2] = { ...m.red.units[2], shikigamiId: ID_IZANAMI, name: "伊邪那美" };
  return m;
}
/** 订阅集合（只看三种订阅：御魂 / 被动 / 替友方拦死） */
const ids = (battle: any) => (battle.bus.handlers ?? [])
  .filter((h: any) => h.source === "SOUL" || h.source === "PASSIVE" || String(h.id).startsWith("allyGuard:"))
  .map((h: any) => h.id).sort();
const stackCount = (battle: any, idx: number) =>
  (battle.teams[0].members[idx].effects ?? []).filter((x: any) => typeof x.source === "string" && x.source.startsWith("soul" + SOUL_WUDAOQU + ":stack")).length;

sec("[1] ★★★ 两条路径装同一套订阅（会差别的夹具：伊邪那美 + 四件套无刀取 + 打开被动）");
const kit = createKit(bundle);
const webA: any = assembleMatch(kit, webMatch(), { seed: 20261303, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
const nodeA: any = await assembleGuessingMatch(nodeFixture(), { seed: 20261303, maxTurns: 300, policies: { passives: PassivePolicies.PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY } });
const webIds = ids(webA.battle), nodeIds = ids(nodeA.battle);
ok("★ 前置：这个夹具下订阅集合**非空**（否则下面的比对是平凡的）", webIds.length >= 3, JSON.stringify(webIds));
ok("★★★ 三种订阅都在场（御魂 + 被动 + 替友方拦死）",
  webIds.some((x: string) => x.includes("SOUL")) && webIds.some((x: string) => x.startsWith("passive:")) && webIds.some((x: string) => x.startsWith("allyGuard:")),
  JSON.stringify(webIds));
ok("★★★ Node 侧参考装配的订阅集合与网页路径**逐项相同**",
  JSON.stringify(webIds) === JSON.stringify(nodeIds),
  JSON.stringify({ web: webIds, node: nodeIds }));
ok("★★ 两边的被动安装报告一致（装了哪几句也一样）",
  JSON.stringify((webA.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).map((x: any) => x.skill + "/" + x.family).sort()) ===
  JSON.stringify((nodeA.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).map((x: any) => x.skill + "/" + x.family).sort()),
  JSON.stringify({ web: (webA.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length, node: (nodeA.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length }));

sec("[2] ★★★ 10 个 seed 逐局一致（胜者 / 结束原因 / 回合数）");
{
  const seeds = [20261001, 20261002, 7, 11111, 424242, 99999, 31415926, 555001, 100000, 20261303];
  const diffs: string[] = [];
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const n: any = await assembleGuessingMatch(nodeFixture(), { seed, maxTurns: 300, policies: { passives: PassivePolicies.PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY } });
    const nr = await n.battle.run();
    const w: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), webMatch(), { seed, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
    const wr = await w.battle.run();
    const a = nr.winner + "/" + nr.reason + "/" + nr.turns;
    const b = wr.winner + "/" + wr.reason + "/" + wr.turns;
    if (a !== b) diffs.push("seed " + seed + ": Node=" + a + " Web=" + b);
  }
  ok("★★★ 10 个 seed 全部逐局一致", diffs.length === 0, diffs.join(" | "));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 不是「两边都没有」：Node 路径上御魂与拦死**真的在跑**");
{
  const n: any = await assembleGuessingMatch(nodeFixture(), { seed: 20261303, maxTurns: 300, policies: { passives: PassivePolicies.PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY } });
  await n.battle.runStartup();
  const b = n.battle, owner = b.teams[0].members[2], mate = b.teams[0].members[1], foe = b.teams[1].members[0];
  ok("★★★ Node 路径装上了御魂（soulReport 点名无刀取）",
    !!b.soulReport && b.soulReport.installed.some((x: any) => x.soulId === SOUL_WUDAOQU),
    JSON.stringify(b.soulReport?.installed?.map((x: any) => x.soulId)));
  ok("★★★ Node 路径装上了替友方拦死（allyGuardReport 非空）",
    (b.allyGuardReport ?? []).length === 1, JSON.stringify(b.allyGuardReport));
  mate.addStatus(DESTRUCT, owner.id, 1, 5);
  mate.hp = 0; mate.hpZero = true;
  await b.resolveLethal(mate, foe.id);
  ok("★★★ 拦死真的生效：队友留下 1 点生命（第 133 轮之前这条路径上它直接死）",
    mate.dead === false && mate.hp === 1, JSON.stringify({ dead: mate.dead, hp: mate.hp }));
  // 御魂：跑到回合结束即可叠一层（无刀取 = TURN_END）
  const before = stackCount(b, 1);
  await b.runPartial(b.turn + 25);   // 无刀取挂在 TURN_END 上 ⇒ 要等那个单位真的行动过（实测第 8 回合叠到第 1 层）
  ok("★★ 御魂的层数 ramp 在 Node 路径上也开始叠了", stackCount(b, 1) > before, JSON.stringify({ before, after: stackCount(b, 1) }));
}

sec("[4] ★★ 反向哨兵：故意让一条路径少给知识库 ⇒ 比对必须红（证明这个比对照得出差别）");
{
  const m: any = webMatch();
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 20261303, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  const b2: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 20261303, passives: PASSIVES, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  b2.battle.bus.unregisterOwner; // 占位：不改动，下面用「手工清掉御魂处理器」来模拟少装一套
  b2.battle.bus.handlers = b2.battle.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => h.source !== "SOUL");
  ok("★★★ 少装一套御魂时订阅集合**确实不同**（所以第 [1] 节的比对不是平凡通过）",
    JSON.stringify(ids(a.battle)) !== JSON.stringify(ids(b2.battle)),
    JSON.stringify({ 全: ids(a.battle), 少御魂: ids(b2.battle) }));
}

sec("[5] ★★ 默认档（被动 OFF、无御魂）两条路径都注册 0 个订阅 —— 默认路径逐位不变");
{
  const plain: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FIXTURE));
  const n: any = await assembleGuessingMatch(plain, { seed: 20261001, maxTurns: 300 });
  const w: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 20261001 });
  ok("★★★ Node 侧：默认夹具 + 默认策略 ⇒ 0 个订阅", ids(n.battle).length === 0, JSON.stringify(ids(n.battle)));
  ok("★★★ 网页侧：同上 ⇒ 0 个订阅", ids(w.battle).length === 0, JSON.stringify(ids(w.battle)));
}

console.log("\ng87-two-path-parity: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed");
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g88-skill-swap.ts`

```ts
// tests/g88-skill-swap.ts — ★★★ 第 134 轮：**「技能替换」这一族第一次有了具名的缺口**
//
// 由来：全库 33 条子句写着「…技能替换为『X』」（姿态 / 状态 / 场上条件触发），而引擎里
//   **没有任何"换技能表"的入口** —— 一个单位的技能表在装配时就定死（Entity.skills），
//   选招只在这张表里挑。可此前这 33 条的账是**分裂**的：
//     · 一部分被逐句分类判成 MECHANIC_UNPARSED，但**没有一条具名的缺口**（说不清缺的是什么机制）；
//     · 另一部分干脆是 PARSED（"完整编译"）—— 报表比代码乐观，正是动词表存在的理由。
// 这一轮把动词表加上「替换」，缺口具名；本文件是它的双向验证与**行为面**钉子。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { splitClauses } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { findUnmodeled, UNMODELED } from "../compile/unmodeled.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(KB) ? KB : (KB.characters ?? KB.items ?? []);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
setTipsTable(loadTips(Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : (Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? []));

sec("[1] ★★★ 动词表新增「替换」：全库 33 条子句逐条具名");
{
  const entry = UNMODELED.find((e: any) => e.verb === "替换");
  ok("★★★ 动词表里有「替换」，且声明为 WARN（它改的是「接下来能放什么」）",
    !!entry && entry.severity === "WARN", JSON.stringify(entry && { verb: entry.verb, severity: entry.severity }));
  const found: Array<{ who: string; skill: string; clause: string }> = [];
  for (const s of LIST) for (const sk of (s.skills ?? [])) {
    const ir: any = compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk);
    for (const h of (ir.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).filter((x: any) => x.verb === "替换")) found.push({ who: s.name, skill: sk.name, clause: String(h.clause) });
  }
  ok("★★★ 全库恰好 33 条（量出来的，不是我挑的）", found.length === 33, String(found.length));
  ok("★★★ 每一条的子句里都真的有「替换」（没有一条是误伤）",
    found.every(x => /替换/.test(x.clause)), JSON.stringify(found.filter(x => !/替换/.test(x.clause))));
  // 抽查几条**形态完全不同**的写法都收进来了（姿态 / 状态 / 场上条件 / 普攻替换 / 敌方技能替换）
  for (const [who, skill] of [["不知火", "初舞"], ["灶门祢豆子", "腿踢"], ["跳跳妹妹", "汪汪出击"], ["般若", "鬼袭"], ["百目鬼", "诅咒之眼"]] as Array<[string, string]>) {
    ok("★★ 「" + who + "「" + skill + "」」在清单里", found.some(x => x.who === who && x.skill === skill));
  }
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 双向：真写法必须收，免疫声明必须不收");
{
  const yes = findUnmodeled("【施放】施放后将该技能替换为「春告」", splitClauses);
  ok("★★★ 真写法（施放后…替换为）⇒ 收", yes.some(h => h.verb === "替换"), JSON.stringify(yes.map(h => h.verb)));
  const yes2 = findUnmodeled("处于离殇姿态时，技能替换为『终舞』", splitClauses);
  ok("★★★ 另一种写法（姿态条件）⇒ 同样收", yes2.some(h => h.verb === "替换"), JSON.stringify(yes2.map(h => h.verb)));
  const no = findUnmodeled("该技能不可替换", splitClauses);
  ok("★★★ 免疫声明（不可替换）⇒ **必须不收**（否定语境规则）", !no.some(h => h.verb === "替换"), JSON.stringify(no.map(h => h.verb)));
  const no2 = findUnmodeled("此技能无法替换为其他技能", splitClauses);
  ok("★★★ 「无法替换」⇒ 同样不收", !no2.some(h => h.verb === "替换"), JSON.stringify(no2.map(h => h.verb)));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 句子分类也必须跟着改（「此前是 PARSED」的那些要变成 MECHANIC_UNPARSED）");
{
  const wasParsed: Array<[string, string]> = [["百目鬼", "诅咒之眼"], ["季", "弥天叶唳"], ["孔雀明王", "流羽风"], ["天逆每", "惧刃之风"], ["犬神", "守护"], ["闻人翊悬", "火拳"]];
  const bad: string[] = [];
  for (const [who, skill] of wasParsed) {
    const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === who)!;
    const sk = (s.skills ?? []).find((x: any) => x.name === skill)!;
    const ir: any = compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk);
    const hit = (ir.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).find((m: any) => m.verb === "替换")!;
    const sent = (ir.sentences ?? []).find((x: any) => x.text.includes(String(hit.clause).slice(0, 6)));
    if (!sent || sent.kind !== "MECHANIC_UNPARSED") bad.push(who + "「" + skill + "」→ " + (sent?.kind ?? "找不到那句"));
  }
  ok("★★★ 这六条此前被判成 PARSED 的，现在都是 MECHANIC_UNPARSED", bad.length === 0, JSON.stringify(bad));
}

sec("[4] ★★★ 行为面：引擎里确实没有换技能表的入口（技能表在整场战斗里不变）");
{
  const g = (p: string) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, p), "utf8");
  const assigners = ["battle-lab/compile/character.ts", "battle-lab/kernel/state.ts"]
    .filter(p => /\.skills\s*=/.test(g(p)));
  ok("★★ 只有装配与恢复两处会写 Entity.skills（没有第三处）",
    assigners.length === 2, JSON.stringify(assigners));

  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], name: "不知火", shikigamiId: LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === "不知火")!.id };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 134134, traceLevel: "SUMMARY" });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const e = a.battle.teams[0].members[0];
  const before = (e.skills ?? []).map((x: any) => x.name).join(",");
  await a.battle.run();
  const after = (e.skills ?? []).map((x: any) => x.name).join(",");
  ok("★★★ 「不知火」带着替换条款打了整场，技能表**一个名字都没变**（这就是未实现的直接证据）",
    before === after && before.length > 0, JSON.stringify({ before, after }));
}

console.log("\ng88-skill-swap: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed");
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);
```

```ts
// tests/g89-sub-cast.ts — ★★★ 第 135 轮：**触发式追加施放**接线 + 「先机」族接线
//
// 两件事共用一条判据链：**"这一句什么时候触发"与"触发时到底执行什么"必须各自有执行点**。
//   ① 「施放『X』」此前**没有任何执行入口**（技能执行点只有主动 execute 与伪回合）：
//      第 129 轮只把与复活同句的那一条记成了账（追加施放 / WARN）。这一轮接上 ——
//      走 Battle.runPseudoTurn（与反击/协战同源），守卫也同源（不连锁 / 施放者活着 / 技能在表里 / 目标可复现）。
//   ② 「先机」= tips_7 定义的「在战斗开始时进行动作」：全库 7 条被动这么写，而「名字+时」的子串判据
//      永远匹配不到它们 ⇒ 这 7 条此前**一条都挂不上**（开局 +1 鬼火、开局 4 层印记全都不存在）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileSkill } from "../compile/skill-compiler.ts";
import { matchFamily } from "../kernel/triggers.ts";
import { loadTips, setTipsTable, resolveTips } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { castTriggeredSkill } from "../kernel/sub-cast.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const LIST: any[] = Array.isArray(KB) ? KB : (KB.characters ?? KB.items ?? []);
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
const tips = loadTips(Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : (Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]) ?? []);
setTipsTable(tips);
const irOf = (who: string, skill: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === who)!;
  const sk = (s.skills ?? []).find((x: any) => x.name === skill)!;
  return compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk);
};
const allIR = () => {
  const out: Array<{ who: string; skill: string; ir: any }> = [];
  for (const s of LIST) for (const sk of (s.skills ?? [])) out.push({ who: s.name, skill: sk.name, ir: compileSkill(s.id, s.name, sk) });
  return out;
};

sec("[1] ★★★ 编译：执行点恰好 1 条，仍未有执行点的 6 条**逐条具名**");
{
  const withCast = allIR().filter(x => (x.ir.subCasts ?? []).length);
  ok("★★★ 全库恰好 1 条触发式追加施放（九命猫「九命」→ skill_207_03，随机敌方目标）",
    withCast.length === 1 && withCast[0].ir.subCasts[0].ref === "207_03" && withCast[0].ir.subCasts[0].target === "ENEMY_RANDOM",
    JSON.stringify(withCast.map(x => x.who + "→" + x.ir.subCasts[0].ref + "/" + x.ir.subCasts[0].target)));
  const flagged = allIR().filter(x => (x.ir.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).some((m: any) => m.verb === "追加施放"));
  /** ★ 第 239 轮：百目鬼「鬼眸」接上了执行点（counterCast → 满层免消耗施放）⇒ 名单 6 → 5（见下面的反向断言） */
  const want = ["辉夜姬", "御馔津", "麓铭大岳丸", "梦寻山兔"];
  ok("★★★ 仍然没有执行点的 5 条全部具名（辉夜姬/御馔津×2/麓铭大岳丸/梦寻山兔）",

  ok("★★★ 反向：百目鬼「鬼眸」**不再**报 追加施放（第 239 轮它有了执行点：counterCast）",

    !!(irOf("百目鬼", "鬼眸") as any).counterCast,

  ok("★★★ 反向：九命猫**不再**报 追加施放（它有执行点了）",

    JSON.stringify((irOf("九命猫", "九命").unmodeledMechanics ?? []).map((m: any) => m.verb)));
  ok("★★ 那三条「不是施放」的写法没有被误记（消耗减少 / 施放前偷取 / 施放X时）",
    !flagged.some(x => x.who === "少羽大天狗" || x.who === "烬天玉藻前" || x.who === "歌留多" || x.who === "封阳君"),
    JSON.stringify(flagged.map(x => x.who)));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 「先机」族：7 条被动第一次能挂上（tips_7 = 在战斗开始时进行动作）");
{
  const senki: Array<{ who: string; skill: string; clause: string }> = [];
  for (const s of LIST) for (const k of (s.skills ?? [])) {
    /**
     * ★ 只数**被动**（cost < 0）—— 族表的 kbCount 口径就是被动里的写法（g42 用同一把尺子）。
     *   主动技能里也有 先机（御馔津「狐狩界」/书翁/化鲸/入内雀 等 4 条），那是"施放时同时也……"的写法，
     *   不属于触发族。第一版把两者混在一起数，得到 11 ⇒ 断言当场红（尺子口径写清楚了才不会再来一次）。
     */
    if ((Number(k.cost) || 0) >= 0) continue;
    for (const raw of String(k.description ?? "").split(/[。；]/)) {
      if (!/tips_7|先机/.test(raw)) continue;
      senki.push({ who: s.name, skill: k.name, clause: resolveTips(raw, tips).text });
    }
  }
  ok("★★★ 全库 7 条**被动**里的「先机」子句（量出来的；主动技能里另有 4 条，不算触发族）",
    senki.length === 7, JSON.stringify(senki.map(x => x.who + "「" + x.skill + "」")));
  const fam = senki.map(x => matchFamily(x.clause)?.family ?? null);
  ok("★★★ 而且**每一条**都归到「先机」族（判据认 [tips_7] 与 [先机] 两种形态）",
    fam.every(f => f === "先机"), JSON.stringify(fam));
  ok("★★ 族的事件码是 BATTLE_START（tips_7 原话「在战斗开始时进行动作」）",
    matchFamily("先机：获得1点鬼火")?.evCode === "BATTLE_START");
}

const unit = (name: string) => {
  const s = LIST.find((x: any) => x.name === name)!;
  return {
    unitId: "u-" + name, shikigamiId: s.id, name,
    stats: { attack: 3000, hp: 20000, defense: 400, speed: 150, critRate: 0, critDamage: 1.5, effectHit: 0, effectResist: 0 },
    soulId: null,
  };
};
const buffs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "buffs.json"), "utf8")) as any[];
async function arena(who: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY" = "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 135) {
  const { compileBuff, toStatusDef } = await import("../compile/buff-compiler.ts");
  const { StatusBook } = await import("../kernel/status.ts");
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = unit(who);
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const def = toStatusDef(compileBuff(buffs.find(b => String(b.id) === "2072_1")));
  if (!StatusBook.has(def.id)) StatusBook.set(def.id, def);
  return { b: a.battle, e: a.battle.teams[0].members[0], foe: a.battle.teams[1].members[0], NINE: def };
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 执行面（双向）：4 层 ⇒ 复活**并施放**；3 层 ⇒ 既不复活也不施放");

  const B = await arena("九命猫", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", 136);

{

  const keep = A.e.skills;

  const r = await castTriggeredSkill(A.b, A.e, { ref: "207_03", target: "RANDOM_ENEMY", clause: "探针" });
  A.e.skills = keep;

    JSON.stringify(r));

  /** ★ bus.within 的返回值是**事件序号**（不是回调结果）—— 结果要用外层变量接住（第一版正是这么写错的） */
  let chained: any = null;
  await A.b.bus.within("PSEUDO_TURN", { probe: true }, A.e.id, A.e.teamId, (id: number) => A.b.teamOf(id), async () => {
    chained = await castTriggeredSkill(A.b, A.e, { ref: "207_03", target: "RANDOM_ENEMY", clause: "探针" });
  });
  ok("★★★ 事件链祖先里已经有伪回合 ⇒ SUBCAST_SKIPPED / CHAINED（子施放不连锁，与反击同一条判据）",
    chained?.fired === false && chained?.reason === "CHAINED",

// ★★★ 第 237 轮：**免消耗施放**（free）—— 鬼火池不动，且不留假付费事件
{

    const ev = a.battle.trace.slice(t0);
    ok("★★★ 免消耗：施放真的发生了", r1.fired === true, JSON.stringify(r1));
    ok("★★★ 免消耗：**没有** ORB_PAY / ORB_COST（假的付费事件比不做更坏）",
      !ev.some((e: any) => e.t === "ORB_PAY") && !ev.some((e: any) => e.t === "ORB_COST"),
      JSON.stringify(ev.map((e: any) => e.t).slice(0, 12)));
    ok("★★★ 免消耗：鬼火池没有下降", a.battle.teams[0].orbs.current >= before, before + " → " + a.battle.teams[0].orbs.current);
  }
}
```

```ts
    pool.gauge === 1 % Math.max(1, size) && pool.cycle === (1 >= size ? 1 : 0), JSON.stringify(pool.snapshot()));

  const off: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 136, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" });
  await off.battle.runStartup();
  ok("★★★ 反向：OFF 档不装、也不推（默认路径逐位不变）",
    (off.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length === 0 &&
    !off.battle.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "ORB_GAUGE_ADVANCE_EXTRA"),
    JSON.stringify({ installed: (off.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length, gauge: off.battle.teams[0].orbs.gauge }));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 多次满格：推进 N 格必须循环调用（一次加 N 会漏掉中间的 cycle++）");
{
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), canonicalMatch(), { seed: 1, traceLevel: "FULL" });
  const pool = a.battle.teams[1].orbs;
  const size = pool.policy.gaugeSize;
  const before = { gauge: pool.gauge, cycle: pool.cycle };
  const filled = a.battle.advanceOrbGauge(1, size + 2, "PROBE");
  const expGauge = (before.gauge + size + 2) % size;
  const expCycle = before.cycle + Math.floor((before.gauge + size + 2) / size);
  ok("★★★ gauge / cycle 与逐格推进完全一致（size=" + size + "，推 " + (size + 2) + " 格）",
    pool.gauge === expGauge && pool.cycle === expCycle, JSON.stringify({ got: { g: pool.gauge, c: pool.cycle }, want: { g: expGauge, c: expCycle } }));
  ok("★★★ 满格次数如实返回（filled=" + filled + "）且记了 pendingReward",
    filled === Math.floor((before.gauge + size + 2) / size) && (filled === 0 || pool.pendingReward >= 0), String(filled));
}

sec("[4] ★★★ 花海：8 条子句记账，「点燃花海」那种修辞不收（双向）");
{
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 145 轮按事实改写：机制**接线并验证**之后（g93 23 条全绿），这一条从 WARN 降为 INFO ——
   *   动词表里保留它，是为了留下"当年缺什么"的可追溯说明，而不是继续主张它是缺口。
   */
  ok("★★★ 动词表里仍有「花海」（留档用），但严重度已降为 INFO", UNMODELED.some((e: any) => e.verb === "花海" && e.severity === "INFO"),
    JSON.stringify(UNMODELED.filter((e: any) => e.verb === "花海").map((e: any) => e.severity)));
  const hits = allIR().flatMap(x => (x.ir.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).filter((m: any) => m.verb === "花海").map((m: any) => ({ who: x.who, skill: x.skill, clause: String(m.clause) })));
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 145 轮按事实改写：8 条子句**全部放行**（逐子句收窄，判据是编译器真的解析出了产物）。
   *   两向仍在：下面那条"合成文本仍会被动词表抓到"证明闸门本身没被关掉 ——
   *   放行的是**编译产物覆盖到的真实子句**，不是"把这个动词从表里删掉"。
   */
  ok("★★★ 全库 0 条花海记录（8 条全部放行）", hits.length === 0, JSON.stringify({ total: hits.length, bySkill: [...new Set(hits.map(h => h.skill))] }));
  ok("★★ 每条都真的含「花海」两个字（没有误伤）", hits.every(h => /花海/.test(h.clause)), JSON.stringify(hits.filter(h => !/花海/.test(h.clause))));
  ok("★★★ 反向：荒骷髅「花吻烈魂」的「于战场上**点燃**花海」**不算缺口**（修辞用法，filterPattern 排除）",
    !hits.some(h => h.who === "荒骷髅") && !findUnmodeled("荒骷髅于战场上点燃花海，战斗开始时，使攻击最高的友方式神获得[buff_5852_1]", splitClauses).some(h => h.verb === "花海"),
    JSON.stringify(hits.map(h => h.who)));
  ok("★★ 而真正的机制句必须收（合成文本双向）",
    findUnmodeled("花海中的敌方，在回合开始时，每层花海对其造成攻击39%伤害", splitClauses).some(h => h.verb === "花海") &&
    findUnmodeled("回合开始时自动减少1层花海，最少不低于1层", splitClauses).some(h => h.verb === "花海"));
}

console.log("\ng90-orb-gauge: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed");
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g91-ir-dump.ts`

```ts
// tests/g91-ir-dump.ts — ★★★ 第 137 轮：把「只写不读的全量 IR 转储」变成**可被断言**的产物
//
// 由来：报告 §39.5（第 47 轮）的处置是「skill-ir.json 保持原样 —— 它是转储，不是检查」。
// 那条处置留了一个没兑现的前提：转储得是**当前**编译器的产物。第 137 轮实测它已经不是了 ——
// 转储里 288_03「血之花海」的 shield 仍是 `{"ratio":20,"base":"maxHp"}`，
// 而第 80 轮修好后的活产物是 `{"ratio":20,"base":"lostHp","evidence":"…已损失生命…"}`。
// 一份"没人比对"的文件与真相矛盾时，**不会报错**：读它的人只会得到与事实相反的结论。
//
// 所以这一轮：① 生成方式统一到生产环境（compileAll，装 tips 表）；② 把"转储 == 生产产物"
// 做成断言，并且按项目纪律配**正向对照**（改一个字节必须红）—— 否则这条断言可能根本没在工作。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";
import { compareDump, dumpKey } from "../tools/ir-dump.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const DUMP = path.join(root, "battle-lab", "fixtures", "skill-ir.json");

const dump: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DUMP, "utf8"));
const { input } = compileAll(path.join(root, "data", "kb"));

sec("[1] 转储的形状：它得是一份**能对得上键**的全量转储");
{
  ok("★ 转储是数组", Array.isArray(dump), typeof dump);
  ok("★★ 条数与生产产物一致（" + input.skills.length + "）", dump.length === input.skills.length, String(dump.length));
  const keys = dump.map(dumpKey);
  ok("★★★ 键唯一（重复键会让后一条覆盖前一条，把真差异藏起来）",
    new Set(keys).size === keys.length, keys.length - new Set(keys).size + " 个重复");
  ok("★ 每条都能反推出 charId/id（键不是空壳）",
    dump.every((ir: any) => ir && ir.charId !== undefined && ir.id), JSON.stringify(dump.find((ir: any) => !ir?.id) ?? null));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 转储 == 生产产物（这一条就是本轮补的那张网）");
{
  const d = compareDump(dump, input.skills);
  ok("★★★ 逐字节相同 " + d.same + "/" + input.skills.length,
    d.same === input.skills.length && d.diff.length === 0 && d.missing.length === 0 && d.extra.length === 0 && d.dupInDump.length === 0,
    JSON.stringify({ diff: d.diff.slice(0, 3), missing: d.missing.slice(0, 3), extra: d.extra.slice(0, 3), dup: d.dupInDump.slice(0, 3) }));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 正向对照：这张网不是空的（改一个字节必须红）");
{
  /**
   * ① 改**值**（不碰键）。
   *   ★ 这条对照被写错过两次，两次都红：
   *     · 第一次 `replace(/\d/, "7")` —— 第 0 条 JSON 的首个数字本来就是 7 ⇒ 改了个寂寞；
   *     · 第二次 `replace(/\d/, 换成别的数字)` —— 文本里第一个数字落在 **"id"** 上 ⇒ **键跟着变**，
   *       于是 compareDump 报的是「缺一条 + 多一条」（diff 是空的），而不是「同一条不同」。
   *   两次都是**断言写错**，不是代码错。现在把这两件事都显式断言下来：
   *   对照必须"改了值、没改键"；改键的语义（键是身份）由 ①b 单独钉。
   */
  const mutated = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dump));
  const m0 = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dump[0]));
  m0.name = String(m0.name) + "X";
  mutated[0] = m0;
  ok("★★ 对照自身：改了内容、**没动键**（否则下面那条测的是另一回事）",
    JSON.stringify(mutated[0]) !== JSON.stringify(dump[0]) && dumpKey(mutated[0]) === dumpKey(dump[0]),
    dumpKey(dump[0]));
  const m1 = compareDump(mutated, input.skills);
  ok("★★★ 只改一条的值 → 恰好报 1 条不同（并把 same 也一起钉住，防止「少算一条」被当成通过）",
    m1.diff.length === 1 && m1.same === input.skills.length - 1 && m1.missing.length === 0 && m1.extra.length === 0 && m1.dupInDump.length === 0,
    JSON.stringify({ diff: m1.diff, same: m1.same, missing: m1.missing.length, extra: m1.extra.length }));

  // ①b 改**键**：键是身份，不是内容 ⇒ 应当报「缺 1 + 多 1」，而不是「同一条不同」
  const rekey = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dump));
  rekey[0] = { ...rekey[0], id: String(rekey[0].id) + "X" };
  const m1b = compareDump(rekey, input.skills);
  ok("★★ 改键 ⇒ 报「缺 1 + 多 1」（这正是上面第二次写错时踩到的那条路径）",
    m1b.missing.length === 1 && m1b.extra.length === 1 && m1b.diff.length === 0,
    JSON.stringify({ missing: m1b.missing, extra: m1b.extra, diff: m1b.diff.length }));

  // ② 少一条：必须报"缺"，不能因为剩下的都对就判绿
  const m2 = compareDump(dump.slice(1), input.skills);
  ok("★★★ 少一条 → 报 1 条缺失（不许当成「都还在」）", m2.missing.length === 1 && m2.same === input.skills.length - 1, JSON.stringify(m2.missing));

  // ③ 多一条：也要报
  const m3 = compareDump([...dump, { charId: 99999, id: "99999_01" }], input.skills);
  ok("★★ 多一条 → 报 1 条多余", m3.extra.length === 1, JSON.stringify(m3.extra));

  // ④ 重复键：后一条会覆盖前一条 —— 只有查重才能抓到
  const dupDump = [...dump, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dump[0]))];
  const m4 = compareDump(dupDump, input.skills);
  ok("★★★ 重复键被查出来（否则「覆盖」会把差异藏起来）", m4.dupInDump.length === 1, JSON.stringify(m4.dupInDump));
}

sec("[4] ★★★ 本轮找到的那处具体矛盾：已损失生命的护盾在**转储里也必须是对的**");
{
  const pick = (id: string) => dump.find((ir: any) => ir.id === id);
  const a = pick("288_03"), b = pick("427_02");
  ok("★★★ 彼岸花「血之花海」：20% 已损失生命 ⇒ base=lostHp（第 80 轮修的那个 bug，转储里也得是修好的值）",
    a?.shield?.[0]?.base === "lostHp" && a?.shield?.[0]?.ratio === 20, JSON.stringify(a?.shield));
  ok("★★★ 彼岸花呱「呱·血之花海」：2% 已损失生命 ⇒ 同样 base=lostHp", b?.shield?.[0]?.base === "lostHp", JSON.stringify(b?.shield));
  ok("★ 反向：全库仍然只有 2 条 lostHp 护盾（不是「全都变成了 lostHp」这种放水）",
    dump.filter((ir: any) => (ir.shield ?? []).some((s: any) => s.base === "lostHp")).length === 2,
    String(dump.filter((ir: any) => (ir.shield ?? []).some((s: any) => s.base === "lostHp")).length));
}

sec("[5] ★★ 生成器自检过：report.ts 写完就比对（同一条判据，两个入口）");
{
  // report.ts 里的自检与这里的 [2] 用的是同一个 compareDump，这里只钉住"它确实被调用了"这件事
  // —— 判据是 compile/report.ts 的源码里出现 compareDump（改回"只写不比对"会让这条红）。
  //   ★ 判据必须**去掉注释行**再找：report.ts 的头部注释里就写着 `compileSkill(id, name, sk)`
  //     （第一版直接在原文上找 ⇒ 被自己的注释判红，又是一条"断言写错"）。
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "battle-lab", "compile", "report.ts"), "utf8")
    .split("\n").filter((l: string) => !l.trim().startsWith("//") && !l.trim().startsWith("*") && !l.trim().startsWith("/*")).join("\n");
  ok("★★★ compile/report.ts 写完转储后调用 compareDump 自检（不许退回「只写不读」）",
    /compareDump\s*\(/.test(src) && /process\.exitCode\s*=\s*1/.test(src), "report.ts 里没找到自检调用");
  ok("★★ 而且它走的是**生产环境**（compileAll，含 tips 表）—— 不是自己再编一遍",
    /compileAll\s*\(/.test(src) && !/compileSkill\s*\(/.test(src), "report.ts 仍在直接调 compileSkill");
}

console.log("\n=== 全量 IR 转储的一致性: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g92-skill-fidelity.ts`

```ts
// tests/g92-skill-fidelity.ts — ★★★ 第 138 轮：**逐技能**编译状态（目标 ① / ⑪：§33）
//
// 由来（第 137 轮审核的结论）：§33 要求「卡上按逐技能机制实现度 ● FULL / ◐ PARTIAL 并可展开」，
// 而 Fidelity 载荷里**只有 6 个聚合计数** —— 界面问不出「这一个技能是哪一档」。
// 补这一层时顺带发现旧计数**不是穷尽的**：「有跳过记录、但没有未解析句」的技能两个计数都不含它
// （实测：典型对局 30 个技能，旧口径 完整 22 + 部分 5 = 27 ≠ 30）。
//
// 这个测试盯三件事：① 四档判据逐条两向；② 计数与逐技能列表**同一次分类**（不可能对不上）；
// ③ 计数是穷尽的（四档之和 == 技能总数，不许再有「谁都不算」的技能）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { charInfo, createKit } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { assessFidelity, classifySkill, SKILL_CLASS_LABEL, SKILL_CLASS_MARK } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";
import type { FidelityUnitInput } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const kit = createKit(bundle);

/** 合成一个技能输入：只写与分档有关的那几个字段（其余按默认） */
const sk = (over: Partial<FidelityUnitInput["skills"][number]> = {}): FidelityUnitInput["skills"][number] => ({
  name: "测试技能", confidence: "HIGH", cost: 2,
  parsed: { damage: 1, heal: 0, shield: 0, timeline: 0, status: 0, orb: 0 },
  unparsedSentences: 0,
  ...over,
});
const empty = { damage: 0, heal: 0, shield: 0, timeline: 0, status: 0, orb: 0 };

sec("[1] ★★★ 四档判据逐条两向（合成输入，先把每条判据单独钉住）");
{
  ok("★★★ 有可执行数值 + 没有未解析句 + 没有跳过记录 ⇒ FULL", classifySkill(sk()) === "FULL", classifySkill(sk()));
  ok("★★★ 有未解析句 ⇒ PARTIAL（哪怕主效果已经可用）", classifySkill(sk({ unparsedSentences: 2 })) === "PARTIAL");
  ok("★★★ 有跳过记录、**没有**未解析句 ⇒ PARTIAL（这正是旧计数漏掉的那一类）",
    classifySkill(sk({ skips: [{ reason: "NOT_A_SUMMON_SPEC", evidence: "原文", kind: "PLACEMENT" }] })) === "PARTIAL");
  ok("★★★ 主动技能 + 没有任何可执行数值 ⇒ NONE（真缺口）", classifySkill(sk({ parsed: empty })) === "NONE");
  ok("★★★ 被动技能（cost<0）+ 没有可执行数值 ⇒ PASSIVE（已知边界，不是解析失败）",
    classifySkill(sk({ parsed: empty, cost: -1 })) === "PASSIVE");
  ok("★★ 两向：主动技能哪怕 cost=0 也不许被判成 PASSIVE", classifySkill(sk({ parsed: empty, cost: 0 })) === "NONE");
  ok("★★ 两向：被动技能**有**可执行数值时走正常分档（不因为 cost<0 就整条豁免）", classifySkill(sk({ cost: -1 })) === "FULL");
  ok("★★★ 未建模机制**不参与分档**（它是另一件事：文本里有动词表里的词），但必须原样带出来",
    classifySkill(sk({ unmodeled: [{ verb: "花海", missing: "没有计数器" }] })) === "FULL");
  ok("★★ 可执行数值只看六类成分：任意一类非 0 就算有（不是只看伤害）",
    ["damage", "heal", "shield", "timeline", "status", "orb"].every(k =>
      classifySkill(sk({ parsed: { ...empty, [k]: 1 } as any })) === "FULL"));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 穷尽性：四档之和必须等于技能总数（不许再有「谁都不算」的技能）");
{
  const all = [sk(), sk({ unparsedSentences: 1 }), sk({ parsed: empty }), sk({ parsed: empty, cost: -1 }),
    sk({ skips: [{ reason: "R", evidence: "e", kind: "STEAL" }] })];
  const tally = ("FULL|PARTIAL|PASSIVE|NONE".split("|") as any[]).map(k => all.filter(s => classifySkill(s) === k).length);
  ok("★★★ 四档计数相加 == 输入条数", tally.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) === all.length, JSON.stringify(tally));
  ok("★★★ 每一条**恰好**落一档（没有一条同时落两档 —— 判据是互斥的）",
    all.every(s => ["FULL", "PARTIAL", "PASSIVE", "NONE"].filter(k => classifySkill(s) === k).length === 1));
  ok("★★ 记号与标签四档齐全（少了哪一档，界面就会显示 undefined）",
    ["FULL", "PARTIAL", "PASSIVE", "NONE"].every(k => !!SKILL_CLASS_MARK[k as any] && !!SKILL_CLASS_LABEL[k as any]),
    JSON.stringify([SKILL_CLASS_MARK, SKILL_CLASS_LABEL]));
  ok("★★★ 词汇里没有 % —— 真实性体系严禁百分比（这条是那个铁律在逐技能层的复述）",
    !JSON.stringify([SKILL_CLASS_MARK, SKILL_CLASS_LABEL]).includes("%"));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 真实阵容：逐技能列表与 SKILL 层计数是**同一次分类的两种视图**");
const CANON: Array<[string, number, "red" | "blue"]> = [
  ["三尾狐", 202, "red"], ["日和坊", 297, "red"], ["思金神", 601, "red"], ["跳跳弟弟", 225, "red"], ["聆海金鱼姬", 346, "red"],
  ["座敷童子", 205, "blue"], ["夜溟彼岸花", 358, "blue"], ["樱花妖", 267, "blue"], ["缚骨清姬", 352, "blue"], ["神启荒", 390, "blue"],
];
const units: FidelityUnitInput[] = CANON.map(([name, id, side]) => {
  const info = charInfo(kit, id);
  return {
    name, side, panelFilled: 4, soul: null,
    skills: info.skillDetails.map((s: any) => ({ ...s, confidence: s.confidence })),
    ai: { dataPresent: true, compiled: true, confidence: info.aiConfidence, gameVerified: false },
  };
});
const rep = assessFidelity({ units, ruleset: [], capabilities: [], displayPrecision: "INTEGER_OBSERVED" });
{
  const layer = rep.layers.find(l => l.layer === "SKILL")!;
  const cnt = (re: RegExp) => Number((layer.counts.find(c => re.test(c.label))?.value) ?? NaN);
  const byClass = (k: string) => rep.skills.filter(s => s.klass === k).length;
  ok("★★ 前置：逐技能列表非空（否则下面全是平凡通过）", rep.skills.length >= 25, String(rep.skills.length));
  ok("★★★ 逐技能列表条数 == 「本局技能总数」", rep.skills.length === cnt(/本局技能总数/), rep.skills.length + " vs " + cnt(/本局技能总数/));
  ok("★★★ 四档各自的条数 == SKILL 层四个计数（**同一次分类**，不可能对不上）",
    byClass("FULL") === cnt(/完整编译/) && byClass("PARTIAL") === cnt(/部分编译/) && byClass("PASSIVE") === cnt(/被动技能/) && byClass("NONE") === cnt(/主动技能但无可执行数值/),
    JSON.stringify({ FULL: byClass("FULL"), PARTIAL: byClass("PARTIAL"), PASSIVE: byClass("PASSIVE"), NONE: byClass("NONE"), layer: layer.counts.map(c => c.label + "=" + c.value) }));
  ok("★★★ 「四档合计」这一行必须等于技能总数（穷尽性在**报告里**也看得见）",
    cnt(/四档合计/) === rep.skills.length && cnt(/四档合计/) === cnt(/本局技能总数/),
    cnt(/四档合计/) + " vs " + rep.skills.length);
  ok("★★ 今日实测：典型对局 30 个技能 ⇒ ●22 ◐6 ○2 ✕0",
    rep.skills.length === 30 && byClass("FULL") === 22 && byClass("PARTIAL") === 6 && byClass("PASSIVE") === 2 && byClass("NONE") === 0,
    JSON.stringify({ n: rep.skills.length, FULL: byClass("FULL"), PARTIAL: byClass("PARTIAL"), PASSIVE: byClass("PASSIVE"), NONE: byClass("NONE") }));
  /**
   * ★★★ 这条就是本轮那个发现：旧口径的两个计数**加起来不等于总数**。
   *   神启荒「星罗云布」有 1 条跳过记录、0 条未解析句 ⇒ 旧口径里它既不算完整、也不算部分。
   *   写上它，是为了让「计数变成穷尽的」这件事**有据可查**，而不是一句声明。
   */
  const rescued = rep.skills.filter(s => s.klass === "PARTIAL" && s.unparsed === 0 && s.skipped > 0);
  /**
   * ★★★ 第 252 轮**按事实改写**：第 234 轮这条断言用来证明「旧口径的两个计数加起来不等于总数」的那一条，
   *   正是神启荒「星罗云布」390_02（有跳过记录、0 条未解析句）。而第 252 轮给它补上了一条**记账**
   *   （缺口动词「次数读成了上限」：「触发6次星爆后幻境结束」被当成了"一次施放 6 段"）⇒ 它现在**有**未解析句，
   *   于是"被旧口径漏掉的那一类"当场**空了**。
   *   ★ 这正是那一轮想要的效果：典型对局里**不再有**技能同时满足「有跳过记录、却没有未解析句」。
   *   所以判据改成两条：① 集合为空；② 反向 —— 390_02 仍在且仍是 PARTIAL（跳过 1 + 未解析 ≥ 1），
   *   也就是"那一类是被**记账**关掉的，不是被改判/被隐藏的"。
   */
  ok("★★★ 第 252 轮起：典型对局里**没有**「有跳过记录、却 0 条未解析句」的技能（旧口径漏掉的那一类已经空了）",
    rescued.length === 0, JSON.stringify(rescued.map(s => s.unit + "「" + s.name + "」skipped=" + s.skipped)));
  const xly: any = rep.skills.find(s => s.name === "星罗云布");
  ok("★★★ 反向：神启荒「星罗云布」仍在，且仍是 PARTIAL（跳过 " + (xly?.skipped ?? "?") + " + 未解析 " + (xly?.unparsed ?? "?") + "）—— 那一类是被记账关掉的，不是被改判的",
    !!xly && xly.klass === "PARTIAL" && xly.skipped >= 1 && xly.unparsed >= 1,
    JSON.stringify(rep.skills.filter((s: any) => s.unit === "神启荒").map((s: any) => [s.name, s.klass, s.skipped, s.unparsed])));
  ok("★★ 反向：旧口径的「完整编译」计数一行都没动（22 == 内核里那个数）", byClass("FULL") === cnt(/完整编译/));
  ok("★★ 逐技能条目带得出未建模机制（动词名），且与「依赖未建模机制的技能」计数口径不冲突",
    rep.skills.some(s => s.unmodeled.length > 0) && rep.skills.filter(s => s.unmodeled.length > 0).length >= cnt(/依赖未建模机制/),
    JSON.stringify(rep.skills.filter(s => s.unmodeled.length > 0).map(s => s.unit + "「" + s.name + "」" + s.unmodeled.join("/"))));
  ok("★★ 每个技能条目都归得上单位与边（界面按 side + 名字取数，缺一个界面上就会串到别人身上）",
    rep.skills.every(s => !!s.unit && (s.side === "red" || s.side === "blue") && !!s.name));
  ok("★★★ 整份报告里仍然没有任何 % 字符（第 49 轮那条铁律不能因为多了一层就破）",
    !JSON.stringify(rep).includes("%"));
}

sec("[4] ★★ 边界：没有单位 / 单位没有技能时不许崩，也不许报出假的档位");
{
  const r0 = assessFidelity({ units: [], ruleset: [], capabilities: [], displayPrecision: "EXACT" });
  ok("★ 空输入 ⇒ 逐技能列表为空（不是 undefined）", Array.isArray(r0.skills) && r0.skills.length === 0, JSON.stringify(r0.skills));
  ok("★ 空输入 ⇒ SKILL 层仍是 UNKNOWN（不被这一层改动带偏）", r0.layers.find(l => l.layer === "SKILL")!.klass === "UNKNOWN");
  const r1 = assessFidelity({
    units: [{ name: "甲", side: "red", panelFilled: 4, soul: null, skills: [], ai: { dataPresent: false, compiled: false, confidence: "LOW", gameVerified: false } }],
    ruleset: [], capabilities: [], displayPrecision: "EXACT",
  });
  ok("★ 单位没有技能 ⇒ 四档计数全 0，且合计 == 总数 == 0（不出现负数或 NaN）",

}

console.log("\n=== 逐技能编译状态（§33）: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g93-layer-field.ts — ★★★ 第 142 轮：叠层场地（花海）的行为验收（目标 ①/⑨）

//   LAYER_FIELD_DECAY 与 LAYER_FIELD_DAMAGE 都是 0 条，而注册本身看起来是成功的。

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { TurnType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { bandOf, layerCap, layersOf, layerFieldActive, syncBands } from "../kernel/layer-field.ts";
import { captureState, stateHash } from "../kernel/state.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const BASE = "2d7c7507e18db61f";

function match() { const m: any = canonicalMatch(); m.red.units[0].shikigamiId = 288; m.red.units[0].name = "彼岸花"; return m; }
async function mk(passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261002) {
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), match(), { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const owner = a.battle.teams[0].members[0];
  const sk = (owner.skills ?? []).find((s: any) => s?.ir?.layerField);
  return { a, owner, spec: sk?.ir?.layerField, foe: a.battle.teams[1].members[0] };
}
const traceOf = (a: any, t: string) => a.battle.trace.filter((x: any) => x.t === t);

sec("[1] ★★★ 反向先立：默认档（被动 OFF）一条都不许发生");

    ["LAYER_FIELD_SET", "LAYER_FIELD_GRANT", "LAYER_FIELD_DECAY", "LAYER_FIELD_DAMAGE"].every(t => traceOf(a, t).length === 0),
```

```ts
// tests/g94-summon-hook-install.ts — ★★★ 第 147 轮：**召唤物钩子的安装点收口**（目标 ⑨：Summon Runtime）
//
// 由来（报告里挂了很久的那一条）：「召唤物钩子 still has two install points」。
//   handler 不进存档，所以新建与恢复两条路径都必须装 —— 但**两处各写一遍**迟早会分叉：
//   分叉的表现是「恢复之后的战斗里那条光环静默消失」，而且不会报错。
// 第 113 轮起两条路径都调**同一个** installSummonHooks（且幂等）；这个文件把这件事钉成可执行事实：
//   · 安装点确实只有两处调用、且都走那个导出函数（没有第三条手写 bus.register 的路）；
//   · 新建的召唤物与**恢复后**的召唤物，订阅集合逐项一致（跨路径 parity）；
//   · 幂等：重复安装不新增；
//   · 反向：没有反应式光环的召唤物一条钩子都不装（不是「每个召唤物都挂一条」）。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch, runtimeFor, attachRuntime } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { TurnType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { captureState, restoreBattle } from "../kernel/state.ts";
import { installSummonHooks } from "../kernel/summon.ts";
import { setTipsTable, loadTips } from "../compile/tips.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const tipsRaw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "tips.json"), "utf8"));
const tips: any[] = Array.isArray(tipsRaw) ? tipsRaw : (Object.values(tipsRaw).find((v: any) => Array.isArray(v)) as any[]);
setTipsTable(loadTips(tips));

const walk = (d: string, acc: string[] = []): string[] => {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(d, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) { if (!/node_modules|\.git|fixtures/.test(p)) walk(p, acc); }
    else if (/\.(ts)$/.test(e.name) && !/tests[\\/]/.test(p)) acc.push(p);
  }
  return acc;
};

sec("[1] ★★★ 安装点唯一：两条路径都走同一个导出函数，没有第三条手写注册的路");
{
  const files = [...walk(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab")), ...walk(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src"))];
  const callers: string[] = [];
  let handRolled = 0;
  for (const f of files) {
    const src = fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8");
    const code = src.split("\n").filter(l => !l.trim().startsWith("//") && !l.trim().startsWith("*") && !l.trim().startsWith("/*")).join("\n");
    if (/installSummonHooks\s*\(/.test(code) && !/export function installSummonHooks/.test(code)) callers.push(path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, "/"));
    if (/bus\.register/.test(code) && /summon:/.test(code) && !f.endsWith("summon.ts")) handRolled++;
  }
  ok("★★★ 调用点恰好两处：addSummon（新建）与 restoreBattle（恢复）",
    callers.length === 2 && callers.some(c => c.endsWith("kernel/battle.ts")) && callers.some(c => c.endsWith("kernel/state.ts")),
    JSON.stringify(callers));
  ok("★★★ 没有第三条手写注册召唤物钩子的路（否则那条路上的召唤物会静默无光环）", handRolled === 0, String(handRolled));
  ok("★★ 而且它是从 kernel/summon.ts 导出的（两条路径读同一份实现）",
    /export function installSummonHooks/.test(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "battle-lab", "kernel", "summon.ts"), "utf8")));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 跨路径 parity：新建的与恢复后的召唤物，订阅集合逐项一致");
{
  const mk = async (name: string, seed: number) => {
    const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
    const m = canonicalMatch();
    m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
    const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed });
    await a.battle.runStartup();
    return a;
  };
  const A: any = await mk("千姬", 20261801);
  const qj = A.battle.teams[0].members[0];
  A.battle.teams[0].orbs.orb = 8;
  await A.battle.runPseudoTurn(qj, TurnType.PSEUDO_TURN, { skill: qj.skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "海潮入梦"), target: A.battle.teams[1].members[0] });
  const lamp = A.battle.teams[0].summons[0];
  ok("★ 前置：海原贝戟上场了（否则下面全是平凡通过）", !!lamp && lamp.notes.some((n: string) => n.startsWith("summon:reactive-heal=")),
    JSON.stringify(lamp?.notes ?? []));
  const idsOf = (b: any) => b.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => String(h.id).startsWith("summon:")).map((h: any) => h.id).sort();
  const fresh = idsOf(A.battle);
  ok("★★ 新建路径装上了钩子（≥1 条，且 id 带 summon: 前缀）", fresh.length >= 1, JSON.stringify(fresh));
  const k2 = createKit(bundle);
  const B: any = restoreBattle(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(captureState(A.battle))), { kit: k2, makeRuntime: (id: number) => runtimeFor(k2, id), attachRuntime });
  const restored = idsOf(B);
  ok("★★★ 恢复后的订阅集合与新建时**逐项相同**（少一条就是「恢复之后光环消失」）",
    JSON.stringify(fresh) === JSON.stringify(restored), JSON.stringify({ fresh, restored }));
  ok("★★★ 比例判据也在（notes 是判据来源，恢复后读得到同一个值）",
    B.teams[0].summons[0].notes.some((n: string) => n === "summon:reactive-heal=0.3"),
    JSON.stringify(B.teams[0].summons[0].notes.filter((n: string) => n.includes("reactive"))));
  const n0 = B.bus.handlers.length;
  installSummonHooks(B, B.teams[0].summons[0]);
  ok("★★★ 幂等：对同一场再装一次，订阅总数不变（重复注册会让反应式回血治两次）",
    B.bus.handlers.length === n0, n0 + " → " + B.bus.handlers.length);
}

sec("[3] ★★ 反向：没有反应式光环的召唤物，一条钩子都不装");
{
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === "慧明灯");
  const m = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name: "慧明灯" };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed: 20261802 });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  const hm = a.battle.teams[0].members[0];
  a.battle.teams[0].orbs.orb = 8;
  const before = a.battle.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => String(h.id).startsWith("summon:")).length;
  await a.battle.runPseudoTurn(hm, TurnType.PSEUDO_TURN, { skill: hm.skills.find((s: any) => s.name === "正念"), target: a.battle.teams[1].members[0] });
  const after = a.battle.bus.handlers.filter((h: any) => String(h.id).startsWith("summon:")).length;
  ok("★★ 明识灯（只有移除代价、没有反应式光环）⇒ 不新增订阅", after === before, before + " → " + after);
  ok("★★ 但它的移除代价判据照样写在 notes 里（两件事分开）",
    a.battle.teams[0].summons[0]?.notes.some((n: string) => n.startsWith("summon:on-remove-orbs=")) === true,
    JSON.stringify(a.battle.teams[0].summons[0]?.notes ?? []));
}

console.log("\n=== 召唤物钩子安装点: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// 探针（tools/_probe-senki159.ts）实测：被施放的两个技能 **IR 里已经带着 field**。

//   一旦这两条的形状悄悄变了（比如谁把 field 解析改了），计划就失效而没人知道。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";

  ok("★★ 御馔津「狐狩界」：有一条「[tips_7]：施放『狐狩界』」的记账",
```

```ts
// tests/g96-senki-field.ts — ★★★ 第 164 轮：**先机 → 结界**（规格见报告 §136，形状见 §137）
// 两向：被动档下战斗开始真的展开结界；默认档（被动 OFF）一条都不发生。
//
// ★★★ 本轮实测的边界（如实记下，不写成断言）：
//   · 辉夜姬「火鼠裘」✅ 端到端跑通（先机施放 280_03 → 幻境展开）；
//   · 御馔津「狐狩界」❌ 那条先机**写在一个 cost=3 的主动技能里**（304_02 自己），
//     而装配点是**被动运行时**（只收 cost<0）⇒ 它被那道 cost 闸门按设计挡住，永远不会装。
//     ⇒ 这不是「再写一行」能解决的：它要一个明确决定 —— 主动技能里的先机，装配点放哪？
//       候选是 compile/character.ts 的装配路径（但那时要不要受「被动 OFF」策略管？按第 140/145 轮的规矩，
//       机制类的东西默认档不装，且要在报告里说清）。在此之前**保持 fail-closed**（什么都不发生，继续按 WARN 记账）。
//   · 第 [1] 节只断言已经跑通的那一半；第 [3] 节把「御馔津那条写在主动技能里」这个事实钉住，
//     免得下一轮误以为它已经接好了。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261010) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}
const tr = (a: any, t: string) => a.battle.trace.filter((x: any) => x.t === t);

sec("[1] ★★★ 被动档：辉夜姬那条先机端到端跑通");
{
  const a = await mk("辉夜姬", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY");
  ok("★★★ 「火鼠裘」先机施放了『龙首之玉』（ref=280_03）", tr(a, "SUBCAST").some((x: any) => x.ref === "280_03"),
    JSON.stringify(tr(a, "SUBCAST").map((x: any) => x.ref)));
  ok("★★★ 而且真的展开了幻境（FIELD_ENTER）", tr(a, "FIELD_ENTER").length >= 1, JSON.stringify(tr(a, "FIELD_ENTER").map((x: any) => x.name)));
  ok("★★ 施放选到了真实目标（不是 NO_TARGET 跳过）", tr(a, "SUBCAST_SKIPPED").every((x: any) => x.reason !== "NO_TARGET"),
    JSON.stringify(tr(a, "SUBCAST_SKIPPED").map((x: any) => x.reason)));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 反向：默认档（被动 OFF）一条都不发生");
{
  const a = await mk("辉夜姬", "NOT_EXECUTED");
  ok("★★★ 默认档没有 SUBCAST 痕迹", tr(a, "SUBCAST").length === 0, JSON.stringify(tr(a, "SUBCAST").map((x: any) => x.ref)));
  ok("★★ 也没有因为这条先机而展开任何场地", tr(a, "FIELD_ENTER").length === 0, JSON.stringify(tr(a, "FIELD_ENTER").map((x: any) => x.name)));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 第 172 轮：**写在主动技能里的先机**也接上了（安装点挪到 cost 闸门之前）");
{
  const { input } = compileAll(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb"));
  const at = (k: string) => JSON.parse((input.skills as any[]).find(e => e.key === k)!.json);
  ok("★★ 两条先机形状相同、归属不同：280_02 是被动（cost<0）、304_02 是主动（cost=3）",
    at("280/280_02").cost < 0 && at("304/304_02").cost === 3,
    JSON.stringify([at("280/280_02").cost, at("304/304_02").cost]));
  ok("★★ 两条都写着 [tips_7] 先机施放（判据同源）",
    [at("304/304_02"), at("280/280_02")].every(ir => (ir.unmodeledMechanics ?? []).some((m: any) => /\[tips_7\]/.test(String(m.clause)))));
  const b = await mk("御馔津", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", 20261011);
  ok("★★★ 御馔津「狐狩界」的先机现在**真的会施放**（ref=304_02）",
    tr(b, "SUBCAST").some((x: any) => x.ref === "304_02"), JSON.stringify(tr(b, "SUBCAST").map((x: any) => x.ref)));
  ok("★★★ 而且结界展开了（FIELD_ENTER）", tr(b, "FIELD_ENTER").length >= 1, JSON.stringify(tr(b, "FIELD_ENTER").map((x: any) => x.name)));
  const off2 = await mk("御馔津", "NOT_EXECUTED", 20261011);
  ok("★★★ 但默认档（被动 OFF）仍然一条都不发生 —— 这条路径跟着「机制类默认不装」的口径走",
    tr(off2, "SUBCAST").length === 0 && tr(off2, "FIELD_ENTER").length === 0,
    JSON.stringify([tr(off2, "SUBCAST").length, tr(off2, "FIELD_ENTER").length]));
}

console.log("\n=== 先机→结界: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/g97-senki-release.ts — ★★★ 第 174 轮：**先机子句的报表放行**（正反五个方向）
//
// 背景：第 164–172 轮把「先机 → 施放『X』」接通了（被动运行时装 BATTLE_START 钩子 → kernel/sub-cast.ts），
//   但编译器的**句子分类**仍写着 MECHANIC_UNPARSED —— 编译器只看得到自己这一个技能，看不到「『X』有没有场地」。
//   于是报表比代码悲观：御馔津「狐狩界」在卡面上一直是 ◐ 部分编译，而它唯一没解析的那句正是**已经跑通**的先机。
// 本轮按引擎自己的产物放行，判据三条（引用解析得到 + 那条技能真带 field + 子句是 [tips_7] 施放），
//   任一条不满足 ⇒ 照旧记缺口。★ IR 不动：编译器"我没解析"与运行时"这句有执行点"两个事实都留着。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createKit, charInfo, senkiReleaseOf } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { classifySkill } from "../kernel/fidelity.ts";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const kit = createKit(bundle);
const { input } = compileAll(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb"));
const irOf = (key: string) => JSON.parse(String((input.skills as any[]).find((e: any) => String(e.key) === key)!.json));
const detailOf = (name: string, skillName: string) => {
  const c = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name)!;
  return charInfo(kit, c.id).skillDetails.find((d: any) => d.name === skillName)!;
};
const upSent = (ir: any) => (ir.sentences ?? []).filter((s: any) => s.kind === "MECHANIC_UNPARSED");

sec("[1] ★★★ 御馔津「狐狩界」（主动技能里的先机，第 172 轮接线）：报表跟着代码走");
{
  const ir = irOf("304/304_02");
  const d: any = detailOf("御馔津", "狐狩界");
  ok("★★ IR 里那句**仍然**是 MECHANIC_UNPARSED（编译器的保守事实不变）",
    upSent(ir).length === 1 && /\[tips_7\]/.test(upSent(ir)[0].text), JSON.stringify(upSent(ir).map((s: any) => s.text)));
  ok("★★★ 但报表里的未解析句数 1 → 0（放行生效）", d.unparsedSentences === 0, String(d.unparsedSentences));
  ok("★★★ 逐技能档位随之从 ◐ 部分编译变成 ● 完整编译", classifySkill(d) === "FULL", classifySkill(d));
  ok("★★ 依赖机制列表里不再挂着「追加施放」（那条已经跑通）",
    !d.unmodeled.some((m: any) => m.verb === "追加施放"), JSON.stringify(d.unmodeled.map((m: any) => m.verb)));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 辉夜姬「火鼠裘」：放行只放**先机那一句**，另外两句照旧算缺口（不许顺带放行）");
```

### `battle-lab/tests/g98-source-bearer-plan.ts`

```ts
// tests/g98-source-bearer-plan.ts — ★★★ 第 175 轮：**逐句承受者归属**（「对伤害来源附加…」）的前置事实
//
// 这是缺口清单里那条「逐句承受者归属（『对伤害来源附加…』）」的**尺子**：先问事实，再动手。
// 本文件**不实现任何行为**（不改 IR、不改运行时、不需要 census 说明），它只把三件事钉住：
//   [1] 族的规模与形状（全库逐句扫描：谁写着"来源"，分四种形状）；
//   [2] 今天的**运行时现状**（哪一种失败关闭、哪一种装上了但目标取的是技能级 targeting）；
//   [3] 「来源」在三个触发点上到底拿不拿得到（事件载荷实测）—— 这决定了下一轮能不能实现。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { DamageType, EV } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { matchFamily } from "../kernel/triggers.ts";
import { tipsTable, resolveTips } from "../compile/tips.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const tips = tipsTable();

/** 逐句扫全库：子句里写着「伤害来源 / 攻击者 / 攻击来源」的 */
interface Hit { who: string; sid: string; skill: string; cost: number; clause: string; family: string; code: string | null }
const hits: Hit[] = [];
for (const c of KB) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
  const raw = [String(sk.description ?? ""), ...((sk.tips ?? []) as any[]).map((t: any) => String(t?.text ?? t))].join(" ");
  const text = resolveTips(raw, tips).text;
  for (const clause of String(text).split(/[。；\n]/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => /伤害来源|攻击者|攻击来源/.test(s))) {
    const fam = matchFamily(clause);
    hits.push({ who: c.name, sid: String(sk.id), skill: sk.name, cost: Number(sk.cost ?? 0), clause, family: fam?.family ?? "无族", code: fam?.evCode ?? null });
  }
}
/** 四种形状：状态落到来源 / 反击来源 / 对来源施放技能 / 其他（提到来源但不是承受者） */
const SHAPES: Array<{ name: string; test: RegExp }> = [
  { name: "状态落到来源", test: /为(?:伤害来源|攻击来源|攻击者)(?:附加|施加|附上)|使(?:攻击来源|攻击者)/ },
  { name: "反击来源", test: /反击(?:伤害来源|攻击来源|攻击者)|对(?:伤害来源|攻击来源|攻击者)进行(?:一次)?反击|反击伤害来源/ },
  { name: "对来源施放技能", test: /对(?:伤害来源|减益来源)(?:无消耗)?施放/ },
  { name: "其他（提到来源但不是承受者）", test: /.*/ },
];
const shapeOf = (h: Hit) => SHAPES.find(s => s.test.test(h.clause))!.name;
const byShape = new Map<string, Hit[]>();
for (const h of hits) { const k = shapeOf(h); if (!byShape.has(k)) byShape.set(k, []); byShape.get(k)!.push(h); }
const ids = (k: string) => (byShape.get(k) ?? []).map(h => h.sid).sort().join(",");

sec("[1] ★★★ 族的规模与形状（全库逐句扫描，判据只用原文）");
{
  const skills = new Set(hits.map(h => h.who + "/" + h.sid));
  console.log("  形状分布：" + SHAPES.map(s => s.name + "×" + (byShape.get(s.name)?.length ?? 0)).join(" · "));
  for (const h of hits) console.log("      [" + shapeOf(h) + "|" + h.family + "→" + (h.code ?? "-") + "] " + h.who + " " + h.sid + " " + h.skill + " (cost=" + h.cost + ")：" + h.clause.slice(0, 70));
  ok("★★ 窄口径（伤害来源 / 攻击者 / 攻击来源）的技能数 = 17（任何变化都会在这里显形）", skills.size === 17, String(skills.size));
  /**
   * ★ 口径必须写清：还有 3 个技能写着**裸「来源」**（不是"伤害来源"三个字）——
   *   神乐&定春「守护必达」的「对来源进行反击」、纺愿缘结神「守缘刃」的「免疫来源于其他目标的行动条改变效果」、
   *   妙主九命猫「国王驾到」的「对减益来源施放速速护驾」。
   *   它们**不进**本族（一个是反击族的另一种写法、一个是否定式的免疫声明、一个是"减益来源"），
   *   但必须记下来 —— 不然下一轮按"来源"两个字做正则就会顺手把它们收进来。
   */
  const wideOnly = ["500/500_02", "554/554_02", "590/590_02"];
  const wide = new Set<string>();
  for (const c of KB) for (const sk of (c.skills ?? [])) {
    const raw = [String(sk.description ?? ""), ...((sk.tips ?? []) as any[]).map((t: any) => String(t?.text ?? t))].join(" ");
    if (/来源/.test(resolveTips(raw, tips).text)) wide.add(String(c.id) + "/" + String(sk.id));
  }
  const extra = [...wide].filter(k => !skills.has(k.split("/")[0] + "/" + k.split("/")[1]) && ![...skills].some(s => s.endsWith("/" + k.split("/")[1])));
  ok("★★ 宽口径（裸「来源」）比窄口径多出的 3 条，正是上面注里那三条",
    extra.length === 3 && wideOnly.every(k => [...wide].some(w => w.endsWith(k.split("/")[1]))), JSON.stringify(extra));
  ok("★★ 四种形状**穷尽**这条族（子句总数 = 四桶之和）",
    hits.length === SHAPES.reduce((s, x) => s + (byShape.get(x.name)?.length ?? 0), 0), String(hits.length));
  ok("★★★ 「状态落到来源」这一桶 = 9 条，与探针一致",
    (byShape.get("状态落到来源")?.length ?? 0) === 9, ids("状态落到来源"));
  ok("★★ 「反击来源」这一桶 = 3 条（反击族已有自己的 evidence 判据）",
    (byShape.get("反击来源")?.length ?? 0) === 3, ids("反击来源"));
  /**
   * ★ 事实（实测出来的，不是我原先以为的 5 条）：另外两条反击**没有点"来源"两个字**——
   *   萤草「生花」写的是「并**对其**进行反击」（其 = 伤害来源）、神乐&定春「守护必达」写的是「对来源进行反击」
   *   （裸"来源"，不在窄口径里）。所以"反击来源"这一族**不能只按字面**点名单，得按族 + evidence 判。
   */
  ok("★★ 萤草「生花」的「对其进行反击」落在「其他」桶里（代词指代，字面看不到「来源」二字）",
    (byShape.get("其他（提到来源但不是承受者）") ?? []).some(h => h.sid === "238_02" && /对其进行反击/.test(h.clause)),
    JSON.stringify((byShape.get("其他（提到来源但不是承受者）") ?? []).map(h => h.sid)));
  ok("★★ 「对来源施放技能」这一桶 = 1 条（大夜摩天阎魔 385_02，与第 135 轮的 sub-cast 入口同源）",
    (byShape.get("对来源施放技能")?.length ?? 0) === 1 && ids("对来源施放技能") === "385_02", ids("对来源施放技能"));
}

async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261012) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 运行时现状（★ 第 176 轮接线后**按事实改写**：这一节以前写的是「装都不装」）");
```

```ts
// tests/g99-source-bearer.ts — ★★★ 第 176 轮：**逐句承受者归属**（「对伤害来源 / 攻击者附加…」）
//
// 缺口清单里那条的第二步（接线）与第三步（验证）。第 175 轮的尺子（g98）已经钉住：
//   族 = 窄口径 17 个技能、「状态落到来源」9 条；现状是「一个少算（九命猫装都不装）+ 一个算错

//
// 本轮实现三处：① 编译期 SkillIR.sourceBearerRefs（逐句证据，fail-closed）
//   ② 执行侧 compile/character.ts 的 damageSourceOf（三个触发点各一条路径，取不到就不施加 + 留痕）
//   ③ 被动运行时放行第 129 轮那道「阵亡族 + 伤害来源」闸门（前提：这一句的每个 buff 引用都有来源证据）
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { DamageType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { createKit, assembleMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/engine/assemble.ts";
import { canonicalMatch } from "../../apps/web/src/mock/canonical-match.ts";
import { compileAll } from "../tools/compile-census.ts";

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, e = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  ✓ " + n); } else { fail++; console.log("  ✗ " + n + (e ? "  — " + e : "")); } };
const sec = (s: string) => console.log("\n" + s);
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..");
const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "apps", "web", "src", "engine", "bundle.json"), "utf8"));
const KB: any[] = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb", "shikigami.full.json"), "utf8"));
const { input } = compileAll(path.join(ROOT, "data", "kb"));
const irs = (input.skills as any[]).map((e: any) => ({ key: String(e.key), ir: JSON.parse(String(e.json)) }));
const irOf = (k: string) => irs.find(x => x.key === k)!.ir;

async function mk(name: string, passives: "NOT_EXECUTED" | "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY", seed = 20261013) {
  const s = KB.find((x: any) => x.name === name);
  const m: any = canonicalMatch();
  m.red.units[0] = { ...m.red.units[0], shikigamiId: s.id, name };
  const a: any = assembleMatch(createKit(bundle), m, { seed, passives });
  await a.battle.runStartup();
  return a;
}
const has = (e: any, id: string) => (e?.statuses ?? []).some((s: any) => String(s.def?.id ?? "") === id);

sec("[1] ★★★ 编译侧：逐句证据收进 IR（fail-closed：引用解析不出的不收）");
{
  const withField = irs.filter(x => (x.ir.sourceBearerRefs ?? []).length > 0);
  const keys = withField.map(x => x.key).sort();
  console.log("  名单：" + withField.map(x => x.key + "→" + x.ir.sourceBearerRefs.map((b: any) => b.ref).join(",")).join(" · "));
  ok("★★★ 带来源承受者证据的技能 = 8 条，且与探针名单逐条一致",
    keys.join(",") === "207/207_02,208/208_02,232/232_02,249/249_02,285/285_02,306/306_02,346/346_01,556/556_02", keys.join(","));
  ok("★★★ 每条证据都带**原句**（判错时要能一眼看出照哪句话判的）",
    withField.every(x => x.ir.sourceBearerRefs.every((b: any) => b.clause.length > 6 && /来源|攻击者/.test(b.clause))));
  ok("★★★ 反例：匣中少女「溢彩」写的是「为攻击者附加1个随机减益」—— 没有具体 buff 引用 ⇒ **一个字都不写**",
    !(irOf("287/287_02").sourceBearerRefs ?? []).length && /随机减益|tips_201/.test(JSON.stringify(irOf("287/287_02").statusRefs ?? []) + String((KB.find((c: any) => c.id === 287)?.skills ?? []).find((s: any) => s.id === "287_02")?.description ?? "")));
  const statusSkills = irs.filter(x => (x.ir.statusRefs ?? []).length > 0).length;
  ok("★★ 而全库带状态引用的技能远多于此（" + statusSkills + " 条）—— 说明这条字段是**逐句窄口径**，不是「给所有状态引用加标记」",
    statusSkills > 100, String(statusSkills));
}

sec("[2] ★★★ 天照「无灭」：以前是「装上了但目标不对」，现在落在**攻击者**身上");
{
  const a = await mk("天照", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY");
  const b = a.battle;
  const all = b.allEntities();
  const self = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
  const foes = all.filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1);
  const attacker = foes[0];
  ok("前置：天照的被动装上了（受击族）", (b.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).some((x: any) => x.skill === "无灭"),
    JSON.stringify((b.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).map((x: any) => x.skill)));
  await b.damage(attacker, self, 100, DamageType.NORMAL, 1);
  ok("★★★ 状态落在**攻击者**身上", has(attacker, "5562_1"), JSON.stringify({ who: attacker.id, got: (attacker.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id) }));
  const wrong = foes.filter((e: any) => e.id !== attacker.id && has(e, "5562_1"));
  ok("★★★ 其他敌人一个都没拿到（旧的技能级 targeting 就是在这里算错的）", wrong.length === 0, JSON.stringify(wrong.map((e: any) => e.id)));
}

sec("[3] ★★★ 反例：被动档下拿不到来源 ⇒ **不施加**并留痕（主动施放这条技能就是这种情况）");
{
  const a = await mk("鸩", "PARSED_CANDIDATES_ONLY");
  const b = a.battle;
  const all = b.allEntities();
  const self = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
  const foe = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 1)!;
  const sk = (self.skills ?? []).find((s: any) => String(s.ir?.id ?? "") === "285_02");
  ok("前置：鸩装着 285_02「毒之华」，且它的状态引用带来源证据",
    !!sk && (sk.ir.sourceBearerRefs ?? []).length > 0, JSON.stringify(sk?.ir?.sourceBearerRefs ?? null));
  await sk.execute(b, self, foe);
  const skip = b.trace.find((t: any) => t.t === "STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED");
  ok("★★★ 主动施放（没有事件载荷）⇒ 留痕 STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED / NO_DAMAGE_SOURCE",
    skip?.ref === "2852_1" && skip?.reason === "NO_DAMAGE_SOURCE", JSON.stringify(skip));
  const foeStatuses = all.filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1)
    .map((e: any) => ({ id: e.id, got: (e.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id) }));
  ok("★★★ 而且**没有任何敌人**拿到 2852_1 —— 宁可少算，不许算错",
    foeStatuses.every((x: any) => !x.got.includes("2852_1")), JSON.stringify(foeStatuses));
}

sec("[4] ★★★ 反向：默认档（被动 OFF）**一个字都不变** —— 红区 E 的行为面钉子（指纹由 g43/g54/g78 守）");
{
  const a = await mk("天照", "NOT_EXECUTED");
  ok("★★ 默认档没有装任何被动处理器", (a.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length === 0,
    JSON.stringify((a.battle.passiveReport?.installed ?? []).length));
  ok("★★ 也没有任何 STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED 痕（那条路径根本没跑到）",
    !a.battle.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED"));

  /**
   * ★★★ 这一条是**红区 E** 的行为面钉子：默认档下，主动施放一条写着"来源子句"的技能，
   *   状态**照旧按技能级 targeting 施加**（与第 176 轮之前逐位相同）——
   *   第一版没有这道被动档闸门，实测指纹从 2d7c7507e18db61f 变成了 ebe69db360755da9，
   *   被 g43 / g54 / g78 三条断言当场照出来。
   */
  const b = await mk("鸩", "NOT_EXECUTED");
  const all = b.battle.allEntities();
  const self = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 0)!;
  const foe = all.find((e: any) => e.teamId === 1)!;
  const sk = (self.skills ?? []).find((s: any) => String(s.ir?.id ?? "") === "285_02");
  await sk.execute(b.battle, self, foe);
  ok("★★★ 默认档：**没有** STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED 痕（闸门没开）",
    !b.battle.trace.some((t: any) => t.t === "STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED"),
    JSON.stringify(b.battle.trace.filter((t: any) => t.t === "STATUS_BEARER_SKIPPED")));
  ok("★★★ 而且状态照旧落在技能级范围上（敌方拿到了 2852_1）—— 与接线前逐位相同",
    all.filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1).some((e: any) => has(e, "2852_1")),
    JSON.stringify(all.filter((e: any) => e.teamId === 1).map((e: any) => (e.statuses ?? []).map((s: any) => s.def?.id))));
}

console.log("\n=== 逐句承受者归属: " + pass + " passed, " + fail + " failed ===");
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

### `battle-lab/tests/guessing-canonical.ts`

```ts
// tests/guessing-canonical.ts — 典型对局 #001：竞猜路径端到端基准
import path from "node:path";
import { assembleGuessingMatch, loadMatchFixture } from "../soul/guessing-match.ts";
import { toDisplay } from "../kernel/stats.ts";
import { monteCarlo, formatResult } from "../runner/monte-carlo.ts";
import { EntityMode, StatSource, judgeLegality } from "../soul/stat-source.ts";

const FIX = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "fixtures", "guessing-match-canonical-001.json");
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, x = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  PASS " + n + (x ? "  " + x : "")); } else { fail++; console.log("  FAIL " + n + "  " + x); } };

console.log("=== 典型对局 #001（竞猜路径）===");
const fx = await loadMatchFixture(FIX);
ok("夹具已记录红蓝双方各 5 只", fx.red.length === 5 && fx.blue.length === 5);

// ★★★ 第 192 轮：**显式要 FULL** —— 下面第 ⑤ 节要看「产生了伤害事件」（读的是 trace），
//   而 assembleGuessingMatch 的默认档按 a1-4 §35 改成了 NONE（Monte Carlo 档）。
const { battle, red, blue, issues, displayTies } = await assembleGuessingMatch(fx, { seed: 20261001, maxTurns: 300, traceLevel: "FULL" });
const all = [...red, ...blue];

// ① 面板逐项回显（这是 Assembly 正确性的硬标准）
let mismatch = 0;
for (const b of all) {
  const disp = toDisplay(b.resolution.exact);
  const src: any = (fx.red.concat(fx.blue)).find((e: any) => e.name === b.entity.name)!;
  for (const k of ["atk", "hp", "def", "spd", "cri", "crid", "efh", "efr"] as const) {
    if (Math.abs(disp[k] - src.stats[k]) > 1e-9) { mismatch++; console.log(`     ✗ ${b.entity.name}.${k}: ${disp[k]} ≠ ${src.stats[k]}`); }
  }
}
ok("★ 10 只 × 8 维 = 80 个面板值全部逐项还原", mismatch === 0, `不一致 ${mismatch} 项`);

// ② 不变量
ok("★ 全部为 AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE 且未叠加御魂静态属性",
   all.every(b => b.resolution.source === StatSource.AUTHORITATIVE_OVERRIDE && b.resolution.soulStaticApplied === false));
ok("★ 全部保留可行区间（未坍缩为整数）",
   all.every(b => b.feasible.every(f => f.range[1] > f.range[0])));
ok("竞猜模式语义 = ACCEPT", all.every(b => b.resolution.legality === "ACCEPT"));

// ③ 技能 / AI 从 KB 自动 Join
ok("技能已从 KB 自动装载", all.every(b => b.entity.skills.length >= 1),
   `技能数 ${all.map(b => b.entity.skills.length).join("/")}`);

// ④ 显示层同速（精度陷阱）
console.log("     显示层同速:", displayTies.length ? JSON.stringify(displayTies) : "无");
ok("同速情形被显式识别（不静默）", Array.isArray(displayTies));

// ⑤ 跑通对局
const r = await battle.run();
ok("对局跑通", battle.turn > 0, `turns=${r.turns} winner=${r.winner} reason=${r.reason}`);
ok("产生了伤害事件", battle.trace.some((x: any) => x.t === "DAMAGE"), `damage=${battle.trace.filter((x: any) => x.t === "DAMAGE").length}`);

if (issues.length) { console.log("     装配期问题:"); for (const i of issues.slice(0, 12)) console.log("       - " + i); }

// ⑥ Monte Carlo（固定 seed 基准）
//   ★★ 第 192 轮：这一路**刻意不传 traceLevel** —— 它量的就是批量路径的默认档（§35 的 NONE）。
const mc = await monteCarlo(async (seed) => (await assembleGuessingMatch(fx, { seed, maxTurns: 300 })).battle, 60, { seedBase: 20261001 });
console.log("\n" + formatResult(mc, "典型对局 #001 · 红方 vs 蓝方（N=60）"));

ok("★ 同一夹具可重复装配并复现", true);
console.log(`\n=== 典型对局: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/guessing-rules.ts — 已确证规则的强制校验
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { Team } from "../kernel/team.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { StartupPolicies, DeathPolicies, GuessingRulesets } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { loadCharacter } from "../compile/load.ts";
import { RuleIndex, VERIFIED_RULES } from "../kernel/evidence.ts";
import { RuleViolation, validateGuessingLineups } from "../kernel/validate.ts";

const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, x = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  PASS " + n + (x ? "  " + x : "")); } else { fail++; console.log("  FAIL " + n + "  " + x); } };

console.log("=== 对弈竞猜规则校验 ===");

const rule = RuleIndex.get("GUESSING_NO_ONMYOJI")!;
ok("规则已登记且来源为 USER_CONFIRMED", rule.source === "USER_CONFIRMED");
ok("规则关闭了此前的待核实项", (rule.supersedes ?? []).length >= 4, `supersedes=${rule.supersedes!.length} 条`);
ok("证据表可枚举", VERIFIED_RULES.length >= 1);

const mk = async (ids: number[], kind: "shikigami" | "onmyoji", guessing: any) => {
  const t0 = new Team(0, "RED", R, 1), t1 = new Team(1, "BLUE", R, 1);
  t0.add((await loadCharacter(ids[0], 0, 1)).entity);
  t1.add((await loadCharacter(ids[1], 1, 101)).entity);
  return new Battle([t0, t1], { seed: 1, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 50 },
    policies: { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI,
      death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER",
      tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", guessing } });
};

// 纯式神 -> 允许
let okShiki = true;
try { await mk([236, 246], "shikigami", GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED); } catch { okShiki = false; }
ok("纯式神阵容在对弈竞猜 ruleset 下可构造", okShiki);

// 含阴阳师 -> 拒绝
let thrown: any = null;
try { await mk([10, 246], "onmyoji", GuessingRulesets.COMMUNITY_2020_UNVERIFIED); } catch (e) { thrown = e; }
ok("含阴阳师的阵容被拒绝", thrown instanceof RuleViolation, thrown ? String(thrown.message).split("\n")[0] : "未抛出");
ok("拒绝信息指明规则与出处", !!thrown && String(thrown.message).includes("GUESSING_NO_ONMYOJI") && String(thrown.message).includes("出处"));

// 显式研究 ruleset -> 放行
let okResearch = true;
try { await mk([10, 246], "onmyoji", GuessingRulesets.RESEARCH_WITH_ONMYOJI); } catch { okResearch = false; }
ok("显式研究 ruleset 下可构造（允许阴阳师）", okResearch);

// validate 可单独调用且不抛
const t0 = new Team(0, "R", R, 1);
t0.add((await loadCharacter(10, 0, 7)).entity);
const probs = validateGuessingLineups([t0], { enforce: false });
ok("非强制模式返回问题清单而不抛", probs.length === 1, probs[0]?.slice(0, 46));

console.log(`\n=== 规则校验: ${pass} passed, ${fail} failed ===`);
if (fail > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```ts
// tests/m0.ts — M0「空战场」验收：不加载任何真实式神数据
import { Battle, DEFAULT_RULES } from "../kernel/battle.ts";
import { DamageType } from "../kernel/types.ts";
import { ResourcePolicies } from "../kernel/resource.ts";
import { DeathPolicies, StartupPolicies } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { makeTeam, wireDummy } from "../dummy/dummy.ts";

const RES = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (name: string, cond: boolean, extra = "") => { if (cond) { pass++; console.log("  PASS " + name + (extra ? "  " + extra : "")); } else { fail++; console.log("  FAIL " + name + "  " + extra); } };

function build(seed: number, policies: any = {}) {
  const a = makeTeam(0, "RED", [
    { name: "R1", hp: 10000, atk: 1200, def: 300, spd: 120, skills: [{ name: "3技能", cost: 3, base: 1200, rate: 1.5, type: DamageType.NORMAL }] },
    { name: "R2", hp: 8000, atk: 900, def: 250, spd: 100, skills: [{ name: "普攻", cost: 0, base: 900, type: DamageType.NORMAL }] },
  ], RES, 0);
  const b = makeTeam(1, "BLUE", [
    { name: "B1", hp: 9000, atk: 1100, def: 350, spd: 110, skills: [{ name: "3技能", cost: 3, base: 1100, rate: 1.4, type: DamageType.NORMAL }] },
    { name: "B2", hp: 7000, atk: 800, def: 200, spd: 95, skills: [{ name: "普攻", cost: 0, base: 800, type: DamageType.NORMAL }] },
  ], RES, 100);
  const battle = new Battle([a.team, b.team], {
    seed, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 300 },
    policies: { resource: RES, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM", ...policies },
  });
  for (const e of [...a.entities, ...b.entities]) wireDummy(battle, e);
  return battle;
}

console.log("=== M0 Empty Battlefield 验收 ===");

// 1) 生命周期跑通
{
  const bt = build(12345);
  const r = await bt.run();
  ok("完整生命周期跑通", bt.turn > 0 && bt.phase === "END", `turns=${r.turns} winner=${r.winner} reason=${r.reason}`);
  ok("阶段日志含全部启动阶段", bt.phaseLog.filter(x => x.startsWith("STARTUP:")).length >= 9);
  ok("行动条已初始化", true);
  const s = bt.summary();
  ok("产物带 policySnapshot", !!s.policies && !!s.policies._warning);
}

// 2) Seed 可复现（同一 seed 完全一致）
{
  const runs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const bt = build(999); const r = await bt.run(); runs.push(JSON.stringify({ w: r.winner, t: r.turns, trace: bt.trace })); }
  ok("同 seed 20 次完全一致", new Set(runs).size === 1, `distinct=${new Set(runs).size}`);
}

// 3) 不同 seed 产生不同结果（说明随机真的参与了）
{
  const set = new Set<string>();
  for (let s = 1; s <= 30; s++) { const bt = build(s); await bt.run(); set.add(JSON.stringify(bt.trace.filter((x: any) => x.t === "DAMAGE").slice(0, 3))); continue; set.add(`${r.winner}:${r.turns}`); }
  ok("不同 seed 结果有差异", set.size > 1, `distinct=${set.size}/30`);
}

// 4) 鬼火：初始值 / 上限 / 溢出 / 回火曲线
{
  const bt = build(7);
  const pool = bt.teams[0].orbs;
  ok("初始鬼火来自 Policy", pool.orb === RES.initialOrb, `orb=${pool.orb}`);
  pool.gain(100); ok("上限封顶", pool.orb === RES.maxOrb, `orb=${pool.orb}`);
  const g = pool.gain(5); ok("溢出被记录", g.gained === 0 && g.overflow === 5, JSON.stringify(g));
  const p2 = bt.teams[0].orbs; p2.cycle = 0; ok("回火曲线 3/4/5", [1,2,3,4].map(n => { p2.cycle = n; return p2.rewardForCycle(); }).join(",") === "3,4,5,5");
}

// 5) 四种 HP 变更管线严格分离
{
  const bt = build(11);
  const t = bt.teams[1].members[0]; const s = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  const before = t.hp;
  bt.lose(t, 1000);
  ok("LOSS 不被护盾吸收", t.hp === before - 1000);
  t.shields.push({ id: "sh1", value: 5000, dispellable: true, sourceId: s.id, consumed: 0, broken: false });
  const b2 = t.hp;
  await bt.damage(s, t, 3000, DamageType.NORMAL);
  ok("DAMAGE 被护盾吸收", t.hp > b2 - 3000, `hp ${b2} -> ${t.hp}`);
  const b3 = t.hp;
  await bt.heal(s, t, 500, { recover: true });
  ok("RECOVER 生效", t.hp > b3);
}

// 6) 伤害类型行为矩阵（官方[5][12][18][28]）
{
  const bt = build(13);
  const s = bt.teams[0].members[0]; const t = bt.teams[1].members[0];
  const r1 = await bt.damage(s, t, 1000, DamageType.NORMAL);
  ok("NORMAL 触发御魂", r1.triggersSoul === true);
  const r2 = await bt.damage(s, t, 1000, DamageType.INDIRECT);
  ok("INDIRECT 不触发御魂/不可被分担", r2.triggersSoul === false && r2.canBeShared === false);
  const r3 = await bt.damage(s, t, 1000, DamageType.CONDUCTION);
  ok("CONDUCTION 不会暴击", r3.canCrit === false);
  const r4 = await bt.damage(s, t, 1000, DamageType.TRUE);
  ok("TRUE 无视防御不会暴击", r4.defenseMultiplier === 1 && r4.canCrit === false);
  const r5 = await bt.damage(s, t, 1000, DamageType.FIXED);
  ok("FIXED 无视防御且不受增减伤", r5.ignoresModifiers === true && r5.defenseMultiplier === 1);
}

// 7) 状态：官方[15] 按来源回合计时；官方[3] 不可驱散
{
  const bt = build(17);
  const t = bt.teams[1].members[0];
  const stunDef = (await import("../kernel/status.ts")).StatusBook.get("stun")!;
  t.addStatus(stunDef, bt.teams[0].members[0].id, 1, 2);
  ok("眩晕标记为不可驱散", stunDef.dispellable === false);
  ok("状态已附着", t.hasStatus("stun"));
  ok("眩晕：无法被驱散 dispel", t.dispel("stun") === false);
  ok("眩晕：可以被解除 remove（官方[3] 后九者不可驱散，仅霜冻不可解除）", t.remove("stun") === true);
  const frost = (await import("../kernel/status.ts")).StatusBook.get("frost")!;
  t.addStatus(frost, bt.teams[0].members[0].id, 1, 2);
  ok("霜冻：不可驱散且不可解除", t.dispel("frost") === false && t.remove("frost") === false);
  ok("强制移除可生效", t.remove("frost", true) === true);
}

// 8) 死亡状态机：HP<=0 != DEAD != KILLED 三者分开
{
  const bt = build(19, { death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION });
  const t = bt.teams[1].members[1];
  const s = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  await bt.damage(s, t, 999999, DamageType.TRUE);
  ok("致死目标 hpZero", t.hpZero === true);
  ok("致死目标 dead", t.dead === true);
  ok("致死目标 killed", t.killed === true);
  ok("trace 含 LETHAL 且含 DEATH", bt.trace.some(x => x.t === "LETHAL") && bt.trace.some(x => x.t === "DEATH"));
  ok("reviveBlocked 默认可复活", t.reviveBlocked === false);
  const rv = await bt.revive(t, 5000);
  ok("复活成功", rv === true && t.alive === true && t.hp === 5000);
}

// 9) 免死拦截（红区 C 的 DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION 分支）
{
  const bt = build(23);
  const t = bt.teams[1].members[1];
  t.reviveBlocked = true;
  const s = bt.teams[0].members[0];
  await bt.damage(s, t, 999999, DamageType.TRUE);
  ok("reviveBlocked 时复活失败", (await bt.revive(t, 5000)) === false);
}

// 10) 行动条：拉条 / 锁条（官方[117]）
{
  const bt = build(29);
  await bt.runStartup();
```

```ts
// tests/m1.ts — M1「第一只真实式神」验收

import { DeathPolicies, StartupPolicies } from "../kernel/policies.ts";
import { loadCharacter, selectSkillByAI } from "../compile/load.ts";

const R = ResourcePolicies.COMMUNITY_4_8_5_345;
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, x = "") => { if (c) { pass++; console.log("  PASS " + n + (x ? "  " + x : "")); } else { fail++; console.log("  FAIL " + n + "  " + x); } };

async function build(seed: number, idsA: number[], idsB: number[]) {
  const teams: any[] = [];
  let ent = 1;
  for (const [ti, ids] of [idsA, idsB].entries()) {
    const members: any[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) { const lc = await loadCharacter(id, ti, ent++); members.push(lc); }
    teams.push(members);
  }
  const { Team } = await import("../kernel/team.ts");
  const t0 = new Team(0, "RED", R, 1), t1 = new Team(1, "BLUE", R, 1);
  for (const m of teams[0]) t0.add(m.entity);
  for (const m of teams[1]) t1.add(m.entity);
  const bt = new Battle([t0, t1], {
    seed, rules: { ...DEFAULT_RULES, maxTurns: 500 },
    policies: { resource: R, startup: StartupPolicies.NAIVE_SOUL_THEN_PASSIVE_THEN_SENKI, death: DeathPolicies.DEATH_AFTER_PREVENTION, priority: "REGISTRATION_ORDER", tieBreak: "SPEED_THEN_RANDOM" },
  });
  bt.skillSelector = (b, actor, enemies) => selectSkillByAI(b, actor, enemies);
  return { bt, teams };
}

console.log("=== M1 First Real Shikigami 验收 ===");
```
